p-001.title: Ƙarfin dumama tulun zafi tun da farko
p-001.summary: Idan ka fara zuba ruwan zafi a cikin tulun zafi don dumama shi, abin sha zai daɗe yana da ɗumi sosai.
p-001.principle: Asarar zafi tana faruwa ta hanyar gudanarwa, juyawar iska da hasken zafi. Ɓangaren mara iska yana rage gudanarwa da juyawar iska, bangon da aka yi masa shafen azurfa kuma yana rage hasken zafi. Zafin da ya kai $Q = mc\Delta T$ yana farawa ne da dumama bangon kwantena.
p-001.example: Dumama bangon tulun zafi na ƙarfe maras tsatsa mai ƙarfin 500 mL (kusan 200 g, $c\approx0.5\ \mathrm{J/g\cdot K}$) daga 20°C zuwa 90°C yana buƙatar kusan 7 kJ. Idan ba a dumama shi ba, abin sha ne zai ba da wannan zafi, kuma zai yi sanyi da kusan 3~4°C nan take.
p-001.actionItem: Yau da safe, cika tulun zafi da ruwan da aka tafasa, bar shi na mintuna 3, sai ka zubar, sannan ka zuba abin sha.

p-002.title: Sanyaya abinci mai zafi kafin a saka shi a firiji
p-002.summary: Idan ka saka miya mai zafi kai tsaye a cikin firiji, zai dumama sauran abinci kuma wutar lantarki za ta ƙara yawa.
p-002.principle: Firiji dole ne ya fitar da zafin da ya shiga, $Q = mc\Delta T$, ta amfani da na'urar matsawa. Kwano mai faɗi da ƙasa yana da girman fuska mafi girma, don haka yana sanyi da sauri bisa $P = hA\Delta T$.
p-002.example: Sanyaya miya lita 3 (80°C) zuwa 5°C yana nufin firiji zai ɗauki kusan $3000\times4.18\times75\approx940\ \mathrm{kJ}$. Idan ka fara sanyaya ta a ɗaki zuwa 40°C, za ka rage kusan rabin wannan.
p-002.actionItem: Yau, raba abincin da aka dafa cikin kwanoni masu faɗi, ka bar su su yi sanyi zuwa 30~40°C, sannan ka saka su a firiji cikin awanni 2.

p-003.title: Rufe taga da filastik mai kumfa don hana asarar zafi
p-003.summary: Idan ka manna filastik mai kumfa (air cap) a taga, layin iska mara motsi yana rage asarar zafi sosai.
p-003.principle: Tsarin gudanar da zafi na iska mara motsi kusan $0.026\ \mathrm{W/m\cdot K}$ ne, kashi 1/40 na na gilashi ($1.0$). A cikin asarar zafi $Q = UA\Delta T$, $U$ yana raguwa.
p-003.example: Taga ɗaya na $2\ \mathrm{m^2}$ da bambancin zafi na 20°C tsakanin ciki da waje, idan $U\approx5.8$, asarar ita ce 232 W. Idan filastik mai kumfa ya rage $U$ zuwa $\approx3.5$, asarar ta zama 140 W, wato kana tanadin kusan 90 W.
p-003.actionItem: Yau, yayyafa ruwa a gilashin taga gwargwadon girmansa, sannan ka manna sashi mai santsi na filastik mai kumfa a gilashin.

p-004.title: Katifar lantarki da na'urar dumama gida
p-004.summary: Idan kana kai kaɗai, katifar lantarki da ke dumama jikinka kawai ta fi dumama daki gaba ɗaya inganci.
p-004.principle: Makamashin dumama yana bin $E = Pt$ kuma yana daidai da girman wurin da za a dumama. Idan ka dumama ƙaramin sarari tsakanin jikinka da bargo kaɗai, zafin da ake buƙata kaɗan ne.
p-004.example: Katifar lantarki ta 50 W idan aka yi amfani da ita awanni 8 tana cin 0.4 kWh. Dumama gaba ɗayan ɗaki mai ƙarfin dumama 4 kW na awanni 8 yana iya cin har 32 kWh, bambanci na ninkin dubbai da yawa.
p-004.actionItem: Yau da dare, rage saitin na'urar dumama gida da 1~2°C kuma kunna katifar lantarki a ƙaramin zafi.

p-005.title: Rike shinkafa a dumi a cikin tukunya da daskarewa a ƙananan sassa
p-005.summary: Raba shinkafa ƙananan sassa, daskare, sannan ka sake dumama ta yana rage wutar lantarki fiye da barin ta a dumi cikin tukunya fiye da awanni 12.
p-005.principle: Riƙe dumi yana buƙatar ci gaba da maye gurbin zafin da ke ɓacewa ta bango, $P = UA\Delta T$. Sake dumama a microwave yana amfani da $E = Pt$ ne kawai a lokacin da ake buƙata.
p-005.example: Riƙe dumi na kusan 60 W na awanni 24 yana cin 1.44 kWh. Sake dumama kwano ɗaya (200 g) a 700 W na mintuna 2 yana cin kusan 0.023 kWh.
p-005.actionItem: Yau, naɗe sauran shinkafa kwano-kwano cikin leda, ka daskare ta, sannan ka kashe maɓallin riƙe dumi.

p-006.title: Baturin wayar hannu a cikin sanyi
p-006.summary: Idan waya ta mutu kwatsam a yanayin ƙasa da sifili, saboda halayen sinadarai a cikin baturi suna raguwa.
p-006.principle: Gudun motsin ions yana bin ma'auni na Arrhenius $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$, yana raguwa sosai idan zafi ya ragu, juriyar cikin baturi tana ƙaruwa kuma ƙarfin lantarki yana faɗuwa.
p-006.example: Baturin lithium-ion yana da kusan 70~80% na ƙarfin da za a iya amfani da shi a 0°C, kuma yana iya raguwa sosai a -10°C. Wayar da ta nuna 100% na iya nuna 30% a waje sannan ta mutu.
p-006.actionItem: Idan za ka fita, saka waya a aljihun ciki, kuma idan ta mutu, ka dumama ta da jikinka sannan ka sake kunna ta.

p-007.title: Duba baturin mota kafin a yi mata tura a lokacin sanyi
p-007.summary: Dalilin da mota ba ta tashi a yanayin ƙasa da sifili shi ne ƙarfin baturi yana raguwa kuma man injin yana yin kauri.
p-007.principle: Ƙarfin baturi shi ne $P = V I$, kuma a ƙananan zafi, juriyar ciki $r$ tana ƙaruwa, wanda ke rage ƙarfin lantarki na tashar $V = \varepsilon - Ir$.
p-007.example: A wutar tashi ta 400 A, idan juriyar ciki ta ƙaru daga 0.01 Ω zuwa 0.02 Ω, faɗuwar ƙarfin lantarki tana ƙaruwa daga 4 V zuwa 8 V, wanda ke sa tashi da baturin 12 V ya yi wahala.
p-007.actionItem: Yau, kashe fitilar gaba da na'urar dumama kafin ka tada mota, kuma ka bincika baturi wanda ya fi shekaru 3.

p-008.title: Yadda ake tafiya a kan kankara
p-008.summary: A kan kankara, rage tsawon taku da sanya dukkan tafin ƙafa a kwance shi ne hanyar amfani da mafi yawan gogayya.
p-008.principle: Sharaɗin rashin zamewa shi ne ƙarfin kwance $F \le \mu N$. A kan kankara $\mu\approx0.05\text{-}0.1$, wato kusan 1/10 na kwalta busasshiya ($\approx0.7$).
p-008.example: Lokacin tafiya, idan rabon ɓangaren kwance na ƙafar gaba zuwa ƙarfin tsaye, $\tan\theta$, ya wuce $\mu$, mutum zai zame. Idan ka rage tsawon taku zuwa rabi, $\theta$ yana raguwa kuma yana shiga cikin kewayon aminci.
p-008.actionItem: Yau, idan dusar ƙanƙara na sauka, rage tsawon takunka zuwa rabin na yau da kullum kuma ka cire hannayenka daga aljihu.

p-009.title: Bar tsakiyar abinci a wofi a cikin microwave
p-009.summary: Idan ka shirya abinci a siffar donut a gefen faranti, microwave yana dumama shi daidai gwargwado.
p-009.principle: Microwave yana dumama ta amfani da raƙuman tsayawa na 2.45 GHz, kuma bisa tsawon rawa $\lambda = c/f \approx 12.2\ \mathrm{cm}$, ana samun wurare masu zafi da masu sanyi.
p-009.example: Tsakiyar faranti sau da yawa yana da sanyi saboda microwave yana da rauni a can. Idan ka shirya abinci a gefe sannan ka juya shi sau ɗaya a tsakiyar lokaci, bambancin zafi zai iya raguwa da fiye da 20°C.
p-009.actionItem: Yau, bar tsakiyar abincin da za ka dumama a wofi, ka sa shi a gefe, sannan ka juya shi sau ɗaya a rabin lokaci.

p-010.title: Tafasa da murfi a rufe
p-010.summary: Rufe tukunya da murfi kaɗai yana rage kuɗin gas sosai.
p-010.principle: Idan ruwa ya ƙafe, zafin ƙafewa $L \approx 2260\ \mathrm{J/g}$ yana tafiya. Murfi yana hana asarar tururi da juyawar iska, don haka ruwa yana tafasa da sauri da zafi iri ɗaya.
p-010.example: Dumama lita 1 na ruwa daga 20°C zuwa 100°C yana buƙatar $Q = 1000\times4.18\times80\approx334\ \mathrm{kJ}$. Idan aka rufe da murfi, lokaci da gas galibi suna raguwa da kusan 20~30%.
p-010.actionItem: Yau, lokacin da kake dafa taliya da miya, rufe tukunya da murfi tun daga farko.

p-011.title: Cika injin daskarewa kuma bar firiji a wofi
p-011.summary: Idan an cika injin daskarewa, zafi bai da yawan tashi koda an buɗe ƙofa, amma firiji yana buƙatar iska ta zagaya.
p-011.principle: Abinci da ƙanƙara masu ƙarfin zafi $C = mc$ mai girma suna adana sanyi kuma suna rage canjin zafi $\Delta T = Q/C$. Firiji yana buƙatar zagayawar sanyi.
p-011.example: Idan aka buɗe ƙofa na dakika 10, ana musanya kusan lita 100 na iska a injin daskarewa, kuma wuri mara abinci yana ɗaukar kusan 5°C, amma injin daskarewa da ya cika yana samun taimako daga abinci, don haka yana murmurewa da sauri.
p-011.actionItem: Yau, daskare wasu kwalaben ruwa don cika wuraren wofi na injin daskarewa.

p-012.title: Allon mai nuna haske a bayan radiator
p-012.summary: Idan ka manna foil na aluminium a bangon da ke bayan radiator, zafi yana dawowa cikin ɗakin.
p-012.principle: Zafin hasken yana bin $P = \varepsilon\sigma A T^4$, kuma aluminium mai sheƙi yana da ƙarancin fitar da haske da yawan komowar haske, don haka yana mayar da hasken infrared zuwa ɗakin.
p-012.example: Wani ɓangare na zafin radiator da ke fuskantar bangon waje yana shiga bangon. Idan allo mai komowa ya mayar da shi, a dumama iri ɗaya, asarar zafi zuwa bango tana raguwa kuma ɗakin yana ɗumi da sauri.
p-012.actionItem: Yau, manna kauri foil mai komowa a bayan radiator da ke manne da bangon waje.

p-013.title: Farautar wutar lantarki ta tsaye (standby)
p-013.summary: Kayan lantarki da suke kama da kashe amma har yanzu suna cikin soket suna ci gaba da cin wutar lantarki.
p-013.principle: Makamashi shi ne $E = Pt$. Ko da 5 W na jiran aiki kaɗan ne a gani, yana taruwa cikin awanni 24 a rana da awanni 8760 a shekara.
p-013.example: Idan jimillar wutar jiran aiki ta kai 20 W, $0.02\times8760 \approx 175\ \mathrm{kWh}$ ne, kuma a Won 200 a kowace kWh, wannan shi ne Won 35,000 a shekara.
p-013.actionItem: Yau, haɗa TV, akwatin saiti da caja a cikin soket mai maɓalli, kuma ka kashe su kafin barci.

p-014.title: Rage zafin dumama da 1°C
p-014.summary: Ko da rage zafin cikin gida da 1°C kaɗai yana rage makamashin dumama sosai.
p-014.principle: Asarar zafi ita ce $Q = UA\Delta T$, daidai da bambancin zafi $\Delta T$ tsakanin ciki da waje.
p-014.example: Idan zafin waje 0°C ne kuma ka rage zafin ciki daga 22°C zuwa 21°C, $\Delta T$ yana raguwa daga 22 zuwa 21, kusan 4.5%, kuma makamashin dumama yana raguwa da kusan haka.
p-014.actionItem: Yau, rage saitin dumama da 1°C kuma ka sa riga mai ɗumi (cardigan).

p-015.title: Tsawon labule da asarar zafi ta taga
p-015.summary: Labule mai kauri da ya kai ƙasa yana hana zagayawar sanyi kusa da taga.
p-015.principle: Iska kusa da gilashi mai sanyi tana da yawa kuma tana faɗuwa ƙasa, tana haifar da juyawar iska. A cikin asarar zafi $Q = hA\Delta T$, labule yana rage ma'aunin juyawar iska $h$.
p-015.example: Idan aka rufe labule mai kauri daga firam ɗin taga zuwa ƙasa, asarar zafi ta taga galibi tana raguwa da 10~25%. Idan akwai gibi a labulen, iska mai sanyi na gudana kamar a hayaƙin bututu.
p-015.actionItem: Yau da dare idan rana ta faɗi, rufe labule gaba ɗaya ka duba ko ƙasansa ya taɓa ƙasa.

p-016.title: Hana iska daga ramin ƙofa
p-016.summary: Rami na 1 mm a ƙofa yana cin kuɗin dumama a lokacin sanyi.
p-016.principle: Iskar da ke shiga ta ramin dole ne a dumama ta gwargwadon yawan kwararar girma $\dot V$, kuma $P = \rho c \dot V \Delta T$. Don iska $\rho c \approx 1.2\ \mathrm{kJ/m^3 K}$.
p-016.example: Idan iskar da ke shiga ta gibi $20\ \mathrm{m^3/h}$ ce kuma $\Delta T=20$°C, $P \approx 1.2\times20\times20/3.6\approx133\ \mathrm{W}$. Idan ka toshe rabin gibin da roba mai hana iska, kana tanadin kusan 66 W.
p-016.actionItem: Yau, manna roba mai hana iska a ƙasan ƙofa da gefen taga.

p-017.title: Matsin iskar tayoyi a lokacin sanyi
p-017.summary: Idan zafin yanayi ya faɗi, matsin iskar tayoyi ma yana faɗuwa.
p-017.principle: A iskar da ta dace da ma'aunin ɗabi'a a cikin girma kafaffe, $P/T = \text{const}$. Idan cikakken zafi $T$ ya ragu, matsi $P$ ma yana raguwa daidai gwargwado.
p-017.example: Taya da take da 35 psi a 20°C (293 K) tana zuwa $35\times263/293\approx31.4\ \mathrm{psi}$ a -10°C (263 K), faɗuwa ta kusan 3.6 psi.
p-017.actionItem: Yau da safe, auna matsin iskar tayoyi yayin da suke sanyi, sannan ka cika zuwa ƙimar da aka ba da shawara.

p-018.title: Dalilin da safar hannu ta babban yatsa ta fi ɗumi
p-018.summary: Safar hannu ta mitten, wadda yatsu ke haɗe a ciki, ta fi safar hannu ta yatsu ɗumi.
p-018.principle: Asarar zafi ita ce $Q = hA\Delta T$, daidai da faɗin fuskar da aka fallasa $A$. Haɗa yatsu yana rage faɗin fuska kuma yatsun suna raba zafi.
p-018.example: Idan aka kwatanta da safar hannu da ke rufe kowanne yatsu daban, mitten yana da kusan 20~30% ƙarancin faɗin fuska da aka fallasa, don haka asarar zafi ma tana raguwa da wannan ƙima a kan insulation iri ɗaya.
p-018.actionItem: Yau, a rana mai tsananin sanyi, sa mitten a saman safar hannu.

p-019.title: Layin iska a cikin sa tufafi da yawa
p-019.summary: Tufafi masu sirara da yawa na iya zama masu ɗumi fiye da tufa guda mai kauri.
p-019.principle: Iska mara motsi tsakanin tufafi tana hana zafi wucewa. Jimillar juriyar zafi $R = \sum d_i/k_i$ tana ƙaruwa yayin da yawan layuka ke ƙaruwa.
p-019.example: Layin iska mara motsi mai kauri 5 mm ɗaya yana ƙara $R = 0.005/0.026\approx0.19\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$. Idan kana jin zafi, cire layi ɗaya don hana sanyaya ta zufa.
p-019.actionItem: Yau, lokacin da za ka fita, sa layuka 3: rigar ciki mai ulu, riga, da jaket mai hana iska.

p-020.title: Busar da wanki a cikin gida da iska mai shiga
p-020.summary: Wanki a cikin gida yana bushewa da sauri sosai idan an bar tazara tsakanin su kuma ana amfani da cire danshi da iska.
p-020.principle: Saurin ƙafewa yana bin $\dot m \propto A(p_s - p_a)$, daidai da faɗin fuska da bambancin matsin tururin ruwa.
p-020.example: Idan kusan 500 g na ruwa daga wanki 1 kg ya ƙafe, yana ɗaukar kusan $500\times2.26\approx1130\ \mathrm{kJ}$. Idan ka bar tazara, bushewa na iya ragewa zuwa kusan rabin lokaci.
p-020.actionItem: Yau, shimfiɗa wanki da tazara tsakanin kowanne ka kunna fanka a ƙaramin ƙarfi.

p-021.title: Hana fashewar gilashin sha mai zafi
p-021.summary: Idan ka zuba ruwan zafi kwatsam a cikin gilashi, yana iya fashewa.
p-021.principle: Bambancin zafi yana sa faɗaɗawa ta bambanta, kuma yana haifar da damuwar zafi $\sigma = E\alpha\Delta T$. Gilashin soda-lime na yau da kullum bai jure wannan sosai ba.
p-021.example: Idan $E\approx70\ \mathrm{GPa}$, $\alpha\approx9\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{K^{-1}}$, kuma $\Delta T=70$°C, $\sigma\approx44\ \mathrm{MPa}$, wanda zai iya haifar da fashewar fuska.
p-021.actionItem: Yau, a gilashi mai sanyi, fara dumama shi da ruwa mai ɗumi kafin ka zuba abin sha mai zafi.

p-022.title: Daidaita ƙasan tukunya da injin dumama na induction
p-022.summary: Injin dumama na induction yana da inganci mafi girma idan ƙasan tukunya yana daidai kuma girmansa ya dace.
p-022.principle: Dumama ta induction yana samar da zafin $P = I^2R$ kai tsaye a ƙasan tukunya ta hanyar eddy currents. Dole ne kayan ya zama maganadisu, kuma ingancin yana ƙaruwa yayin da haɗuwa ke inganta.
p-022.example: Idan diamitar tukunya ta yi ƙanƙanta sosai fiye da coil, zafi yana raguwa kuma yana ɗaukar lokaci mai tsawo. Ingancin yana kusan 85~90%, wanda ya fi gas (kusan 40~50%).
p-022.actionItem: Yau, ka taɓa ƙasan tukunya da maganadisu don ganin ko yana manne.

p-023.title: Amfani da juyawar iskar air fryer
p-023.summary: A cikin air fryer, dole ne a bar sarari tsakanin abinci don ya yi kauri da gasasshe.
p-023.principle: A cikin jujjuyawar iska mai ƙarfi $Q = hA\Delta T$ ta saurin zagayawar iska mai zafi, $h$ yana ƙaruwa. Idan aka haɗa abinci, $A$ da iska ke taɓawa yana raguwa.
p-023.example: Juyawar iska a oven $h\approx10\ \mathrm{W/m^2K}$, a cikin fan $h\approx30\text{-}50$, wanda ya fi sau 3~5 sauri. Idan ka shimfiɗa a layi ɗaya, wani lokaci yana rage mintuna 10.
p-023.actionItem: Yau, shimfiɗa abinci a layi ɗaya a cikin kwandon air fryer, ba tare da haɗa su ba.

p-024.title: Tsabtace matatar na'urar busar da tufafi
p-024.summary: Idan ka zubar da matatar ƙura (lint) na na'urar busar da tufafi, lokacin bushewa yana raguwa.
p-024.principle: Idan matatar ta toshe, yawan kwararar iska $\dot V$ yana raguwa kuma ƙimar cire danshi $\dot m = \dot V\Delta\omega\rho$ tana faɗuwa.
p-024.example: Matattar da ta toshe na iya ƙara lokacin bushewa da 20~30%. Idan daga mintuna 80 ya zama 100, ana ƙara cin 0.4 kWh (a 2 kW).
p-024.actionItem: Yau, buɗe matatar lint na na'urar busar da tufafi ka cire ƙura.

p-025.title: Rage tartsatsin wutar lantarki a lokacin sanyi
p-025.summary: Cizon da kake ji a hannun ƙofa a lokacin sanyi yana faruwa ne saboda cajin ba zai iya tserewa a bushewar iska ba.
p-025.principle: Cajin $Q$ da aka tara ta gogayya yana ɗaga ƙarfin lantarki kamar a capacitor $V = Q/C$, kuma idan iska ta bushe, fitar da caji yana jinkiri, wanda ke kaiwa dubban V.
p-025.example: Idan jikin mutum $C\approx100\ \mathrm{pF}$ ne kuma $Q=0.3\ \mu\mathrm{C}$, $V = 3000\ \mathrm{V}$. Idan ka ɗaga danshi sama da 40%, cajin yana fita a hankali.
p-025.actionItem: Yau, kafin ka kama hannun ƙofa, fara taɓa maɓalli ko bango don fitar da cajin.

p-026.title: Hana yin lodi fiye da kima a soket mai tashoshi da yawa
p-026.summary: Idan ka haɗa manyan na'urorin dumama da yawa a soket mai tashoshi da yawa, akwai haɗarin zafi da gobara.
p-026.principle: Ƙarfi $P = VI$, don haka a 220 V, $I = P/V$, kuma zafin da ake samarwa $P_\text{heat} = I^2R$ yana daidai da murabba'in wutar.
p-026.example: Na'urar dumama 1500 W + kettle na lantarki 1000 W suna ɗaukar $2500/220\approx11.4\ \mathrm{A}$, wanda ya wuce soket na 10 A na yau da kullum. Ko da wutar ta ƙaru da 10% kawai, zafin da ake samarwa yana ƙaruwa da 21%.
p-026.actionItem: Yau, duba ƙimar soket mai tashoshi (misali 10 A) kuma ka haɗa na'urorin dumama kai tsaye a bangon soket.

p-027.title: Cajin baturi daga 20 zuwa 80%
p-027.summary: Idan ka yi amfani da wayar hannu tsakanin 20~80%, rayuwar baturi tana tsawaita.
p-027.principle: Babban ƙarfin cajin yana saurin lalata electrolyte. Saurin lalacewa yana da saukin kamuwa da zafi bisa $k\propto e^{-E_a/RT}$.
p-027.example: An san cewa guje wa cajin 100% da fallasa zafi na iya ƙara zagayen da baturi ke riƙe 80% na ƙarfinsa daga kusan 500 zuwa ƙarin ɗaruruwa.
p-027.actionItem: Yau, kunna 'Optimized Charging' ko iyakar 80% a wayarka.

p-028.title: Nawa za a tanada idan an canza zuwa LED
p-028.summary: Ko da kwan fitila yana ba da haske iri ɗaya, LED yana cin wutar lantarki ƙasa da yawa.
p-028.principle: Ana kwatanta ta hanyar ingancin haske $\eta = \Phi/P$ (lm/W). Fitila mai zafi kusan 13 lm/W ne, LED kuma kusan 100 lm/W ko fiye.
p-028.example: Kwan fitila na 800 lm shine 60 W a incandescent, 8 W a LED. A awanni 5 a rana, kana tanadin $0.052\times5\times365\approx95\ \mathrm{kWh}$ a shekara.
p-028.actionItem: Yau, canza kwan fitila ɗaya a ɗakin da ya fi daɗewa yana haske zuwa LED.

p-029.title: Dalilin da hannun ƙarfe ya fi sanyi
p-029.summary: Ko da suna da zafi iri ɗaya, ƙarfe yana jin sanyi sosai fiye da itace.
p-029.principle: Gudun zafi a taɓawa yana daidai da shigar zafi $e = \sqrt{k\rho c}$. Idan zafi yana fita da sauri, ana jin sanyi.
p-029.example: Ƙarfe $e\approx10{,}000\text{-}20{,}000$, itace $e\approx400$ (SI), bambanci na sau goma da yawa. Ko da duka a 0°C, ƙarfe yana jin sanyi sosai.
p-029.actionItem: Yau, a lokacin sanyi idan za ka fita, kama hannun ƙarfe da safar hannu ko ka naɗe shi da yadi.

p-030.title: Yadda ake hana bututun ruwa daskarewa
p-030.summary: Idan zafi ya faɗi ƙasa da sifili, ruwan da ke bututu yana daskarewa kuma yana faɗaɗawa, wanda ke iya fasa bututu.
p-030.principle: Idan ruwa ya daskare, girmansa yana ƙaruwa da kusan 9%. A cikin rufaffen bututu, matsi yana ƙaruwa sosai kuma bututun yana lalacewa bisa $\Delta P = K\Delta V/V$.
p-030.example: Idan an ƙididdige da ma'aunin matsawar girma $K\approx2\ \mathrm{GPa}$, a ka'ida yana kaiwa ɗaruruwan MPa kuma ya fashe. Idan ruwa yana ɗan gudana, ba ya daskarewa da sauƙi.
p-030.actionItem: Yau, idan an yi hasashen ƙasa da sifili, buɗe famfo kaɗan sosai, sannan ka naɗe mita da kayan insulation.

p-031.title: Kashe dumama ko ka bar shi a kunne lokacin fita
p-031.summary: Idan fitarka gajere ce, bar dumama a kunne; idan tsawon lokaci ne, ya fi dacewa a rage shi.
p-031.principle: Ƙimar asarar zafi ita ce $P = UA(T_\text{in}-T_\text{out})$, kuma ƙaramin zafi yana nufin ƙarancin asara. Makamashin sake dumama shi ne ƙarfin zafi $C\Delta T$.
p-031.example: Idan za ka fita na awanni 12, rage zafin ciki daga 22°C zuwa 17°C yana rage asara da kusan 25%, kuma zafin sake dumama ya fi ƙanƙanta, don haka akwai riba. Idan awanni 2~3 ne, ribar kaɗan ce.
p-031.actionItem: Yau, idan za ka fita fiye da awanni 6, rage zuwa yanayin fita, kuma ka bar shi yadda yake idan fitar gajere ce.

p-032.title: Tazarar tsayawa a kan dusar ƙanƙara
p-032.summary: A kan dusar ƙanƙara, tazarar tsayawa tana ƙaruwa sau da yawa fiye da busasshiyar hanya.
p-032.principle: Tazarar tsayawa ita ce $d = v^2/(2\mu g)$. Tana daidai da murabba'in gudu kuma akasin ma'aunin gogayya.
p-032.example: A 50 km/h (13.9 m/s), busasshiyar hanya $\mu=0.7$ tana da $d\approx14\ \mathrm{m}$, dusar ƙanƙara $\mu=0.2$ tana da $d\approx49\ \mathrm{m}$. Idan ka rage gudu zuwa 30 km/h, kusan 18 m ne.
p-032.actionItem: Yau, a kan dusar ƙanƙara, rage gudu zuwa rabin na yau da kullum kuma ka ƙara tazara tsakaninka da motar gaba.

p-033.title: Kare ƙugu lokacin share dusar ƙanƙara
p-033.summary: Lokacin ɗaukar dusar ƙanƙara, riƙe sandar shebur dogo kuma ka yi amfani da jiki don rage nauyi a ƙugu.
p-033.principle: Juzu'in tauri na lever shi ne $\tau = Fd$. Yayin da nauyi ya yi nisa daga ƙugu, lokacin ƙugu yana ƙaruwa.
p-033.example: Idan ka ɗauki dusar ƙanƙara 5 kg a hannu ka miƙe, 0.6 m daga ƙugu, $\tau\approx5\times9.8\times0.6\approx29\ \mathrm{N\cdot m}$; idan ka riƙe kusa da jiki a 0.2 m, kusan 10 N·m ne, wato 1/3.
p-033.actionItem: Yau, lokacin share dusar ƙanƙara, ɗauki ƙaramin nauyi sau da yawa, kusa da jiki, kuma ka yi amfani da ƙafafu maimakon ƙugu.

p-034.title: Buɗe murfin kwalba cikin sauƙi
p-034.summary: Murfin kwalba da aka matse sosai yana buɗewa idan ka ƙara radius na hannu don ƙara torque.
p-034.principle: Torque shi ne $\tau = Fr$. Ko da ƙarfi iri ɗaya, idan ka ƙara radius $r$, torque yana ƙaruwa daidai gwargwado.
p-034.example: A murfin diamita 3 cm ($r=1.5\ \mathrm{cm}$), idan ana buƙatar torque 3 N·m, $F=200\ \mathrm{N}$. Da buɗa-kwalba $r=6\ \mathrm{cm}$, $F=50\ \mathrm{N}$, wato 1/4.
p-034.actionItem: Yau, naɗe safar hannu ta roba ko tawul a murfin ka kama shi, ko ka yi amfani da na'urar buɗe kwalba.

p-035.title: Kafin ka hau kan kujera
p-035.summary: Idan za ka hau kan kujera, tsakiyar nauyi dole ya kasance sama da tushen goyon baya don kada ka faɗi.
p-035.principle: Abu yana da kwanciyar hankali idan layin tsaye na tsakiyar nauyi yana cikin tushen goyon baya. Iyakar karkata ita ce $\tan\theta = b/h$.
p-035.example: A tushe mai faɗi $b=20\ \mathrm{cm}$, idan tsakiyar nauyin mutum $h=100\ \mathrm{cm}$ ne, kwanciya da $\theta=\arctan0.2\approx11^\circ$ kawai yana jawo faɗuwa.
p-035.actionItem: Yau, a wuraren da suka yi tsayi, yi amfani da tsani mai kwanciyar hankali maimakon kujera.

p-036.title: Tsani a kusurwar digiri 75
p-036.summary: Idan kusurwar tsani ta tsaya sosai, yana faɗuwa baya; idan ya kwanta, yana zamewa.
p-036.principle: Sharaɗin da tsani ba zai zame ba shi ne $\tan\theta \ge 1/(2\mu)$ (ba tare da la'akari da gogayyar bango ba).
p-036.example: Idan ƙasa $\mu=0.4$, $\tan\theta \ge 1.25$, wato $\theta\ge51^\circ$. Ana ba da shawarar ma'aunin aminci na kusan 75° (a ɗaga ƙasan daga bango da 1/4 na tsawon tsani).
p-036.actionItem: Yau, tsayar da tsani tare da ƙasansa a nesa da bango daidai da 1/4 na tsawonsa.

p-037.title: Hazo a madubin ban ɗaki
p-037.summary: Madubi yana lulluɓewa bayan wanka saboda tururin ruwa yana taruwa a ƙasa da wurin raɓa.
p-037.principle: Idan zafin fuska ya kasance ƙasa da wurin raɓa $T_d$, ana samun taruwa. Kimantawa $T_d \approx T - (100-RH)/5$.
p-037.example: A ban ɗaki 30°C da danshi 90%, $T_d\approx28$°C. Idan madubi yana 25°C, taruwa yana faruwa. Idan ka rage danshi zuwa 60% da fanka mai fitar da iska, $T_d\approx14$°C.
p-037.actionItem: Yau, a lokacin wanka kunna fanka mai fitar da iska ka bar shi na mintuna 10 bayan ka gama.

p-038.title: Kada ka ja manyan kayan gida
p-038.summary: Maimakon turawa manyan kayan gida, ya fi sauƙi ka ɗaga gefe ɗaya, ka shimfiɗa yadi, ka motsa su.
p-038.principle: Gogayyar tsaye ita ce $f = \mu_s N$. Idan aka shimfiɗa yadi, $\mu$ yana raguwa kuma yana hana lalacewar ƙasa.
p-038.example: Ga akwatin tufafi na 50 kg, $\mu=0.5$, $f=0.5\times50\times9.8\approx245\ \mathrm{N}$. Idan an sa pad na kayan gida kuma $\mu=0.2$, yana zama 98 N, ragewar 60%.
p-038.actionItem: Yau, shimfiɗa pad na felt ko tawul a ƙarƙashin ƙafafun kayan gida ka tura su.

p-039.title: Daidaita yawan ruwan kettle na lantarki
p-039.summary: Idan ka tafasa abin da za ka sha kawai, wutar lantarki da lokaci suna raguwa daidai.
p-039.principle: Zafin tafasa $Q = mc\Delta T$ yana daidai da yawan ruwa $m$.
p-039.example: Tafasa lita 1 daga 20°C zuwa 100°C yana buƙatar 334 kJ ≈ 0.093 kWh. Kofi ɗaya (250 mL) yana cin 0.023 kWh, 1/4.
p-039.actionItem: Yau, duba alamar kofi ka zuba ruwan da ake buƙata kawai ka tafasa.

p-040.title: Bar tazara a bayan firiji
p-040.summary: Idan ka manna firiji da bango, ba zai watsa zafi ba kuma wutar lantarki za ta ƙaru.
p-040.principle: Zafin da na'urar matsawa ke fitarwa yana fita daga farantin zafi na baya ta hanyar juyawar iska ta halitta. A cikin $Q = hA\Delta T$, idan zagayawar iska ta toshe, $h$ yana raguwa.
p-040.example: Idan watsa zafi ta toshe kuma zafin condenser ya ƙaru da 10°C, inganci (COP) yana faɗuwa kuma wutar da ake ci na iya ƙaruwa da kusan 10~15%. A 400 kWh a shekara, wannan 40~60 kWh ne.
p-040.actionItem: Yau, bar tazara 5~10 cm tsakanin bayan da gefen firiji da bango, kuma ka goge ƙura.

p-041.title: Rage girgizar wankin inji lokacin matsewa
p-041.summary: Idan tufafi sun taru a gefe ɗaya, injin wanki yana girgiza sosai lokacin matsewa.
p-041.principle: Lokacin da talakar da ba ta daidaita $m$ ta juya a radius $r$, ƙarfin centrifugal $F = m\omega^2 r$ yana tasowa kuma yana daidai da murabba'in saurin kusurwa.
p-041.example: A 1000 rpm ($\omega\approx105\ \mathrm{rad/s}$), tare da rashin daidaituwa 1 kg da $r=0.2\ \mathrm{m}$, $F\approx2200\ \mathrm{N}$. Idan an daidaita, wannan ƙarfi kusan ya ɓace.
p-041.actionItem: Yau, lokacin saka babban wanki kamar bargo, sa ƙananan wanki tare kuma ka shimfiɗa su daidai.

p-042.title: Dawo da ƙarfin tsotsar na'urar ƙura
p-042.summary: Idan ka zubar da matatar na'urar ƙura da kwandon ƙura, ƙarfin tsotsa yana komawa kusan kamar da.
p-042.principle: Ƙarfin tsotsa ya kasance sakamakon bambancin matsi $\Delta P$ da yawan kwararar iska $Q$: $P = \Delta P\cdot Q$. Idan ya toshe, kwararar tana raguwa sosai.
p-042.example: Idan matatar ta toshe rabi, kwararar na iya raguwa da 30~50%. Ko da motar iri ɗaya, ƙarfin tsotsar ƙura yana raguwa daidai kuma lokacin tsaftacewa yana ƙaruwa.
p-042.actionItem: Yau, zubar da kwandon ƙurar na'urar ƙura, girgiza matatar ko wanke ta da ruwa ka busar da ita.

p-043.title: Zafin ɓoye na fakitin ƙanƙara
p-043.summary: Don adana abu a sanyi, amfani da zafin ɓoye na narkewar ƙanƙara shi ne mafi inganci.
p-043.principle: Lokacin da ƙanƙara ta narke, tana shan zafin $Q = mL$ tare da $L=334\ \mathrm{J/g}$, kuma zafi yana tsayawa a 0°C.
p-043.example: Fakitin ƙanƙara na 500 g yana shan $500\times334\approx167\ \mathrm{kJ}$ don narkewa. Wannan ya ninka sau 16 na zafin da ruwa na 0°C mai nauyi iri ɗaya zai sha don ɗagawa da 5°C (10 kJ).
p-043.actionItem: Yau, lokacin sayayya, saka fakitin ƙanƙara kuma ka ƙarasa da abincin daskararre a ƙarshe.

p-044.title: Nauyin dusar ƙanƙara a kan rufin gida
p-044.summary: Dusar ƙanƙara mai jike tana da nauyi sau da yawa fiye da busasshiya, kuma tana iya rushe rufi da gidan filastik na noma.
p-044.principle: Nauyi shi ne $P = \rho g h$. Dusar ƙanƙara busasshiya $\rho\approx100\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, mai jike $\rho\approx400\text{-}500$.
p-044.example: Dusar ƙanƙara mai jike mai kauri 30 cm ($\rho=400$) tana da $400\times9.8\times0.3\approx1180\ \mathrm{Pa}$, sau 4 na busasshiya (kusan 300 Pa).
p-044.actionItem: Yau, idan dusar ƙanƙara ta yi yawa, share dusar ƙanƙarar daga gidan filastik da rufi a wuri mai aminci.

p-045.title: Ingancin dumama na kwandishan heat pump
p-045.summary: Dumama da kwandishan yana ba da zafi fiye da na'urar dumama ta lantarki da wuta iri ɗaya.
p-045.principle: Heat pump yana motsa zafi, don haka $\mathrm{COP} = Q_h/W$ ya fi 1. Na'urar dumama ta lantarki tana da $\mathrm{COP}=1$.
p-045.example: Idan COP 3 ne, 1 kWh yana ba da zafin 3 kWh. Dumama 3 kW na awanni 5 yana cin 15 kWh da na'urar lantarki, 5 kWh da heat pump, tanadin 10 kWh.
p-045.actionItem: Yau, maimakon na'urar dumama ta lantarki, gwada yanayin dumama na kwandishan a 20°C.

p-046.title: Dalilin da safar hannu mai jike ta fi sa sanyi
p-046.summary: Safar hannu mai jike tana ɗaukar zafi da sauri fiye da busasshiya.
p-046.principle: Tsarin gudanar da zafi na ruwa kusan $0.6\ \mathrm{W/m\cdot K}$ ne, wanda ya ninka na iska ($0.026$) kusan sau 23, kuma zafin ƙafewa yana ƙarawa, don haka $Q = kA\Delta T/d$ yana girma.
p-046.example: Ko da kauri iri ɗaya, asarar zafi daga safar hannu mai ruwa tana ƙaruwa sau da yawa kuma hannu yana jin sanyi da sauri. Ga kowanne gram 1 na ƙafewa, ana rasa ƙarin 2.26 kJ.
p-046.actionItem: Yau, busar da safar hannun da ka taɓa dusar ƙanƙara da shi nan take kuma ka kawo ƙarin biyu.

p-047.title: Ƙanƙara mai rataye a gefen rufi alama ce ta zafi yana zubewa ta rufi
p-047.summary: Idan dusar ƙanƙara a kan rufi tana narkewa daga ƙasa kuma ta sake daskarewa a gefen rufi, hakan na iya zama shaida cewa zafin cikin gida yana zubewa ta rufi.
p-047.principle: Ƙimar asarar zafi ita ce $\dot Q=UA\,\Delta T$. Idan insulation ba ta da kyau, $U$ yana ƙaruwa kuma zafin saman rufi yana tashi sama da 0 °C, wanda ke narkar da dusar ƙanƙara.
p-047.example: A rufi mai faɗin 100 m², idan $U$ ya ragu daga 0.5 zuwa 0.25 $\mathrm{W/(m^2\,K)}$, a $\Delta T=20$ K asarar tana raguwa daga $0.5\times100\times20=1{,}000$ W zuwa 500 W, wato rabi.
p-047.actionItem: Yau, duba ko akwai ƙanƙara mai rataye a gefen rufi ko rufin baranda (kada ka tsaya a ƙarƙashinta), idan akwai da yawa, bincika insulation na rufi ko soro.

p-048.title: Murfin sabulu mai sirara don hana hazo a gilashin ido
p-048.summary: Hazo yana lulluɓe gilashin ido ko da ana sa abin rufe fuska saboda saman ruwan tabarau ya fi sanyi fiye da wurin raɓar numfashi. Idan ka shafa sirrin sabulu a tabarau, ruwa yana zama sirara mai haske maimakon digo, kuma gani yana ci gaba.
p-048.principle: Idan zafin fuska $T_s$ ya yi ƙasa da wurin raɓa $T_d$, tururin ruwa yana taruwa. Surfactant yana rage kusurwar taɓawa, ƙananan digo suna yaɗuwa su zama fim mai haske.
p-048.example: Wurin raɓar numfashi mai 34℃ da danshi 100% kusan 34℃ ne, yayin da saman tabarau kusan 20℃ ne, don haka taruwa yana faruwa nan take. Idan ka shafa digo ɗaya na sabulu mai tsaka-tsaki sirara a tabarau ka bar shi ya bushe, digon ruwa suna yaɗuwa a dukkan tabarau kuma hazo yana raguwa sosai.
p-048.actionItem: Yau, shafa digo ɗaya kacal na sabulu mai tsaka-tsaki a bangarorin biyu na tabarau, kada ka goge, ka bar shi ya bushe, ka matse gadar hancin abin rufe fuska don kada numfashi ya tashi sama.

p-049.title: Gane ainihin tabarau mai polarized
p-049.summary: Hasken da ke komowa daga ruwa da jike hanya galibi polarized ne a kwance, kuma tabarau polarized yana tace shi, yana rage haske da gajiyar ido. Na bogi na iya zama kawai tabarau mai duhu, don haka ka tabbatar da kanka.
p-049.principle: Ƙarfin hasken da ya wuce polarizer yana bin dokar Malus $I=I_0\cos^2\theta$, kuma komowar ruwa tana kusan cikakkiyar polarization kusa da kusurwar Brewster $\theta_B=\arctan(n)\approx 53^\circ$.
p-049.example: Idan alkiblar polarization da axis na tabarau suna $90^\circ$, $\cos^2 90^\circ=0$, don haka hasken da ke komowa kusan an toshe shi. Haka kuma, idan ka tara tabarau biyu a $90^\circ$ kuma suka yi duhu, kana tabbatar da ainihi. Ko da polarized ne, kariya daga UV (UV400) daban take, don haka duba alamar.
p-049.actionItem: Kalli allon wayar ta tabarau, ka juya tabarau $90^\circ$ ka ga ko allon yana yin duhu, kuma ka duba alamar UV400.

p-050.title: Dalilin da hanya a kan gada ta fara daskarewa
p-050.summary: Gada tana da sanyi daga sama da ƙasa, don haka tana daskarewa kafin hanyar ƙasa kuma baƙar kankara da ba a lura da ita yana da sauƙin samuwa.
p-050.principle: Hanya a ƙasa tana samun zafin ƙasa daga ƙasa, amma gada tana da iska a ƙasanta, don haka ba ta da samar da zafi. Tazarar tsayawa ita ce $d=\dfrac{v^2}{2\mu g}$.
p-050.example: A 50 km/h ($v\approx13.9$ m/s), a busasshiyar hanya $\mu\approx0.7$ kusan 14 m ne, a kankara $\mu\approx0.1$ kusan 99 m ne, wato kusan sau 7.
p-050.actionItem: Da asuba ko dare idan zafi ya kai 3 °C ko ƙasa, rage gudu tun kafin gada, bakin rami da sassan inuwa.

p-051.title: Dalilin da ninki 2~3 ya isa ga madubin kwalliya
p-051.summary: Madubin ƙara girma ba ya da kyau idan ninkinsa ya yi yawa. Idan tsawon mai da hankali gajere ne, dole ne a kawo fuska kusa sosai kuma fagen gani yana ƙanƙanta.
p-051.principle: Madubi mai zurfi $\dfrac1f=\dfrac1{d_o}+\dfrac1{d_i}$, ƙarawa $m=-\dfrac{d_i}{d_o}$. Idan abu yana cikin tsawon mai da hankali, ana samun hoto mai tsaye da girma.
p-051.example: Idan tsawon mai da hankali $f=20$cm kuma fuska tana $d_o=10$cm, $d_i=-20$cm, $m=2$ sau. Madubi mai ninki 10 mai tsawon mai da hankali 5cm yana buƙatar fuska cikin 5cm, don haka idan ɗaya ne kawai ake gani a lokaci ɗaya. Idan ka wuce tsawon mai da hankali, hoton yana juyewa.
p-051.actionItem: Lokacin sayen madubi, auna tazarar da fuskarka take da ita a kullum, ka zaɓi wanda tsawon mai da hankalinsa ya ninka wannan tazarar kusan sau 2 (ninki 2~3).

p-052.title: Rage lokacin dafa abinci da kuɗin gas ta tukunyar matsi
p-052.summary: Tukunyar matsi tana ɗaga matsi na ciki, tana ɗaga wurin tafasar ruwa zuwa kusan 120℃, kuma tana rage lokacin dafawa zuwa 1/3 ko ƙasa.
p-052.principle: Wurin tafasa yana ƙaruwa da matsi (Clausius-Clapeyron). Saurin amsawa yana ninkawa kusan sau 2 a kowane $10^\circ$C, don haka $2^{(120-100)/10}=4$ sau da sauri.
p-052.example: A matsi na ma'auni 1 atm (cikakken matsi kusan 2 atm), wurin tafasa kusan 120℃. Naman da ke ɗaukar mintuna 60 a tukunya ta yau da kullum yana ƙarewa cikin kusan mintuna 20, kuma a injin induction na 1.5kW ana tanadin kusan 1kWh. Kada ka buɗe murfi kafin matsin ya fita gaba ɗaya.
p-052.actionItem: Yau da yamma, dafa abincin da ke ɗaukar lokaci (nama, wake, tururi) da tukunyar matsi, kuma maimakon ƙarin dumama, kashe wuta ka bar matsin da ya rage ya kammala.

p-053.title: Gibin ƙofa 1% yana rage kariyar sauti daga 30dB zuwa 20dB
p-053.summary: Ko da ƙofa mai kauri tana rasa kariyar sauti sosai idan akwai gibi ɗaya a ƙasanta. Tef na hana iska na ƙofa na Won ƴan dubu yana rage hayaniya da iska tare.
p-053.principle: Haɗakar watsawa $\tau=\dfrac{\sum S_i\tau_i}{\sum S_i}$, asarar watsawa $TL=-10\log_{10}\tau$.
p-053.example: Idan ƙofa mai kariyar sauti 30dB (τ=0.001) tana da gibi na 1% na faɗin (τ≈1), $\tau=0.99\times0.001+0.01=0.011$, don haka TL kusan 19.6dB ne, wato 30→20dB. Idan ka rufe gibin da tef na hana iska (kusan Won 3,000), iskar hunturu ma tana raguwa kuma kuɗin dumama yana raguwa.
p-053.actionItem: Rufe ƙofa, ka duba ko haske yana zubewa ta gibin ƙasa da gefe, sannan ka manna roba mai hana iska ko door sweep.

p-054.title: Ko canza wurin router na WiFi kaɗai yana sauya gudu
p-054.summary: Duk lokacin da tazara ta ninka, sigina yana raguwa sau 4 (6dB), kuma kowane bango yana cire ƙarin 3~10dB. Idan ka sa router a buɗaɗɗen wuri a tsakiyar gida, gudun yana inganta.
p-054.principle: Asarar hanya a sararin samaniya $FSPL(\mathrm{dB})=20\log_{10}d+20\log_{10}f+32.44$ ($d$ km, $f$ MHz).
p-054.example: A 2.4GHz, 10m kusan 60.0dB ne, 20m kusan 66.0dB ne, wato +6dB idan tazara ta ninka. Idan bangon siminti ya shiga tsakani, ana rasa ƙarin 5~10dB, kuma gudu a ƙarshen ɗaki yana raguwa sosai.
p-054.actionItem: Fitar da router daga bayan TV ko tebur ko ƙasa, ka mayar da shi a buɗaɗɗen shiryayye mai tsawon 1~1.5m a tsakiyar gida, sannan ka kwatanta gudun a ɗaki na ƙarshe kafin da bayan.

p-055.title: Kowanne 3dB na ƙarar belun kunne yana rage lokacin aminci zuwa rabi
p-055.summary: Duk lokacin da ƙarfin sauti ya ƙaru da 3dB, makamashi yana ninkawa kuma lokacin da za a iya saurara lafiya yana raguwa zuwa rabi. Ko rage ƙarar kaɗan yana ƙara lokacin kare kunne sosai.
p-055.principle: Matakin matsin sauti $L=10\log_{10}\dfrac{I}{I_0}$ ($I_0=10^{-12}$W/m²). Shawarar fallasa: awanni 8 a 85dB, kuma lokaci yana raguwa zuwa rabi a kowane ƙarin 3dB.
p-055.example: 85dB awanni 8, 88dB awanni 4, 91dB awanni 2, 94dB awa 1, 100dB mintuna 15. Idan ka ƙara ƙara saboda hayaniyar jirgin ƙasa na ƙarƙashin ƙasa har ya kai 95dB ko fiye, ko mintuna 30 yana da nauyi.
p-055.actionItem: Yau, kunna saitin amincin belun kunne da iyakar ƙara a wayarka kuma ka iyakance matsakaicin ƙara zuwa kusan 60%.

p-056.title: Hydroplaning a ruwan sama na bazara: rage gudu da 20% kawai
p-056.summary: A kan hanya mai jike, idan gudu ya yi yawa, ruwan da ke gaban taya ba zai iya fita ba kuma yana zama ƙugiya wadda ke ɗaga taya. Idan hydroplaning ya faru, tuƙi da birki kusan ba za su yiwu ba.
p-056.principle: Idan matsin ruwa mai motsi $q=\tfrac12\rho v^2$ ya kusanci matsin taɓawa $p$, fim ɗin ruwa yana ɗaga taya. Gudun mai mahimmanci $v\approx\sqrt{2p/\rho}$ (kimantawa mai sauƙi).
p-056.example: Idan matsin taɓawa kusan 220kPa ne, $v\approx\sqrt{2\times220000/1000}\approx21$m/s, wato kusan 76km a awa. Idan ramukan taya sun ƙare, ruwa ba ya fita kuma yana faruwa a ƙaramin gudu har ma, don haka a yankin 100km a awa ya fi aminci ka rage zuwa 80km.
p-056.actionItem: Duba ko alamar iyakar sawa (TWI) tsakanin ramukan taya tana daidai da zurfin ramin, kuma a ranakun ruwan sama tuƙa a kashi 80% na gudun da ka saba.

p-057.title: Kada ka dogara da lambar NRR na kunnen kunne kawai
p-057.summary: NRR da aka rubuta a kan kunshin shi ne mafi girman ƙimar dakin gwaji, don haka ainihin kariyar ta fi ƙanƙanta sosai. Don kunnen kunne na wurin kide-kide ko gini, kwatanta da ƙimar da aka gyara.
p-057.principle: Kimantawar ainihin raguwa $\mathrm{NRR}_{\text{ainihi}}\approx\dfrac{\mathrm{NRR}-7}{2}$ dB (bayan gyaran A-weighting, ana amfani da 50%).
p-057.example: Ainihin kariyar kunnen kumfa mai NRR 33 shi ne $(33-7)/2=13$dB. A wurin kide-kide na 100dB, yana raguwa zuwa 87dB, wanda har yanzu ya fi ma'aunin 85dB kaɗan. Sanyawa daidai ya fi muhimmanci fiye da lamba.
p-057.actionItem: Mirgina kunnen kumfa sirara, ja kunne sama da baya, saka shi, sannan ka riƙe da yatsa na dakika 30 don ya faɗaɗa.

p-058.title: A cajin mara waya, wurin coil yana ƙayyade inganci
p-058.summary: Cajin mara waya yana da asara fiye da na waya, don haka idan wuri ya kauce, zafi yana fitowa kuma ana cin ƙarin wuta. Ko daidaita wuri kawai yana rage asara da lalacewar baturi.
p-058.principle: Ingancin haɗin induction ya dogara da ma'aunin haɗi $k$, $\eta=\dfrac{k^2Q_1Q_2}{\left(1+\sqrt{1+k^2Q_1Q_2}\right)^2}$. Idan ya kauce, $k$ yana faɗuwa sosai.
p-058.example: Lokacin cajin waya mai 5000mAh·3.85V (kusan 19.3Wh), a waya 90% yana cin 21.4Wh, mara waya 70% yana cin 27.5Wh, kuma idan ya kauce 50% yana cin 38.5Wh. Idan ana caji sau ɗaya a rana, a daidaitacce ana amfani da kusan 2kWh ƙari a shekara, a kauce kuma kusan 6kWh ƙari a shekara.
p-058.actionItem: Sa wayar daidai a tsakiyar alamar coil na pad ɗin caji, kuma ka cire kauri murfi, kati ko farantin ƙarfe kafin caji.

p-059.title: Cire ƙafa daga fedal a gaban sigina da wuri
p-059.summary: Idan ka ga sigina ja ka taka birki, makamashin motsin motar yana ɓata a matsayin zafi. Idan ka cire ƙafa daga fedal tun da wuri, motar tana birgima da yankewar mai kuma tana tanadin mai.
p-059.principle: Makamashin motsi $E_k=\tfrac12mv^2$. Makamashin da ke ɓacewa ta birki yana daidai da murabba'in gudu.
p-059.example: Idan mota mai nauyin 1,500kg tana gudun 60km a awa (16.7m/s), $E_k\approx208$kJ. Idan an ɗauki ingantaccen makamashin lita 1 na fetur kusan 8.5MJ, kowace tsayawa tana daidai da kusan 25mL. Idan ka amsa sigina 10 tun da wuri, kana tanadin dubun zuwa ɗaruruwan mL a rana.
p-059.actionItem: Yau, yayin tuƙi idan siginar gaba ja ce, cire ƙafa daga fedal kusan mita 150 kafin ta, bar motar ta birgima da kanta, sannan ka yi amfani da birki da sauƙi kawai idan ana buƙata.

p-060.title: Matsar da ruwa da siphon ba tare da famfo ba
p-060.summary: Don musanya ruwan akwatin kifi ko zubar da ganga ruwan sama, bututu da bambancin tsawo kawai ake buƙata. Da zarar ka cika bututu da ruwa, ruwa yana ci gaba da gudu zuwa ƙasa.
p-060.principle: Idan mashigar fita ta yi ƙasa da saman ruwa da $\Delta h$, bambancin matsi $\Delta P=\rho g\Delta h$ yana sa ruwa gudu, kuma ingantaccen gudu $v=\sqrt{2g\Delta h}$.
p-060.example: Idan bambancin tsawo 0.5m ne, ingantaccen gudu 3.1m/s, amma saboda gogayyar bututu ainihin gudu kusan 1m/s ne. A bututu mai diamita 10mm, $Q\approx0.08$L/s, don haka ana matsar da lita 20 a cikin kusan mintuna 4.
p-060.actionItem: Nutsar da bututu a ruwa ka cika shi, toshe ƙarshen ɗaya, sannan ka tura zuwa guga a ƙasa. Kada ka tsotsa ruwan sinadarai da baki ba.

p-061.title: A ranar da dusar ƙanƙara ta rufe, UV yana zuwa daga sama da ƙasa
p-061.summary: Sabuwar dusar ƙanƙara tana mayar da UV da yawa, don haka a filin dusar ƙanƙara na hunturu, idanu da fuska suna ƙonewa da sauƙi fiye da yadda ake tsammani.
p-061.principle: Ƙimar komowa (albedo) ita ce $\alpha=I_r/I_0$, kuma jimillar fallasa UV kusan $I_0(1+\alpha)$. Albedon UV na sabuwar dusar ƙanƙara kusan 0.8~0.9, na ciyawa kusan 0.03.
p-061.example: Idan UV kai tsaye 1 ne, a ciyawa kusan 1.03 ne, a kan sabuwar dusar ƙanƙara kusan 1.8~1.9, wato kusan ninki biyu.
p-061.actionItem: A ranar dusar ƙanƙara ko idan za ka je filin dusar ƙanƙara, ɗauki tabarau (goggles) masu kariyar UV da man kariya daga rana.

p-062.title: Dalilin da kunnuwa ke toshewa lokacin da jirgin sama ke sauka
p-062.summary: Matsin iska a cikin gidan jirgi yana daidai da tsayin mita 2,400 sama da matakin teku, don haka iskar da ke cikin kunne tana faɗaɗa bayan tashi, sannan ta matse lokacin saukowa. Idan ka buɗe kunnuwanka tun lokacin da saukowa ta fara, za ka guje wa zafi.
p-062.principle: Dokar Boyle $P_1V_1=P_2V_2$ (zafin jiki bai canza ba).
p-062.example: Idan matsin iska a ƙasa ya kai 101kPa, kuma a cikin gidan jirgi lokacin tafiya ya zama kusan 75kPa, ƙarar iskar da ke cikin kunne tana ƙaruwa zuwa $101/75\approx1.35$ sau, wato 35%. Lokacin saukowa kuma tana raguwa, sai a ja kunnen kunne zuwa ciki. Idan hanci ya toshe saboda mura, bututun kunne yana wahalar buɗewa.
p-062.actionItem: Idan an yi sanarwar saukowa, ka tauna cingam ko ka riƙa hamma da haɗiye miyau, kuma kada ka yi barci, ka kasance a farke.

p-063.title: Lambar na'urar hangen nesa 8x42, yadda ake karanta haske
p-063.summary: Lambar na'urar hangen nesa tana nufin ƙarfin faɗaɗawa×diamita na babban ruwan tabarau. Idan za ka yi amfani da shi da wayewar gari ko magariba, ɗalibin fita ya zama babba domin haske, amma idan don rana ne kawai, ƙarami mai sauƙi ya fi.
p-063.principle: Ɗalibin fita $d_{ep}=\dfrac{D}{M}$ (mm), haske na dangi $\propto d_{ep}^2$.
p-063.example: 8x42 yana da $42/8=5.25$mm kuma hasken dangi kusan 27.6, 10x25 yana da 2.5mm da kusan 6.3, don haka a wuri mai duhu ya fi haske sau 4 ko fiye. A duhu ɗalibin idon ɗan Adam yana 5~7mm, don haka don kallon tsuntsaye da wayewar gari, ɗalibin fita na 4mm ko fiye ya fi dacewa.
p-063.actionItem: Idan manufarka kallon tsuntsaye da wayewar gari ko maraice, zaɓi samfurin $D/M\ge4$mm, idan kuma yawon rana ne, zaɓi ƙarami mai nauyi kaɗan, kuma ka gwada da kanka kafin ka saya.

p-064.title: Idan ka lulluɓe bututun ruwan zafi, zafi ba zai riƙa zubewa ba
p-064.summary: Bututun ruwan zafi maras lulluɓi daga na'urar dumama zuwa famfo yana asarar zafi ba tare da hutawa ba. Idan ka sa masa abin rufewa, asarar tana raguwa sosai.
p-064.principle: Asarar zafi a bututu shi ne $\dot Q\propto \Delta T/R$, kuma abin rufewa yana ƙara juriyar zafi $R$. Idan $R$ ya ninka sau 2, asarar ta zama rabi a $\Delta T$ ɗaya.
p-064.example: Idan bututun ruwan zafi mai tsawon mita 10 maras lulluɓi yana da bambancin 25 K da zafin ɗaki, kuma aka ɗauka yana asarar kusan 25 W a kowane mita, jimilla 250 W ce. Bayan rufewa, idan ya zama kusan 60 W, za a adana kusan 1.9 kWh bisa awa 10 a rana.
p-064.actionItem: A ɗakin na'urar dumama ko ƙarƙashin kwatami, auna tsawon bututun ruwan zafi maras lulluɓi, ka sayi abin rufe na kumfa, ka shirya yadda za ka lulluɓe shi.

p-065.title: Akwatin rufin mota, ka sauke shi a bazara
p-065.summary: Idan ka bar akwatin rufin motar da kake ɗaukar kayan wasan kankara a lokacin hunturu, juriyar iska a tafiya mai sauri tana ƙaruwa kuma ana ɓata mai.
p-065.principle: Ƙarfin juriyar iska $P=\tfrac12\rho C_dAv^3$ (cubic na gudu).
p-065.example: Mota mai $C_dA=0.69\,\mathrm{m^2}$ da ke gudun kilomita 100 a awa (27.8m/s) tana bukatar kusan 8.9kW, amma idan $C_dA$ ya ƙaru 20% saboda akwatin rufin, ta zama kusan 10.7kW, wato 1.8kW ƙari. A tafiyar kilomita 100, wannan kusan lita 0.8 ne ƙari.
p-065.actionItem: Duba akwatin rufin da sandunan rufin mota, idan babu komai a ciki, ka cire su yau, ka ajiye a garejin.

p-066.title: Kada ka cire ƙugiyar manne ta sama, ka miƙa ta a hankali
p-066.summary: Ƙugiyar manne tana da ƙarfi kan ja zuwa ƙasa (shear), amma tana da rauni kan cirewa kai tsaye daga bango (peel).
p-066.principle: A shear dukan fuskar manne tana raba ƙarfin, amma a peel ƙarfin yana taruwa ne a gefen layi ɗaya, don haka $F_{\text{cirewa}}\ll F_{\text{shear}}$.
p-066.example: Misali, ƙugiya da ke ɗaukar 2 kgf a shear tana iya faɗuwa a 0.2~0.5 kgf a peel. Don haka nauyi da ke ƙasa ba matsala, amma idan ka ɗaga sama, tana faɗuwa da sauƙi.
p-066.actionItem: Lokacin manna ƙugiya, goge ƙura da ruwa daga saman, ka danna sama da minti 1. Lokacin cirewa, a hankali ka miƙa ta daidai da bango.

p-067.title: Rage ƙarar sauti da 6dB da noise cancelling
p-067.summary: Noise cancelling yana ƙirƙirar sauti mai kishiyar lokaci da hayaniya don ya soke ta. A jirgin ƙasa na ƙarƙashin ƙasa ba sai ka ƙara ƙarar ba, kuma kunnuwanka suna samun kariya.
p-067.principle: Soke juna: $A\sin\omega t+A\sin(\omega t+\pi)=0$. Yana da tasiri kan sautuka masu ƙarancin mita da ke ci gaba (ƙasa da kusan 1kHz).
p-067.example: Idan hayaniyar jirgin ƙasa ta kai 80dB, kuma noise cancelling ya rage hayaniyar ƙaramar mita da kusan 20dB, za ka iya sauraron waƙa ɗaya da ƙarar da ta yi ƙasa da 6dB (misali 91dB→85dB), kuma lokacin sauraro mai aminci yana ƙaruwa daga awa 2 zuwa awa 8, wato sau 4.
p-067.actionItem: A jirgin ƙasa ko bas, ka kunna noise cancelling kuma ka rage ƙarar da matakai 2~3.

p-068.title: Kwana a lokacin ruwan bazara, wannan shi ne iyakar gudu
p-068.summary: Iyakar gudun da za ka iya yin kwana lafiya ana tantance ta da jujjuyawar tituna da radius. Idan ya jiƙe, iyakar tana raguwa sosai.
p-068.principle: Iyakar gudu $v=\sqrt{\mu g r}$ (ƙarfin tsakiya = ƙarfin gogayya).
p-068.example: A kwana mai radius 50m, titi busasshe ($\mu=0.7$) kusan 67km/h, jikakke (0.4) kusan 50km/h, kan ƙanƙara (0.2) kusan 36km/h. Gudun da alamar hanya ta nuna na busasshen titi ne, don haka idan ana ruwa ka ƙara rage.
p-068.actionItem: Kafin shiga kwana, ka rage gudu tun a madaidaicin hanya, kuma a cikin kwanar ka guji birki da tuƙi kwatsam.

p-069.title: Girman TV, nisan kallo ya fi ƙudurin hoto
p-069.summary: Ƙudurin ido na ɗan Adam kusan minti 1 na kusurwa ne. Idan ka zauna nesa, ido ba zai bambanta 4K da cikakken HD ba, don haka ya fi a saka kuɗi a girman allo maimakon ƙuduri.
p-069.principle: Ƙudurin ido $\theta\approx1'\approx2.9\times10^{-4}$ rad, kuma idan tazarar pixel ita ce $p$, mafi nisan da za a iya bambancewa shi ne $d=\dfrac{p}{\theta}$.
p-069.example: Tazarar pixel na 4K na inci 55 kusan 0.32mm ne, don haka bambancin pixel yana ganuwa ne kawai a cikin $d\approx1.1$m. Idan kujera tana nesa mita 3, ko cikakken HD ba za a ga pixel ba har inci 75, don haka ka duba girma da inganci (bambancin haske, HDR) maimakon ƙarin kuɗi na 4K.
p-069.actionItem: Auna nisa daga wurin da za a girka TV zuwa kujera da ma'auni, kuma ka yanke shawarar girman allo bisa wannan nisa.

p-070.title: Dusar ƙanƙarar firiza idan ta yi kauri tana cinye wutar lantarki ƙari
p-070.summary: Dusar ƙanƙara tana da iska mai yawa tsakanin lu'ulu'un kankara, don haka tana zama kariyar zafi, tana hana isar da sanyi, kuma na'urar tana daɗe tana aiki.
p-070.principle: Juriyar zafi shi ne $R=d/k$ kuma yana daidai da kauri $d$. $k$ na dusar ƙanƙara kusan 0.2~0.5 $\mathrm{W/(m\,K)}$, ƙasa da na kankara tsantsa (kusan 2.2) sosai.
p-070.example: Idan $k=0.3$, $R=0.005/0.3\approx0.017\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$ ne ga dusar ƙanƙara mai kauri 5 mm, wato sau 5 na lokacin da kauri 1 mm. Haka kuma ingancin sanyaya yana raguwa.
p-070.actionItem: Idan dusar ƙanƙara ta wuce 3~5 mm, kashe wutar ka bar ta ta narke da kanta. Kada ka kankare ta da wuƙa ko wani abu mai kaifi.

p-071.title: Ruwan sama lita 200, ruwa kyauta ga lambun bazara
p-071.summary: Idan ka tara ruwan bazara da ke sauka a kan rufin, za ka iya ba lambu ruwa ba tare da ruwan famfo ba. Idan ka ɗaga tankin sama, matsin ruwa zai ba ka damar haɗa tiyo.
p-071.principle: Matsin ruwa $P=\rho g h$, yawan tarawa $V=A\times R$ (fuskar rufin×ruwan sama).
p-071.example: Idan an yi ruwan sama na 20mm a kan rufin mai 10m², lita $10\times20=200$ za a tara. Idan ka ɗaga tankin da mita 1, matsin ruwa 9.8kPa (kusan 0.1bar) yana samuwa, kuma ruwa yana zuwa ƙananan shuke-shuke ta tiyo da nauyi.
p-071.actionItem: Ɗaga tankin ruwan sama sama da 50cm a kan tushe, kuma ka rufe shi da murfi da raga don kada sauro ya yi ƙwai.

p-072.title: Kururuwar makirufo, idan ka rage 3dB za ta ɓace
p-072.summary: Idan makirufo ya sake ƙara sautin lasifika, kururuwar «bii» tana faruwa. Za ka iya hana ta cikin sauƙi kawai ta daidaita nisa da ƙara.
p-072.principle: Riba-zagaye $G=g_{amp}\cdot g_{path}\ge1$, kuma idan lokaci ya yi daidai, tana yin girgiza.
p-072.example: Idan ka ninka nisan da ke tsakanin makirufo da lasifika, asarar hanya tana ƙaruwa da 6dB, kuma za ka iya ƙara ƙarar sosai. A akasin haka, idan ka rage ƙarar da 3dB kaɗai, riba-zagaye ta zama rabi kuma kururuwar tana ɓacewa.
p-072.actionItem: Kada ka sa lasifika a hanyar da makirufo ke fuskanta, ka juya shi zuwa masu sauraro, kuma ka rage ƙarar shigar makirufo da 3dB (mataki ɗaya ko biyu).

p-073.title: A kimanta ƙarfin hasken ultraviolet da inuwa
p-073.summary: Idan inuwa ta fi tsayinka gajarta, tsayin rana ya fi digiri 45 kuma hasken ultraviolet yana da ƙarfi. A ƙarshen Maris inuwar tsakar rana ta riga ta fi tsayinka gajarta.
p-073.principle: Adadin ultraviolet yana daidai da $\sin\alpha$ na tsayin rana $\alpha$, kuma tsawon inuwa $L=\dfrac{h}{\tan\alpha}$.
p-073.example: A latitude digiri 37, tsayin rana a tsakar rana na equinox na bazara (kusan 20 ga Maris) shi ne $90^\circ-37^\circ=53^\circ$, kuma inuwa ita ce $1/\tan53^\circ=0.75$ sau na tsayin mutum. A farkon Fabrairu (tsayi kusan digiri 38) ta kasance sau 1.28.
p-073.actionItem: Yau a kusa da tsakar rana, ka duba inuwarka; idan ta gaza tsayinka, ka shafa man kariya na SPF30 ko fiye kuma ka saka hula.

p-074.title: Binciken sashe, ko da ka gudu da sauri za ka samu minti 2 kawai
p-074.summary: Binciken sashe yana duba matsakaicin gudu. Lokacin da kake samu daga gudun wucin gadi kaɗan ne, amma makamashi da haɗari suna ƙaruwa sosai.
p-074.principle: Matsakaicin gudu $\bar v=\dfrac{\Delta s}{\Delta t}$, ƙarfin juriyar iska $\propto v^3$.
p-074.example: Sashen kilomita 20 a gudun 100km/h yana ɗaukar minti 12, a 120km/h kuma minti 10, wato bambancin minti 2, amma ƙarfin juriyar iska yana zama $1.2^3=1.73$ sau (+73%) kuma kuzarin motsi yana ƙaruwa 44%. Gudun da aka yi a sashen farko dole a rama shi a baya, don haka babu riba.
p-074.actionItem: A sashen bincike, saita cruise control a iyakar gudu ka tuƙa da gudu ɗaya.

p-075.title: Ga lasifika, duba hankali (dB) ba watt ba
p-075.summary: Bambancin hankali na 3dB don samun ƙarar sauti ɗaya yana nufin bambancin ƙarfin amplifier sau 2. Ba wai lambar watt kawai ta fi girma ba ne yana nufin sauti ya fi ƙarfi.
p-075.example: Don samun 85dB a mita 3, ana buƙatar kusan 94.5dB a mita 1. Lasifika mai hankali 90dB tana buƙatar kusan 2.8W, ta 84dB kuma kusan 11.2W, wato bambancin sau 4.
p-075.actionItem: A takardar bayanin lasifika da kake son saya, duba hankali (dB/1W/1m) kuma ka zaɓi wanda ya fi hankali.

p-076.title: Ko da ka rage saurin fan da 20% kawai, wuta ta zama rabi
p-076.summary: Ƙarfin wutar fan yana daidai da cube na yawan juyawa. Idan ba damuwa iska ta yi rauni kaɗan, za ka iya adana wuta sosai.
p-076.principle: Dokokin kamanceceniyar fan: yawan iska $Q\propto N$, ƙarfin wuta $P\propto N^3$.
p-076.example: Idan ka rage yawan juyawa zuwa 80%, yawan iska ya zama 80% kuma wuta ta zama $0.8^3=0.51$, kusan rabi. Fan na 40W yana zama kusan 20W, kuma ana adana kusan 4.7kWh a wata idan ana amfani da shi awa 8 a rana.
p-076.actionItem: Yau ka saita fan ko na'urar iska zuwa 'matsakaici' maimakon 'mai ƙarfi' ka ga ko jin daɗin ya isa.

p-077.title: Bututun ruwan lambu, bututun fesa ɗaya yana adana ruwa 40%
p-077.summary: Idan ka matse ƙarshen tiyo, ruwa yana ƙara gudu a yawan kwarara ɗaya, ya yi nisa, kuma bututun yankewa yana kawar da ɓata lokacin tafiya.
p-077.example: Idan lita 10 a minti (0.167L/s) suna gudana a tiyon diamita 15mm, saurin ruwa kusan 0.94m/s ne, kuma idan ka saka bututun fesa na 5mm, ya zama kusan 8.5m/s, wato sau 9, kuma ana buƙatar matsin kusan 36kPa. Idan ka dakatar da ruwa yayin motsi da bututun yankewa, shayarwa ta lita 50 a minti 5 na iya zama kusan lita 30.
p-077.actionItem: Ka sa bututun yankewa mai hannu a ƙarshen tiyo kuma ka ba da ruwa ga tushen shuka kawai.

p-078.title: Sautin 'bam' lokacin rufe famfo, bugun ruwa
p-078.summary: Idan ka rufe da sauri, ruwan da ke gudana yana tsayawa kwatsam kuma ana samun raƙuman girgiza a bututu, ana jin sautin 'bam' kuma bututu na iya lalacewa.
p-078.principle: Dabarar Zhukovsky $\Delta p=\rho c\,\Delta v$ (c: saurin sauti a cikin bututu).
p-078.example: A bututun tagulla mai saurin ruwa 2m/s da $c\approx1200$m/s, idan aka rufe nan take, $\Delta p\approx2.4$MPa (24bar), wato sau 6 na matsin ruwa na yau da kullum na 3~4bar. Idan lokacin rufewa ya fi $2L/c$ (kusan 17ms ga bututun mita 10), girgizar tana raguwa sosai.
p-078.actionItem: Rufe famfon lever da bawul na injin wanki a hankali, kuma idan ya ci gaba, tambayi game da girka na'urar hana bugun ruwa.

p-079.title: Lokacin canza takalmin gudu, a duba shi da ƙarfin bugu
p-079.summary: Idan matashin ya ƙare, lokacin da ƙafa ke tsayawa yana gajarta, kuma ƙarfin da ke kan gwiwa da idon sawu yana ƙaruwa. Duba duk kusan kilomita 500~800.
p-079.principle: Ƙarfin bugun $F\,\Delta t=\Delta p$, don haka matsakaicin ƙarfin bugu $F=\dfrac{m\Delta v}{\Delta t}$.
p-079.example: Idan aka sauƙaƙa cewa mutum mai nauyin 70kg yana rage ƙarfin motsi na 70N·s lokacin sauka, idan ya tsaya a 0.035s, yana 2,000N, idan matashin ya ƙare ya tsaya a 0.02s, yana 3,500N (kusan sau 5 na nauyin jiki), wato ƙaruwa 75%.
p-079.actionItem: Yau ka duba ko tafin takalmin gudu ya matse ya yi ƙuƙƙulewa, kuma ka rubuta nisan da ka yi tun canjin ƙarshe.

p-080.title: Tuƙin dare, gudu fiye da kewayon hasken ƙasa haɗari ne
p-080.summary: Nisan da hasken ƙasa ke haskakawa kusan mita 40 ne, amma tazarar tsayawa a 80km/h ta fi haka. Kamar kana ruga zuwa inda ba ka gani ne.
p-080.example: A 80km/h (22.2m/s), jinkirin amsa na daƙiƙa 1 da $\mu=0.7$, $22.2+36=58$m ne, fiye da mita 40. A 60km/h, $16.7+20=37$m ne, lafiya. Hazo ko mai a cikin gilashin gaban motar suna watsa haske, su kuma rage hangen nesa ƙari.
p-080.actionItem: Kafin tashi, goge cikin gilashin gaba da fitilun gaba, kuma a duhun titunan gefe, kada ka wuce 60km/h.

p-081.title: Hular keken, kauri na shan bugu shi ne mabuɗi
p-081.summary: Hula tana ƙara tazarar da kai ke tsayawa don rage ƙarfin bugu. Takardar shaida da dacewa sun fi farashi ko ƙira muhimmanci.
p-081.example: Kai mai nauyin 5kg da ya buga da 6m/s yana da $E_k=90$J. Ba tare da hula ba, a tazarar tsayawa 2mm yana kusan 45kN, kuma da kumfar EPS mai kauri 20mm kusan 4.5kN, wato kashi ɗaya cikin goma. EPS idan ya matse da bugu ɗaya, tasirinsa yana ƙarewa.
p-081.actionItem: Duba alamar shaida ta KC·CPSC·EN1078, daidaita hular ta zauna tsayin yatsu biyu sama da girar ido kuma madaurin haɓa ya zama Y a ƙasan kunne.

p-082.title: Fitilar lambun rana, idan ka tsaya mata kudu digiri 35, 25% ƙari
p-082.summary: Allon hasken rana yana karɓar mafi yawa lokacin da ya fuskanci rana tsaye. Idan ka karkatar da fitilar lambu bisa latitude, cajin yana ƙaruwa.
p-082.principle: Hasken da aka karɓa $\propto\cos\theta$ ($\theta$: kusurwar shigowa). Mafi kyawun karkata $\approx$ latitude.
p-082.example: A latitude digiri 37, tsayin rana digiri 53 a tsakar rana na equinox, allon kwance yana samun $\sin53^\circ=0.80$, allon tsaye a bango $\cos53^\circ=0.60$, kuma allon da aka karkata digiri 37 yana samun 1.0. Yana samun kusan 25% ƙari fiye da kwance, kuma 67% ƙari fiye da tsaye.
p-082.actionItem: Karkatar da allon fitilar lambu zuwa kudu digiri 35~40 kuma ka cire inuwa da ƙura.

p-083.title: Fitilar tebur, idan ka kusanto da 30cm wuta ta zama kashi ɗaya cikin huɗu
p-083.summary: Hasken haske yana daidai da juzu'in murabba'in nisa. Idan ka sa fitilar kusa, kwan fitila mai rauni ma zai ba da haske ɗaya.
p-083.example: Idan ka matsar da fitilar daga 60cm zuwa 30cm, haske yana ninka sau 4. Don samun 500lux a 60cm ana buƙatar LED na 12W, amma a 30cm 3W ya isa, wato idan awa 4 a rana ne, ana adana kusan 13kWh a shekara.
p-083.actionItem: Sa fitilar tebur kusan 30cm daga littafi, a gefen da ba na hannun rubutu ba, kuma ka canza kwan fitila zuwa mai ƙaramin watt.

p-084.title: Dalilin da kiran waya ke yankewa a lif
p-084.summary: Akwatin ƙarfe akwatin Faraday ne da ke toshe igiyoyin lantarki, don haka sigina ba ta shiga. Idan ka yi shiri kafin siginar ta yanke, za ka kare muhimman kira.
p-084.principle: Zurfin fata $\delta=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{\pi f\mu\sigma}}$ (zurfin da igiyar rediyo ke raguwa a cikin mai gudanar da wuta).
p-084.example: A aluminium ($\sigma=3.8\times10^7$S/m), zurfin fata na igiyar 1.8GHz ɗan 1.9µm ne kawai, don haka ko siririn farantin ƙarfe yana toshe siginar. Kuna dogara ne da ɗan siginar da ke shiga ta tazarar ƙofa da iskar da ke fita.
p-084.actionItem: Kammala muhimman kira kafin shiga lif ko ka kunna kiran Wi-Fi, kuma ka sauke fayilolin da ake buƙata kafin shiga garejin ƙarƙashin ƙasa.

p-085.title: Babban tsabtace bazara, kada ka share ƙura, ka goge ta
p-085.summary: Ƙurar ƙanana tana daɗe a sama daban-daban gwargwadon girma. Idan ka share, ƙurar da ta ɗiga tana sake tashi ta shiga hanyar numfashi.
p-085.example: Ƙurar diamita 10µm tana faɗuwa mita 1 cikin kusan minti 3 a kusan 6mm/s, amma ta 2.5µm gudun yana $1/16$ wato 0.38mm/s, don haka tana ɗaukar kusan minti 44. Ƙananan ƙwayoyi suna daɗewa a iska ko bayan tsabtacewa.
p-085.actionItem: Yau a tsabtace da rigar goge ko danyen zane maimakon share, kuma bayan an gama ka buɗe tagogi ka bar iska ta shiga na awa 1.

p-086.title: Dokar daƙiƙa 2 na tazarar tsaro a babban titi
p-086.summary: Idan ana yin birki daidai da motar gaba, tazarar da ake buƙata ita ce tazarar amsawar direba. Idan ka bar daƙiƙa 2 kawai, a 100km/h za ka samu kusan mita 56.
p-086.example: A 100km/h (27.8m/s), idan amsawa ta ɗauki daƙiƙa 1.5, ana buƙatar $41.7$m, kuma dokar daƙiƙa 2 ta ba da mita 55.6, wato isasshen tazara. A ranakun ruwan sama, ƙara zuwa daƙiƙa 3~4.
p-086.actionItem: Lokacin da motar gaba ta wuce alamar hanya ko fitilar titi, ka ƙidaya 'ɗaya, biyu' ka ga ko ka gama kafin ka isa wurin.

p-087.title: Akwatin tafiya da keken jariri, mafi girman ƙafa, mafi sauƙin wuce shamaki
p-087.summary: Manyan ƙafafu suna hawa shamaki ɗaya da kusurwa mai sauƙi, kuma ana buƙatar ƙarancin ƙarfi.
p-087.principle: Lokacin da ƙafar radius $R$ ta wuce shamakin tsayi $h$, ƙarfin kwance da ke tura axle shi ne $F=mg\,\dfrac{\sqrt{2Rh-h^2}}{R-h}$.
p-087.example: Idan nauyin da ƙafa ke ɗauka $mg=100$ N, tsayin shamaki $h=1$ cm, ƙafa mai diamita 6 cm tana buƙatar kusan 112 N, ta 10 cm kusan 75 N, ta 16 cm kusan 55 N.
p-087.actionItem: Lokacin zaɓar akwatin tafiya ko keken jariri, duba diamita da kayan ƙafa (roba·urethane), kuma kafin shamaki, ka ɗaga ƙafar gaba kaɗan.

p-088.title: Caji mai sauri, dalilin da yawan ƙarfin lantarki ke rage asara
p-088.summary: Zafin da ke ɓacewa a juriyar kebul yana daidai da murabba'in wutar lantarki. Ko da wuta ɗaya, idan ka yi caji da ƙarfin lantarki mai yawa da ƙarancin wuta, asara tana raguwa.
p-088.example: Idan aka aika 18W da 5V, yana zama 3.6A, kuma a kebul mai juriya 0.2Ω 2.6W (14%) suna ɓacewa, amma idan da 9V, yana zama 2A kuma 0.8W (4.4%) kawai ke ɓacewa. Kebul sirara kuma doguwa tana da asara fiye.
p-088.actionItem: Yi amfani da kebul mai kauri da gajere da ke goyon bayan ƙa'ida ɗaya da caja (PD da sauransu) kuma ka maye gurbin tsofaffin kebul.

p-089.title: Busar da tufafi da hasken bazara da iska
p-089.summary: Ana buƙatar makamashi mai yawa don ƙafe ruwan da ke cikin rigar tufafi. Hasken rana da iska suna ba da wannan makamashi kyauta.
p-089.principle: Zafin ƙafewa $Q=mL$ ($L=2.26\times10^6$J/kg), yawan ƙafewa $E\propto(a+bu)(e_s-e_a)$ (yana ƙaruwa yayin da iska $u$ ke ƙaruwa).
p-089.example: Don ƙafe ruwan kilo 1 na tufafi ana buƙatar $2.26$MJ $\approx0.63$kWh. Idan ka matse da injin wanki sama da 1,000rpm kuma ka shanya a iska 2m/s, tana bushewa da sauri fiye da cikin gida, kuma ana adana kusan 2~3kWh na amfani ɗaya na na'urar busarwa. A ranakun da pollen ke da yawa, yi amfani da cikin gida.
p-089.actionItem: Bayan an gama matse tufafin, ka girgiza ka shimfiɗa su, ka bar tazara don iska ta shiga, ka shanya su a wurin da rana ke shiga.

p-090.title: Canza tayoyin bazara, ƙusar ƙafa da ba ta kwance
p-090.summary: Dalilin da ƙusoshi ba sa motsawa lokacin canza daga tayoyin hunturu zuwa na yau da kullum shi ne ƙarfin da ake buƙata yana da girma. Dogon maƙulli yana rage ƙarfin.
p-090.example: Idan aka kwance ƙusar ƙafa mai ƙayyadadden murɗawa kusan 110N·m da maƙulli mai tsawon 0.3m, ana buƙatar kusan 370N, da maƙulli na 0.6m kusan 183N, wato rabi. Amma lokacin ƙuntatawa, kada ka sa bututu don ƙuntatawa fiye da kima, ka bi ƙimar da aka ƙayyade da torque wrench.
p-090.actionItem: Kafin ka ɗaga mota da jack, ka kwance ƙusoshin rabin juyi tun suna ƙasa, kuma ka yi aikin a wuri mai lebur.

p-091.title: Jakar hawa dutse, kaya masu nauyi kusa da baya
p-091.summary: Idan jakar ta yi nesa da jiki, ƙarfin juyawa da ke kan kugu da kafaɗa yana ƙaruwa. Idan ka sa kaya masu nauyi kusa da baya kuma ka tura nauyin zuwa bel ɗin kugu, gajiya tana raguwa.
p-091.principle: Murɗawa $\tau=mgd$ ($d$: nisa daga axis na jiki zuwa tsakiyar nauyin kaya).
p-091.example: Idan kayan 6kg suna 25cm nesa da jiki, $\tau=6\times9.8\times0.25=14.7$N·m, kuma idan aka kawo su 10cm, 5.9N·m ne, kusan raguwa 60%. Bari bel ɗin kugu ya tura 70% na nauyi zuwa gindi.
p-091.actionItem: Sa kaya masu nauyi kamar kwalbar ruwa ko abinci a tsakiyar tsayin baya, ka ƙara matse bel ɗin kugu, sannan ka tashi.

p-092.title: Samun iskar ƙofa-biyu na minti 10
p-092.summary: Maimakon buɗe taga ɗaya kawai, idan ka buɗe wurare biyu masu fuskantar juna, iskar cikin gida tana canzawa da sauri sosai.
p-092.principle: Gudanar iska yana bin ma'aunin Bernoulli $p+\tfrac{1}{2}\rho v^2=\mathrm{const}$ da yawan kwarara $Q=Av$. Idan akwai mashiga da mafita, iska tana wucewa kuma yawan iskar da ake canzawa yana ƙaruwa.
p-092.example: A ɗaki mai 75 m³, idan iska ta shiga ta buɗewa ta 0.5 m² da 1 m/s, $Q=0.5\times1=0.5\ \mathrm{m^3/s}$ (1,800 m³/h). A gaskiya ana canza iska sau 5~10 a awa, don haka minti 10 sun isa, kuma idan taga ɗaya kawai aka buɗe, sau 1~2 ne kawai.
p-092.actionItem: Yau ka buɗe tagogi masu fuskantar juna (ko ƙofar shiga da taga) a lokaci ɗaya ka bar iska ta shiga na minti 10.

p-093.title: Matsin iskar tayar keke da juriyar mirgina
p-093.summary: Idan matsin iskar tayar ya yi ƙasa, ko da a gudu ɗaya yana wahala sosai.
p-093.principle: Juriyar mirgina $F_\mathrm{rr}=C_\mathrm{rr}\,mg$; idan iska ta fita, fuskar taɓa ƙasa tana faɗaɗa, asarar gurɓatar tana ƙaruwa, kuma $C_\mathrm{rr}$ yana ƙaruwa.
p-093.example: Idan jimillar nauyi 80 kg, kuma $C_\mathrm{rr}$ ya tashi daga 0.005 zuwa 0.010, $F_\mathrm{rr}$ yana ninkawa daga kusan 3.9 N zuwa 7.8 N, kuma a 20 km/h (5.6 m/s) yana ƙaruwa daga kusan 22 W zuwa 44 W.
p-093.actionItem: Kafin tashi, cika iska zuwa matsin da aka ba da shawara (psi/bar) da aka rubuta a gefen tayar.

p-094.title: Abin rufe fuska na ƙurar yashi yana tacewa da wutar lantarki ta tsaye
p-094.summary: Abin rufe fuska na KF yana kama ƙura ƙanana da wutar lantarki ta tsaye ba da ƙananan ramuka ba, don haka idan ruwa ko alkohol ya taɓa shi, aikinsa yana raguwa.
p-094.principle: Zaren tace suna da caji na dindindin, suna jan barbashi da ƙarfin Coulomb $F=k\dfrac{q_1q_2}{r^2}$. Idan ruwa, alkohol ko gumi ya taɓa, cajin yana ɓacewa.
p-094.example: KF94 yana tace sama da 94% na barbashi 0.4 μm, amma bayan fesa alkohol ingancin na iya raguwa zuwa ƙasa da 80%. Da zarar an yi amfani da shi, yawanci rana ɗaya (kusan awa 8 a mafi yawa) ta dace.
p-094.actionItem: Kada ka wanke abin rufe fuska ko ka fesa masa maganin kashe ƙwayoyin cuta, kuma idan ya jiƙe ko ya lalace, ka maye gurbinsa da sabo yau.

p-095.title: Kofi na digo da kwararar ruwa
p-095.summary: Idan ka zuba ruwa a siriri da jinkiri, hakar tana yin daidai kuma za ka sami ɗanɗano mai ƙarfi daga wake ɗaya.
p-095.principle: Bakin da ya yi ƙunci yana ƙara gudun ruwa $v=Q/A$ kuma yana haifar da hargitsi, yana haɗa gari daidai. Hakar tana dogara da lokacin taɓawa da zafin jiki.
p-095.example: Daidaitaccen abu shi ne zuba ruwa 250 mL a 92~96 °C a kan wake 15 g, a raba a mintuna 2 da rabi zuwa 3. Idan ka zuba ruwan gaba ɗaya a daƙiƙa 30, lokacin taɓawa yana raguwa zuwa 1/5, kofi ya yi laushi da tsami.
p-095.actionItem: Yau da safe ka zuba ruwan kofi a sau 3, da sirara kuma a hankali.

p-096.title: Idan ka rage haske na allo, wuta ma tana raguwa
p-096.summary: Ƙarfin hasken baya na na'urar LCD kusan yana daidai da haske, don haka idan ka rage haske, wuta da gajiyar ido suna raguwa tare.
p-096.principle: Ƙarfin hasken baya yana a siffar $P\approx kB$, daidai da haske $B$, kuma jimilla ita ce $P=P_0+kB$.
p-096.example: Idan daga cikin jimillar 40 W hasken baya yana 25 W a haske 100%, a 50% ana rage 12.5 W, kusan 31% ana adanawa. A awa 8 a rana, $0.0125\times8\times30\approx3$ kWh a wata.
p-096.actionItem: Yau ka rage haske na na'urar duba da TV zuwa kusan 50% daidai da hasken kewaye.

p-097.title: Tukunyar induction dole ne ƙasanta ya zama lebur
p-097.summary: Induction yana yin zafi ta hanyar ƙirƙirar wuta a ƙasan tukunya, don haka idan ƙasan ya karkace, ingancin zafi yana raguwa.
p-097.principle: Maganaɗisu mai canzawa yana haifar da eddy currents a ƙasan tukunya, yana zafi ta zafin Joule $P=I^2R$. Idan tazara tsakanin ƙasa da wurin dafa ta yi girma, haɗin yana yin rauni.
p-097.example: Ingancin induction kusan 85~90%, ya fi na murhun gas (kusan 40~50%). Idan ƙasan tukunya ya ɗaga sama da 2 mm, inganci yana raguwa a fili, kuma tafasa tana ɗaukar mintuna da yawa ƙari.
p-097.actionItem: Yau ka duba cewa ƙasan tukunya yana kan lebur, bai girgiza ko ya ɗaga ba.

p-098.title: Ka sa littattafai masu nauyi kusa da mai ɗaukar shiryayye
p-098.summary: Ko da nauyi ɗaya, idan ya yi nesa da mai ɗaukar, ƙarfin juyawa (moment) da shiryayye ke karɓa yana ƙaruwa, ya sunkuya ko ya faɗi.
p-098.principle: Moment da ke kan mai ɗaukar shi ne $M=Fd$ kuma yana daidai da nisa $d$.
p-098.example: Idan littafin 5 kg (kusan 49 N) yana 5 cm daga mai ɗaukar, $M\approx2.5\ \mathrm{N\,m}$, kuma idan yana 25 cm, $M\approx12\ \mathrm{N\,m}$, wato sau 5.
p-098.actionItem: Yau lokacin shirya shiryayye, ka sa kaya masu nauyi kusa da bango ko mai ɗaukar, masu sauƙi kuma a waje.

p-099.title: Kada ka buɗe ƙofar firiji na dogon lokaci
p-099.summary: Idan ka buɗe ƙofa, sanyi yana fita, iska mai ɗumi tana shiga, kuma compressor dole ya sake aiki.
p-099.principle: Iska tana gudana ta bambancin yawa, kuma zafi $Q=mc\Delta T$ yana shiga. Iskar da ke cikin firiji mai lita 300 kusan 0.36 kg ce.
p-099.example: Idan ka buɗe ƙofa na daƙiƙa 30, zafin ciki yana tashi daga 4 °C zuwa kusan 10 °C, kuma sake sanyaya yana buƙatar compressor ya yi aiki na minti 10~20. Idan ka buɗe ba dole ba sau 20 a rana, wutar wata na iya ƙaruwa kusan 2~4%.
p-099.actionItem: Yau kafin ka buɗe firiji, ka yanke shawarar abin da za ka ɗauka, kuma ka rufe cikin daƙiƙa 10.

p-100.title: Idan nisa ya ninka, hayaniya tana raguwa da 6 dB
p-100.summary: Kawai nesa daga tushen sauti yana rage hayaniya sosai, hanya mafi sauƙi ta kare ji.
p-100.principle: Ƙarfin tushen sauti mai ma'ana $I\propto1/r^2$ kuma matakin matsin sauti $L=10\log_{10}(I/I_0)$. Idan nisa ya ninka, $\Delta L=-20\log_{10}2\approx-6\ \mathrm{dB}$.
p-100.example: Lasifika da ke 90 dB a mita 1, a mita 2 tana 84 dB, a mita 4 78 dB. 85 dB awa 8 ne, 91 dB awa 2 ne iyakar shawarar bayyanuwa, don haka idan ka nisanta, lokacin aminci yana ƙaruwa.
p-100.actionItem: Yau a wurin kiɗa ko gini, ka tsaya sau biyu nesa da lasifika ko tushen hayaniya.

p-101.title: Idan gudu ya ninka, tazarar tsayawa ta ninka sau huɗu
p-101.summary: Kaɗan rage gudun tuƙi yana rage tazarar tsayawa sosai, yana rage haɗarin hatsari.
p-101.principle: Tazarar tsayawa daga kuzarin motsi $\tfrac{1}{2}mv^2=\mu mg\,d$ ita ce $d=\dfrac{v^2}{2\mu g}$. Tana daidai da murabba'in gudu.
p-101.example: A busasshen titi ($\mu\approx0.7$), 50 km/h (13.9 m/s) kusan mita 14, 100 km/h (27.8 m/s) kusan mita 56, wato sau 4. A jikakken titi ($\mu\approx0.4$), a 100 km/h ana buƙatar kusan mita 98.
p-101.actionItem: Yau idan ana ruwa, ka rage gudu da 20% a ƙasa da iyaka, ka ninka tazarar motar gaba.

p-102.title: Auna nauyi a kan ƙasa mai tauri kuma lebur
p-102.summary: A kan kafet mai laushi ko ƙasa mai karkata, ƙarfi ba ya rarrabuwa daidai a na'urorin auna, don haka sakamako yana canzawa.
p-102.principle: Ma'aunin nauyi yana auna da jimillar na'urori huɗu na kusurwoyi $W=\sum F_i$. Idan ƙasa ta karkata ko ta yi laushi, rabon nauyin kowace na'ura yana canzawa.
p-102.example: Idan nauyi 70 kg, $mg\approx686$ N yana rabuwa kusan 171 N a kowace na'ura huɗu, amma idan ƙafa ɗaya ta nutse a laushi, na'ura ɗaya tana karɓa fiye kuma kuskure yana faruwa.
p-102.actionItem: Sa ma'aunin nauyi a wuri mai tauri kuma lebur kamar tayal ɗin banɗaki, kuma ka auna a wuri ɗaya kowane lokaci.

p-103.title: Zoben tsotsa yana manne ne idan an fitar da iska
p-103.summary: Ƙarfin da ke manna zoben tsotsar banɗaki ba manne ba ne, matsin iska na waje ne ke danna shi.
p-103.principle: Ƙarfin tsotsa $F=\Delta P\cdot A$. Idan ka fitar da iskar ciki, bambancin da matsin iska na waje (kusan 101 kPa) yana danna farantin.
p-103.example: Yankin farantin diamita 5 cm ya kai $A=\pi(0.025)^2\approx1.96\times10^{-3}\ \mathrm{m^2}$, don haka matsakaicin ƙarfin a ka'ida shi ne $101{,}000\times1.96\times10^{-3}\approx198$ N. A gaskiya ya fi ƙanƙanta saboda iska tana zubowa.
p-103.actionItem: Kafin manne, goge ruwa da ƙura a tayal ko gilashi, danna da ƙarfi don fitar da iska, kuma ka ɗora nauyin da bai wuce iyakar da aka ƙayyade ba.

p-104.title: Da rana ka kashe fitila saboda hasken taga
p-104.summary: A ranar bazara mai haske, hasken yanayi a taga yana yawa sau da yawa fiye da hasken cikin gida, don haka da rana kashe fitila yakan isa.
p-104.principle: Haske shi ne $E=\Phi/A$ (naúrar lx). A rana mai haske taga yawanci 1,000 lx ko fiye, kuma hasken ɗaki da aka ba da shawara don aiki da karatu shi ne 300~500 lx.
p-104.example: Idan ka kashe kwan fitila LED guda 3 na 8 W (24 W) a falo na awa 6 da rana, ana adana $0.024\times6\times30\approx4.3$ kWh a wata.
p-104.actionItem: Yau da rana ka buɗe labule ka matsar da tebur ko wurin karatu zuwa wajen taga, ka kashe fitila.

p-105.title: Don fan, ka kwatanta yawan iska (CMM) tare da hayaniya
p-105.summary: Ko da diamita ɗaya, yawan iska ya bambanta. Yawan iska ana tantance shi ne ta ninka yankin ruwa da gudun iska.
p-105.principle: Yawan iska $Q=Av$ (naúrar $\mathrm{m^3/min}$). Yankin fan mai diamita $D$ shi ne $A=\pi D^2/4$.
p-105.example: Idan fan mai diamita 0.3 m ($A\approx0.071\ \mathrm{m^2}$) yana busawa da matsakaicin 3 m/s, $Q\approx0.21\ \mathrm{m^3/s}\approx12.8\ \mathrm{m^3/min}$, kuma yana haɗa iskar ɗaki mai 30 $\mathrm{m^3}$ sau ɗaya cikin kusan minti 2 da daƙiƙa 20.
p-105.actionItem: Lokacin siyan fan ko circulator, ka kwatanta yawan iska (CMM), hayaniya (dB) da amfani da wuta (W) a teburin samfurin tare.

p-106.title: Idan ragar sauro ta yi kauri, tana hana kwari amma kuma tana rage iska
p-106.summary: Idan yawan raga ya ƙaru, ramuka suna ƙanƙanta kuma suna hana ƙananan kwari, amma yankin da iska ke wucewa (buɗewa) shima yana raguwa.
p-106.principle: Girman rami kusan $25.4/N-d$ mm ($N$: adadin zare a inci, $d$: diamita na zare) kuma kashi na buɗewa $\varphi=\left(\dfrac{p-d}{p}\right)^2$ ($p=25.4/N$).
p-106.example: Idan diamita na zare 0.25 mm, raga 18 yana da rami kusan 1.16 mm da buɗewa kusan 68%, kuma raga 24 yana da rami kusan 0.81 mm da buɗewa kusan 58%.
p-106.actionItem: Kafin ka canza ragar sauro, ka yanke shawara kan girman kwarin da kake son hanawa da yawan iska da ake buƙata, sannan ka zaɓi yawan raga.

p-107.title: Ana buƙatar wuta ƙari daidai da ingancin caja
p-107.summary: Makamashin da ake ɗauka daga soket ya fi wanda ke shiga batirin waya. Bambancin yana ɓacewa a matsayin zafi a caja da batiri.
p-107.example: Batirin 5,000 mAh·3.85 V kusan 19.3 Wh ne. Idan ingancin caji 85%, ana amfani da $19.3/0.85\approx22.7$ Wh daga soket, kuma idan aka yi caji sau 300 a shekara, kusan 6.8 kWh ne.
p-107.actionItem: Yau lokacin caji, yi amfani da adaftar da aka tabbatar mai inganci kamar ta asali, kuma ka yi caji a wuri mai iska ba cikin bargo ba.

p-108.title: Idan ka ƙara sunkuyar da kai, nauyin da wuya ke ɗauka yana ƙaruwa
p-108.summary: Nauyin kai yayin da yake ƙara zuwa gaban ƙashin wuya, saboda tasirin lever, yana buƙatar ƙarfi mai girma daga tsokokin wuya.
p-108.principle: Idan nauyin kai $W$ ya yi nisa $d$ gaba daga wurin goyon bayan wuya, moment $M=Wd$ yana tasowa, kuma dole tsoka ta ɗauke shi.
p-108.example: Nauyin kai kusan 5 kgf ne, kuma samfurin bincike yana kimanta cewa idan ka sunkuyar da kai digiri 15, nauyin ƙashin wuya yana kusan 12 kgf, kuma a digiri 60 kusan 27 kgf.
p-108.actionItem: Yau ɗaga allon laptop ko waya zuwa tsayin ido, kuma kowane minti 30 ka ɗaga kai ka miƙe wuya.

p-109.title: Tebur mai ƙafa huɗu yana girgiza saboda maki uku ne kawai ke taɓawa
p-109.summary: Fuskar lebur ana tantance ta da maki uku, don haka idan ƙafa ta huɗu ba ta kan fuska ɗaya, ƙafa ɗaya za ta ɗaga kuma tebur zai girgiza.
p-109.principle: Yanayin daidaito shi ne $\sum F=W$ da $\sum M=0$. Goyon bayan maki uku koyaushe yana da tsayayye, amma maki huɗu suna taɓawa duka ne kawai idan suna kan fuska ɗaya.
p-109.example: Idan ƙafa ɗaya ta gajarta da 1 mm, wannan ƙafar tana ɗagawa, sauran uku suna raba nauyi. Takarda ɗaya da aka nada yawanci 0.1~0.2 mm ce, don haka ana buƙatar nada ƴan takardu a saka.
p-109.actionItem: Saka takarda da aka nada ko mai gyaran tsayi a ƙarƙashin ƙafar da ke girgiza, kuma idan ya daidaita, danna da hannu don ganin ko har yanzu yana girgiza.

p-110.title: Idan ruwan shawa ya yi rauni
p-110.summary: Idan lemun tsami (limescale) ya taru a ramukan shawa, ramuka suna ƙunci kuma kwararar ruwa tana raguwa sosai.
p-110.principle: Yawan kwarara a bututu mai ƙunci yana daidai da ikon radius na huɗu bisa dokar Poiseuille $Q=\dfrac{\pi r^4\Delta P}{8\eta L}$.
p-110.example: Idan radius na rami ya ragu 20%, yawan kwarara yana zama $0.8^4\approx0.41$, raguwa 59%. Idan ka tsoma kan shawa a ruwa da vinegar da aka dilute kusan 1:1 na minti 30, lemun tsami yana narkewa.
p-110.actionItem: Yau cire kan shawa, ka tsoma shi a maganin vinegar na minti 30, sannan ka wanke.

p-111.title: Matsin ruwan tanti a mm tsayin ginshiƙin ruwa ne
p-111.summary: Ma'aunin ruwa na tantin sansani a lokacin damina yana nufin tsayin ginshiƙin ruwa (mm) da zane ke jurewa.
p-111.principle: Matsin ruwa tsayayye shi ne $P=\rho g h$. Ginshiƙin ruwa 1,000 mm kusan 9.8 kPa ne.
p-111.example: Ma'aunin ruwa 1,500 mm yana nufin zane da ke jure $1000\times9.8\times1.5=14.7$ kPa. Don ruwan sama mai ƙarfi da ƙasa da nauyin mutum ke danna, ƙima mafi girma tana da amfani.
p-111.actionItem: Kafin sansani a lokacin damina, ka duba alamar matsin ruwa ta tanti (ana ba da shawarar fly 1,500 mm ko fiye) da yanayin hatimin ɗinki.

p-112.title: Ka duba hatimin ƙofar firiji da takarda ɗaya
p-112.summary: Idan hatimin roba na ƙofa ya sako, iska mai ɗumi tana shiga kuma compressor yana aiki na tsawon lokaci.
p-112.principle: Zafin da ke shiga ta tazara shi ne $\dot Q=\dot m c_p\Delta T$. Yayin da yankin tazara ke ƙaruwa, kwararar iska da shigar zafi suna ƙaruwa.
p-112.example: Idan matsakaicin tazara 1 mm ce kuma kewayen ƙofa mita 3, yankin tazara shi ne $0.001\times3=3\times10^{-3}\ \mathrm{m^2}$, wato 30 cm², kamar rami irin faɗin tafin hannu a buɗe.
p-112.actionItem: Saka takarda ɗaya a tazarar ƙofa, ka rufe, sannan ka ja. Idan akwai wurin da take fita da sauƙi, goge hatimin ko ka maye gurbinsa.

p-113.title: Wutar da kayan lantarki ke amfani da ita a ƙarshe zafi ne a cikin ɗaki
p-113.summary: Yawancin makamashin lantarki a ƙarshe yana zama zafi kuma yana ɗaga zafin cikin gida. Nauyin na'urar sanyaya shima yana ƙaruwa.
p-113.principle: Bisa kiyaye makamashi, $Q=Pt$. Ƙarfin wutar $P$ da kayan lantarki ke amfani da shi kusan duka tana zama zafi a ɗaki.
p-113.example: Idan ka yi amfani da kwamfuta ta 100 W na awa 4, $0.1\times4=0.4$ kWh, wato kusan 1.44 MJ yana zama zafi a ɗaki, daidai da ƙaramin hita na 100 W.
p-113.actionItem: Yau ka kashe kwamfutoci, fitilu da caja da ba ka amfani da su don rage tushen zafi a ɗaki.

p-114.title: Alamar ingancin amfani da makamashi, ka kwatanta da kWh na shekara
p-114.summary: Kada ka duba matsayi kawai; idan ka kwatanta kWh na amfani da wuta a shekara (ko wata) da ke alamar, za ka san ainihin amfani da wuta.
p-114.principle: Makamashin wuta shi ne $E=Pt$ (kWh). Idan aka ninka bambancin amfani na shekara da tsawon lokacin amfani, ya zama bambancin jimillar wutar da aka yi amfani da ita.
p-114.example: Firiji na 300 kWh a shekara da na 450 kWh a shekara suna da bambancin 150 kWh a shekara, kuma a shekara 10 bambancin 1,500 kWh.
p-114.actionItem: Lokacin siyan kayan lantarki, kwatanta matsayin ingancin makamashi da kWh na shekara da ke kan alamar tare.

p-115.title: Zaɓi na'urar tsarkake iska da CADR da girman ɗaki
p-115.summary: A lokacin ƙurar yashi, aikin na'urar tsarkakewa dole ne ya dace da girman ɗaki. Mabuɗi shi ne sau nawa a awa take tace iska.
p-115.principle: Yawan canjin iska a awa shi ne $\mathrm{ACH}=\mathrm{CADR}/V$. CADR shi ne yawan iskar da aka tsarkake ($\mathrm{m^3/h}$).
p-115.example: Idan ka yi amfani da na'urar CADR 300 $\mathrm{m^3/h}$ a ɗaki mai 25 $\mathrm{m^2}$ × 2.4 m = 60 $\mathrm{m^3}$, $300/60=5$ sau a awa.
p-115.actionItem: Yau ka ninka yankin ɗaki da tsayin rufi don samun girma, ka duba ko CADR na na'urar tsarkakewa ya kai kusan sau 5 na girman ko fiye.

p-116.title: Hazon gilashin mota saboda wurin raɓa ne
p-116.summary: Idan zafin gilashi ya yi ƙasa da wurin raɓa na iskar ciki, tururin ruwa yana taruwa kuma hazo yana bayyana.
p-116.principle: Wurin raɓa $T_d$ ana ƙayyade shi daga ɗanɗanon dangi $\mathrm{RH}$ da zafin iska ta dabarar Magnus $T_d\approx\dfrac{243.12\,\gamma}{17.62-\gamma}$, $\gamma=\ln\mathrm{RH}+\dfrac{17.62\,T}{243.12+T}$.
p-116.example: A ciki 22 °C da ɗanɗanon dangi 70%, wurin raɓa kusan 16.3 °C ne. Idan zafin gilashi 10 °C ne, hazo yana bayyana, kuma idan ka kunna AC (busar da ɗanɗano) da iska mai zafi tare, ɗanɗanon fuskar gilashi yana raguwa.
p-116.actionItem: Idan hazo ya bayyana a gilashin gaba, yau ka danna maɓallin AC ka canza zuwa shigar iska ta waje don busar da shi.

p-117.title: Don abu mai kauri, yanka shi a cikin gefen almakashi
p-117.summary: Almakashi lever ne, don haka a cikin ruwan da ke kusa da axis, da ƙarfin hannu ɗaya, ƙarfin yanke yana ƙaruwa.
p-117.principle: Daidaiton lever shi ne $F_{\text{yankewa}}\,d_c=F_{\text{hannu}}\,d_h$. Yayin da wurin yankewa ke kusa da axis, $d_c$ yana raguwa kuma $F_{\text{yankewa}}$ yana ƙaruwa.
