p-117.example: Idan daga hannu zuwa axis $d_h=10$ cm, idan wurin yanke yana 3 cm daga axis, ƙarfin hannu 50 N yana zama $50\times10/3\approx167$ N. A ƙarshe (10 cm) 50 N ne kamar yadda yake.
p-117.actionItem: Yau lokacin yanke kayan marufi ko kwali mai kauri, sa shi zurfi a cikin ruwan almakashi ka yanke.

p-118.title: Hawa matakala motsa jiki ne mai kyau ko da an auna da ƙarfin lokaci
p-118.summary: Idan ka hau bene ɗaya da ƙafa, kana yin aikin ɗaga jiki, kuma a ɗan gajeren lokaci kana samun ƙarfi mai girma.
p-118.principle: Ƙarfin hawa $P=\dfrac{mgh}{t}$. Ƙaruwar kuzarin matsayi $mgh$ ne aka raba da lokacin da aka ɗauka.
p-118.example: Mutum mai nauyi 70 kg da ya hau bene ɗaya (3 m) cikin daƙiƙa 15, $P=70\times9.8\times3/15\approx137$ W. A wannan lokacin kuzarin matsayi na bene ɗaya kusan 2.1 kJ ne, kuma idan an ɗauka ingancin tsoka 25%, kuzarin metabolism kusan 2 kcal ne.
p-118.actionItem: Yau a maimakon lif, hau bene biyu da matakala kuma ka riƙe hannun matakala don tafiya lafiya.

p-119.title: Adaftar tafiya, duba ƙarfin lantarki da wuta ba siffar toshe kawai ba
p-119.summary: Ba kowace na'ura za a iya amfani da ita saboda toshe kawai ya yi daidai ba. Idan ƙarfin lantarki ya bambanta daga ƙasa zuwa ƙasa, wutar da amincin na'ura suna canzawa.
p-119.principle: Ƙarfi $P=VI$, don haka a ƙarfi ɗaya, idan ƙarfin lantarki ya yi ƙasa, wuta $I=P/V$ tana ƙaruwa.
p-119.example: Na'urar 1,500 W a 220 V tana da $I\approx6.8$ A, amma idan aka yi amfani da transformer a ƙasar 110 V, $I\approx13.6$ A, wanda ke da sauƙin wuce ƙimar adaftar.
p-119.actionItem: Kafin tafiya, ka duba ƙarfin lantarki na wurin da za ka je da na shigarwa a alamar na'urarka (misali 100-240 V), kuma ka duba wutar da adaftar ta yarda.

p-120.title: A bas da ke tsayawa kwatsam, ka lankwasa gwiwa ka buɗe ƙafa
p-120.summary: Idan bas ya yi birki kwatsam, jiki yana ruga gaba saboda inertia. Matsayi da gogayyar ƙafa suna hana faɗuwa.
p-120.principle: Ƙarfin inertia $F=ma$, kuma don kada ƙafa ta zamo, gogayya dole ta zama $\mu\ge a/g$.
p-120.example: Idan raguwar gudu $a=3\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$ (kusan 0.3 g), mutum mai nauyi 60 kg yana fuskantar kusan 180 N gaba, kuma gogayyar takalmi da ƙasa dole ta zama $\mu\ge0.31$ don kada ya zamo.
p-120.actionItem: Yau idan kana tsaye a bas ko jirgin ƙasa, ka buɗe ƙafafunka a hanyar tafiya kuma ka riƙe hannun riƙo.

p-121.title: Wuƙa mai kaifi tana buƙatar ƙarancin ƙarfi
p-121.summary: Idan gefen wuƙa yana da kaifi, yankin taɓawa ƙarami ne, don haka da ƙarfi ɗaya matsin yana ƙaruwa sosai kuma abu yana tsagewa da sauƙi.
p-121.principle: Matsin $P=\dfrac{F}{A}$. Yayin da yankin gefe $A$ ke ƙanƙanta, a $F$ ɗaya $P$ yana ƙaruwa.
p-121.example: Idan faɗin gefen wuƙa mai tsawon 1 cm ya kai 0.02 mm, $A=2\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{m^2}$, kuma a 20 N, $P=10\ \mathrm{MPa}$. Idan ya yi dushe zuwa 0.2 mm, ya zama 1 MPa, kashi ɗaya cikin goma, don haka dole a danna da ƙarfi, kuma haɗarin zamewa da jikkata yana ƙaruwa.
p-121.actionItem: Yau ka gwada wuƙar da kake amfani da ita ko tana yanke takarda ɗaya da sauƙi, kuma idan ta yi dushe, ka kaifafa gefenta da dutsen kaifi ko na'urar kaifafawa.

p-122.title: Kada ka riƙa kashewa da kunna AC mai inverter
p-122.summary: AC mai inverter yana daidaita saurin compressor don riƙe zafin da aka saita, don haka barin shi a kunne ya fi inganci.
p-122.principle: Ma'aunin aikin sanyaya $\mathrm{COP}=\dfrac{Q_c}{W}$ yana ƙaruwa a ƙaramin nauyi saboda mai musayar zafi ya yi dangi girma kuma bambancin zafi yana raguwa.
p-122.example: Idan na'ura mai gudu ɗaya tana amfani da matsakaicin 480 W (0.8 kW×kashi 60% na aiki) kuma inverter kusan 300 W, a awa 6 a rana yana 2.88 da 1.8 kWh, kuma a kwana 30 ana adana kusan 32 kWh.
p-122.actionItem: Yau ka saita AC zuwa 26~28 °C ka bar shi a kunne.

p-123.title: Yi wa na'urar waje ta na'urar sanyaya iska inuwa
p-123.summary: Idan iskar da ke kewaye da na'urar waje ta fi sanyi, kwampreso ba ya aiki sosai, kuma ana samun sanyaya iri ɗaya da ƙarancin wutar lantarki.
p-123.principle: Ingancin sanyaya mafi kyau shi ne na Carnot $\mathrm{COP}_\mathrm{max}=\dfrac{T_c}{T_h-T_c}$. Yana ƙaruwa idan zafin ƙunshewa $T_h$ ya yi ƙasa.
p-123.example: Idan zafin tururi $T_c=280\ \mathrm{K}$, sakamakon yana da 7.4 idan $T_h=318\ \mathrm{K}$ kuma 10 idan $308\ \mathrm{K}$, wato kusan kashi 35 cikin 100 ya fi girma. A na'urori na zahiri, rage zafin iskar shiga da 3 zuwa 5 °C yana rage wutar lantarki da kashi 5 zuwa 10.
p-123.actionItem: A yau, sanya inuwa a saman na'urar waje, amma kada ka toshe kwararar iska ta gaba da baya (aƙalla 30 cm).

p-124.title: Yi amfani da na'urar sanyaya iska da fanka tare
p-124.summary: Iskar da fanka ke yi tana rage zafin da ake ji da 2 zuwa 3 °C, don haka za ka iya ɗaga saitin na'urar sanyaya iska.
p-124.principle: Asarar zafi ta convection a fata ita ce $Q=hA(T_s-T_a)$, kuma yayin da saurin iska ke ƙaruwa, ma'aunin canja zafi $h$ yana ƙaruwa.
p-124.example: Fata 33 °C, ɗaki 28 °C, fili 1.8 m²: ba tare da iska ba $h\approx5$ yana ba da 45 W, kuma da iska 1 m/s $h\approx10$ yana ba da asarar kusan 90 W, wanda ke sa a ji sanyi. Ɗaga saiti da 1 °C yana rage wutar lantarki da kusan kashi 5 zuwa 10.
p-124.actionItem: A yau, ɗaga na'urar sanyaya iska zuwa 28 °C kuma ka kunna fanka a hankali tare.

p-125.title: Sanyaya gwangwanin abin sha da sauri da takarda mai danshi
p-125.summary: Idan ruwa yana ƙafewa yana ɗaukar zafi, don haka takarda mai danshi a kusa da gwangwani da iska suna rage zafin abin sha da kaɗan digiri.
p-125.principle: Ƙafewa yana buƙatar zafi $Q=mL_v$, kuma $L_v\approx2.4\ \mathrm{kJ/g}$ na ruwa. Ana ɗaukar wannan zafin daga abin sha.
p-125.example: Idan 10 g na ruwa ya ƙafe, yana ɗaukar kusan 24 kJ, don haka abin sha na 355 mL yana sanyi a ka'ida da $\Delta T=24/(0.355\times4.0)\approx17\ \mathrm{K}$. A zahiri, a cikin minti 10 a ƙarƙashin iska kusan 5 zuwa 8 °C.
p-125.actionItem: A yau, naɗe gwangwani mai ɗumi da takardar kitchen mai danshi ka sanya ta a gaban fanka na minti 10.

p-126.title: Inuwa tana aiki mafi kyau a wajen gilashi
p-126.summary: Idan an hana hasken rana bayan ya ratsa gilashi, zafi ya riga ya shiga. Inuwar waje tafi tasiri sosai.
p-126.principle: Zafin rana da ke shigowa ta taga shi ne $Q=\mathrm{SHGC}\times A\times I$. Na'urar inuwa tana rage SHGC mai tasiri.
p-126.example: Taga 2 m², hasken rana 600 W/m²: gilashi mai haske (SHGC 0.8) yana ba da 960 W, labulen ciki (0.5) 600 W, inuwar waje (0.15) kusan 180 W, wato raguwa da kusan kashi 80.
p-126.actionItem: A yau, bincika wace inuwar waje (awning, labule, rolling screen) za ka iya sanyawa a wajen taga.

p-127.title: Cikin mota da aka ajiye yana zafi nan take
p-127.summary: Cikin mota a rana yana kama zafi kamar greenhouse, don haka barin yaro ko dabba a ciki ko da na ɗan lokaci yana da haɗari.
p-127.principle: Gilashi yana barin hasken rana mai ɗan gajeren raƙuman ruwa ya shiga amma yana kama dogon raƙuman ruwa (infrared) da ciki mai ɗumi ke fitarwa. Zafin da aka sha $Q=\alpha IA$ ya fi asarar convection da conduction.
p-127.example: A waje 30 °C, cikin mota zai iya kaiwa kusan 50 °C cikin mintuna 30 kuma dashboard fiye da 70 °C. Buɗe taga kaɗan ba ya rage hauhawar zafin sosai.
p-127.actionItem: A yau, duba kujerar baya duk lokacin da ka fita daga mota, kuma kada ka bar yaro ko dabba a ciki.

p-128.title: Saita tsayin sirdin keke domin gwiwa ta ɗan lanƙwasa
p-128.summary: Sirdi mai ƙasa sosai yana ɗora wa gwiwoyi nauyi, kuma mai tsayi sosai yana girgiza ƙugu kuma yana iya cutar da baya da gwiwoyi.
p-128.principle: Ƙimar da aka fi amfani da ita ita ce tsayin sirdi $\approx0.883\times$(tsawon ƙafa daga ƙasa zuwa tsakiyar cinya). Idan fedal yana ƙasa, gwiwa tana lanƙwasa 25 zuwa 35°.
p-128.example: Idan tsawon ƙafa 80 cm, tsayin sirdi shine $0.883\times80\approx70.6$ cm (daga ƙusar fedal zuwa saman sirdi).
p-128.actionItem: A yau, auna tsayin sirdi kafin hawa, ka tabbata gwiwa ta kusa miƙewa idan fedal yana ƙasa kuma ɗiddigar ƙafa tana kansa.

p-129.title: Rage zafin ruwan wanka da 2 zuwa 4 °C yana rage amfani da makamashi
p-129.summary: Ko da adadin ruwan ɗumi ɗaya ne, dumama ruwa zuwa zafi mafi girma yana buƙatar ƙarin makamashi.
p-129.principle: Zafin da ake buƙata don dumama ruwa shi ne $Q=mc\Delta T$. Zafin musamman na ruwa shine $c=4.18\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\,K)}$.
p-129.example: Idan ruwan famfo 15 °C kuma ana dumama 40 L na ruwan wanka zuwa 42 °C, yana buƙatar $40\times4.18\times27\approx4{,}514$ kJ (1.25 kWh), kuma zuwa 38 °C kusan 3,846 kJ (1.07 kWh). Bambanci shine 0.19 kWh ga kowane wanka da kusan 68 kWh a shekara.
p-129.actionItem: A yau, rage zafin ruwan wanka da 2 zuwa 4 °C, kuma idan sanyi ya yi yawa, fara rage lokacin wanka.

p-130.title: Rage gudu da 10 km/h kawai a babbar hanya
p-130.summary: Jurewar iska tana ƙaruwa da murabba'in gudu, don haka ko ɗan rage gudu yana ceton mai sosai.
p-130.principle: Ƙarfin jurewar iska shine $F_d=\tfrac{1}{2}C_d\rho A v^2$ kuma ƙarfin da ake amfani da shi $P=\tfrac{1}{2}C_d\rho A v^3$.
p-130.example: Idan $C_dA=0.7\ \mathrm{m^2}$, a 110 km/h (30.6 m/s) ƙarfin yana kusan 12.0 kW kuma a 100 km/h kusan 9.0 kW, wato kashi 25 ƙasa. Makamashi ga kowane nisa shine $(100/110)^2\approx0.83$, wato kashi 17 ƙasa, kuma tafiyar 100 km tana ɗaukar mintuna 5 kawai fiye.
p-130.actionItem: A yau, yi tuƙi a babbar hanya a saurin da ya yi 10 km/h ƙasa da iyaka.

p-131.title: Bincika kewayon nauyi da ƙarfin ɗagawa (N) na rigar ceto
p-131.summary: Tayar ninkaya ba rigar ceto ba ce. Rigar ceto tana ba da isasshen ɗagawa don ya riƙe fuskarka sama da ruwa.
p-131.principle: Ƙarfin ɗagawa shine $F_b=\rho V g$. Cire lita 1 na ruwa yana ba da ƙarfi na kusan 9.8 N.
p-131.example: Riga mai 50 N tana daidai da ɗagawar cire kusan lita 5 na ruwa (kusan 5.1 kgf). Yaro da babba suna buƙatar ɗagawa daban, don haka dole kewayon nauyi ya dace da mai amfani.
p-131.actionItem: Kafin shiga ruwa, bincika kewayon nauyi da alamar amincewa a kan lakabin rigar ceto, kuma ƙarfafa madaurin haɓa bayan sanya ta.

p-132.title: Hawan keke yana sauƙi a bayan wanda ke gaba
p-132.summary: Wanda ke gaba yana kare ka daga iska (slipstream), don haka za ka iya yin gudu iri ɗaya da ƙaramin ƙoƙari.
p-132.principle: Ƙarfin jurewar iska shine $P=\tfrac{1}{2}C_d\rho A v^3$. Idan kana bayan wani, $C_d$ mai tasiri yana raguwa.
p-132.example: A kan fili a 30 km/h (8.3 m/s) da $C_dA=0.35\ \mathrm{m^2}$, $P\approx0.5\times0.35\times1.2\times8.3^3\approx120\ \mathrm{W}$, kuma kai tsaye a bayan wani yana raguwa da kashi 30 zuwa 40, wato kusan 75 zuwa 85 W.
p-132.actionItem: A yau, a tafiyar ƙungiya ka riƙe tazarar mita 1 zuwa 2 daga wanda ke gaba, kada ƙafafunku na gaba su haɗu.

p-133.title: Bincika takardar shaidar caja mai sauri da zafinsa
p-133.summary: Yayin da ƙarfin caji ke ƙaruwa, zafi ma yana ƙaruwa, don haka caja mai takarda da samun iska suna ƙayyade tsaro da rayuwar baturi.
p-133.principle: Ƙarfi shine $P=VI$ kuma asarar sauyawa $P_\mathrm{loss}=(1-\eta)P$. Idan ingancin $\eta=0.88$, caja mai 20 W yana samar da kusan 2.4 W na zafi.
p-133.example: Zafin caja mai 5 W kusan 0.6 W ne, kuma na 65 W kusan 7.8 W. Idan zafi ba zai fita ba, misali a ƙarƙashin bargo, baturi ya wuce 35 °C, caji yana raguwa, rayuwa tana raguwa.
p-133.actionItem: A yau, bincika alamar takardar shaida (misali KC/CE) da adadin W da ya dace da na'urarka a kan caja, kuma kada ka yi caji a ƙarƙashin bargo.

p-134.title: Idan za ka tsaya fiye da daƙiƙa 10, gara ka kashe injin
p-134.summary: Injin da ke gudu a banza yana ci gaba da ƙona mai ko da motar ba ta motsi. Tsayuwa mai tsawo, ɓarna ta fi yawa.
p-134.principle: Amfani da mai shine $V_f=\dot V_f\,t$, kuma yawan amfani da mai a banza na motar fasinja yawanci 0.6 zuwa 1 L/h ne.
p-134.example: Idan $\dot V_f=0.8$ L/h, gudun banza na minti 5 (300 s) yana cin $0.8/3600\times300\approx0.067$ L, kuma sau ɗaya a rana tsawon kwanaki 365 kusan 24 L.
p-134.actionItem: Kashe injin a wurin ajiye mota ko lokacin da kake jiran wani (idan motarka tana da tsayawa ta atomatik a fitila, ci gaba da amfani da ita kamar yadda take).

p-135.title: Diddigen sama mai kunkuntar yana ninka matsi sau da yawa da nauyi iri ɗaya
p-135.summary: Idan nauyi ya taru a wuri ɗaya, matsi yana ƙaruwa kuma yana wahalar da ƙafa da bene.
p-135.principle: Matsi shine $P=F/A$. Da ƙarfi iri ɗaya, matsi yana ƙaruwa idan faɗin taɓawa $A$ ƙarami ne.
p-135.example: Idan nauyin 60 kgf (kusan 588 N) ya sauka a ƙafa ɗaya, diddigen da fili 1 cm² yana ba da kusan 5.9 MPa kuma faffadan diddige (20 cm²) kusan 0.29 MPa, wato bambanci na kusan sau 20.
p-135.actionItem: A ranar tafiya mai tsawo, saka takalmi mai faɗin taɓawa don rage nauyi a ƙafafu da gwiwoyi.

p-136.title: Hana hayaniyar sama na ƙasa yana buƙatar nauyi da shan sauti
p-136.summary: Wajen toshe sauti, kayan masu nauyi da kauri suna da tasiri, kuma tabarmi ko pad suna taimakawa rage hayaniyar bugawa.
p-136.principle: Bisa ƙa'idar nauyi, asarar wucewa ita ce $TL\approx20\log_{10}(mf)-47\ \mathrm{dB}$ ($m$: kg/m², $f$: Hz), kuma ninka nauyi yana ƙara kusan 6 dB.
p-136.example: Raguwar 10 dB tana nufin sauti yana kama da rabi. Manna pad na felt a ƙafafun kujera na iya rage hayaniyar jan kujera da kusan 5 zuwa 10 dB, kuma tabarmi mai kauri tana rage hayaniyar tsalle.
p-136.actionItem: A yau, manna pad na felt a ƙafafun kujera kuma shimfiɗa tabarmi mai kauri a wuraren da ake yawan tafiya.

p-137.title: Sanduna suna sauƙaƙa wa gwiwa lokacin saukowa daga tudu
p-137.summary: Sanduna suna rarraba wani ɓangare na nauyi zuwa hannaye kuma suna rage nauyi a gwiwa a gangare.
p-137.principle: A gangare, gwiwa tana ɗaukar kusan nauyin jiki sau uku wajen shan girgiza, kuma idan sanda ta ɗauki ƙarfin tallafi $F_s$, ƙarfin gwiwa yana raguwa zuwa $F_k=3mg-F_s$.
p-137.example: Idan nauyi 70 kg, nauyi 686 N ne kuma ƙarfin gwiwa kusan 2,060 N. Idan sanduna sun ɗauki kusan kashi 20, ƙarfin gwiwa yana raguwa da kusan 410 N.
p-137.actionItem: A yau, a hawan dutse, saita tsawon sanduna domin gwiwar hannu ta zama 90 digiri, kuma tsawaita su a gangare.

p-138.title: Narkar da daskararren abinci a firiji yana amfani da sanyin sa
p-138.summary: Idan ƙanƙara tana narkewa tana ɗaukar zafi, don haka narkarwa a firiji tana amfani da wannan sanyi wajen sanyaya firijin.
p-138.example: Idan 1 kg na nama daskararre yana ɗauke da kusan kashi 70 na ƙanƙara, narkarwa tana ɗaukar $0.7\times334\approx234$ kJ (kusan 0.065 kWh). Firiji yana yin aiki da ƙasa daidai gwargwado.
p-138.actionItem: A yau, ɗauki kayan abincin dare daga firizar zuwa firiji da daddare. Guji narkarwa a zafin ɗaki saboda tsafta.

p-139.title: Idan igiyar wanki ta fi tauri, igiyar da ƙugiyoyi suna ɗaukar ƙarfi mai yawa
p-139.summary: Idan ka ja igiyar wanki ta yi tauri sosai, kwangwanta tana raguwa, amma tashin igiya da wuraren ɗaure suna ƙaruwa sosai.
p-139.principle: Idan nauyi $W$ ya rataya a tsakiyar igiya a kwance kuma igiyar tana da kusurwa $\theta$ da kwance, tashin shine $T=\dfrac{W}{2\sin\theta}$.
p-139.example: Idan wanki 5 kg (kusan 49 N) kuma kusurwar kwangwani 30°, $T=49\text{ N}$, amma a 5° $T\approx281$ N (kusan 29 kgf), wato kusan sau 6.
p-139.actionItem: A yau, kada ka ja igiyar wanki ko tarkon bushewa sosai, ka bar kwangwani na kusan kashi 5 zuwa 10 na tsawon igiya.

p-140.title: Yi hukunci kan zafi da zafin da ake ji (zafi index)
p-140.summary: Ko da zafin iska ɗaya ne, yawan danshi yana hana gumi bushewa kuma yana sa a ji zafi da haɗari fiye.
p-140.principle: Zafi index aiki ne na zafin iska da danshin kwatance $HI = f(T, RH)$, kuma yayin da sanyayar ƙafewa ke raguwa, zafin da ake ji yana ƙaruwa.
p-140.example: A 32 °C da danshi 40%, zafin da ake ji kusan 32 °C ne, amma da danshi 70% kusan 41 °C, wanda yake yankin gargaɗin cututtukan zafi.
p-140.actionItem: A damina, kafin ka fita, duba danshi ba zafi kaɗai ba, kuma daidaita lokacin ayyukan waje.

p-141.title: Za ka iya sanin ko motar asibiti tana gabatowa daga sautin siren
p-141.summary: Siren yana ji sama idan yana gabatowa da ƙasa idan yana nisanta, wannan shine tasirin Doppler.
p-141.principle: Idan tushen sauti yana motsi da gudu $v_s$, mitar da ake ji shine $f'=f\,\dfrac{v}{v\mp v_s}$ ($-$ lokacin gabatowa, $+$ lokacin nisanta).
p-141.example: Idan mota mai siren 1,000 Hz tana gabatowa da 20 m/s, ana jin $1000\times343/323\approx1{,}062$ Hz, kuma lokacin nisanta $1000\times343/363\approx945$ Hz.
p-141.actionItem: A yau, idan ka ji siren yana ƙara ƙarfi da tsayi, duba kewayenka ka ba da hanya.

p-142.title: Zaɓi na'urar sanyaya iska bisa girman ɗaki
p-142.summary: Babbar na'urar sanyaya iska ba ta fi kyau ba; tana da inganci idan ta dace da nauyin sanyin ɗakin.
p-142.principle: Ana zaɓar ƙarfi bisa nauyin sanyaya $Q \approx q_0 A$ (kusan 150 zuwa 200 W/m²). Idan ta yi girma da yawa, tana kunnawa da kashewa a gajerun zagaye.
p-142.example: Ɗaki 15 m² yana dacewa da kusan 2.3 zuwa 3.0 kW (kusan 8,000 zuwa 10,000 BTU/h). Idan ƙarfin ya wuce kima, aikin kunnawa da kashewa yana rage inganci.
p-142.actionItem: Kafin zaɓar na'urar sanyaya iska, rubuta girman ɗaki, ko akwai tagar yamma, da bene, ka kwatanta ƙarfi da mai sayarwa.

p-143.title: Ɗaga saitin na'urar sanyaya iska da 1 zuwa 2 °C yana rage nauyin sanyi
p-143.summary: Idan bambancin zafi tsakanin ciki da waje ya ƙanƙanta, ƙarancin zafi yana shigowa ta bango da taga, kuma na'urar sanyaya iska tana yin aiki kaɗan.
p-143.principle: Zafin da ke shigowa ta conduction shine $\dot Q=UA\,\Delta T$, mai daidaituwa da bambancin zafi $\Delta T$.
p-143.example: Idan waje 33 °C kuma ka ɗaga zafin ciki daga 24 °C zuwa 26 °C, $\Delta T$ yana raguwa daga 9 K zuwa 7 K kuma shigar zafi ta conduction tana raguwa da kusan kashi 22.
p-143.actionItem: A yau, ɗaga saitin na'urar sanyaya iska zuwa 26 °C kuma yi amfani da fanka a hankali tare.

p-144.title: Idan harshen wuta ya wuce gindin tukunya, ana ɓata iskar gas
p-144.summary: Harshen wuta da ya fi gindin tukunya girma yana kwarara gefe kuma yana ɗumama iska kawai. Idan ka daidaita harshen a cikin gindi, zafi yana isa tukunya sosai.
p-144.principle: Zafin da ke zuwa tukunya shine $Q=\eta E_{\text{mai}}$. Idan ingancin zafi $\eta$ ya fi girma, ana amfani da ƙaramin mai don dumama iri ɗaya.
p-144.example: Dumama lita 1 na ruwa daga 20 °C zuwa 100 °C yana buƙatar 334 kJ, kuma idan $\eta$ 40% ne, ana buƙatar mai mai 835 kJ, kuma da 50% 668 kJ. Da ƙima, ana ceton kashi 20.
p-144.actionItem: A yau, idan kana girki, rage harshen wuta har sai bai kai gefen gindin tukunya ba.

p-145.title: Mayafin ruwa a laima da kusurwar taɓawa
p-145.summary: Laima tana jefar da digon ruwa saboda kusurwar taɓawa ta saman tana da girma, kuma ana iya dawo da mayafin bayan wanki.
p-145.principle: Ma'auni na Young: $\cos\theta = \frac{\gamma_{sv} - \gamma_{sl}}{\gamma_{lv}}$. Idan kusurwar taɓawa $\theta > 90^\circ$, saman yana tsoron ruwa (hydrophobic).
p-145.example: Zanen laima mai maganin ruwa yana da kusurwar taɓawa na kusan 110 zuwa 120°, kuma digon ruwa yana mirginawa kamar ƙwallo. Idan gogayya ta rage kusurwar zuwa ƙasa da kusan 70°, zane ya fara jiƙewa.
p-145.actionItem: Busar da laima mai jiƙaƙƙiya a buɗe a inuwa, kuma idan ruwa ya fara shiga, fesa mata maganin ruwa.

p-146.title: Auna nisa daga tazarar walƙiya da tsawa
p-146.summary: Idan ka ƙidaya daƙiƙu daga walƙiya zuwa tsawa, za ka iya sanin yadda walƙiyar take kusa.
p-146.principle: Gudun sauti kusan $v \approx 343\ \mathrm{m/s}$ ne kuma haske yana zuwa nan take, don haka nisa $d = vt$.
p-146.example: Idan ana jin tsawa daƙiƙu 9 bayan walƙiya, $d \approx 343 \times 9 \approx 3.1\ \mathrm{km}$. Idan tazarar kusan daƙiƙu 10 (3.4 km) ko ƙasa, ka riga ka shiga yankin haɗarin walƙiya.
p-146.actionItem: Idan ka ji tsawa a lokacin damina, dakatar da ayyukan waje ka shiga gini ko mota.

p-147.title: Yi birki a keke da na gaba da na baya tare, tare da ƙarin birkin gaba
p-147.summary: Lokacin birki, nauyi yana komawa kan ƙafar gaba, don haka ƙafar gaba za ta iya ba da ƙarfin birki mafi girma.
p-147.principle: A lokacin birki, nauyin da ke komawa ƙafar gaba shine $\Delta N=\dfrac{m a h}{L}$ ($h$: tsayin cibiyar nauyi, $L$: tazarar ƙusoshi).
p-147.example: Idan nauyi 80 kg, $h=1.0$ m, $L=1.0$ m kuma raguwar gudu $a=4\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$, $\Delta N=320$ N. Nauyin tsaye gaba 314 N da baya 470 N yana canzawa zuwa gaba 634 N da baya 150 N.
p-147.actionItem: A yau, kada ka yi amfani da birkin baya kawai lokacin hawan keke; riƙe na gaba da na baya tare a hankali. Riƙe na gaba kaɗai ba zato ba tsammani na iya sa ka faɗi.

p-148.title: Bincika nisa da fitar zafi na thermometer mara taɓawa
p-148.summary: Thermometer infrared yana karanta zafi daga zafin da abu ke fitarwa, don haka yanayin sama da nisa suna shafar karatun.
p-148.principle: Ƙarfin hasken zafi shine $P=\varepsilon\sigma T^4$. Saman mai sheƙi tare da ƙarancin fitarwa $\varepsilon$ yana nuna ƙasa da gaskiya.
p-148.example: Fitar fata kusan 0.98 ne, don haka karatun daidai ne, amma ƙarfe mai sheƙi 0.1 zuwa 0.3 ne kuma kuskure yana da girma. Idan rabon nisa 12:1, daga nisan 1.2 m ana ɗaukar matsakaicin yanki mai diamita 10 cm.
p-148.actionItem: Lokacin siyan thermometer, bincika nisan amfani da wurin aunawa, kuma a yau auna daga nisan da littafin amfani ya ce (yawanci wasu cm).

p-149.title: Ƙaramin toaster oven yana amfani da ƙarancin zafi don ƙaramin abinci
p-149.summary: Babban tanda yana da iska da ƙarfe da yawa da za a dumama, don haka don abincin mutum ɗaya ko biyu ƙaramin tanda ya isa da ƙarancin zafi.
p-149.principle: Zafin da ake buƙata don dumama shine $Q=\sum m c\,\Delta T$. Idan nauyin da za a dumama ƙarami ne, ana buƙatar ƙarancin zafi.
p-149.example: Dumama farantin da ƙarfe na ciki (5 kg, $c\approx0.45$ kJ/(kg·K)) da 180 K yana buƙatar kusan 405 kJ, amma 1 kg yana buƙatar kusan 81 kJ kawai. Dumama iska (60 L) kusan 13 kJ ne kawai.
p-149.actionItem: A yau, idan abincin da za ka gasa kaɗan ne, yi amfani da toaster oven ko air fryer maimakon babban tanda.

p-150.title: Kashe wuta kaɗan da wuri kuma ka gama da zafin da ya rage
p-150.summary: Ruwa da kayan abinci a tukunya suna ajiye zafi, don haka idan an rufe murfi, girki yana ci gaba ba tare da wuta ba.
p-150.principle: Zafin da aka adana shine $Q=mc\Delta T$, kuma idan akwai murfi, asarar zafi tana da ƙarami, don haka zafi yana saukowa a hankali.
p-150.example: Idan murhu 3 kW (ana zaton ingancin zafin gas 40%) an kashe mintuna 2 da wuri, ana ceton $3\times120=360$ kJ na zafin mai. Lita 1.5 na ruwa da aka rufe suna ci gaba da kasancewa sama da 90 °C na 'yan mintuna.
p-150.actionItem: A yau, idan kana dafa taliya, miya ko tururi, kashe wuta mintuna 1 zuwa 2 da wuri ka rufe murfi ka gama da zafin da ya rage.

p-151.title: Naɗe igiyar belun kunne a siffar 8 don kada ta kulle
p-151.summary: Idan ka naɗe igiya a hanya ɗaya kawai, tana tara karkacewa kuma tana kullewa idan ka buɗe ta. Naɗin 8 yana soke karkacewar.
p-151.principle: A kowane jujjuya igiya, kusurwar karkacewa $\theta=2\pi$ tana taruwa, kuma ƙarfin karkacewa shine $\tau=\dfrac{GJ}{L}\theta$.
p-151.example: Idan ka naɗe igiya ta mita 1 a hanya ɗaya sau 10, karkacewa ta taru sau 10, amma idan ka naɗe sau 5 + da sau 5 − (siffar 8), jimilla ta zama 0 kuma kusan babu kullewa idan ka buɗe.
p-151.actionItem: A yau, kada ka naɗe belun kunne ko kebul ɗin caji a kewayen yatsa; ninka su a siffar 8 don ajiya.

p-152.title: Ruwan da ya shiga kunne ba ya fita saboda tashin hankalin sama
p-152.summary: Digon ruwa a cikin kunkuntar ramin kunne yana kamuwa da matsi da tashin hankalin sama ke yi, kuma ba ya fita da sauƙi.
p-152.principle: Matsi na Laplace shine $\Delta P=\dfrac{2\gamma}{r}$ kuma $\gamma\approx0.072$ N/m na ruwa. Ƙaramin radius $r$, mafi girman matsi.
p-152.example: Idan $r=3$ mm, $\Delta P=2\times0.072/0.003=48$ Pa, kuma ruwa ba zai fita da nauyi kawai ba.
p-152.actionItem: Bayan ninkaya, karkatar da kai, ja kunne a hankali, kuma yi tsalle da ƙafa ɗaya. Kada ka yi amfani da auduga, kuma idan akwai ciwo ko ruwa, je asibiti.

p-153.title: Kafa turaku na tanti a karkace gaba da hanyar igiya
p-153.summary: Idan turaku ya kusa kusurwar dama da hanyar igiya, ƙasa tana jure ƙarfin cirewa mafi kyau.
p-153.principle: Tashin igiya $T$ yana rabuwa zuwa $T\cos\theta$ a kwance da $T\sin\theta$ a tsaye, kuma ɓangaren tsaye yana ɗaga turaku.
p-153.example: Idan tashin 100 N kuma kusurwar igiya 45°, a kwance 71 N ne kuma ƙarfin ɗagawa 71 N. Idan aka kafa turaku a karkace kusan 45 zuwa 60° gaba da igiya, ƙasa tana riƙewa.
p-153.actionItem: A yau, a zango ko tafiya, kafa turaku kusa da kusurwar dama da igiya a karkace, kuma ja igiya a kusurwar kusan 45°.

p-154.title: Zaɓi akwatin sanyi bisa kauri, rufewar murfi da adadin ƙanƙara
p-154.summary: Tsawon lokacin da akwatin sanyi yake riƙe sanyi ya dogara da kaurin rufin zafi da adadin ƙanƙara.
p-154.principle: Shigar zafi ta bango shine $\dot Q=\dfrac{kA\Delta T}{d}$ kuma zafin narkar ƙanƙara shine $Q=mL_f$, $L_f\approx334$ kJ/kg.
p-154.example: Idan shigar zafi 10 W, 2 kg na ƙanƙara (668 kJ) yana ɗaukar $668{,}000/10\approx18.6$ awanni, kuma a 20 W kusan awanni 9.3.
p-154.actionItem: Idan kana da shirin fita yau, cika akwatin da aƙalla 2 kg na ƙanƙara da abin sha da aka riga aka sanyaya ba tare da gibi ba, kuma kada ka buɗe murfi akai-akai.

p-155.title: Wani ɓangare na wutar na'urar sanyaya iska a damina yana tafiya wajen ƙunsar danshi
p-155.summary: A ranakun da ke da danshi, makamashi yana tafiya ba wajen sanyaya iska kaɗai ba, har ma wajen mayar da tururin ruwa zuwa ruwa.
p-155.principle: Idan tururin ruwa ya zama ruwa, ana fitar da zafi $Q=mL_v$, kuma $L_v\approx2{,}260\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$ na ruwa.
p-155.example: A ɗaki 60 $\mathrm{m^3}$ (iska kusan 72 kg), rage 2 g na tururin ruwa a kowace kg na iska yana nufin na'urar sanyaya tana sarrafa $0.144\times2{,}260\approx325$ kJ (kusan 0.09 kWh).
p-155.actionItem: A ranar da ke da danshi, yi amfani da yanayin busar da danshi na na'urar sanyaya iska ko iska mai rauni a 26 zuwa 28 °C, ka rufe ƙofofi da tagogi don kada danshi ya shiga.

p-156.title: Kettle na lantarki yana da inganci fiye da murhun gas
p-156.summary: Wajen tafasa ruwa, kettle na lantarki wanda zafi ba ya tserewa yana amfani da ƙarancin makamashi don tafasa ruwa iri ɗaya.
p-156.principle: Inganci $\eta = \frac{mc\Delta T}{E_{in}}$. Dumama lita 1 na ruwa daga 20 °C zuwa 100 °C yana buƙatar $1 \times 4.18 \times 80 = 334\ \mathrm{kJ}$ ($\approx 0.093\ \mathrm{kWh}$).
p-156.example: Kettle na lantarki mai inganci kusan 90% yana amfani da kusan 0.103 kWh kuma harshen gas mai kusan 40% yana amfani da kusan 0.23 kWh na makamashi.
p-156.actionItem: Lokacin tafasa ruwa, auna adadin da ake buƙata kawai ka tafasa shi da kettle na lantarki.

p-157.title: Ana iya ƙididdige lokacin dumama kofi ɗaya
p-157.summary: Idan an saita lokacin microwave ta hanyar zato, yana da sauƙi a yi amfani da shi na tsawon lokaci kuma a ɓata makamashi.
p-157.principle: Zafin da ake buƙata don dumama ruwa shine $Q=mc\Delta T$, kuma lokacin da ake buƙata $t=Q/P_{\text{ƙarfi}}$.
p-157.example: Dumama 250 g na ruwa daga 20 °C zuwa 90 °C yana buƙatar $0.25\times4.18\times70\approx73$ kJ, kuma da ƙarfin 700 W yana ɗaukar kusan daƙiƙu 104 (minti 1 da daƙiƙa 44).
p-157.actionItem: A yau, idan ka dumama abin sha, fara da kusan minti 1 da daƙiƙa 30, sannan ƙara daƙiƙu 20 a lokaci guda idan bai isa ba.

p-158.title: Idan ruwan sama yana zuwa daga sama kawai, gudu yana jiƙa ƙasa
p-158.summary: Idan ka gudu a ruwan sama, lokacin da ruwa ke bugun kai da kafaɗu yana raguwa, amma adadin ruwa da ke bugun gaban jiki yana ƙaddara ta nisa.
p-158.principle: A cikin ruwan sama da ke sauka a tsaye, adadin da ke bugun saman sama shine $W_{\text{sama}}\propto t=L/v$, mai juyi da gudu, kuma adadin da ke bugun gaba daidai yake da nisa $L$ kawai.
p-158.example: Idan aka yi tafiya mita 100 (1.4 m/s) yana ɗaukar kusan daƙiƙu 71 kuma gudu (3.5 m/s) kusan daƙiƙu 29, don haka lokacin bugun saman sama yana raguwa da kashi 59. Idan akwai iska, sakamakon na daban ne.
p-158.actionItem: Idan a yau ana ruwa kuma ba ka da laima, yi tafiya da sauri a ɗan gajeren nisa ba tare da ɓata tsaro ba, kuma ka kula da benaye masu santsi.

p-159.title: Ƙa'idar 20-20-20: duba mita 6 na daƙiƙu 20 a kowane minti 20
p-159.summary: Idan ka daɗe kana kallon allo na kusa, ruwan tabarau na ido yana ci gaba da kauri kuma gajiya tana taruwa.
p-159.principle: A ma'aunin ruwan tabarau $\dfrac1f=\dfrac1{d_o}+\dfrac1{d_i}$, ƙarfin da ake buƙata (diopter) $D=1/d_o$ yana ƙaruwa yayin da abu ya kusanto.
p-159.example: Allo a nisan 40 cm yana buƙatar kusan 2.5 D na daidaitawa, amma a nisan mita 6 kusan 0.17 D, wato nauyi yana raguwa kusan sau 15.
p-159.actionItem: A yau, saita mai ƙidayar lokaci zuwa minti 20, kuma duk lokacin da ya yi ƙara, duba wani wuri nesa da aƙalla mita 6 na daƙiƙu 20.

p-160.title: Idan rip current ya ja ka, yi ninkaya a layi ɗaya da bakin teku
p-160.summary: Rip current kunkuntar hanyar ruwa mai sauri ce daga bakin teku zuwa teku, kuma ninkaya a gabanta yana gajiyar da kai.
p-160.principle: Bisa ma'aunin ci gaba $A_1v_1=A_2v_2$, idan ruwa ya taru a kunkuntar hanya, gudun kwarara yana ƙaruwa.
p-160.example: Gudun rip current na iya kaiwa kusan 2 m/s, wanda ya fi gudun ninkayar ɗan adam (kusan 1 m/s), kuma faɗinsa yawanci mita goma ne, don haka matsawa gefe mita 20 zuwa 30 yana fitar da kai.
p-160.actionItem: Idan kana da shirin yin ninkaya a teku yau, yi wasa inda akwai mai tsaro, kuma idan rip current ya ja ka, adana ƙarfinka, yi ninkaya a layi ɗaya da bakin teku sannan ka daga hannu don neman taimako.

p-161.title: Laima tana da kyau idan waje fari ne kuma ciki duhu
p-161.summary: Farin waje yana mayar da hasken rana, kuma duhun ciki yana shan hasken da ke tashi daga ƙasa.
p-161.principle: Hasken da saman ke sha shine $q=(1-\alpha)I$. $\alpha$ shine ma'aunin mayarwa.
p-161.example: A rana ta tsakar rana 800 $\mathrm{W/m^2}$, fari mai mayarwa 0.7 yana shan 240 $\mathrm{W/m^2}$ kuma baƙi mai mayarwa 0.05 yana shan 760 $\mathrm{W/m^2}$ (ƙima).
p-161.actionItem: Lokacin siyan laima, duba launin sama da alamar kariya daga UV kamar UPF 50+.

p-162.title: Dalilin da babban fanka ya fi inganci
p-162.summary: Da iska iri ɗaya, fanka mai manyan ruwan wuta yana cinye ƙarancin makamashi idan aka juya shi a ƙaramin gudu.
p-162.principle: Ƙarfin kuzarin motsin iska $P = \frac{1}{2}\rho A v^3 = \frac{\rho Q^3}{2A^2}$ ($Q = Av$ yawan iska).
p-162.example: Da yawan iska 0.5 m³/s, fanka mai diamita 30 cm yana da ƙarfin ka'ida kusan 15 W kuma mai 60 cm kusan 1 W. Idan fili ya ninka sau huɗu, ƙarfi yana zama 1/16.
p-162.actionItem: Lokacin siyan fanka, kwatanta diamita na ruwan fanka kuma yi amfani da babban fanka a ƙaramin gudu.

p-163.title: Don tafiyar kilomita 5, keke yana cin ƙarancin makamashi fiye da mota
p-163.summary: Don gajerun tafiye-tafiye, amfani da keke maimakon mota yana rage amfani da mai da makamashi sosai.
p-163.principle: Ana ƙididdige makamashin motsa jiki daga aiki $W=Pt$ da inganci. Lita ɗaya ta fetur tana ɗauke da kusan 9 kWh na makamashin sinadari.
p-163.example: Kilomita 5 a keke (15 km/h, 100 W, minti 20) shine 33 Wh, kuma ko da an yi la'akari da ingancin tsoka 25%, kusan 0.13 kWh. Motar fasinja mai 12 km/L tana amfani da kusan 3.7 kWh a 5 km, wato kusan sau 28 fiye.
p-163.actionItem: A yau, gwada tafiya a ƙafa ko amfani da keke don fita da ba su wuce kilomita 5.

p-164.title: Tukunyar fure tana shan ruwa daga ƙasa ta capillary
p-164.summary: Ƙananan giɓi tsakanin ƙwayoyin ƙasa suna ja ruwa sama, don haka ruwan da aka zuba a ƙarƙashi yana isa tushen.
p-164.principle: Tsayin tashin capillary shine $h=\dfrac{2\gamma\cos\theta}{\rho g r}$. Ƙaramin radius na giɓi $r$, ruwa yana tashi sama.
p-164.example: Idan $\gamma=0.072$ N/m, $\theta\approx0$ da $r=0.1$ mm, $h\approx2\times0.072/(1000\times9.8\times10^{-4})\approx0.15$ m (15 cm).
p-164.actionItem: A yau, zuba ruwa a farantin tukunyar fure, bar shi mintuna 20 sannan ka zubar da ragowar. Ruwan da ya tsaya yana haddasa ruɓar tushe da sauro.

p-165.title: Auna hawan jini da hannu a tsayin zuciya
p-165.summary: Idan hannu ya fi zuciya ƙasa, nauyin jini (matsin hydrostatic) yana ƙaruwa kuma hawan jini yana nuna sama da gaskiya.
p-165.principle: Bambancin matsin hydrostatic shine $\Delta P=\rho g h$. Yawan jini kusan 1,060 $\mathrm{kg/m^3}$ ne kuma 1 kPa kusan 7.5 mmHg.
p-165.example: Idan hannu ya fi zuciya ƙasa da 20 cm, $\Delta P=1060\times9.8\times0.2\approx2.08$ kPa, wato kusan 15.6 mmHg ƙari a ma'auni.
p-165.actionItem: Lokacin auna hawan jini, zauna a kujera ka jingina baya, kuma ka ɗora hannunka mai maɗaurin a kan tebur a tsayin zuciya.

p-166.title: Kayan da ke cikin mota suna tashi gaba da ƙarfi mai yawa lokacin birki kwatsam
p-166.summary: Kayan da ba a ɗaure ba suna ci gaba da motsi saboda inertia idan mota ta tsaya, kuma sun zama ƙarfin bugu mai yawa a birki kwatsam.
p-166.principle: Yayin da mota ke raguwa, ƙarfin da ke kan kaya shine $F=ma$ kuma $a=v/\Delta t$.
p-166.example: Idan kaya 10 kg ya tsaya daga 50 km/h (13.9 m/s) cikin daƙiƙa 0.1, $a\approx139\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$, $F\approx1{,}390$ N (kusan 140 kgf).
p-166.actionItem: A yau, ajiye kayan a ƙasan akwatin mota ka ɗaure su, kuma kada ka sanya abubuwa masu nauyi a kan shelf ɗin baya ko kujeru.

p-167.title: Lambar IPX ta rashin ratsawar ruwa tana nuna yanayin da ruwa ke taɓawa
p-167.summary: IPX4 yana nufin jure fesar ruwa, kuma IPX7 yana jure nutsewa a zurfin mita 1 na minti 30, kuma lamba mafi girma ba koyaushe take da kyau ba.
p-167.principle: Matsin ruwa shine $P=\rho g h$. Matsi a zurfin mita 1 kusan 9.8 kPa ne.
p-167.example: Ana gwada IPX4 da ruwan da ke fesawa daga kowane bangare, kuma IPX7 da nutsewa na minti 30 a zurfin mita 1, kuma sau da yawa garanti ba ya shafi ruwan teku, ruwan sabulu ko ruwan zafi.
p-167.actionItem: A yau, bincika lambar IPX ta belun kunne ko lasifika, kuma don amfani a ranar ruwan sama tabbatar da cewa aƙalla IPX4 ne.

p-168.title: Na'urar busar da danshi: nau'in kwampreso ko nau'in Peltier
p-168.summary: Idan ɗaki babba ne, nau'in kwampreso ya dace, kuma ga ƙaramin wuri kamar kabad, nau'in Peltier ya dace.
p-168.principle: Ma'aunin aiki $COP = \frac{Q_c}{W}$. Nau'in kwampreso kusan 3 ne kuma Peltier kusan 0.5.
p-168.example: Ƙunsar 1 kg na ruwa yana buƙatar kusan 2.26 MJ (0.63 kWh). Nau'in kwampreso yana amfani da kusan 0.2 kWh kuma Peltier kusan 1.3 kWh.
p-168.actionItem: A damina, bincika ƙarfin busar da danshi da ya dace da girman ɗaki kuma yi amfani da nau'in kwampreso a falo.

p-169.title: Fitar da zafin gida ta iska lokacin da iskar dare ta yi sanyi
p-169.summary: Za a iya fitar da zafin da ya taru da rana ta buɗe taga da dare lokacin da iskar waje ta fi sanyi, ba tare da makamashi ba.
p-169.principle: Zafin da ke fita ta iska shine $\dot Q=\dot m c_p\Delta T$.
p-169.example: Idan ciki 28 °C kuma iskar dare 22 °C, iska 600 $\mathrm{m^3/h}$ (iska kusan 0.2 kg/s) tana fitar da $0.2\times1.005\times6\approx1.2$ kW na zafi.
p-169.actionItem: A yau da dare, idan zafi ya sauka ƙasa da cikin gida, buɗe tagogi don iska ta ratsa, ka rufe su da wuri da safe.

p-170.title: Gurguzu a bututun ruwan sharar shine canjin matsin iska
p-170.summary: Idan ruwa ya sauka lokaci ɗaya, matsin iska a bututu yana canzawa, ruwan tarko yana tsotsewa kuma iska tana shiga da fita tana haddasa sauti.
p-170.principle: Matsin ginshiƙin ruwa shine $P=\rho g h$, don haka matsin mara kyau $\Delta P$ yana jan ruwa har tsayin $h=\Delta P/(\rho g)$.
p-170.example: Matsin mara kyau 100 Pa yana daidai da ginshiƙin ruwa na kusan $100/(1000\times9.8)\approx10$ mm. Idan zurfin ruwan tarko aƙalla 50 mm, yawanci yana jurewa.
p-170.actionItem: A yau, idan bututun sharar ruwa yana gurguzu, a bar ruwa ya zubo a hankali, kuma idan ya maimaita, nemi mai kula da ginin ko mai aikin bututu ya duba.

p-171.title: Iskar fanka tana korar sauro
p-171.summary: Sauro suna tashi a hankali, don haka yana da wuya su kusanci wurin da akwai iskar fanka.
p-171.principle: Gudun tashin sauro ƙasa da kusan 1.5 m/s ne, don haka idan saurin iska $v_{wind} > v_{mosq}$, kusanta yana da wuya, kuma iska tana warwatsa ginshiƙin carbon dioxide.
p-171.example: Fanka mai 3 m/s ya ninka mafi girman gudun sauro sau biyu. Idan ka yi nufin iska zuwa ƙafafu, kusantar sauro don shan jini yana raguwa.
p-171.actionItem: A baranda ko waje, kunna fanka yana nufin tsayin ƙafafu.

p-172.title: Shirya wa iska ta gefe lokacin wuce manyan motoci a babbar hanya
p-172.summary: Idan iska ta gefe ta zo ba zato ba tsammani a kusa da babbar mota ko a kan gada, motarka tana tura gefe.
p-172.principle: Ƙarfin da iska ke yi wa mota shine $F=\tfrac12\rho C A v^2$ kuma yana daidaita da murabba'in saurin iska $v$.
p-172.example: Idan saurin iska 20 m/s (72 km/h), filin gefe 2.5 $\mathrm{m^2}$ kuma $C\approx0.8$, $F\approx0.5\times1.2\times0.8\times2.5\times400\approx480$ N.
p-172.actionItem: A yau, idan akwai hasashen damina ko guguwa, riƙe sitiyari da hannaye biyu a bakin gadoji da ramukan hanya kuma rage gudu.

p-173.title: Zaɓi kayan sanyi bisa ƙimar sanyin taɓawa (Q-max)
p-173.summary: Kayan sanyi suna ɗaukar zafi da sauri daga fata idan sun taɓa ta kuma suna jin sanyi, kuma ana nuna wannan da Q-max.
p-173.principle: Zafin da ke gudana a lokacin taɓawa shine $q\propto\dfrac{b\,\Delta T}{\sqrt{t}}$, kuma mafi girman ƙarfin shigar zafi $b=\sqrt{k\rho c}$, mafi sanyi ake ji.
p-173.example: Idan $\Delta T=5$ K a lokacin taɓawa, yadi mai Q-max na 0.25 $\mathrm{W/cm^2}$ yana ɗaukar zafi kusan sau 1.7 da sauri fiye da yadi mai 0.15 (misali).
p-173.actionItem: Lokacin zaɓar kayan bazara da na gado, bincika ƙimar Q-max a kan lakabi (yawanci 0.2 ko fiye ana rubuta shi kayan sanyi).

p-174.title: Ana ƙididdige nisan keken lantarki daga Wh na baturi da amfani
p-174.summary: Raba ƙarfin baturi (Wh) da makamashin da ake amfani da shi a kowane km (Wh/km) yana ba da kimanin nisan tafiya.
p-174.principle: Nisan tafiya shine $d=E/e$, kuma tunda jurewar iska $F\propto v^2$ ce, amfani $e$ yana ƙaruwa da gudu.
p-174.example: Baturi 500 Wh da 15 Wh/km yana ba da kusan 33 km. A 25 km/h jurewar iska ta fi sau $(25/20)^2\approx1.56$ na 20 km/h, don haka nisan yana raguwa.
p-174.actionItem: A yau, idan kana hawan keken lantarki, riƙe gudu kusan 20 km/h kuma bincika matsin iska na tayoyi.

p-175.title: Kaya 100 kg a akwatin mota yana ƙona ƙarin mai a 100 km
p-175.summary: Idan mota ta fi nauyi, ana buƙatar ƙarin makamashi don juriyar birgima da hanzari, don haka tafiya da kayan da ba a amfani da su yana ɓata mai.
p-175.principle: Juriyar birgima shine $F_r=C_{rr}mg$ kuma aiki $W=F_r d$.
p-175.example: Idan $C_{rr}=0.01$ da $m=100$ kg, $F_r\approx9.8$ N kuma a 100 km $W\approx0.27$ kWh. Da ingancin injin 25% da fetur 9 kWh/L, wannan kusan 0.12 L ne, kuma makamashin hanzari daban ne.
p-175.actionItem: A yau, fitar da kayan da ba ka amfani da su daga akwatin mota.

p-176.title: Dalilin da benen banɗaki mai jiƙa yake da santsi
p-176.summary: Fim ɗin ruwa yana rage ma'aunin gogayya sosai, don haka shimfiɗa tabarmar hana zamewa a banɗaki.
p-176.principle: Iyakar gogayya a tsaye $F \le \mu N$. Idan ma'aunin gogayya ya yi ƙasa da abin da tafiya ke buƙata (kusan 0.3 zuwa 0.4), mutum yana zamewa.
p-176.example: Tayal bushe $\mu \approx 0.6$, tayal mai santsi mai jiƙa $\mu \approx 0.2$, kuma tabarmar roba kusan 0.6 ne ko da ta jiƙa.
p-176.actionItem: Shimfiɗa tabarmar hana zamewa a ƙasan banɗaki da wurin shawa.

p-177.title: Hasken ultraviolet yana ratsa gajimare ma
p-177.summary: Gajimare yana rage hasken da ake gani, amma yana barin wani babban ɓangare na ultraviolet ya ratsa, don haka ana buƙatar kariya a ranar gajimare ma.
p-177.principle: Ma'aunin UV $UVI = 40 \int E_\lambda\, s(\lambda)\, d\lambda$ (hanyar aikin ja $s$). Siraran gajimare ba sa rage UV sosai.
p-177.example: Siraran gajimare suna barin kusan kashi 80 zuwa 90 na UV ya ratsa. Idan ma'aunin UV a tsakar ranar Yuni ya kai 8, fata na iya ƙonewa cikin kusan mintuna 20.
p-177.actionItem: Hatta ranar gajimare, bincika ma'aunin UV kafin ka fita kuma shafa man kariya daga rana.

p-178.title: Bayan wuce kududdufin ruwa, danna birki a hankali don busar da shi
p-178.summary: Pad da faifan birki masu jiƙa suna rasa gogayya, kuma birki yana yin jinkiri. Danna a hankali yana ƙafe ruwan da zafin gogayya.
p-178.principle: Nisan birki shine $d=\dfrac{v^2}{2\mu g}$. Idan gogayyar birki ta ragu, $d$ yana ƙaruwa.
p-178.example: A 60 km/h (16.7 m/s) da $\mu=0.4$, nisan birki kusan 35.5 m ne, kuma idan ya jiƙa $\mu$ ya sauka zuwa 0.25, kusan 56.7 m, wato kusan sau 1.6 (ƙima).
p-178.actionItem: A yau, bayan wuce zurfin kududdufin ruwa a damina, a wuri mai aminci danna birki a hankali sau kaɗan ka bincika yanayinsa.

p-179.title: Zaɓi tukunya bisa kaurin ƙasa da kayan aiki
p-179.summary: Tukunya mai kauri a ƙasa da ke da layin aluminium ko jan ƙarfe tana yaɗa zafi daidai kuma abinci yana ƙonewa kaɗan.
p-179.principle: Dokar Fourier $q = k\frac{\Delta T}{d}$. Bakin karfe $k \approx 16$, aluminium $\approx 237$ W/(m·K).
p-179.example: Idan kauri 3 mm da ΔT 10 K, bakin karfe yana watsa kusan 53 kW/m² kuma aluminium kusan 790 kW/m², wato kusan sau 15 ƙarin zafi.
p-179.actionItem: Lokacin zaɓar tukunya, bincika cewa ƙasa tana kwance da kauri, kuma idan induction ne, cewa ƙasan magnet ne.

p-180.title: Ɗumama tankin ruwa da rana don adana ruwan wanka
p-180.summary: Hasken rana yana ba da har kusan 1 kW na makamashi a kowane murabba'in mita, don haka za a iya ɗumama ruwa a baƙin tanki kyauta.
p-180.principle: Zafin da aka sha shine $Q=\alpha I A t$ kuma hauhawar zafin ruwa $\Delta T=Q/(mc)$.
p-180.example: Idan baƙin tanki na 20 L (0.25 $\mathrm{m^2}$) yana samun $I=700\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$ kuma shan 0.9, ƙarfi shine $0.9\times700\times0.25\approx158$ W, kuma cikin awanni 2 yana shigowa kusan 1.1 MJ, ruwa yana ɗumama kusan 13 °C.
p-180.actionItem: Idan rana tana da ƙarfi yau, cika baƙin tanki ko bututu da ruwa ka bar su a rana awanni 2 zuwa 3 sannan ka yi amfani da shi wajen ban ruwa ko wankin mota.

p-181.title: Ƙofa mai ƙugi da gogayyar manne-zamiya
p-181.summary: Ƙofa tana ƙugi saboda gogayya a tsaye ta fi gogayyar motsi kuma yana manne yana zamiya ba tsayawa.
p-181.principle: Stick-slip: $F_s = \mu_s N > F_k = \mu_k N$. Shafawa yana rage duka biyun $\mu$.
p-181.example: Idan busasshen ƙarfe $\mu \approx 0.5$ ya sauka zuwa kusan 0.1 bayan shafawa, gogayya tana raguwa da kusan kashi 80 kuma sautin yana ɓacewa.
p-181.actionItem: Shafa digon man silicone ko mai a ƙusar ƙofa ka goge abin da ya zube.

p-182.title: Hayaniya tana haɗuwa 3 dB, fanka biyu
p-182.summary: Idan na'urori biyu masu hayaniya iri ɗaya suna aiki, sauti ba ya ninka sau biyu ba; yana ƙaruwa da 3 dB kawai. Lokacin bacci, ƙarancin hayaniya yana da muhimmanci.
p-182.example: Fanka biyu na 40 dB suna ba da $10\log_{10}(2\times10^4) \approx 43\ \mathrm{dB}$. WHO ta ba da shawarar hayaniyar dare a ɗakin kwana ta kasance kusan 30 dB ko ƙasa.
p-182.actionItem: Kwatanta hayaniya (dB) na na'urorin ɗakin kwana kuma yi amfani da mafi shuru kaɗai yayin bacci.

p-183.title: A bakin teku da ƙafafu babu takalmi da tsakar rana, busasshen yashi yana zafi kuma yashi mai jiƙa yana sanyi
p-183.summary: Busasshen yashi a tsakar rana yana ɗumama da sauƙi kuma yana iya ƙone tafin ƙafa, yayin da yashi mai jiƙa da ruwa ba ya zafi sosai.
p-183.principle: Idan an sami adadin zafi $Q$ iri ɗaya, hauhawar zafi shine $\Delta T=\frac{Q}{mc}$. Zafin musamman na busasshen yashi $c\approx0.8\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$ ne, kuma na ruwa $4.18\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$, don haka ruwa yana ɗumama ƙasa, kuma ƙafewar ruwa tana ɗaukar zafi shi ma.
p-183.example: Idan 1 kg na yashi da 1 kg na ruwa kowanne ya sami 50 kJ, yashi yana ɗumama kusan $+62\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kuma ruwa kusan $+12\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Shi yasa saman busasshen yashi a tsakar rana na iya kaiwa 50 zuwa 60 °C, amma yashi mai jiƙa da ruwan raƙuman ruwa yana kasancewa kusan 30 °C.
p-183.actionItem: A tsakar rana, sanya silifas ka yi tafiya a kan yashi mai jiƙa a bakin ruwa.

p-184.title: Ruwan teku yana ɗaga mutum fiye da ruwan kogi
p-184.summary: Ko mutum ɗaya yana yin ɗagawa kaɗan sama a teku fiye da a wurin ninƙaya ko kogi.
p-184.principle: Ɗagawa (buoyancy) shi ne nauyin ruwan da aka kora, $F_b=\rho g V$. Ruwan teku yana da $\rho\approx1025\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ kuma ruwa mai daɗi $1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, wato kusan 2.5 % ya fi.
p-184.example: Don mutum mai nauyin 70 kg ya yi ɗagawa gaba ɗaya, yana buƙatar kora ruwa mai daɗi 70 L ko ruwan teku $70/1.025\approx68.3$ L. Girman da ake buƙatar nutsewa yana raguwa da kusan 1.7 L. A Dead Sea mai ƙarin gishiri (kusan 1240 kg/m³) ɗagawa ya fi yawa.
p-184.actionItem: Gwada kwanciya a bayanka a teku da numfashin da ka ja ka saki jiki ka yi ɗagawa. Yi haka a ruwa mara zurfi kawai, kuma ka kiyaye rigar ceto a jikinka.

p-185.title: Bututun snorkel ya zama gajere, kada ka tsawaita shi sama da 30 cm
p-185.summary: Idan ka tsawaita bututun snorkel, numfashi yana yin wuya da sauri saboda matsin ruwa kuma iskar da aka fitar tana tsayawa a cikin bututu, wanda ke da haɗari.
p-185.principle: Matsin ruwa shi ne $\Delta P=\rho g h$ kuma yana ƙaruwa da kusan 0.1 atmosphere (kusan 9.8 kPa) a kowace zurfin mita 1. Ƙirji dole ne ya shawo kan wannan matsin don shaƙar iska, kuma yayin da bututu ya fi tsayi, dead space inda iskar da aka fitar ke tsayawa ma yana ƙaruwa.
p-185.example: Idan saman bututu yana kan ruwa kuma ƙirji yana zurfin 30 cm, $\Delta P\approx2.9\ \mathrm{kPa}$, amma a zurfin 1 m kusan 9.8 kPa ne, kusa da matsakaicin matsin shaƙar mutum, don haka numfashi kusan ba zai yiwu ba. Bututu mai diamita na ciki 18 mm da tsawon 30 cm yana da dead space na kusan 75 mL.
p-185.actionItem: Duba tsawon snorkel ɗinka yau, kuma kada ka yi amfani da kayan da aka tsawaita fiye da ma'auni ko aka haɗa da hoses.

p-186.title: Ƙasan wurin ninƙaya yana kama da mara zurfi fiye da gaskiya
p-186.summary: Ƙasa ƙarƙashin ruwa tana kama da kusan kashi uku cikin huɗu na zurfin gaskiya, don haka a gaskiya tana da zurfi fiye da yadda take kama.
p-186.principle: Lokacin da haske ya fito daga ruwa zuwa iska, yana karkacewa kuma zurfin da yake kamawa ya zama $d'=\frac{d}{n}$. Refractive index na ruwa shi ne $n\approx1.33$, don haka $d'\approx0.75\,d$.
p-186.example: Ƙasan wurin ninƙaya mai zurfin gaske 2.0 m tana kama daga sama kamar $2.0/1.33\approx1.5$ m. Zurfin 3 m yana kama da kusan 2.3 m, bambancin 0.7 m ne.
p-186.actionItem: Kafin ka shiga wurin ninƙaya, duba alamar zurfin ruwa a bango, kuma kada ka tsallaka da kai a gaba a wurin da ba ka san zurfinsa ba.

p-187.title: Dalilin da ya sa ake haɗuwa da layin ruwa mai sanyi a teku
p-187.summary: A lokacin rani teku da tabkuna suna da ruwan dumi a sama da ruwan sanyi a ƙasa, don haka bayan ƴan matakai kaɗan zuwa zurfi za ka iya jin sanyi kwatsam.
p-187.principle: Ruwan saman da rana ta ɗumama yana da ƙarancin yawa $\rho(T)$ kuma yana iyo a sama, yayin da ruwan sanyi yana nutsewa ya samar da layi mai karko (thermocline). Idan layin yana karko, ruwan sama da ƙasa ba sa haɗuwa sosai, don haka zafi yana canzawa ba zato ba tsammani a iyaka.
p-187.example: Yawan ruwa kusan 997.0 ne a 25 °C kuma kusan 999.1 kg/m³ a 15 °C, don haka ko da bambancin kusan 0.2 % yana riƙe da layin. A tabkuna da teku, zafi yana faɗuwa 5~10 °C cikin ƴan mita, kuma idan iska ta tura ruwan saman, ruwan sanyi yana hawa sama kuma zafin ruwan bakin teku yana faɗuwa kwatsam.
p-187.actionItem: Kafin ka shiga zurfi, saka ƙafafu da ƙwauron ƙafa a hankali don jin canjin zafi, kuma a ranakun ruwa mai sanyi kada ka yi iyo nesa lokaci ɗaya.

p-188.title: Saurin faɗuwa cikin ruwa: daga tsayin 3 m kusan 28 km/h
p-188.summary: Idan ka yi tsalle daga tsayin 3 m, za ka bugi ruwa da kusan 28 km/h, don haka yana da haɗari a yi tsalle ba tare da sanin zurfin ruwa ba.
p-188.principle: Ba tare da juriyar iska ba, saurin daga tsayin faɗuwa $h$ bisa kiyaye ƙarfi shi ne $v=\sqrt{2gh}$.
p-188.example: Idan $h=3\ \mathrm{m}$, $v=\sqrt{2\times9.8\times3}\approx7.7\ \mathrm{m/s}\approx27.6\ \mathrm{km/h}$. Daga tsayin 10 m kusan 14 m/s (kusan 50 km/h), don haka idan tsayi ya fi sau 3, saurin yana zama kusan sau 1.8.
p-188.actionItem: Kafin tsalle ko nutsewa, duba alamar zurfi, kuma kada ka shiga ruwa da kai a gaba a wurin da ba ka san zurfinsa ba.

p-189.title: Duba abin da rigar bazara ke mayarwa maimakon launi
p-189.summary: A lokacin rani sanyin jiki yana dogara ne da yawan hasken rana da riga ke mayarwa da yadda iska ke ratsawa, fiye da sunan launi.
p-189.principle: Ƙarfin da riga ke sha shi ne $q=(1-\alpha)\,I$. $\alpha$ shi ne reflectivity (albedo) kuma $I$ shi ne hasken rana. Launuka masu haske suna da babban reflectivity na haske mai gani don haka suna sha ƙasa.
p-189.example: A hasken rana $I=1000\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$, farar riga mai reflectivity 0.7 tana sha kusan 300 W/m² kuma baƙar riga mai reflectivity 0.1 tana sha kusan 900 W/m², bambancin sau 3. Amma wasu yadudduka masu duhu suna toshe UV da kyau, don haka duba UPF ɗin ma.
p-189.actionItem: Idan za ka sayi rigar bazara, nemo launi mai haske da saƙa wanda iska ke ratsawa da kyau, kuma ka duba alamar UPF a kan lakabi.

p-190.title: Kwalaben gilashi masu ruwa da akwatin kifi na gilashi na iya zama tushen wuta
p-190.summary: Kwalba mai zagaye mai haske ko akwatin kifi mai ruwa na iya tara hasken rana kamar ruwan tabarau (lens) ya cinna wuta a abubuwa masu ƙonewa.
p-190.principle: Convex lens yana bin $\frac{1}{f}=\frac{1}{u}+\frac{1}{v}$, kuma hasken abubuwa masu nisa kamar Rana ($u\to\infty$) yana taruwa a focus $v=f$. Focal length na kwantena mai zagaye cike da ruwa shi ne $f\approx\frac{nD}{4(n-1)}$.
p-190.example: Kwalbar ruwa mai diamita $D=8\ \mathrm{cm}$ tana da $f\approx1.33\times8/(4\times0.33)\approx8\ \mathrm{cm}$. A hasken rana 1000 W/m², yankin giciye na kusan 50 cm² yana tara kusan 5 W waɗanda ke taruwa a ɗigo na ƙananan mm² kuma za su iya kaiwa zafin da ke ƙone takarda ko zane.
p-190.actionItem: Matsar da kwalabe na ruwa, akwatunan kifi da kayan ado na gilashi da ke wurin da rana ke shiga a tagogi, baranda ko mota zuwa inuwa, ko ka rufe su da zane mara haske.

p-191.title: Zaɓi kankana ta hanyar sautin da take yi idan an buga ta
p-191.summary: Kankana mai nuna tana da halin yin sauti mai zurfi mai amo, don haka sautin buguwa zai iya zama alama. Amma kada ka yanke hukunci da sauti kaɗai, ka duba nauyi da kamanni ma.
p-191.principle: Natural frequency na abu shi ne $f\propto\sqrt{k/m}$. Idan naman 'ya'yan itacen ya nuna, taurinsa $k$ yana raguwa kuma frequency yana ƙasa, yayin da wanda bai nuna ba yana yin sauti mai tsayi mai tauri.
p-191.example: Idan taurin $k$ ya ragu da 36 % zuwa $0.64k$ da taro iri ɗaya, frequency ya zama $\sqrt{0.64}=0.8$ sau, wato 20 % ƙasa. Idan girmansu iri ɗaya ne, zaɓi mafi nauyi mai tabo rawaya a ƙasa.
p-191.actionItem: Idan za ka sayi kankana, buga ta da hannu ka duba ko sautin yana da zurfi mai amo, ka zaɓi mafi nauyi a cikin masu girma ɗaya.

p-192.title: A hura tayoyin ruwa da ƙwallon bakin teku 80 % kawai
p-192.summary: A cikin zafin rana iska tana faɗaɗa don haka cikakkiyar tayar ruwa ko ƙwallon bakin teku na iya fashewa, kuma hura su 80 % kawai ya fi aminci.
p-192.principle: Daga ideal gas $PV=nRT$, a matsin lamba ɗaya $V\propto T$ (dokar Charles), kuma idan girma ya tsaya $P\propto T$. Ana lissafa zafi a absolute temperature (K).
p-192.example: Idan zafi ya tashi daga 25 °C (298 K) zuwa 50 °C (323 K), girma ya zama $323/298\approx1.084$ sau, wato 8.4 % ya ƙaru. Ko da 95 % ne cike, ya wuce iyaka, kuma a bayan motar da ke 60 °C (333 K) yana faɗaɗa da kusan 12 %.
p-192.actionItem: Hura tayoyin ruwa da ƙwallayen bakin teku 80~90 % kawai, kuma kada ka bar su dogon lokaci a cikin mota mai zafi ko ƙarƙashin hasken rana kai tsaye.

p-193.title: Me ya sa ɗigon ruwan sama ba ya yin zafi: saurin ƙarshe 9 m/s
p-193.summary: Ko ɗigon ruwan sama da ke faɗowa daga tsayin kilomita da yawa, saboda juriyar iska ba ya wuce kusan 30 km/h kuma ba ya yin zafi. Amma ƙanƙara tana da sauri kuma tana da haɗari.
p-193.principle: Idan nauyi da juriyar iska suka yi daidai, sauri yana tsayawa, kuma daga $mg=\tfrac{1}{2}\rho v^2C_dA$ saurin ƙarshe shi ne $v_t=\sqrt{\frac{2mg}{\rho C_dA}}$.
p-193.example: Ɗigon ruwan sama mai diamita 5 mm yana da kusan 9 m/s (kusan 32 km/h) kuma ɗigo mai 2 mm kusan 6.5 m/s. A cikin vacuum zai kai kusan 140 m/s bayan kilomita 1. Ƙanƙara mai diamita 2 cm tana da kusan 20 m/s (kusan 72 km/h) kuma za ta iya ɓata mota.
p-193.actionItem: A ranakun da ake hasashen ƙanƙara, duba hasashen yanayi ka ajiye mota a wurin da ke da rufi.

p-194.title: Juya iskar na'urar sanyaya zuwa sama
p-194.summary: Lokacin sanyaya, idan ka aika iska sama, iska mai sanyi tana sauka kuma ɗakin gaba ɗaya yana yin sanyi daidai.
p-194.principle: Yawan ideal gas shi ne $\rho=\frac{PM}{RT}$ kuma ya fi girma a ƙaramin zafi. Iska mai sanyi tana da nauyi tana nutsewa kuma iska mai zafi tana hawa, don haka natural convection yana faruwa.
p-194.example: A 1 atm iska a 18 °C (291 K) kusan 1.21 kg/m³ ce kuma a 28 °C (301 K) kusan 1.17 kg/m³, don haka iska mai sanyi ta fi nauyi da kusan 3.4 %. Idan ka aika iska sama, ba ta bugi mutane kai tsaye, don haka ko da ka ƙara saitin zafi da 1~2 °C har yanzu yana da daɗi kuma za a iya rage ƙarfi.
p-194.actionItem: Yau lokacin sanyaya, saita fika-fikan iska zuwa sama (ko kwance), kuma lokacin dumama zuwa ƙasa.

p-195.title: Kallon raƙuman ruwa daga tashar jirgin ruwa: ninka tsayin raƙuman ruwa sau 2 yana ninka ƙarfi sau 4
p-195.summary: Idan tsayin raƙuman ruwa ya ninka sau biyu, ƙarfin raƙuman yana ninka sau huɗu, don haka kallon raƙuman ruwa daga tashar jirgin ruwa ko duwatsun bakin teku yana da haɗari fiye da yadda ake tsammani.
p-195.principle: Ƙarfin kowane yanki na raƙuman ruwa na yau da kullum shi ne $E=\frac{1}{8}\rho g H^2$ kuma yana daidai da murabba'in tsayin raƙuman $H$.
p-195.example: A $\rho=1025\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, tsayin raƙuman 1 m kusan 1.26 kJ/m² ne kuma 2 m kusan 5.0 kJ/m², sau 4. Overtopping (raƙuman ruwa da ke tsallake tashar) na iya kwashe mutum lokaci ɗaya.
p-195.actionItem: A ranakun raƙuman ruwa masu tsayi, kada ka hau tashar jirgin ruwa ko duwatsun bakin teku, kuma duba tsayin raƙuman a hasashen teku kafin ka tashi.

p-196.title: Zafin wayar hannu a tsakiyar rani: cire murfin don kare tsawon rayuwa
p-196.summary: Zafi mai yawa yana rage tsawon rayuwar batir da sauri, don haka a tsakiyar rani cire murfin ka guji hasken rana kai tsaye don zafi ya fita da kyau.
p-196.principle: Thermal resistance na conduction shi ne $R=\frac{L}{kA}$, kuma idan aka samar da zafi $P$, bambancin zafi shi ne $\Delta T=PR$. Murfin insulation mai kauri $L$ yana ƙara $R$ yana sa zafi ya yi wuyar fita.
p-196.example: Idan murfin silicone mai kauri 2 mm da thermal conductivity $k\approx0.2\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$ ya rufe yanki 70 cm², $R\approx1.4\ \mathrm{K/W}$. Lokacin da ake samar da 3 W kamar a navigation, zafin yana ƙaruwa da kusan 4 °C. Batirin lithium-ion yana lalacewa da sauri sama da 35 °C, kuma saurin tsufa yana kusan ninkawa a kowane hauhawar zafi na kusan 10 °C.
p-196.actionItem: Lokacin amfani da navigation ko caji a ƙarƙashin rana, cire murfin ka ajiye wayar a inuwa ko wurin da iska ke ratsawa.

p-197.title: Frisbee yana tashi nesa kuma tsaye idan an ba shi juyawa
p-197.summary: Idan ka jefa frisbee ka ba shi juyawa da kuzarin wuyan hannu, yana tashi nesa kuma tsaye ba tare da girgiza ba, kuma jifar tana zama motsa jiki mai sauƙi ga jiki gaba ɗaya.
p-197.principle: Idan babu waje torque, angular momentum $L=I\omega$ ana kiyaye shi. Frisbee mai juyawa ana daidaita shi ta tasirin gyroscope inda alkibla ba ta canzawa cikin sauƙi.
p-197.example: Frisbee da aka ba shi kusan juyawa 5~8 a kowace daƙiƙa yana tashi cikin karko 30~40 m, amma idan aka jefa shi a kwance ba tare da juyawa ba, yana jujjuyawa ko faɗuwa cikin ƴan mita. A gudun iri ɗaya, ninka adadin juyawa yana ninka $L$, don haka ana buƙatar ninka torque don ɓata yanayinsa.
p-197.actionItem: Jefa frisbee a wurin shakatawa na mintuna 10 tare da kuzarin wuyan hannu. Kafin ka jefa, ɗan miƙa kafaɗu da wuyan hannu.

p-198.title: Ruwan da aka ɗumama a microwave ba ya kama da tafasa amma yana tsiriri kwatsam
p-198.summary: Idan ka ɗumama ruwa a kofi mai santsi a microwave na dogon lokaci, zai iya wuce wurin tafasa ba tare da tafasa ba sannan ya tafasa ya yi tsiriri a lokacin da ka taɓa shi, don haka za ka iya ƙonewa.
p-198.principle: Don kumfa ya samu, ana buƙatar ƙyalle ko barbashi a matsayin nuclei, amma kofi mai santsi da ruwa mai tsabta ba su da su, don haka ruwan yana superheating sama da wurin tafasa (100 °C). Idan aka buge shi ko aka ƙara foda, yana zama tururi nan take.
p-198.example: Ɗumama 250 mL daga 20 °C zuwa 100 °C yana buƙatar $Q=0.25\times4.18\times80\approx84\ \mathrm{kJ}$, kuma da microwave na 800 W yana ɗaukar kusan daƙiƙa 105. Idan ka ɗumama fiye da haka, wasu ɓangarori na iya wuce 100 °C kuma ko cokali ɗaya na foda yana sa kumfa ya zube.
p-198.actionItem: Lokacin ɗumama ruwa, saka sandar itace ko sandar microwave a ciki, bar shi daƙiƙa 30 bayan ɗumamawa kafin ka fitar da shi, kuma kada ka kawo fuskarka sama da kofin.

p-199.title: Ɗumama kaskon har sai ɗigon ruwa ya yi birgima kamar ƙwallo
p-199.summary: Kaskon stainless steel ana ɗumama shi ne har sai ɗigon ruwa ya yi birgima kamar ƙwallo, don abinci ya manne ƙasa kuma ana iya adana gas ta rashin ɗumamawa fiye da haka.
p-199.principle: Idan saman kaskon ya wuce kusan 200 °C, layin tururi yana samuwa ƙarƙashin ɗigon ruwa don haka ruwa ba ya tafasa nan take amma yana iyo yana birgima (tasirin Leidenfrost). Wannan zafi alama ce mai kyau ta ɗumamawa kafin saka mai.
p-199.example: Ɗumama kaskon stainless steel mai nauyi 1.2 kg (takamaiman zafi kusan 0.5 kJ/(kg·K)) daga 20 °C zuwa 200 °C yana buƙatar $Q=1.2\times0.5\times180\approx108\ \mathrm{kJ}$ (kusan 0.03 kWh). Idan ɗigon ya ɓace nan take da sautin tsiri, kaskon har yanzu kusan 150~190 °C ne.
p-199.actionItem: Digar da ɗigon ruwa a kaskon, idan ya yi birgima kamar ƙwallo, saka mai ka rage wuta.

p-200.title: A bangon gypsum, rarraba nauyi da anchors
p-200.summary: Allunan gypsum raunana ne don haka sukurori kawai suna faɗuwa cikin sauƙi, kuma dole ne a rarraba nauyi zuwa fili mai girma da anchors da ke buɗewa a baya.
p-200.principle: Matsin ɗauka shi ne $p=\frac{F}{A}$. Yayin da yankin tuntuɓa $A$ ya fi girma, matsin da ke kan allon gypsum a nauyi iri ɗaya yana raguwa. Wedge-expansion anchors da toggle anchors suna buɗewa a baya suna faɗaɗa yankin.
p-200.example: Idan hoto mai nauyin 10 kg ($F\approx98\ \mathrm{N}$) ana ɗaukarsa da sukurori ɗaya mai kusan 1 cm², matsin ya kai kusan 0.98 MPa, amma idan toggle anchor ya ɗauke shi a 8 cm², kusan 0.12 MPa ne, 1/8. Kowane anchor yana da nauyin da aka yarda daban, don haka duba lakabin samfurin.
p-200.actionItem: Sanya abubuwa masu nauyi a studs (ƙashin bango), ko ka zaɓi anchor mai isasshen nauyin da aka yarda.

p-201.title: Zafin launin kwan fitila a K: falo 3000K, ɗakin karatu 5000K
p-201.summary: Yayin da zafin launi na kwan fitila ya fi girma, hasken yana zama shuɗi da sanyi. Zaɓi K ƙasa don wuraren hutawa kuma K mai girma don wuraren karatu da aiki.
p-201.principle: Tsayin raƙuman da baƙin jiki mai zafi ke fitarwa da ƙarfi mafi girma shi ne dokar Wien $\lambda_{max}=\frac{b}{T}$, $b=2.898\times10^{-3}\ \mathrm{m\cdot K}$. Yayin da zafi ya ƙaru, yana matsawa zuwa shuɗi, kuma zafin launi na kwan fitila ƙima ce da aka kwatanta da launin hasken irin wannan baƙin jiki.
p-201.example: Baƙin jiki 3000 K yana da kololuwa a kusan 966 nm, 5000 K a kusan 580 nm da 6500 K a kusan 446 nm, don haka yana jin shuɗi yayin da ya fi girma. Ana amfani da 2700~3000 K (fari mai ɗumi) a falo da 4000~5000 K (hasken rana) a ɗakin karatu.
p-201.actionItem: Lokacin da za ka sayi kwan fitila, duba alamar K a kan kwali kuma ka zaɓi kusan 3000 K don falo da kusan 5000 K don ɗakin karatu.

p-202.title: Duba flicker na LED da slow-motion na waya
p-202.summary: Hasken LED na iya yin flicker ba tare da ganuwa ba, kuma samfura masu arha sun fi yin flicker mai girma wanda zai iya gajiyar da ido. Ana duba shi cikin sauƙi da hoton slow-motion.
p-202.principle: LED da aka gyara alternating current yana canza haske a sau biyu na mitar wutar lantarki, don haka yana yin flicker a 120 Hz a yankunan 60 Hz da 100 Hz a yankunan 50 Hz. Lokaci shi ne $T=\frac{1}{f}$, kuma a 120 Hz kusan 8.3 ms ne.
p-202.example: Idan ka nuna waya zuwa hasken a 240 fps slow-motion, tazarar frame kusan 4.2 ms ce don haka frames kusan 2 suna cikin zagaye ɗaya kuma ana ganin layuka ko canjin haske. Samfura masu zurfin flicker na iya sa wasu mutane gajiya a ido ko ciwon kai.
p-202.actionItem: Ɗauki bidiyon fitilar gidanka da slow-motion, kuma idan ka ga layuka, yi tunanin canza ta zuwa samfurin da ba ya yin flicker.

p-203.title: A gangara, yi amfani da engine brake don guje wa zafin birki
p-203.summary: Idan ka taka birki kawai a dogon gangara, zafi yana taruwa kuma ƙarfin birki yana raguwa, don haka kuma ka yi amfani da engine brake a ƙaramin gear. Yanke mai na iya adana mai ma.
p-203.principle: Ƙarfin matsayi da aka rasa $mgh$ da ƙarfin motsi da aka rage $\frac{1}{2}mv^2$ suna zama zafi a brake pads. Idan zafi ya yi yawa sosai, fading yana faruwa inda gogayya ke faɗuwa kwatsam.
p-203.example: Idan mota mai nauyin 1500 kg ta gangaro tsayin 500 m, kusan $1500\times9.8\times500\approx7.4\ \mathrm{MJ}$ (kusan 2 kWh) suna zama zafi. Ƙarfin motsi na tsayawa daga 100 km/h (27.8 m/s) ma kusan 580 kJ ne. Idan ka yi amfani da ƙaramin gear, juriyar injin tana rabawa wannan zafi.
p-203.actionItem: Kafin dogon gangara ya fara, canza zuwa ƙaramin gear don ka yi birki lokaci-lokaci kawai.

p-204.title: Idan ka girgiza hannuwanka yayin tafiya, kana amfani da ƙarancin ƙarfi
p-204.summary: Idan ka yi tafiya da girgiza hannuwa na halitta, kana amfani da ƙarancin ƙarfi kuma kana girgiza ƙasa fiye da idan ka riƙe hannuwa a tsaye.
p-204.principle: Hannu pendulum ne da ke girgiza a kafaɗa da natural period $T=2\pi\sqrt{L/g}$. Lokacin da tsarin tafiya da girgizar hannu suna resonance, ƙarfin da ake buƙata ya yi ƙasa, kuma hannayen da ke girgiza suna kawar da juyawar jiki na sama da ƙafafu ke samarwa.
p-204.example: Idan tsawon hannu mai tasiri $L\approx0.35\ \mathrm{m}$, $T\approx1.2\ \mathrm{s}$, daidai da zagayen mataki (kusan 1.1 s). Bisa bincike, amfani da ƙarfi a tafiya yana ƙaruwa kusan 10 % idan an hana girgizar hannu.
p-204.actionItem: Yau lokacin da kake tafiya, saki kafaɗunka ka yi tafiya na mintuna 10 da girgizar hannu ta halitta.

p-205.title: Me ya sa waƙa ke da daɗi a bandaki: sautin sake dawowa
p-205.summary: Tiles da gilashi a bandaki ba sa shan sauti sosai don haka sauti yana daɗe kuma waƙa tana da ƙarfi. A kiran bidiyo yana iya zama amo kuma ya dame ka.
p-205.principle: Reverberation time shi ne dokar Sabine $T=\frac{0.161\,V}{A}$. $V$ shi ne girman ɗaki (m³), kuma $A$ shi ne jimillar shan sauti (m²), jimillar yankunan saman da absorption coefficients.
p-205.example: Idan girma 7.2 m³, yankin sama kusan 23 m² kuma absorption coefficient na tile kusan 0.02, $A\approx0.46\ \mathrm{m^2}$ da $T\approx2.5\ \mathrm{s}$. Falo mai kafet da labule yana kusan daƙiƙa 0.4~0.6 don haka sauti yana ɓacewa da sauri.
p-205.actionItem: Idan za ka yi kira ko rikodi a bandaki, rataya tawul ko tabarma don rage sake dawowar sauti, ko ka koma ɗaki mai kayan laushi.

p-206.title: Bututun ruwan na'urar sanyaya dole ya yi gangara har ƙarshe
p-206.summary: Ruwan da na'urar sanyaya ke samarwa yana gudana ne ta nauyi kawai, don haka bututun fitarwa dole ya yi gangara har ƙarshe, kuma idan ya lanƙwasa ko ya yi kwaɓe a tsakiya, yana toshewa kuma ruwa na iya zubo cikin ɗaki.
p-206.principle: Ruwan da aka tara yana gudana daga sama zuwa ƙasa ta nauyi, kuma bututun yana buƙatar gangara ƙasa aƙalla 1 cm a kowace mita (gangara 1/100 ko fiye). Idan ruwa ya taru, gurɓata, toshewa da zubewa suna faruwa.
p-206.example: A ranakun danshi na'urar sanyaya tana samar da kusan 1 L na ruwa a awa. Bututu mai tsawon 5 m dole ƙarshensa ya zama ƙasa da farko aƙalla 5 cm. Idan zubewa ta jiƙa takardar bango da ƙasa, kashe kuɗin gyara yana da nauyi.
p-206.actionItem: Duba cewa bututun fitarwa yana gangara har ƙarshe, babu lanƙwasa ko kwaɓewa, kuma ƙarshensa ba ya nutse a ruwa.

p-207.title: A ƙarƙashin ruwa yana da wuya a san alkiblar sauti
p-207.summary: A ƙarƙashin ruwa sauti yana tafiya da sauri har bambancin lokaci tsakanin kunnuwa biyu ya ɓace, don haka yana da wuya a san daga wane gefe jirgi ko mutum ke zuwa.
p-207.principle: Saurin sauti kusan 343 m/s ne a iska da kusan 1500 m/s a ruwa. Ana ƙayyade alkibla ta bambancin lokaci tsakanin kunnuwa biyu $\Delta t=\frac{d\cos\theta}{v}$, amma idan $v$ ya yi girma, $\Delta t$ yana zama ƙarami sosai.
p-207.example: Idan tazarar kunnuwa $d\approx0.2\ \mathrm{m}$, mafi girman bambancin lokaci a iska kusan 0.58 ms ne amma a ruwa kusan 0.13 ms, 1/4.4. Kwakwalwa tana da wahalar bambantawa don haka ba za ka iya sanin inda sautin injin ke fitowa ba.
p-207.actionItem: Lokacin wasa a ruwa, yi ninƙaya a wurin da aka tsara kawai (cikin buoys) kuma ka ɗaga kai lokaci-lokaci don ka ga jiragen da ke kewaye da idonka.

p-208.title: Bindigar ruwa tana harbawa mafi nisa a digiri 45
p-208.summary: Idan juriyar iska ƙarama ce, rafin ruwa yana tafiya mafi nisa idan an harbo shi a digiri 45. Yi amfani da shi lokacin gasar nisa a wasan ruwa.
p-208.principle: Nisan harba daga tsayi ɗaya shi ne $R=\frac{v^2\sin2\theta}{g}$ kuma ya fi girma a $\theta=45^\circ$ inda $\sin2\theta$ ya fi girma. A gaskiya kusurwar da ta fi dacewa na iya zama ƙasa kaɗan saboda juriyar iska.
p-208.example: Rafin ruwa mai 10 m/s a digiri 45 $R=10^2/9.8\approx10.2\ \mathrm{m}$, kuma a digiri 30 ko 60 $\sin60^\circ\approx0.866$ don haka kusan 8.8 m ne, kusan 86 %.
p-208.actionItem: Lokacin harba bindigar ruwa, gwada canza kusurwa don gano kusurwar da ke tafiya mafi nisa, amma kada ka nuna wa fuska ko idon wani.

p-209.title: Ƙwallo yana lanƙwasa saboda juyawa, ƙarfin Magnus
p-209.summary: Ƙwallon da ke tashi yana juyawa yana lanƙwasa zuwa gefe ɗaya, saboda juyawa yana sa matsin iska ya bambanta a gefuna biyu na ƙwallon.
p-209.principle: Lokacin da ƙwallo mai juyawa ke tafiya cikin iska, ƙarfin $\vec F=S(\vec\omega\times\vec v)$ yana samuwa, wanda ke tsaye zuwa saurin $\vec v$ da axis ɗin juyawa $\vec\omega$ (ƙarfin Magnus). Iskar da ke gefe ɗaya tana yin sauri kuma bambancin matsin lamba yana samuwa.
p-209.example: Free kick na ƙwallon ƙafa a 108 km/h (30 m/s) tare da kusan juyawa 8 a daƙiƙa na iya lanƙwasa gefe kusan 3~4 m a tafiyar 25 m. Ba tare da juyawa ba, ƙwallon yana tashi kusan a kai tsaye.
p-209.actionItem: Lokacin da kake buga ƙwallo a wurin shakatawa, ba shi juyawa gefe da cikin ƙafa ka lura yadda alkiblar lanƙwasa ke canzawa.

p-210.title: Sararin sama a bakin teku yana nesa kusan kilomita 4.7 ne kawai
p-210.summary: Daga tsayin ido 1.7 m, nisan sararin samaniyar teku kusan kilomita 4.7 ne kawai, don haka teku mai nisa da ake gani daga bakin teku ya fi kusa fiye da yadda ake tsammani.
p-210.principle: Saboda Duniya zagaye ce, nisan sararin sama daga tsayin ido $h$ (m) shi ne $d\approx3.57\sqrt{h}$ km. Wannan ƙima ta riga ta ƙunshi gyaran refraction na yanayi.
p-210.example: A tsayin ido 1.7 m, $d\approx3.57\times\sqrt{1.7}\approx4.65$ km, kuma daga tsayin gini na bakin teku 10 m kusan 11.3 km. Jirgin da ke zuwa daga nesa yana ɓacewar jikinsa da farko kuma ana ganin mast ɗinsa kawai.
p-210.actionItem: Duba jirgi mai nisa a teku daga bakin teku ka lura yadda jikin jirgin ke ɓacewa bayan sararin sama kuma mast ɗin kawai ya rage.

p-211.title: Gwada maɓallin gwajin earth-leakage breaker kowane wata a lokacin damina
p-211.summary: A lokacin damina mai danshi haɗarin leakage yana ƙaruwa, don haka kowane wata duba da maɓallin gwaji cewa earth-leakage breaker yana aiki yadda ya kamata.
p-211.principle: Earth-leakage breaker yana gano bambancin wutar da ke shiga da fita $I_\Delta=|I_{in}-I_{out}|$ kuma yawanci yana yanke wuta cikin kusan daƙiƙa 0.03 a nominal sensitivity na 30 mA ko fiye. Maɓallin gwaji da gangan yana samar da wannan bambanci don tabbatar da aiki.
p-211.example: Leakage current na 30 mA na iya zama haɗari idan mutum ya taɓa shi, don haka dole a yanke shi nan take a wannan ƙima. Idan ka danna maɓallin gwaji, lever ɗin ya sauka kuma wutar ta mutu abu ne na al'ada.
p-211.actionItem: Ajiye fayilolin da kake aiki a kai, danna maɓallin gwaji na earth-leakage breaker ka ga ko yana yanke, kuma idan bai yanke ba, nemi ma'aikacin lantarki ya duba.

p-212.title: Duba infrared na remote na na'urar sanyaya da kyamarar waya
p-212.summary: Idan na'urar sanyaya ba ta amsa remote, duba da kyamarar wayarka ko remote yana fitar da sigina don guje wa kiran gyara maras amfani.
p-212.principle: Infrared LED na remote yana aika sigina a kusan 940 nm (tsayin raƙuma da ba a gani da ido) kuma ƙarfin photon shi ne $E=\frac{hc}{\lambda}\approx\frac{1240\ \mathrm{eV\cdot nm}}{940\ \mathrm{nm}}\approx1.32\ \mathrm{eV}$. CMOS sensor na kyamara yana gano wannan haske ya nuna shi a matsayin haske mai haske a allo.
p-212.example: Idan ka nuna remote ga ruwan tabarau na kyamara ka danna maɓalli kuma ka ga haske mai shuɗi mai duhu ko fari yana kiftawa a allo, remote yana lafiya. Idan ba ka gani ba, da farko canza batura (yawanci AAA 2) ko duba remote. Wasu kyamarorin gaba suna da infrared filter mai rauni kuma suna nuna shi da kyau.
p-212.actionItem: Kunna kyamarar gaban waya ka danna maɓalli a remote ka ga ko haske ya bayyana.

p-213.title: Dalilin da ya sa nauyinka ke canzawa lokacin da lif ke tashi da tsayawa
p-213.summary: Lokacin da lif ya fara hawa jiki yana jin nauyi, kuma idan ya tsaya yana jin sauƙi. Ba nauyinka ne ke canzawa ba, ƙarfin da ƙasa ke turawa ne ke canzawa.
p-213.principle: A cikin lif da ke motsi da acceleration ɗin sama $a$, ƙarfin da ƙasa ke tura mutum (normal force) shi ne $N=m(g+a)$. Ma'aunin yana karanta wannan ƙima don haka nauyin da ake gani yana canzawa.
p-213.example: Idan mutum mai 70 kg ya hanzarta sama da 1 m/s², $N=70\times(9.8+1)\approx756\ \mathrm{N}$ kuma ma'auni yana nuna kusan 77 kg. Lokacin da lif ya tsaya daga hawa tare da acceleration ƙasa 1 m/s², yana jin kamar kusan 63 kg.
p-213.actionItem: Lokacin da lif ke farawa da tsayawa, ɗan lanƙwasa gwiwoyi ka kama hannun ƙarfe don kiyaye daidaito.

p-214.title: Gefen dama na alkiblar guguwa ya fi haɗari
p-214.summary: A arewacin duniya iska tana ƙara ƙarfi a gefen dama na alkiblar guguwa, don haka a yankunan dama na hanyar guguwa ya kamata a shirya don lalacewa mafi girma.
p-214.principle: Guguwa tana da iska mai juyawa a kishiyar agogo $v_{rot}$ da saurin motsin guguwar $v_{move}$, don haka a gefen dama na alkibla ana haɗa saurin biyu, kuma a hagu ana rage su: $v_{wind}=v_{rot}\pm v_{move}$.
p-214.example: Tare da iska mai juyawa 40 m/s da saurin motsi 8 m/s, gefen dama kusan 48 m/s ne kuma hagu kusan 32 m/s, kuma matsin iska yana daidai da murabba'in sauri, don haka bambancin $(48/32)^2=2.25$ sau ne. Wannan yankin dama ana kiransa dangerous semicircle.
p-214.actionItem: Idan akwai guguwa, duba hanyar da ake hasashe daga hukumar yanayi, kuma idan kana gefen dama na hanya, soke ko jinkirta fita da tafiye-tafiyen bakin teku.

p-215.title: Ninka saurin iska sau 2 yana ninka matsin iska sau 4
p-215.summary: Idan saurin iska ya ninka sau biyu, ƙarfin da ke kan tagogi da alamu yana ninka sau huɗu, don haka kada ka kimanta guguwa da jin raunin iska.
p-215.principle: Ƙarfin da iska ke yi a kan yanki $A$ shi ne $F=\frac{1}{2}\rho v^2A$ (ana zaton drag coefficient kusan 1) kuma yana daidai da murabba'in sauri. Yawan iska shi ne $\rho\approx1.225\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.
p-215.example: A kan taga 1 m², saurin iska 20 m/s $F\approx245\ \mathrm{N}$ ne kuma 40 m/s kusan 980 N (kusan 100 kgf), sau 4. Manyan tagogin gilashi suna ɗaukar ƙarfi fiye da haka sosai.
p-215.actionItem: Kafin guguwa, duba makullan tagogi, kuma lokacin guguwa ka nisanci tagogi.

p-216.title: Idan taga ta yi hayaniya cikin iska mai ƙarfi, yi amfani da gasket
p-216.summary: Taga tana yin hayaniya cikin iska domin girgizar ta yi daidai da natural frequency na taga, don haka idan ka manne gasket a gibin, za ka iya rage hayaniya da iskar da ke shigowa duka.
p-216.principle: Natural frequency na firam ɗin taga shi ne $f=\frac{1}{2\pi}\sqrt{\frac{k}{m}}$. Idan mitar iska tana kusa da $f$, resonance yana faruwa kuma taga tana girgiza sosai. Gasket yana ƙara damping kuma yana canza taurin $k$ don guje wa resonance.
p-216.example: Idan sash na taga mai nauyin 8 kg ana tallafa masa da $k=80\ \mathrm{kN/m}$, $f=\frac{1}{2\pi}\sqrt{80000/8}\approx15.9\ \mathrm{Hz}$. Idan $k$ ya ninka da gasket, yana hawa zuwa kusan 22.5 Hz kuma damping yana ƙaruwa don haka hayaniya tana raguwa. Idan aka toshe gibi, iskar sanyi ta lokacin sanyi ma tana raguwa kuma ana iya adana ƙarfin dumama.
p-216.actionItem: Manne gasket mai kauri 5~10 mm a gibin firam ɗin taga ka ga ko hayaniyar tana raguwa.

p-217.title: Me ya sa tarpaulin na sansani ke ɗagawa cikin iska
p-217.summary: Iska mai sauri da ke wucewa saman tarpaulin tana rage matsin lamba kuma tana ɗaga zane, don haka a ranakun iska yadda ake ɗaure tarpaulin yana tantance aminci.
p-217.principle: Bisa ƙa'idar Bernoulli matsin lamba yana raguwa inda saurin ruwa ya fi girma, kuma bambancin matsin sama da ƙasa shi ne $\Delta P\approx\frac{1}{2}\rho v^2$. Wannan bambancin matsin lamba yana zama ɗagawa da ke ɗaga zane.
p-217.example: A saurin iska 10 m/s, $\Delta P\approx\frac{1}{2}\times1.225\times10^2\approx61\ \mathrm{Pa}$, don haka tarpaulin 4 m × 4 m (16 m²) na iya ɗaukar ƙarfi har zuwa kusan 980 N (kusan 100 kgf). A 20 m/s yana ninka sau 4.
p-217.actionItem: Lokacin da za ka sayi tarpaulin, duba adadin eyelets da ƙarfafawa, kuma lokacin kafawa saita gefen ƙasa a alkiblar iska ka kafa pegs a karkace kuma a zurfi.

p-218.title: Kunna fan na mintuna 10 kafin ka kashe na'urar sanyaya
p-218.summary: Idan ka kunna fan na kusan mintuna 10 kafin ka kashe na'urar sanyaya, ciki yana bushewa kuma ƙamshin mold zai iya raguwa kuma ba ya ƙara kuɗin wuta kusan da komai.
p-218.principle: Bayan sanyaya, digon ruwa da suka taru suna ragewa a evaporator. Saurin evaporation yana daidai da bambancin saturated vapor pressure da ainihin vapor pressure $(p_s-p)$, don haka idan aka tura iska mai danshi da fan, yana bushewa da sauri.
p-218.example: Ƙarfin yanayin fan kusan 40 W ne kuma cikin mintuna 10 yana zama $40\times\frac{10}{60}\approx6.7\ \mathrm{Wh}$ kawai. Idan danshi ya rage, mold da ƙwayoyin cuta suna ƙaruwa suna samar da ƙamshi, wanda zai iya kai ga kuɗin tsabtace na'urar da rage aiki.
p-218.actionItem: Yau kafin ka kashe na'urar sanyaya, kunna fan ko yanayin bushewa na mintuna 10, ko kunna aikin bushewa na atomatik idan akwai.

p-219.title: Ɗaure bel koyaushe yayin turbulence a jirgi
p-219.summary: Turbulence tana zuwa ba tare da gargaɗi ba, don haka mafi tabbacin hanyar hana rauni ita ce koyaushe ɗaure bel ɗin aminci idan kana zaune.
p-219.principle: Bisa dokar Newton ta biyu $F=ma$, idan jirgi ya yi acceleration mai ƙarfi a tsaye, acceleration iri ɗaya yana shafar jiki. Idan acceleration na tsaye $\pm1\,g$, nauyin da ake gani yana zama 0 ko ninki biyu.
p-219.example: Mutum mai 70 kg yana fuskantar canjin ƙarfi na kusan $0.5\times70\times9.8\approx343\ \mathrm{N}$ ko da a matsakaicin turbulence na $\pm0.5\,g$. A turbulence mai ƙarfi na 1 g ko fiye, wanda bai ɗaure bel ba na iya tashi daga kujera ya bugi rufin jirgi.
p-219.actionItem: Yayin da kake zaune a kujerarka a lokacin tashi, ɗaure bel ɗin aminci daidai a ƙasan ƙugu.

p-220.title: Motar da ke ƙarƙashin ruwa ƙofarta ba za ta buɗe ba
p-220.summary: Ƙofar motar da ta nutse a ruwa ba za ta buɗe ba saboda matsin ruwa, don haka dole ka gaggauta tserewa ta taga maimakon ƙofa.
p-220.principle: Ƙarfin da ruwa ke yi a kan ƙofa shi ne matsin da ya yi daidai da matsakaicin zurfi ya ninka yankin, $F=\rho g\frac{h}{2}A$. Har sai matakin ruwa a cikin da wajen ƙofar ya yi daidai, dole ne a buɗe a kan wannan ƙarfi.
p-220.example: Idan faɗin ƙofa 1.0 m da matakin ruwa 0.5 m (yanki 0.5 m²), $F=1000\times9.8\times0.25\times0.5\approx1225\ \mathrm{N}$, wato kusan 125 kgf. Tagogin lantarki na iya daina aiki nan da nan. Dole a yi aiki nan take lokacin da mota ta fara nutsewa, kafin ruwa ya cika.
p-220.actionItem: Ajiye nauyin karya taga (kayan fasa gilashi) a wurin da hannu ke kaiwa a cikin mota, kuma kada ka shiga hanyar da ruwa ya malalo.

p-221.title: Cire kayan lantarki daga wuta lokacin tsawa
p-221.summary: Lokacin walƙiya, ƙarfin lantarki mai yawa (surge) yana shiga igiyoyi kuma zai iya lalata talabijin da kwamfuta, don haka cire su daga wuta kafin tsawa ta fara.
p-221.principle: Idan walƙiya na canzawa da sauri, ƙarfin lantarki $V=-M\frac{dI}{dt}$ yana shiga madaukai na waya da ke kusa ($M$ shi ne mutual inductance). Yayin da canjin current ya fi girma, kV da yawa suna samuwa.
p-221.example: Idan $M=1\ \mathrm{\mu H}$ da $dI/dt=6\times10^9\ \mathrm{A/s}$, $V\approx6\ \mathrm{kV}$, wanda ya wuce kusan 1.5~2.5 kV da na'urorin gida na 220 V ke iya jurewa. Amma kada ka je cire caji lokacin da walƙiya ke faɗuwa kai tsaye sama da kai.
p-221.actionItem: Kafin guguwa, cire talabijin, kwamfuta da router, ko amfani da surge-protected strip, kuma kada ka taɓa igiyoyi da na'urori lokacin tsawa.

p-222.title: A shigar da tukwanen baranda kafin guguwa
p-222.summary: Tukwanen da guguwa ta hura ko suka faɗi na iya kashe mutane a ƙasa, don haka a shigar da tukwanen baranda da abubuwa kafin lokaci.
p-222.principle: Ƙarfin abin da ke faɗuwa daga tsayi $h$ shi ne $mgh$, kuma saurin faɗuwa ba tare da juriyar iska ba shi ne $v=\sqrt{2gh}$. Haɗari yana ƙaruwa da nauyi da tsayi.
p-222.example: Idan tukunya mai nauyin 5 kg ta faɗo daga tsayin kusan 30 m (bene na 10), $v\approx24\ \mathrm{m/s}$ (kusan 87 km/h) kuma ƙarfin kusan $5\times9.8\times30\approx1470\ \mathrm{J}$ ne. Wannan yayi daidai da ƙarfin abu mai nauyin kusan 3.8 kg da ke zuwa da kusan 100 km/h.
p-222.actionItem: Idan aka yi hasashen guguwa, shigar da tukwane, busar da tufafi da ƙananan kayan daki daga ƙarfen baranda ka kulle tagogi.

p-223.title: Ciwon teku ya fi sauƙi a tsakiyar jirgin a ƙananan benaye
p-223.summary: Tsakiyar jirgin da ƙananan benaye suna motsi mafi ƙanƙanta kuma ciwon teku ya fi sauƙi, don haka zaɓi wannan wuri lokacin da za ka zaɓi ɗaki ko kujera.
p-223.principle: Jirgi yana girgiza a kusa da cibiyar nauyi, don haka girman motsin matsayi yana daidai da nisa daga cibiyar juyawa ($s\approx r\theta$). Idan abin da idanu ke gani da jin balance organ a kunne ba su daidaita ba, ciwon teku yana faruwa.
p-223.example: A girgizar gefe $\pm2^\circ$ (0.035 rad), gaban jirgi nisan 40 m daga tsakiya yana motsi kusan $\pm1.4\ \mathrm{m}$ kuma tsakiya nisan 5 m kusan $\pm0.17\ \mathrm{m}$, bambancin sau 8. Yayin da benen ya fi tsayi, motsin yana ƙaruwa.
p-223.actionItem: Lokacin da za ka yi booking na jirgi, zaɓi ɗaki a tsakiyar jiki a ƙaramin bene, kuma bayan hawa ka kalli sararin sama.

p-224.title: Ana ganin taurari masu faɗuwa bayan idanu sun saba da duhu a mintuna 20
p-224.summary: Idan ka fito daga wuri mai haske don ka ga taurari masu faɗuwa, idanunka suna ɗaukar mintuna 20~30 kafin su saba da duhu, don haka kafin lokacin ba za ka ga meteors masu rauni ba.
p-224.principle: A wurare masu duhu, rod cells suna zama masu saurin ji da haske, photopigments suna sake samuwa, kuma ƙaramin haske da ake buƙata don gani yana raguwa sosai da lokaci. Cikakken saba wa rod cells yana ɗaukar mintuna 20~30, kuma saba da duhu yana ɓacewa idan hasken allon waya ya same su.
p-224.example: Bayan idanu sun saba da duhu, ji da haske ya fi na haske sau kusan 10,000 ko fiye. Perseids suna da kololuwa kusan 12~13 ga Agusta kowace shekara, kuma a wuraren da ba a samu hasken wata da na birni sosai ana iya ganin dozin da yawa a awa.
p-224.actionItem: Lokacin da za ka je kallon meteor shower, kada ka kalli waya na mintuna 20 a wuri mafi duhu, ka kalli sararin sama a faɗi.

p-225.title: Dalilin da ba a ganin allo a waje da rana: luminance da hasken da ke mayarwa
p-225.summary: Rashin ganin allo a haske mai ƙarfi a waje ba don allon duhu ba ne, sai don hasken rana da saman allon ke mayarwa yana rufe hasken allon.
