p-225.principle: Contrast ratio shi ne $CR=\frac{L+L_a}{L_a}$, inda $L$ shi ne luminance na allo (nit), kuma $L_a=\frac{RE}{\pi}$ shi ne luminance na hasken kewaye da saman ke mayarwa ($R$ reflectivity, $E$ illuminance). Idan hasken da ake mayarwa ya ƙaru, contrast ratio yana kusantar 1.
p-225.example: A hasken rana kai tsaye $E=100{,}000\ \mathrm{lx}$ da reflectivity $R=2\%$, $L_a\approx637\ \mathrm{nit}$. Allo mai 800 nit yana da $CR\approx(800+637)/637\approx2.3$:1 kuma kusan ba a ganin sa, yayin da a ɗaki mai 300 lx $L_a\approx1.9\ \mathrm{nit}$ kuma $CR$ ɗaruruwa ne.
p-225.actionItem: A ranakun rana mai ƙarfi, saita hasken allo zuwa mafi girma ko atomatik, kuma yi inuwa a kan allo da jiki ko hannu.

p-226.title: Dalilin da compass na taswira ke karkacewa a tafiya
p-226.summary: Compass na waya yana karanta raunin filin maganadisu na Duniya, don haka alkibla tana karkacewa cikin sauƙi da maganadisu ko ƙarfe da ke kusa.
p-226.principle: Filin maganadisu na Duniya kusan $50\ \mu\mathrm{T}$ ne (a Korea) kuma yana da rauni sosai, don haka idan filin maganadisu $B_{int}$ daga abubuwan maganadisu da ke kusa ya ƙara, kuskuren alkibla $\theta\approx\arctan\frac{B_{int}}{B_{earth}}$ yana samuwa.
p-226.example: Ko da murfin maganadisu ko mariƙin mota ya ƙara $10\ \mu\mathrm{T}$ kawai, kuskuren shi ne $\arctan(10/50)\approx11^\circ$. Bugu da ƙari Korea tana da bambancin kusan 8° tsakanin arewa ta maganadisu da arewa ta gaskiya, don haka bambancin arewar taswira da arewar maganadisu ma dole a yi la'akari da shi.
p-226.actionItem: Idan aikace-aikacen taswira yana nuna alkibla da ban mamaki, daidaita compass ta hanyar juya waya kamar lamba 8, kuma ka nisanci maganadisu da ƙarfe.

p-227.title: A kowace tsayin 100 m na dutse, zafi yana faɗuwa digiri 0.65
p-227.summary: Manyan duwatsu suna da sanyi fiye da ƙasa mai faɗi a rana ɗaya, don haka idan ka shirya tufafi bisa zafin ƙasa kawai, za ka yi sanyi a kan dutse.
p-227.principle: Zafin yanayi yana raguwa da tsayi tare da matsakaicin lapse rate $\Gamma\approx6.5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C/km}$. Idan bambancin tsayi $\Delta z$, zafi yana canzawa da $\Delta T=-\Gamma\Delta z$.
p-227.example: Idan 30 °C ne a wurin farawa mai tsayin 100 m sama da teku, a kololuwar Cheonwangbong na Jirisan (1915 m) shi ne $30-0.65\times18.15\approx18.2\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Idan akwai iska, zafin da ake ji yana ƙara ƙasa.
p-227.actionItem: Kafin ka tafi dutse, duba hasashen zafi a tsayin kololuwa ka saka jaket mai hana iska a jaka.

p-228.title: Tropical night: bango yana sakin zafin da ya tara da rana da dare
p-228.summary: Zafin da ake ji a tropical nights yana fitowa daga zafin da bango da bene suka tara da rana, don haka a toshe rana da rana kuma a bar iska ta shiga da dare.
p-228.principle: Kayan da ke tara zafi kamar concrete suna adana zafi $Q=mc\Delta T$ idan zafi ya hauhawa, kuma suna sakin wannan zafi idan ɗaki ya yi sanyi. Yayin da taro da takamaiman zafi suka fi girma, ajiyar ta fi girma.
p-228.example: Bangon concrete mai kauri 20 cm da yanki 10 m² (taro kusan 4800 kg, takamaiman zafi kusan 0.88 kJ/(kg·K)) yana adana $Q\approx4800\times0.88\times5\approx21\ \mathrm{MJ}$ (kusan 5.9 kWh) idan ya hau 5 °C. Wannan zafi yana fita a hankali zuwa ɗaki duk dare.
p-228.actionItem: Da rana rufe taga mai rana da labule ko blinds, kuma da dare idan zafin waje ya fi na ciki ƙasa, buɗe taga don iska ta shiga sannan saita na'urar sanyaya zuwa 26~27 °C.

p-229.title: Yi wanka mai ɗumi sa'o'i 1~2 kafin barci
p-229.summary: Wanka mai ɗumi sa'o'i 1~2 kafin kwanciya yana fitar da zafi daga jiki ya samar da canjin zafi da ke sauƙaƙa barci.
p-229.principle: Idan ruwan ɗumi ya faɗaɗa jijiyoyin jini na waje, zafi yana fita ta fata kuma zafin cibiyar jiki yana raguwa: $q = hA(T_s - T_a)$.
p-229.example: Idan ka yi wanka na mintuna 10 da ruwan kusan 40°C ka kwanta bayan sa'o'i 1~2, binciken ya nuna lokacin yin barci ya ragu da matsakaicin kusan mintuna 10.
p-229.actionItem: Yau da dare gwada yin wanka na mintuna 10 da ruwan kusan 40°C sa'o'i 1~2 kafin barci.

p-230.title: Plunger yana buɗe toshewa idan aka ja, ba idan aka tura ba
p-230.summary: Plunger kayan aiki ne inda ake sa kofin ya nutse a ruwa a manne sannan a ja da ƙarfi don girgiza toshewa a fitar da ita.
p-230.principle: Bambancin matsin lamba a ciki da wajen kofin yana samar da ƙarfi: $F = \Delta P \cdot A$. Dole a cika shi da ruwa, ba iska ba, don matsin ya isa ba tare da canji ba.
p-230.example: Idan yankin kofin $0.01\ \mathrm{m^2}$ da $\Delta P = 5\ \mathrm{kPa}$, ƙarfin kusan 50 N (kusan 5 kgf) yana shafar toshewar.
p-230.actionItem: Yau, tabbatar da kofin plunger ya nutse a ruwa a magudanar, manna shi, danna a hankali sannan ja da ƙarfi, ka maimaita sau 10 (kada ka yi amfani da sinadarai tare).

p-231.title: Sukurori masu zare mai ƙyalle suna shiga da ƙaramin ƙarfi
p-231.summary: Yayin da tazarar zare (pitch) ke ƙasa, za ka iya ƙara matse da ƙarfi iri ɗaya, don haka sukurori masu sirara suna da fa'ida a itace mai tauri.
p-231.principle: Ideal mechanical advantage na sukurori shi ne $MA = \dfrac{2\pi r}{p}$ ($r$: radius na screwdriver, $p$: pitch).
p-231.example: A $r = 2\ \mathrm{mm}$, pitch 1.0 mm yana ba $MA \approx 12.6$ kuma 0.5 mm yana ba $MA \approx 25$, don haka ana buƙatar rabin ƙarfi (ba tare da la'akari da gogayya ba).
p-231.actionItem: Yau zaɓi sukurori masu pitch ƙanana don itace mai tauri, kuma ka haƙa ƙaramin rami da farko.

p-232.title: Motsa jiki da band na roba yana ba da juriya daban-daban bisa tsayi
p-232.summary: Maƙallan roba suna da juriya kusan daidai da tsawon da aka miƙa, don haka miƙa su zuwa tsawo ɗaya shi ne ma'aunin ƙarfin motsa jiki.
p-232.principle: Dokar Hooke: $F = kx$ (band na roba ba linear ba ne idan aka miƙa sosai, don haka ƙiyasi ne).
p-232.example: Band mai $k = 100\ \mathrm{N/m}$ yana ba da juriya kusan 30 N a miƙa 0.3 m da kusan 60 N a miƙa 0.6 m.
p-232.actionItem: Yau lokacin da kake motsa jiki da band, yi alamar tazarar hannu ka miƙa shi zuwa tsawo ɗaya kowane lokaci.

p-233.title: Iska mai sanyi kafin ruwan sama alama ce ta neman mafaka
p-233.summary: Iska mai sanyi da ke tashi kwatsam kafin guguwa ita ce downdraft mai sanyi na tsawa kuma alama ce cewa walƙiya da iska mai ƙarfi za su zo nan da nan.
p-233.principle: Iska mai sanyi tana da yawa mafi girma, don haka tana nutsewa tana yaɗuwa: $\rho = \dfrac{P}{R_s T}$.
p-233.example: A 1 atm yawan iska kusan $1.165\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ ne a 30°C da kusan $1.204\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ a 20°C, kusan 3 % ya fi nauyi, kuma iskar na iya kaiwa 60~90 km/h.
p-233.actionItem: Idan yau a waje iska mai sanyi ta tashi kwatsam kuma ka ji tsawa, shiga gini ko mota nan take.

p-234.title: Na'urar sanyaya mota: da farko iska ta waje, idan ya yi sanyi recirculation
p-234.summary: Nan da nan bayan shiga, buɗe tagogi don fitar da iska mai zafi, kuma idan ciki ya yi sanyi canza zuwa recirculation don a rage nauyin sanyaya.
p-234.principle: Nauyin sanyaya yana daidai da kwararar iska da bambancin zafi: $\dot{Q} = \dot{m}\, c_p\, \Delta T$.
p-234.example: A $\dot{m} = 0.1\ \mathrm{kg/s}$ da $c_p = 1.005\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$, iskar waje 35°C→22°C kusan 1.3 kW ne kuma iska mai maimaitawa 25°C→22°C kusan 0.3 kW.
p-234.actionItem: Yau idan ka shiga mota, buɗe tagogi na minti 1 don iska ta shiga, kuma idan ya yi sanyi canza zuwa recirculation (a dogon tafiya a lokaci-lokaci a yi iska da iska ta waje).

p-235.title: Hoton dare mai gudu: yi amfani da ƙa'idar rufe 1/focal length
p-235.summary: Lokacin ɗaukar hoto da hannu, za ka iya rage ɓatar hoton da girgiza ke haifarwa sosai ta hanyar riƙe lokacin rufe ƙasa da juyayyen focal length na ruwan tabarau.
p-235.principle: Ƙa'idar yatsa: $t \le \dfrac{1}{f}$ ($t$ daƙiƙu idan focal length da aka mayar zuwa full-frame $f$ mm).
p-235.example: Ruwan tabarau 50 mm yana da aminci a kusan 1/50 daƙiƙa ko ƙasa da haka kuma 200 mm a kusan 1/200 daƙiƙa ko ƙasa, kuma idan duhu ne dole a ƙara ISO ko a daidaita jiki.
p-235.actionItem: Yau lokacin ɗaukar hoton dare, manne gwiwar hannunka da jikinka ko ka jingina da bango ka ɗauki hoto da timer na daƙiƙa 2.

p-236.title: Wutar sansani tana ci da kyau idan an tara itace a tsaye
p-236.summary: Idan ka tara itace a tsaye ka jingina su a karkace, iska tana tsotsowa daga ƙasa saboda tasirin bututun hayaƙi kuma wuta tana kama da kyau.
p-236.principle: Ɗaukar iska daga ginshiƙin iska mai zafi: $\Delta P \approx \rho g h \dfrac{\Delta T}{T}$.
p-236.example: A tsayi $h = 0.5\ \mathrm{m}$, 600 K a wurin harshen wuta da 300 K a waje, $\Delta P \approx 1.2 \times 9.8 \times 0.5 \times \dfrac{300}{600} \approx 3\ \mathrm{Pa}$.
p-236.actionItem: A sansaninka yau, tara itace a tsaye kamar ƙaramin tanti, amma ka ajiye ruwa kusa kuma kada ka yi wuta a wuraren da aka hana buɗaɗɗiyar wuta.

p-237.title: Ko da ƙanƙara ta narke, ruwan da ke cikin gilashi ba ya zubewa
p-237.summary: Ƙanƙarar da ke iyo a ruwa ba ta canza matakin ruwa idan ta narke, don haka ko cikakken gilashi ba ya zubewa.
p-237.principle: Ƙanƙarar da ke iyo tana kora ruwa daidai da nauyinta: $V_{\mathrm{d}} = \dfrac{m}{\rho_w}$, kuma girman ruwan da ya narke shi ma $\dfrac{m}{\rho_w}$.
p-237.example: Ƙanƙara 90 g tana kora ruwa 90 mL (kusan $8\ \mathrm{cm^3}$ ne kawai daga jimillar girma kusan $98\ \mathrm{cm^3}$ ke fitowa sama), kuma idan ta narke ta zama 90 mL don haka matakin ruwa iri ɗaya ne.
p-237.actionItem: Yau cika gilashi da ƙanƙara da ruwa ka duba matakin ruwa har sai duka sun narke (kada ka danna da hannu).

p-238.title: Duba ma'aunin matsin na'urar kashe wuta cewa yana cikin yankin kore
p-238.summary: Na'urar kashe wuta mai matsin lamba tana aiki ne idan allurar ma'auni tana yankin kore (al'ada 0.7~0.98 MPa).
p-238.principle: Matsin lamba ƙarfi ne a kowane yanki: $P = \dfrac{F}{A}$. Idan gas ya zube, matsin cikin kwantena yana faɗuwa kuma ƙarfin feshi yana rauni.
p-238.example: Kewayen al'ada 0.7~0.98 MPa kusan 7~9.8 bar ne (sau 7~10 na matsin yanayi), kuma idan allurar tana yankin ja ko kusa da 0, ana buƙatar maye ko sake cikawa.
p-238.actionItem: Yau duba cewa ma'aunin na'urar kashe wuta a gida ko mota yana yankin kore, kuma duba pin ɗin aminci da yanayin bututun.

p-239.title: Seesaw yana daidaita idan mai nauyi ya zauna kusa da tsakiya
p-239.summary: Ko mutane biyu masu nauyi daban-daban suna iya daidaita seesaw idan mai nauyi ya zauna kusa da tsakiya.
p-239.example: Idan yaro mai 30 kg yana zaune 2 m daga tsakiya kuma yaro mai 60 kg 1 m, daidaiton ya cika domin $30 \times 2 = 60 \times 1$.
p-239.actionItem: Idan ka tafi filin wasa da yaro yau, musanya wuraren zama ka nemo wurin daidaito, kuma ka saukar da su ɗaya bayan ɗaya cikin aminci.

p-240.title: Me ya sa akwai giɓi a haɗin gadoji da hanyoyi a lokacin rani
p-240.summary: Ƙarfe da concrete suna faɗaɗa idan sun yi zafi, don haka gadoji da hanyoyi suna da giɓi a haɗinsu don faɗaɗa.
p-240.example: Sashen ƙarfe ($\alpha \approx 12 \times 10^{-6}\ \mathrm{/K}$) mai tsawon 100 m wanda ke canzawa daga -10°C zuwa 40°C yana zama $\Delta L \approx 0.06\ \mathrm{m}$, wato kusan 60 mm ya yi tsawo.
p-240.actionItem: Yau lokacin da kake wucewa gada ko haɗin hanyar tafiya, nemi giɓin kuma kada ka saka duwatsu ko shara a cikinsa.

p-241.title: Batura a tocila suna da haske a series kuma suna daɗewa a parallel
p-241.summary: Idan aka haɗa batura a series, ƙarfin lantarki yana ƙaruwa kuma haske yana ƙaruwa, kuma idan aka haɗa su a parallel ƙarfin lantarki iri ɗaya ne kuma ƙarfin caji ya haɗu don haka suna daɗewa, amma jimillar ƙarfi iri ɗaya ne.
p-241.principle: Series: $V = V_1 + V_2$, parallel: $Q = Q_1 + Q_2$. Ƙarfi $E = VQ$.
p-241.example: Batura 2 na 1.5 V·2500 mAh suna ba da series 3 V·2.5 Ah da parallel 1.5 V·5 Ah, duka kusan 7.5 Wh.
p-241.actionItem: Yau musanya batirin tocila lokaci ɗaya iri ɗaya da ragowar ƙarfi iri ɗaya, kuma kada ka haɗa sababbi da tsofaffi.

p-242.title: Murfin iska da ke rage hayaniyar iska a bidiyon bakin teku
p-242.summary: Murfin gashi a gaban makirufo yana watsar da turbulence yana rage hayaniyar iska sosai.
p-242.principle: Ma'aunin da ke tantance lokacin da kwarara ke zama turbulent shi ne Reynolds number: $\mathrm{Re} = \dfrac{\rho v D}{\mu}$.
p-242.example: A saurin iska 5 m/s da diamita na makirufo 1 cm, $\mathrm{Re} \approx 3{,}300$, kuma murfin gashi yana rage hayaniyar iska da kusan 10~20 dB.
p-242.actionItem: Yau lokacin da kake ɗaukar bidiyo a bakin teku, saka murfin gashi ka juya makirufo zuwa gefen da ba iska.

p-243.title: Me ya sa allon taɓawa ke aiki ba daidai ba da hannu mai jika
p-243.summary: Digon ruwa yana gudanar da wutar lantarki kuma yana yaɗuwa a allo yana canza capacitance a electrodes da yawa, don haka ghost touches suna faruwa.
p-243.principle: Capacitance: $C = \dfrac{\varepsilon A}{d}$ (relative permittivity na ruwa kusan 80, iska kusan 1).
p-243.example: Idan digon ruwa ya taɓa allo, sensor na iya karanta canjin capacitance mai kama da na yatsa, don haka allo yakan yi aiki ba daidai ba ko da ba ya lalace ba.
p-243.actionItem: Idan allon yana nuna ban mamaki yau, kafin ka gyara, goge ruwan hannu da allo da bushewar zane da farko.

p-244.title: Murhun sansani: saka garkuwar iska amma kada ka rufe gas canister
p-244.summary: Garkuwar iska tana rage asarar zafi na murhu da tukunya, amma idan ka rufe gas canister, yana iya yin zafi fiye da kima kuma yana da haɗari.
p-244.principle: Convective heat loss: $q = hA\Delta T$ ($h$ yana ƙaruwa idan iska tana da ƙarfi).
p-244.example: A yankin tukunya $0.05\ \mathrm{m^2}$ da $\Delta T = 80\ \mathrm{K}$, asarar tana ƙaruwa daga 40 W zuwa 120 W idan $h$ ya tashi daga 10 zuwa 30 $\mathrm{W/(m^2\cdot K)}$ (misali).
p-244.actionItem: Yau lokacin girki a waje, saita garkuwar iska kewaye da tukunya da murhu kawai kuma ka bar gas canister a waje (an hana amfani a ciki ko tanti).

p-245.title: Dalilin hazo a asuba mai haske ta kaka
p-245.summary: A dare mai haske da rashin iska, ƙasa tana yin sanyi ta radiation, iska ta kai dew point, sai hazo ya samu.
p-245.principle: Kimanin dew point: $T_d \approx T - \dfrac{100 - \mathrm{RH}}{5}$ (°C, RH a %).
p-245.example: Idan rana tana 20°C da danshi 70%, $T_d \approx 14$°C, kuma idan zafi ya sauka zuwa 12°C da asuba, iska ta cika da danshi sai hazo ya samu.
p-245.actionItem: Idan za ka tuƙa da asuba mai hazo yau, kunna fitilar ƙasa da ta hazo, ka ƙara tazara tsakaninka da motar gabanka fiye da yadda aka saba.

p-246.title: A daidaita gear ɗin keke bisa cadence, ba ƙarfi ba
p-246.summary: Idan ƙarfin da ake bayarwa ɗaya ne, gear da yake ba da damar juya fedal sau 70~90 a minti ɗaya yana rage nauyi a gwiwa.
p-246.principle: Power shi ne ninkin torque da angular velocity: $P = \tau \omega$, $\omega = \dfrac{2\pi \cdot \mathrm{rpm}}{60}$.
p-246.example: Idan ana samar da power na kusan 210 W, a 60 rpm ana buƙatar torque na kusan 33 N·m, a 90 rpm kuma kusan 22 N·m.
p-246.actionItem: A hawan keke na yau, canja gear ka ci gaba da juya fedal sau 70~90 a minti ɗaya.

p-247.title: Ƙasar laka ta bakin teku tana buɗewa da kusan mintuna 50 a makare kowace rana
p-247.summary: Wata yana ɗaukar kusan mintuna 50 fiye don ya zagaya duniya sau ɗaya a kowace rana, don haka lokutan ruwa suna makara da kusan mintuna 50 kowace rana.
p-247.principle: Ranar wata ita ce $T_{\mathrm{lunar}} \approx 24\ \mathrm{h}\ 50\ \mathrm{min}$, kuma teku yana cika da ja da baya sau biyu a rana, don haka tazara ta kusan awa 12 da mintuna 25.
p-247.example: Idan ruwa ya ja baya da 10:00 a yau, gobe zai kasance kusan 10:50, bayan kwana 6 kuma kusan 15:00, wato $6 \times 50 = 300$ mintuna a makare.
p-247.actionItem: Kafin ka je ƙasar laka ta bakin teku yau, duba teburin lokutan ruwa ka tsai da lokacin fitowa kafin ruwa ya cika.

p-248.title: Na'urar rufe abinci da vacuum tana amfani da ƙarfin da matsin yanayi yake danna
p-248.summary: Na'urar rufe abinci da vacuum tana fitar da iska daga cikin jaka, kuma matsin yanayi na waje yana danna abinci ya manne.
p-248.example: A jaka mai yanki $0.03\ \mathrm{m^2}$ da bambancin matsi 80 kPa, kusan ƙarfin 2.4 kN (kusan 240 kgf) ne yake yaɗuwa a kan dukkan jakar.
p-248.actionItem: Yau, rufe busasshen kayan abinci ko abincin da za a daskarar da shi a rarrabe a cikin vacuum, amma abincin da yake saurin lalacewa har yanzu a ajiye a firiji ko firiza.

p-249.title: Tukunyar tururi tana dafa abinci da sauri ta zafin condensation na tururi
p-249.summary: Tururi yana condensation a saman abinci ya zama ruwa yana fitar da latent heat mai yawa, don haka yana isar da zafi da sauri fiye da ruwa mai tafasa.
p-249.principle: Zafin da ake fitarwa lokacin condensation: $Q = mL$ ($L \approx 2260\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$).
p-249.example: Idan tururi 50 g ya yi condensation, yana fitar da kusan 113 kJ, wanda ya fi sau 6.8 fiye da lokacin da ruwa 50 g na 100°C yake sanyi zuwa 20°C (kusan 16.7 kJ).
p-249.actionItem: Yayin dafa abinci da tururi yau, ka bar murfin a rufe, kuma idan za ka buɗe, ka ɗaga shi ta gefen da ba fuskarka ba don hana ƙonewa da tururi.

p-250.title: Ana iya hasashen zafin yanayi daga sautin kuriyar
p-250.summary: Kuriyar tana yin sauti da sauri idan yanayi ya fi ɗumi, don haka ta yawan sautinta ana iya sanin zafin yanayi kusan.
p-250.principle: Dokar Dolbear: $T_{\mathrm{F}} \approx 40 + \dfrac{N_{60}}{4}$ ($N_{60}$: yawan sauti a minti ɗaya).
p-250.example: Sauti 100 a minti ɗaya yana nufin kusan 65°F (kusan 18°C), 160 kuma kusan 80°F (kusan 27°C); ƙiyasi ne wanda zai iya bambanta bisa nau'in kuriyar.
p-250.actionItem: A yammacin yau, ƙidaya sautin kuriyar tsawon daƙiƙa 15, ninka da 4, sannan ka ƙiyasta zafin yanayi da dokar da ke sama.

p-251.title: Dalilin da faɗuwar rana take ja
p-251.summary: Idan rana ta yi ƙasa, haske yana ratsa yanayi tsawon lokaci, hasken shuɗi yana watsewa da farko, hasken ja ya rage, don haka faɗuwar rana take ja.
p-251.example: Shuɗi (450 nm) yana watsewa da ƙarfi sau $(700/450)^4 \approx 5.9$ fiye da ja (700 nm), don haka yana ɓacewa da farko.
p-251.actionItem: Yau, kalli sauye-sauyen launin sama a lokacin faɗuwar rana, amma kada ka kalli rana kai tsaye ko ka nufe ta da kyamara ko na'urar hangen nesa.

p-252.title: Cikakken wata yana kama da girman tsabar kuɗi ɗaya da aka ajiye da nisa
p-252.summary: Cikakken wata ya fi ƙanƙanta fiye da yadda ake tsammani; a tsayin hannu, ƙwayar shinkafa na iya rufe shi.
p-252.example: Tsabar kuɗi mai diamita 24 mm da aka ajiye nesa da kusan 2.7 m tana da girman kusurwa iri ɗaya, kuma a tsayin hannu kusan 60 cm, abu mai diamita kusan 5 mm yana rufe wata.
p-252.actionItem: Idan cikakken wata ya fito yau, miƙa hannunka ka rufe wata da ƙwayar shinkafa ɗaya.

p-253.title: Cunkoson hanya yana farawa daga taka birki ɗaya na motar gaba
p-253.summary: A hanya mai cunkoso, idan mota ɗaya ta taka birki, jinkirin amsawar motocin baya yana taruwa, kuma igiyar cunkoso tana yaɗuwa zuwa baya.
p-253.principle: Nisan tsayawa: $d = v\,t_r + \dfrac{v^2}{2a}$, igiyar cunkoso yawanci tana tafiya zuwa baya da gudun kusan 15~20 km/h.
p-253.example: A 100 km/h (kusan 27.8 m/s), idan amsa ta ɗauki daƙiƙa 1, motar tana tafiya 27.8 m a lokacin; idan ka bar tazarar daƙiƙa 3 ka tuƙa a hankali, za ka iya tara kusan 5~10% na mai.
p-253.actionItem: A tuƙin yau, bar tazarar daƙiƙa 2~3 da motar gaba kuma ka ɗaga ƙafa daga fedalin gas da wuri don rage amfani da birki.

p-254.title: Nisan tsaro na dutse da ake jefawa ta injin yankan ciyawa ya wuce m 15
p-254.summary: Ƙarshen ruwan injin yankan ciyawa yana da sauri sosai, don haka duwatsu suna tashi kamar harsashi; kada wani mutum ya kasance cikin radius na m 15 na wurin aiki.
p-254.principle: Gudun ƙarshen ruwa: $v = \omega r$, nisan tashi: $R = \dfrac{v^2 \sin 2\theta}{g}$.
p-254.example: Idan radius na ruwa 0.115 m, 6,500 rpm ($\omega \approx 681\ \mathrm{rad/s}$), $v \approx 78\ \mathrm{m/s}$, wato kusan 280 km/h.
p-254.actionItem: Kafin aikin yankan ciyawa yau, tabbatar babu mutum ko abin hawa cikin radius na m 15, ka kuma sa gilashin kariya da abin rufe fuska.

p-255.title: Don jakar bacci, duba comfort temperature; don tabarma, duba R-value
p-255.summary: Sanyin dare yana ɗaukar zafi zuwa ƙasa fiye da sama, don haka a duba comfort temperature na jakar bacci da R-value na tabarma tare.
p-255.example: Tabarmar foam mai kauri 2 cm da $k = 0.035\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$ tana da $R \approx 0.57\ \mathrm{m^2 K/W}$ (R-value na Amurka kusan 3.2), kuma R-value na 3 ko fiye ma'auni ne na gama-gari don zangon kaka.
p-255.actionItem: Yayin zaɓar kayan zango yau, tabbatar comfort temperature na jakar bacci yana ƙasa ko daidai da mafi ƙarancin zafin da ake tsammani, kuma R-value na tabarma ya kai 3 ko fiye.

p-256.title: Ana iya karanta canjin tsayi ta barometer na wayar hannu
p-256.summary: Yawancin wayoyin hannu suna da barometric sensor, kuma ta canjin matsi ana iya ƙiyasta tsayin da aka hau ko saukowa.
p-256.principle: $\Delta P \approx -\rho g\,\Delta h$, kusa da matakin teku, raguwar kusan 1 hPa = hawan kusan m 8.
p-256.example: Idan $\rho = 1.2\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, a kowace m 8 $1.2 \times 9.8 \times 8 \approx 94\ \mathrm{Pa} \approx 0.94\ \mathrm{hPa}$, don haka bene na 30 (kusan m 90) yana ƙasa da kusan 11 hPa.
p-256.actionItem: Yau, buɗe manhajar barometer ka kwatanta darajoji na ƙasa da kuma saman matakala (canjin yanayi ma yana canza darajar, don haka ka auna cikin ɗan lokaci kaɗan).

p-257.title: A ɗaure akwatin littattafai da firiji a bango don girgizar ƙasa
p-257.summary: Kayan daki masu tsayi da kunkuntar suna faɗuwa da ƙaramar girgiza, don haka ɗaure su a bango yana ba da tsaro.
p-257.principle: Yanayin faɗuwa: $mg\,\dfrac{b}{2} < m a\, h_c$, wato $a > g\,\dfrac{b}{2 h_c}$ ($b$: faɗi, $h_c$: tsayin cibiyar nauyi).
p-257.example: Akwatin littattafai mai tsawo 1.8 m ($h_c = 0.9\ \mathrm{m}$) da faɗi 0.3 m yana faɗuwa a $a > 0.3/1.8\, g \approx 0.17\,g$.
p-257.actionItem: Yau, ɗaure kayan daki masu tsayi a katakon bango da L-bracket, ka ajiye abubuwa masu nauyi a ɗakunan ƙasa.

p-258.title: Dalilin da sautin guitar yake canzawa a lokacin sauyin yanayi da bambancin zafi mai yawa
p-258.summary: Idan zafi ya canza, tashin igiya yana canzawa kuma sauti yana canzawa, don haka dole a sake daidaita shi kafin kaɗa.
p-258.example: Idan tashin igiya ya ragu 1%, frequency yana raguwa kusan 0.5%, don haka sautin 440 Hz yana sauka kusan 2.2 Hz (kusan cents 9) wanda zai iya ɓata kunne.
p-258.actionItem: Yau, kafin ka kaɗa, sake daidaita igiyoyin da tuner (sake yi sau ɗaya bayan sauyin ya daidaita bayan kaɗa).

p-259.title: A kan hanyar lanƙwasa ta filin wasa, a karkata jiki zuwa ciki
p-259.summary: Lokacin juyawa a lanƙwasa, idan ka karkata jiki zuwa ciki, rikici yana samar da centripetal force kuma ka juya ba tare da zamewa ba.
p-259.example: Idan ka juya a lanƙwasa mai radius 20 m da 14.4 km/h (4 m/s), $\tan\theta \approx 16/196 \approx 0.082$, wato karkata kusan 4.7°.
p-259.actionItem: A sashen lanƙwasa yau, rage gudu da wuri ka gwada karkata a hankali zuwa ciki daga idon sawu.

p-260.title: Idan hanyar jirgin sama tana daɗewa, alama ce ta sama mai danshi
p-260.summary: Idan farin hanyar jirgin sama bai ɓace da sauri ba yana yaɗuwa, yana nufin sama mai tsayi tana da danshi sosai wanda ya wuce saturation na kankara.
p-260.principle: Danshi mai alaƙa dangane da kankara: $\mathrm{RH}_i = \dfrac{e}{e_i} \times 100\%$, idan $\mathrm{RH}_i > 100\%$ contrail yana dawwama.
p-260.example: A kusan -40°C, saturation vapor pressure na kankara kusan 68% na na ruwa ne, don haka ko da danshi na ruwa ya kai 70% kawai, $\mathrm{RH}_i > 100\%$.
p-260.actionItem: Yau, kalli tsawon lokacin da hanyoyin jirgin sama suke ɗauka a sama, kuma idan sun daɗe suna yaɗuwa, ɗauke shi alamar tunani kawai cewa sama mai tsayi tana da danshi (ba hasashen yanayi ba ne).

p-261.title: Idan ka tura sandar cin abinci cikin kwandon shinkafa, kwandon yana ɗagawa
p-261.summary: Idan aka tattara shinkafa aka tura sandar cin abinci a ciki, ƙwayoyin suna riƙe sandar da ƙarfi har a iya ɗaga dukkan kwandon.
p-261.principle: Matsi tsakanin ƙwayoyin shinkafa yana matse sandar ya samar da rikici: $f = \mu N$.
p-261.example: Misali, idan ƙarfin matsi na gefe $N = 50\ \mathrm{N}$, $\mu = 0.4$, rikici kusan 20 N ne, wanda zai iya ɗaga kwandon shinkafa na kusan 1 kg (kusan 9.8 N).
p-261.actionItem: Yau, cika kwalbar gilashi kunkuntar da shinkafa, tattara ta ka tura sandar cin abinci ƙasa sosai ka ɗaga (a kan teburi don kada kwalbar ta karye).

p-262.title: A zaɓi 'ya'yan itace mai nauyi idan girmansu ɗaya ne
p-262.summary: Idan girmansu ɗaya ne, 'ya'yan itace mafi nauyi galibi suna da ruwa da yawa kuma ba su bushe ba.
p-262.example: Idan lemun zaki biyu masu girma iri ɗaya suna 220 g ($\rho \approx 1.10\ \mathrm{g/cm^3}$) da 190 g ($\rho \approx 0.95\ \mathrm{g/cm^3}$), mai nauyin galibi yana da ruwan 'ya'yan itace mai yawa.
p-262.actionItem: Yayin sayen 'ya'yan itace yau, riƙe masu girma iri ɗaya a hannu biyu ka kwatanta nauyi, kuma ka duba ko akwai rauni.

p-263.title: Idan ka yi tafiya akan tafiyar-lantarki ta filin jirgin sama, gudu yana ƙaruwa
p-263.summary: Idan ka yi tafiya a kan moving walkway, gudun tafiyarka yana ƙarawa da gudun walkway ɗin, don haka kana tafiya da sauri sosai.
p-263.example: Idan aka ƙara tafiya 1.4 m/s da walkway 0.75 m/s, ya zama 2.15 m/s; m 200 a tsaye yana ɗaukar kusan daƙiƙa 267, idan ka yi tafiya kuma kusan daƙiƙa 93, wato kusan mintuna 3 a gaggauce.
p-263.actionItem: Yayin tafiya a kan walkway yau, yi gefe ɗaya ka riƙe hannu, ka ajiye kaya kusa da jikinka.

p-264.title: Mannen haske na keke suna mayar da haske
p-264.summary: Retroreflective stickers suna mayar da hasken mota ta inda ya zo, don su sa keke ya bayyana a hanya mai duhu.
p-264.principle: Corner cube yana mayar da haske ta kishiyar hanya da madubai uku masu tsaye-tsaye: $\vec{r}_{out} = -\vec{r}_{in}$.
p-264.example: Kayan haske yawanci ana iya ganinsu daga nesa da kusan m 150, yayin da tufafi masu duhu galibi ana ganinsu a cikin m 30~50 kawai.
p-264.actionItem: Yau, manna reflective stickers a ƙafafun keke, firam da fedal, kuma kunna fitila ta gaba da ta baya tare.

p-265.title: Kada ka saka miya mai zafi a blender kai tsaye
p-265.summary: Idan ka saka miya mai zafi a blender da aka rufe ka kunna, tururi yana faɗaɗa, murfi zai fashe ya kuma iya ƙona ka.
p-265.principle: Ideal gas: $PV = nRT$. Idan ruwa 1 g ya zama tururi, a 100°C da 1 atm girmansa kusan 1.7 L.
p-265.example: Idan $n = \dfrac{1}{18} \approx 0.056\ \mathrm{mol}$, $V = \dfrac{nRT}{P} \approx 1.7\ \mathrm{L}$, wato yana kumbura kusan sau 1,700 na girman ruwa.
p-265.actionItem: Yau, bar miya mai zafi ta yi sanyi aƙalla mintuna 10, ka cika rabin ƙarfin ko ƙasa da haka, ka buɗe ramin murfi ka rufe da tawul kafin ka kunna.

p-266.title: Dalilin da dare da rana suke kusan daidai a lokacin autumnal equinox
p-266.summary: A autumnal equinox, rana tana kai tsaye sama da equator, don haka a ko'ina a duniya rana da dare kusan awa 12 ne kowanne.
p-266.principle: Karkatar axis na ƙasa $23.4^\circ$, declination na rana $\delta \approx 23.44^\circ \sin\!\left[\dfrac{360^\circ}{365}(d - 81)\right]$.
p-266.example: Declination yana +23.4° a summer solstice (kusan 21 ga Yuni), 0° a autumnal equinox (kusan 22 ga Satumba), -23.4° a winter solstice (kusan 21 ga Disamba).
p-266.actionItem: Yau, duba lokutan fitowar rana da faɗuwarta ka lissafta ko tsawon rana kusan awa 12 ne.

p-267.title: A fitar da iska daga boiler da radiators a lokacin sauyin yanayi
p-267.summary: Idan iska ta cika bututun dumama, ruwa ba ya zagaye da kyau kuma saman radiator yana sanyi. Idan aka fitar da iskar, ɗumi yana ƙaruwa da mai iri ɗaya.
p-267.principle: Zafin da ake bayarwa yana da alaƙa kai tsaye da yawan zagayawa: $Q = \dot{m}\, c\, \Delta T$.
p-267.example: Radiator na 1 kW yana buƙatar ruwa ya riƙa gudana kusan $1\ \mathrm{L/min}$ a $\Delta T = 15\ \mathrm{K}$, kuma wurin da iska ta cika ba ya fitar da zafi.
p-267.actionItem: A kashe dumama ka bar ya yi sanyi, sannan ka buɗe air valve na radiator mai sanyin sama ka fitar da iskar, ka duba matsin boiler bisa littafin umarni.

p-268.title: Lokacin ajiye mota a gangara, juya ƙafafu ka jingina da kerb
p-268.summary: Lokacin ajiye mota a gangara, ban da handbrake da gear, ka juya ƙafafun zuwa kerb don idan ta zamo kerb ɗin ya tsare ta.
p-268.principle: Ƙarfin da ke bin gangara: $F = mg\sin\theta$, rikici: $f = \mu N$.
p-268.example: Idan mota mai nauyin 1,500 kg ta tsaya a gangara 10% ($\theta \approx 5.7^\circ$), kusan 1.46 kN (kusan 150 kgf) yana jan ta ƙasa.
p-268.actionItem: Yau, a ajiye mota a gangarar ƙasa ka juya ƙafafun zuwa kerb, a gangarar sama kuma ka juya su gefe kishiyar kerb, ka saka handbrake da P (ko gear na 1).

p-269.title: Wurare kusa da taga jirgin ƙasa suna wucewa da sauri
p-269.summary: Ko da gudu iri ɗaya ne, abubuwa kusa suna wucewa da sauri saboda layin gani yana jujjuyawa da sauri, tsaunuka masu nisa kuma suna kama da a hankali.
p-269.example: A 100 km/h (27.8 m/s), itace mai nisan m 20 yana da $\omega \approx 1.39\ \mathrm{rad/s} \approx 80^\circ/\mathrm{s}$, tsauni mai nisan km 5 kuma kusan $0.3^\circ/\mathrm{s}$.
p-269.actionItem: Idan kana jin ciwon tafiya yau, maimakon kallon wurare kusa, kalli tsaunuka masu nisa ko sama.

p-270.title: A ja igiya, ba nauyin jiki ba ne amma rikicin tafin ƙafa ne yake nasara
p-270.summary: A jan igiya, igiyar tana jan bangarorin biyu da ƙarfi iri ɗaya, kuma nasara tana dogara ne ga matsakaicin rikicin da ƙasa take tallafa wa ƙafa.
p-270.principle: Static friction: $f \le \mu N$ ($N = mg$), tashin igiya iri ɗaya ne a bangarorin biyu (action-reaction).
p-270.example: Idan nauyin jiki 70 kg, a busasshiyar ƙasa $\mu = 0.8$ matsakaici kusan 550 N, a ƙasa mai santsi $\mu = 0.4$ kusan 270 N.
p-270.actionItem: Idan za ka yi wasan jan igiya yau, sa takalmi mai kyakkyawan riko ka runtse jikinka baya, amma kada ka naɗa igiyar a hannu.

p-271.title: Idan ka yanka nama zuwa rabi, yana dahuwa sau 4 da sauri
p-271.summary: Idan ka yanka nama zuwa rabin kauri, lokacin da zafi yake kaiwa tsakiya yana raguwa zuwa kusan kashi ɗaya cikin huɗu, kuma ana tara mai.
p-271.principle: Lokacin yaɗuwar zafi: $t \propto \dfrac{L^2}{\alpha}$ ($L$: kauri, $\alpha$: thermal diffusivity).
p-271.example: Idan guntu mai kauri 6 cm yana ɗaukar kusan mintuna 60, na 3 cm ana ƙiyasta shi a $60 \times \left(\dfrac{3}{6}\right)^2 = 15$ mintuna.
p-271.actionItem: Yau, yanka babban nama sirara ka gasa shi, ka duba da thermometer ko zafin tsakiya ya kai 75°C ko fiye.

p-272.title: A baseball, a bugi ƙwallo da sweet spot don hannu kada ya yi zafi
p-272.summary: Bat yana da cibiyar bugu (sweet spot) wanda idan aka buga da shi, hannu ba ya jin ƙarfi kusan kwata-kwata.
p-272.principle: Nisan cibiyar bugu daga ƙarshen riƙewa: $q = \dfrac{I}{m d}$ ($I$: moment of inertia a kewayen axis, $d$: nisa daga axis zuwa cibiyar nauyi).
p-272.example: Idan ka riƙe sanda mai daidaiton nauyi na 0.84 m a ƙarshen riƙewa, $q = \dfrac{2}{3} L \approx 0.56\ \mathrm{m}$; bat na gaske yana da nauyi a ƙarshe, don haka wurin ya ɗan bambanta.
p-272.actionItem: A atisayen buga ƙwallo yau, ka mai da hankali ka buga ƙwallo da tsakiyar bat (sweet spot) ba ƙarshensa ba.

p-273.title: Idan ka naɗa igiya sau uku a kan ginshiƙi, ƙarfi yana raguwa
p-273.summary: Idan ka naɗa igiya a kan ginshiƙi sau da yawa, rikici yana ƙaruwa kuma za ka iya riƙe kaya mai nauyi da ƙaramin ƙarfi.
p-273.example: Idan $\mu = 0.3$ da naɗi 3 ($\varphi = 6\pi \approx 18.85\ \mathrm{rad}$), $e^{5.65} \approx 285$ sau, don haka nauyin 1,000 N ana riƙe shi da kusan 3.5 N (ƙima ta manufa).
p-273.actionItem: Yau, lokacin ɗaure kaya, naɗa igiya sau 2~3 a kan ginshiƙi, amma kada ka naɗa igiya a hannu ko jiki, kuma kada ka yi amfani da shi don nauyi da yake da alaƙa da rai.

p-274.title: Zuma da syrup suna gudana cikin sauƙi idan aka ɗumama su
p-274.summary: Idan zafi ya ƙaru, danko (viscosity) na zuma da syrup yana raguwa sosai kuma abin da ya rage a kwalba yana ƙaranci.
p-274.principle: Dogaro da zafi na danko (nau'in Arrhenius): $\eta = A\,e^{E/(RT)}$.
p-274.example: Dankon zuma, wanda yake kusan 10 Pa·s a 20°C, yana raguwa zuwa 1~2 Pa·s a 40°C, wato sau 5~10 ya yi ruwa.
p-274.actionItem: Yau, saka kwalbar zuma mai murfi a rufe cikin ruwan ɗumi na kusan 40°C na mintuna 5 kafin amfani, kuma ka guji ruwa mai tafasa ko microwave.

p-275.title: A ajiye kimchi na hunturu a Styrofoam a baranda mara rana
p-275.summary: Styrofoam ba ya ɗaukar zafi kusan, inuwa kuma tana hana zafin rana na radiation. Idan aka haɗa su, kimchi yana riƙe ƙaramin zafi tsayayye tsawon lokaci.
p-275.principle: Asarar zafi ta conduction ita ce $q=\frac{kA\Delta T}{L}$, kuma thermal conductivity na Styrofoam $k\approx0.035\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$ ya fi na itace (kusan $0.12$) ƙasa. Hasken rana kai tsaye yana ɗumama saman akwati ta radiation, don haka ana buƙatar inuwa.
p-275.example: A akwati mai kauri $3\ \mathrm{cm}$ da yanki $1\ \mathrm{m^2}$, idan bambancin zafi tsakanin ciki da waje $10\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $q=0.035\times1\times10/0.03\approx12\ \mathrm{W}$. Akwatin itace mai kauri iri ɗaya yana zubar da kusan $40\ \mathrm{W}$, fiye da sau 3.
p-275.actionItem: Yau, saka kwanon kimchi a Styrofoam a gefen baranda mai inuwa, cika giɓi da jarida ka rufe murfi.

p-276.title: A cire ganyen da suka toshe magudanar ruwa kafin ruwa ya cika
p-276.summary: Idan ganye suka rufe yankin magudanar ruwa, yawan ruwan da yake fita yana raguwa sosai ko da ruwan sama ɗaya ne, wanda yake kaiwa ga komawar ruwa da ambaliya. Tsaftacewa na minti 1 kafin ruwan sama shi ne mafi arha rigakafi.
p-276.principle: Flow rate $Q=Av$, don haka idan yankin da ruwa zai wuce ($A$) ya ragu, yawan magudanar yana raguwa daidai gwargwado. Ganye suna toshe ramukan grille kuma suna rage $A$ sosai.
p-276.example: Yankin magudanar mai diamita $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ kusan $79\ \mathrm{cm^2}$ ne. Idan ganye sun rufe rabi, $A\approx39\ \mathrm{cm^2}$, kuma da saurin gudana iri ɗaya, yawan magudanar yana sauka zuwa kusan $50\%$.
p-276.actionItem: Yau, cire ganye daga murfin magudanar ruwa na baranda, rufin gida da ƙofar gida da hannun safar hannu ko tongs.

p-277.title: Mintuna 10 na hasken rana na safe sun fi hasken cikin gida haske sau da dama
p-277.summary: A safiyar rana mai gajimare, waje ma ya fi hasken cikin gida haske sosai, kuma wannan haske yana taimakawa wajen daidaita agogon jiki na yini. Ɗan fita na safe shi ne mafi sauƙin maganin haske.
p-277.principle: Illuminance shi ne adadin haske da ke shiga kowane yanki $E=\frac{\Phi}{A}$ kuma naúrarsa lux ($\mathrm{lm/m^2}$). Waje a rana mai haske kusan $10{,}000\sim100{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$, cikin gida na yau da kullum $100\sim500\ \mathrm{lux}$.
p-277.example: Waje na safiya mai haske kusan $10{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$ ya fi ofis ($500\ \mathrm{lux}$) kusan sau 20, falo ($150\ \mathrm{lux}$) kuma kusan sau 70. Ko a ranar gajimare yawanci sama da $1{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$ ne, don haka ya fi cikin gida haske.
p-277.actionItem: Yau da safe, yi tafiya a waje na mintuna 10, ba a bayan taga ba. Kada ka kalli rana kai tsaye.

p-278.title: Hawan tsaunin kaka: rana tana ɓacewa da wuri fiye da taswira saboda inuwar tsauni
p-278.summary: Teburin lokacin faɗuwar rana yana bisa sararin samaniya a ƙasa mai faɗi, don haka idan akwai tsauni a yamma, rana tana ɓoyewa da wuri sosai. A tsauni, lokacin da rana take taɓa tsauni shi ne ainihin faɗuwarta.
p-278.principle: Idan kusurwar rufewa na tsaunin yamma $h$ ne, lokacin da rana take saukowa zuwa wannan tsayi shi ne ainihin faɗuwa, kuma rana tana ɓoyewa da wuri da $\Delta t\approx\frac{h}{\omega}$. A tsakiyar latitude a kaka, gudun saukar rana a tsaye kusan $\omega\approx12^\circ/\mathrm{h}$.
p-278.example: Idan kusurwar rufewa na tsaunin yamma $10^\circ$ ne, $\Delta t\approx10^\circ/12^\circ\mathrm{/h}\approx50\ \mathrm{min}$ a makare inuwa tana farawa. Idan aka haɗa da lokacin duhu bayan faɗuwa, lokacin sauka yana raguwa fiye da awa 1.
p-278.actionItem: A shirin hawan tsauni yau, saita lokacin gama sauka awa 1.5~2 kafin lokacin faɗuwar rana da ke tebur, ka saka headlamp a jaka.

p-279.title: A jaket ɗin gashin tsuntsu, duba fill power da adadin cikawa tare
p-279.summary: Fill power ma'auni ne na yadda gashin tsuntsu yake kumbura yana kama iska. Lambar da ta fi yawa tana nufin ya fi sauƙi don ɗumi iri ɗaya, amma jimillar ɗumi ana ƙayyade ta da adadin cikawa tare.
p-279.principle: Fill power shi ne $\mathrm{FP}=\frac{V\,(\mathrm{in^3})}{m\,(\mathrm{oz})}$, wato girman da yake kumburawa a kowane nauyi. Ɗumi yana dogara ne ga kaurin layin iska mai tsayayye da aka kama ($k\approx0.026\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$), don haka nauyin da ake buƙata don cika girma ɗaya shi ne $m\propto\frac{1}{\mathrm{FP}}$.
p-279.example: Don cika kauri ɗaya, fill power 600 yana buƙatar $100\ \mathrm{g}$, fill power 800 kuma $600/800\times100=75\ \mathrm{g}$. Don ɗumi ɗaya, ya fi sauƙi da kusan $25\%$.
p-279.actionItem: Yayin sayen jaket yau, duba fill power da nauyin cikawa (g) a lakabi duka ka kwatanta.

p-280.title: Calculator mai solar cell yana aiki ko da hasken cikin gida
p-280.summary: Calculator yana amfani da microwatts kaɗan kawai, don haka hasken cikin gida, wanda ya fi hasken rana rauni sosai, ya isa. Ainihin abu shi ne ko makamashin photon ya wuce bakin kofa, ba ƙarfin haske ba.
p-280.principle: Makamashin photon shi ne $E=h\nu=\frac{hc}{\lambda}\approx\frac{1240\ \mathrm{eV\cdot nm}}{\lambda}$. Idan wannan ya fi band gap na semiconductor, ana fitar da electrons kuma wutar lantarki tana gudana; idan haske ya yi rauni, kwararar wutar ce kawai ke raguwa.
p-280.example: Photon na haske mai ganuwa mai tsawon wave $550\ \mathrm{nm}$ yana da $E\approx2.25\ \mathrm{eV}$, wanda ya fi band gap na amorphous silicon (kusan $1.7\ \mathrm{eV}$). Hasken cikin gida na $500\ \mathrm{lux}$ kusan $1/200$ ne na hasken rana na rana mai haske (kusan $100{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$), amma ya isa calculator na ƴan $\mu\mathrm{W}$.
p-280.actionItem: Yau, kunna calculator mai solar cell a ƙarƙashin hasken cikin gida, ka rufe solar panel da hannunka ka duba ko lambobin sun yi dusashe.

p-281.title: A wayar OLED, dark mode yana ceton batir
p-281.summary: OLED yana fitar da haske da kansa a kowane pixel, don haka baƙin pixels kusan ba sa amfani da wuta. Idan bangon allo ya fi duhu, ƙarfin allo yana raguwa.
p-281.principle: Ƙarfin allo shi ne jimillar ƙarfin pixels $P=\sum_i P_i$, kuma baƙin pixel $P_i\approx0$. A LCD wanda backlight koyaushe yana kunne, ƙarfi kusan iri ɗaya ne ba tare da la'akari da abin da aka nuna ba, don haka babu tasiri.
p-281.example: Idan ƙarfin allo ya kasance $1.0\ \mathrm{W}$ a farin bango kuma $0.5\ \mathrm{W}$ a baƙin bango, a awa 3 a rana ana ceton $0.5\ \mathrm{W}\times3\ \mathrm{h}=1.5\ \mathrm{Wh}$. Wannan kusan $10\%$ na batir na $15\ \mathrm{Wh}$.
p-281.actionItem: Yau, idan wayarka allon OLED ce, kunna dark mode a settings. Idan LCD ce, tasirin ƙarami ne, don haka rage haske.

p-282.title: Tuƙi cikin hazo: fitilar ƙasa da ta hazo
p-282.summary: Idan ka kunna fitilar sama a cikin hazo, haske yana komawa daga ɗigon ruwa kuma ka ƙara rashin gani. Fitilar ƙasa da fitilar hazo suna ba da ƙarin gani.
p-282.principle: Ɗigon hazo (diamita kusan $1\sim20\ \mu\mathrm{m}$) yana kama da tsawon wave na haske, don haka Mie scattering yana watsa haske ta kowane bangare, musamman gaba da baya. Haske yana raguwa kamar $I=I_0e^{-\beta x}$, kuma hasken sama kusa da tsayin ido yana dawowa yana ƙirƙirar kyalli.
p-282.example: A hazo mai ganuwa cikin m $50$, bisa dokar zirga-zirga dole a rage matsakaicin gudu da $50\%$ ko fiye; a hanya mai iyakar $100\ \mathrm{km/h}$, wannan ya zama $50\ \mathrm{km/h}$ ko ƙasa.
p-282.actionItem: Daga yau, a ranakun hazo, kunna fitilar ƙasa da ta hazo, kashe fitilar sama, kuma ƙara tazara da motar gaba fiye da yadda aka saba.

p-283.title: Fitilar karatu a haskaka daga gefen kishiyar hannun rubutu
p-283.summary: Saboda haske yana tafiya kai tsaye, inuwar hannu da alƙalami tana rufe rubutu. Idan ka haskaka daga gaba a gefen kishiyar hannun rubutu, inuwar tana tafiya bayan hannu kuma idanu ba sa wahala.
p-283.principle: Daga tushen haske na ɗigo mai tsayi $H$, tsayin abu $h$ da nisa a kwance $d$, inuwa tana miƙewa bayan abu da $s=\frac{dh}{H-h}$. Idan tushen haske yana gefen hannun rubutu ɗaya, wannan inuwa tana kan rubutu.
p-283.example: Idan tsayin fitilar tebur $H=40\ \mathrm{cm}$, tsayin hannu $h=3\ \mathrm{cm}$, nisa a kwance $d=30\ \mathrm{cm}$, inuwar $s=\frac{30\times3}{37}\approx2.4\ \mathrm{cm}$ tana samuwa. Haskakawar karatu na gama-gari $300\sim500\ \mathrm{lux}$ ne.
p-283.actionItem: Yau, mai hannun dama ya saka fitilar tebur a gaba ta hagu na tebur, mai hannun hagu kuma a gaba ta dama.

p-284.title: A kan tudu mai tsayi, hau ta hanyar zigzag
p-284.summary: Idan tsayin da za a hau ɗaya ne, aiki iri ɗaya ne, amma idan ka kewaya hanya a karkace, ƙarfin da ake buƙata a kowane mataki yana raguwa kuma ba ka gajiya da numfashi. A madadin, nisan tafiya yana ƙaruwa.
p-284.principle: Aikin da ake buƙata a gangara shi ne $W=mgh$ ba tare da la'akari da hanya ba, amma ƙarfin da ke bin gangara $F=mg\sin\theta=mg\frac{h}{L}$ yana raguwa yayin da tsawon hanya $L$ ya ƙaru.
p-284.example: Idan mutum mai nauyin $70\ \mathrm{kg}$ ya hau $100\ \mathrm{m}$, $W\approx69\ \mathrm{kJ}$. Hawa kai tsaye a $30^\circ$ yana da $F\approx343\ \mathrm{N}$ da $200\ \mathrm{m}$; zigzag a $15^\circ$ kuma yana da $F\approx178\ \mathrm{N}$ da kusan $386\ \mathrm{m}$.
p-284.actionItem: Yau, idan ka haɗu da sashe mai tsayi, zaɓi hanyar kewayawa a cikin hanyar tafiya, kada ka tsallaka ta gajeriyar hanya.

p-285.title: Tayoyin hunturu suna riƙe laushi a ƙasa da 7°C
p-285.summary: Roba tana taurara idan sanyi ya yi, kuma riƙon ƙasa yana raguwa; tayoyin hunturu suna amfani da cakuɗar da take taushi a ƙananan zafi. Ko ba tare da dusar ƙanƙara ba, idan zafi kusan 7°C, bambanci yana bayyana.
p-285.principle: Roba tana riƙe elasticity sama da glass transition temperature $T_g$ kuma tana taurara kusa da shi. Rikici shi ne $F=\mu N$ kuma nisan birki $d=\frac{v^2}{2\mu g}$, don haka idan $\mu$ ya ragu, nisan yana ƙaruwa.
p-285.example: A $80\ \mathrm{km/h}$ ($22.2\ \mathrm{m/s}$), idan $\mu=0.8$ kusan $31\ \mathrm{m}$, idan taya mai sanyi $\mu=0.6$ kusan $42\ \mathrm{m}$. Waɗannan lambobin zato ne don bayani.
p-285.actionItem: Yau, duba hasashen yanayi don ganin ko mafi ƙarancin zafin yau da kullum zai ci gaba kusan 7°C, ka tsara lokacin canza tayoyin hunturu.

p-286.title: Fitilar corridor mai sensor tana ganin infrared na zafin jikin mutum
p-286.summary: Fitilar sensor tana kunna idan ta gano canjin infrared da zafin jikin mutum yake fitarwa lokacin da yake motsi. Tana kunna ne kawai idan ya zama dole, kuma tana rage amfani da wutar corridor sosai.
p-286.principle: Tsawon wave na kololuwar radiation na abu shi ne Wien's law $\lambda_{\max}=\frac{b}{T}$, $b\approx2898\ \mu\mathrm{m\cdot K}$. Fata a kusan $33\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ($306\ \mathrm{K}$) tana da $\lambda_{\max}\approx9.5\ \mu\mathrm{m}$, kuma PIR sensor yana kallon canjin wannan infrared.
p-286.example: LED na corridor na $10\ \mathrm{W}$ idan yana kunne awa 24 yana cinye $240\ \mathrm{Wh}$. Idan sensor yana kunna shi awa 2 kawai a rana kuma standby power na sensor $0.5\ \mathrm{W}$ ne, $20+12=32\ \mathrm{Wh}$, wanda ya rage kusan $87\%$.
p-286.actionItem: Yau, canza fitilar corridor ko ƙofar shiga zuwa fitilar sensor, ko saita tsawon lokacin da take kasancewa a kunne zuwa minti 1~2.

p-287.title: A rufe ƙofar ɗakin da ba a amfani da shi don rage girman dumama
p-287.summary: Idan iskar da za a ɗumama da yankin bango suka ragu, zafin da ake buƙata don samun zafi ɗaya yana raguwa. Duk da haka, idan an toshe gaba ɗaya, condensation yana samuwa, don haka a kiyaye mafi ƙarancin zafi.
p-287.principle: Zafin ɗumama iska shi ne $Q=mc\Delta T$ kuma $m=\rho V$, don haka yana da alaƙa kai tsaye da girman da za a ɗumama $V$. Iska $\rho\approx1.2\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, $c\approx1005\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$.
p-287.example: Don ɗaga iskar ɗaki mara komai na $25\ \mathrm{m^3}$ da $5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $Q=1.2\times25\times1005\times5\approx151\ \mathrm{kJ}\approx0.04\ \mathrm{kWh}$. Idan aka haɗa da ɗumama bango da kayan daki da zafin da yake zubewa koyaushe, ainihin yana ninkawa sau da yawa.
p-287.actionItem: Yau, rufe ƙofar ɗakin da ba a amfani da shi, kuma kada ka rufe valve na dumama na ɗakin gaba ɗaya, sai dai ka rage shi zuwa mafi ƙarancin zafi.

p-288.title: Idan fitilar mota ta kishiyar hanya ta kyalli, mayar da gani zuwa layin dama
p-288.summary: Idan ka ƙara karkatar da ido daga tushen haske, adadin hasken da ya watse a cikin ido yana raguwa sosai. Idan ka mai da gani zuwa gefen layin dama, kyalli yana raguwa kuma za ka ga hanya.
p-288.principle: Veiling luminance da hasken da ya watse a cikin ido yake samarwa kusan shi ne $L_v\approx\frac{10E}{\theta^2}$. A nan, $E$ shi ne illuminance da ke zuwa ido ($\mathrm{lux}$), $\theta$ kuma kusurwa ce tsakanin tushen haske da layin gani ($^\circ$).
p-288.example: Layin gani mai nisan $5^\circ$ daga tushen haske yana da $L_v\propto1/25$, idan $10^\circ$ kuma $1/100$, don haka veiling luminance yana raguwa zuwa $1/4$. Idan haske ya yi yawa, ƙwayar ido ma tana ƙuntatawa, wanda ya fi taimako.
p-288.actionItem: Yau da dare, idan ka haɗu da fitilar sama daga kishiyar hanya, kada ka rufe idanu, mai da gani zuwa farin layin dama ka rage gudu.

p-289.title: Dalilin da kallon allo kawai a ɗaki mai duhu yake gajiyar da ido
p-289.summary: A ɗaki mai duhu ƙwayar ido tana faɗaɗa, amma allo yana da haske sosai, don haka ido dole ne ya ci gaba da daidaitawa da bambancin haske. Idan ka haskaka kewaye a hankali, bambancin yana raguwa kuma ido yana samun sauƙi.
p-289.principle: Yankin ƙwayar ido $A=\frac{\pi d^2}{4}$ kuma diamita yana canzawa tsakanin $2\sim8\ \mathrm{mm}$, kuma haskakawar retina $E_r\propto L\,A$. Idan bambancin luminance tsakanin allo da kewaye ya yi yawa, ido yana ci gaba da canza yanayin daidaitawa.
p-289.example: Idan diamita na ƙwayar ido ya faɗaɗa daga $2\ \mathrm{mm}$ zuwa $8\ \mathrm{mm}$, yanki yana ninkawa sau 16. Idan kewaye $0.5\ \mathrm{cd/m^2}$ ne kuma allo $200\ \mathrm{cd/m^2}$, rabon luminance $400:1$ ne, wanda ya fi yadda ake ba da shawara ($3:1\sim10:1$) sosai.
p-289.actionItem: Yau da dare, yayin kallon allo, kunna fitilar bangaranci ko ƙaramar fitilar tebur a bayan allo don haskaka kewaye a hankali.

p-290.title: Layin tsaro na tashar jirgin ƙasa na ƙarƙashin ƙasa yana da alaƙa da iskar jirgin
p-290.summary: Idan jirgin ƙasa mai sauri ya wuce, iskar da ke gefensa tana yin sauri kuma matsi yana raguwa, wanda zai iya jan mutum zuwa jirgin. Tsayawa bayan layin tsaro shi ne mafi tabbacin kariya.
p-290.principle: Bisa Bernoulli's principle $p+\frac12\rho v^2=\mathrm{const}$, idan saurin iska $v$ ya ƙaru, matsi $p$ yana raguwa. Raguwar matsi shi ne $\Delta p=\frac12\rho v^2$.
p-290.example: Idan iskar da ke gefen jirgin tana gudana a $10\ \mathrm{m/s}$, $\Delta p=0.5\times1.2\times10^2=60\ \mathrm{Pa}$, kuma ƙarfin $F\approx36\ \mathrm{N}$ (kusan $3.7\ \mathrm{kgf}$) yana aiki a kan yankin jiki na gefe $0.6\ \mathrm{m^2}$. A gaskiya turbulence yana ƙara canje-canje.
p-290.actionItem: Yau, idan jirgin ƙasa yana shigowa tashar, yi mataki ɗaya baya bayan layin tsaro.

p-291.title: Kwanon gasa mai duhu yana gasa da sauri
p-291.summary: Kwanon baƙi yana shan radiation na tanda fiye, kwanon azurfa kuma yana nuna mafi yawansa. Ko da girke-girke ɗaya, ƙasa tana yin launin ruwan kasa da wuri bisa launin kwano.
p-291.principle: Makamashin radiation da saman yake sha yana da alaƙa kai tsaye da absorptivity (= emissivity) $\varepsilon$, kuma ƙarfin da ake fitarwa shi ne $P=\varepsilon\sigma AT^4$. Baƙin saman yana da $\varepsilon\approx0.95$, aluminium mai sheƙi kusan $0.1$.
p-291.example: A yanayin radiation iri ɗaya, kwano baƙi yana shan radiation kusan $0.95/0.1\approx9$ sau fiye da kwano mai sheƙin azurfa. Don haka akan ba da shawarar rage zafin tanda kusan $10\sim15\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ga kwano mai duhu.
p-291.actionItem: Yau, lokacin gasa da kwano mai duhu, rage zafin tanda $10\sim15\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ka duba launin gasa da wuri.

p-292.title: Bimetal ne yake daidaita zafin bargon lantarki
p-292.summary: Sirara farantin da aka haɗa da ƙarfe daban-daban yana karkace zuwa gefe ɗaya idan ya sami zafi, kuma yana buɗewa ko rufe lambar lantarki. Wannan shi ne thermostat mai sauƙi da yake yanke wuta a zafi da aka ƙayyade.
p-292.principle: Linear expansion shi ne $\Delta L=\alpha L\Delta T$, kuma saboda bambancin expansion coefficient $\Delta\alpha$ na ƙarfe biyu, farantin yana karkacewa kuma ƙaurawar ƙarshensa ita ce $\delta=\frac{3\Delta\alpha\Delta T L^2}{4t}$ ($t$: jimillar kauri).
p-292.example: Idan $L=50\ \mathrm{mm}$, $t=1\ \mathrm{mm}$, $\Delta\alpha=7\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{/K}$, $\Delta T=40\ \mathrm{K}$, $\delta\approx0.5\ \mathrm{mm}$ yana motsawa kuma lambar tana rabuwa.
p-292.actionItem: Yau, yi amfani da bargon lantarki a shimfiɗe, kada a naɗe ko a tattara shi, kuma a lokacin bacci saita shi a matakin ƙasa.

p-293.title: Tushen zafi kusa da thermostat na boiler yana ruɗar dumama
p-293.summary: Thermostat yana auna zafin wurin da yake kawai don kunna da kashe boiler. Idan akwai murhu ko hasken rana a kusa, dukkan gidan yana yin sanyi fiye da yadda aka saita, kuma idan yana kusa da bango mai sanyi, dumama ya yi yawa.
p-293.principle: Thermostat yana aiki ne kawai lokacin da zafin sensor $T_{\mathrm{sensor}}$ ya yi ƙasa da ƙimar da aka saita $T_{\mathrm{set}}$, don haka a matsakaicin zafin ɗaki $T_{\mathrm{room}}=T_{\mathrm{sensor}}+\epsilon$, kuskuren wuri $\epsilon$ shi ne kuskuren dumama.
p-293.example: Idan saboda tushen zafi kusa da sensor ana karanta $23\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ amma matsakaicin ɗaki $20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ne, ko da an saita $22\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ boiler yana kashewa kuma yana sanyi da $2\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Akasin haka, dumama mai yawa da $2\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ yana ƙara kuɗin dumama da kusan $14\%$ (kusan $7\%$ a kowane 1°C).
p-293.actionItem: Yau, cire na'urar dumama ta lantarki, TV da kayan daki da ke tsakanin thermostat da hasken rana daga kusa da thermostat.

p-294.title: Idan polarity na gefe ɗaya na lasifika ya canza, bass yana ɓacewa
p-294.summary: Idan ka haɗa + da − na gefe ɗaya na lasifika a juye, lasifikun biyu suna yin sauti a kishiyar phase, kuma bass mai tsayin wave yana soke juna. Idan sauti yana da sirara kuma yanayin sarari baƙon abu ne, fara duba polarity.
p-294.principle: Raƙuman ruwa biyu da phase ɗinsu ya bambanta da $\pi$ suna yin destructive interference inda jimillar ke raguwa. Idan wavelength $\lambda=\frac{v}{f}$ ya fi nisan lasifika tsayi sosai, kusan an soke gaba ɗaya a ko'ina.
p-294.example: Wavelength na $100\ \mathrm{Hz}$ shi ne $\lambda=343/100=3.4\ \mathrm{m}$, wanda ya fi nisan lasifika $2\ \mathrm{m}$, don haka yana raguwa sosai kusa da tsakiya. $5\ \mathrm{kHz}$ kuma $\lambda\approx6.9\ \mathrm{cm}$ ne, don haka ko da motsi na ƴan cm kaɗan ƙarfin yana hawa da sauka, kuma kamar bass kawai ya ɓace.
p-294.actionItem: Yau, duba ko + (ja) na wayar lasifika an haɗa shi da tashar + kuma − (baƙi) da tashar −, a lasifikun biyu duka iri ɗaya.

p-295.title: Push-up na gwiwa yana rage leverage na jiki
p-295.summary: Idan ka sa gwiwa a ƙasa, tsawon lever yana raguwa kuma nauyin da hannu yake ɗauka yana raguwa. Idan standard push-up ya yi wahala, za ka iya farawa da push-up na gwiwa da madaidaicin tsari.
p-295.principle: Idan ka ɗauki jiki a matsayin lever, daga torque equilibrium $F_{\mathrm{hand}}\,L=mg\,d$, ƙarfin da hannu yake ɗauka shi ne $F_{\mathrm{hand}}=mg\frac{d}{L}$. Idan wurin tallafi ya koma daga yatsun ƙafa zuwa gwiwa, $L$ da $d$ suna canzawa kuma kaso na nauyi yana raguwa.
p-295.example: A bincike, an ruwaito cewa nauyin da hannu yake ɗauka kusan $64\%$ ne a standard push-up, kusan $49\%$ kuma a push-up na gwiwa. Ga nauyin jiki $70\ \mathrm{kg}$, kusan $45\ \mathrm{kg}$ da $34\ \mathrm{kg}$, wato kusan $23\%$ ya fi sauƙi.
p-295.actionItem: Yau, ka riƙe jiki a layi ɗaya (kai-kwatangwalo-gwiwa) ka yi push-up na gwiwa sau 8 a saiti 2. Idan akwai ciwo, ka tsaya.

p-296.title: Nemo kudu da agogon analog da rana
p-296.summary: Idan ka nufi rana da hour hand, rabin hanyar tsakanin hour hand da 12 kusan kudu ce. Hanya ce ta ƙiyasi a Arewacin Duniya ba tare da compass ba.
p-296.principle: Rana tana motsawa $\omega_\odot=15^\circ$ a awa ɗaya kuma hour hand yana motsawa $\omega_h=30^\circ$ a awa ɗaya. Don haka rabin kusurwar hour hand $\frac{\omega_\odot}{\omega_h}=\frac12$ yana daidai da canjin azimuth na rana, kuma bisector yana nuna kudu.
p-296.example: Da ƙarfe 4 na yamma, idan ka nufi rana da hour hand (wanda yake $120^\circ$ daga 12), rabin hakan, wato wurin 2 o'clock, shi ne kudu. Meridian na standard time na Koriya (gabas $135^\circ$) da Seoul (kusan $127^\circ$) sun bambanta, don haka lokacin rana yana bambanta da kusan mintuna $30$, kuma kuskure kusan $\pm15^\circ$ ne.
p-296.actionItem: Yau a rana mai haske a waje, ƙiyasta kudu da agogon analog ka kwatanta da compass na wayarka.

p-297.title: Gilashin ƙara girma: idan diopter (D) ya fi girma, focal length ya fi gajarta
p-297.summary: Ƙarfin gilashin ƙara girma shi ne juyin focal length, don haka lamba mafi girma tana nufin focal length mafi gajarta da ƙara girma mafi yawa. Idan ƙara girma ya yi yawa, filin gani yana kunkuntar kuma dole ne ka kusanto gilashi da ido da abu.
p-297.principle: Ƙarfin ruwan tabarau shi ne $D=\frac{1}{f}$ ($f$ a m, $D$ a diopter), kuma angular magnification bisa near point na ido $25\ \mathrm{cm}$ shi ne $M\approx\frac{25\ \mathrm{cm}}{f}=\frac{D}{4}$.
p-297.example: $5\ \mathrm{D}$ shi ne $f=20\ \mathrm{cm}$, kusan $1.25$ sau; $10\ \mathrm{D}$ shi ne $f=10\ \mathrm{cm}$, kusan $2.5$ sau; $20\ \mathrm{D}$ shi ne $f=5\ \mathrm{cm}$, kusan $5$ sau.
p-297.actionItem: Yayin sayen gilashin ƙara girma yau, zaɓi diopter da ya dace da amfaninka, kuma kada ka bar shi a wurin rana saboda yana iya tattara hasken rana ya haifar da wuta.

p-298.title: Heat recovery ventilation yana dawo da zafin da yake fita
p-298.summary: Na'ura ce da take mika zafin cikin gida da aka zubar yayin iska zuwa iska mai sanyi da ke shigowa. Tana musanya iska amma tana kiyaye babban ɓangaren zafin dumama.
p-298.principle: Ingancin dawo da zafi shi ne $\eta=\frac{T_{\mathrm{supply}}-T_{\mathrm{out}}}{T_{\mathrm{in}}-T_{\mathrm{out}}}$, kuma asarar zafi na iska shi ne $P=\rho c\,\dot V\,\Delta T$ ($\rho c\approx1200\ \mathrm{J/(m^3\cdot K)}$).
p-298.example: Idan cikin gida $22\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, waje $0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ da yawan iska $150\ \mathrm{m^3/h}$, asara shi ne $1200\times\frac{150}{3600}\times22\approx1100\ \mathrm{W}$. Idan $\eta=70\%$, ya ragu zuwa kusan $330\ \mathrm{W}$ kuma iskar da ake kawowa kusan $15.4\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
p-298.actionItem: Yau, idan kana da heat recovery ventilator (na'urar iska), tsabtace filter bisa tazarar da littafin umarni ya nuna.

p-299.title: Katifar ƙasa ɗaya tana ƙara layin thermal resistance ɗaya
p-299.summary: Katifa tana ƙara layin insulation tsakanin ƙasa da ƙafa. Amma idan dumama ne a ƙasa, katifa mai kauri tana toshe zafin da zai zo ɗakin ma, don haka yi amfani da sirara.
p-299.principle: Idan layuka suna a jere (series), thermal resistance shi ne $R=\sum\frac{L_i}{k_i}$, kuma heat flux shi ne $q=\frac{\Delta T}{R}$. Idan aka ƙara layi ɗaya, $R$ yana ƙaruwa kuma $q$ yana raguwa.
p-299.example: Katifa mai kauri $1\ \mathrm{cm}$, $k\approx0.05\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$ tana da $R=0.2\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$. Idan ƙasa tana da $R=0.5$ kuma $\Delta T=10\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $q=20\to14.3\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$, wato raguwar kusan $29\%$.
p-299.actionItem: Yau, shimfiɗa katifa a wurin ƙasa mai sanyi inda kake zama ko tsayawa sau da yawa, kuma idan ɗakin yana da dumama a ƙasa, zaɓi sirara.

p-300.title: Idan ƙofa ta zube, fara ƙara matsi screws na hinge na sama
p-300.summary: Nauyin ƙofa yana jan hinge na sama yana danna na ƙasa, don haka screws na sama suna sakewa da farko. Sau da yawa, ƙara matsi screws na hinge na sama kawai yana gyara zubewar.
p-300.principle: Ƙofar da take a tsaye tana da torque equilibrium $\sum\tau=0$. Idan nauyi $W$ yana aiki a tsakiyar ƙofa ($\frac{w}{2}$ daga hinge), ƙarfin a kwance a tazarar hinge $h$ shi ne $F=\frac{W\,w/2}{h}$.
p-300.example: Idan nauyin ƙofa $20\ \mathrm{kg}$ ($W\approx196\ \mathrm{N}$), faɗi $0.9\ \mathrm{m}$ da tazarar hinge $1.6\ \mathrm{m}$, $F=\frac{196\times0.45}{1.6}\approx55\ \mathrm{N}$ yana jan hinge na sama kuma yana danna na ƙasa.
p-300.actionItem: Yau, ka bar ƙofar a buɗe, ƙara matsi screws na hinge na sama da screwdriver na Phillips, kuma cika ramukan da suke juyawa kawai da tsinken haƙori da manne na itace sannan ka sake matsi.

p-301.title: Lokacin tashi daga kujera, runtse jikin sama gaba da farko
p-301.summary: A zaune, cibiyar nauyi tana bayan ƙafafu, don haka runtse jikin sama gaba don matsar da cibiyar nauyi sama da ƙafafu yana sa tashi ya yi sauƙi kuma ya fi tabbas.
p-301.principle: Don mutum ya tashi, tsayuwar tsaye ta cibiyar nauyi (COM) dole ta kasance a cikin yankin tallafi da ƙafafu suke yi. Idan cibiyar ta yi nisa a kwance $x$ daga ƙafa, torque da gravity yake samarwa shi ne $\tau=mg\,x$.
p-301.example: Idan COM a zaune yana kusan $15\ \mathrm{cm}$ bayan ƙafa, idan ka runtse jikin sama gaba kusan $30^\circ$, COM yana tafiya gaba kusan $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ kuma $x$ ya kusan ɓace (ƙiyasi).
p-301.actionItem: Yau, lokacin tashi daga kujera, runtse hancinka zuwa gaban yatsun ƙafa, ja ƙafafu kusa da kujera sannan ka tashi. Idan jiri ya ci gaba da faruwa, tuntuɓi ƙwararre.

p-302.title: Tsayin Polaris a dare na hunturu daidai yake da latitude ɗina
p-302.summary: Polaris yana kusa da celestial north pole, don haka tsayinsa kusan daidai yake da latitude na mai kallo. Da tauraro ɗaya za ka iya ƙiyasta latitude na wurinka.
p-302.principle: Altitude angle na celestial north pole daidai yake da latitude na wurin lura $\varphi$, kuma Polaris yana da nisan kusan $0.7^\circ$ daga pole, don haka $h_{\mathrm{Polaris}}\approx\varphi$.
p-302.example: A Seoul (kusan $37.5^\circ$ N), Polaris yana kusan $37.5^\circ$ sama da sararin samaniya, a Jeju (kusan $33.5^\circ$ N) kuma kusan $33.5^\circ$. Hannu miƙaƙƙe da dunƙule kusan $10^\circ$ ne, don haka Seoul tsayin dunƙule kusan 3.75 ne.
p-302.actionItem: Yau, a dare mai haske, nemo Polaris ta Big Dipper ko W na Cassiopeia kuma ka auna tsayinsa da dunƙulen hannu.

p-303.title: Dalilin da anti-reflective coating na gilashin ido yake da launin shuɗi kaɗan
p-303.summary: Anti-reflective coating yana sa hasken da aka nuna daga siririn fim su soke juna. An daidaita shi da tsawon wave kore na tsakiya, don haka ɗan shuɗi da ja suna rage, kuma launin reflection yana bayyana.
p-303.principle: Idan kaurin fim $d$ ya kasance $\frac{\lambda}{4n}$, bambancin hanya tsakanin raƙuman da aka nuna daga sama da ƙasa ya zama $\frac{\lambda}{2}$ kuma suna yin destructive interference. Madaidaicin refractive index na fim shi ne $n_c=\sqrt{n_s}$.
p-303.example: Fim na $\mathrm{MgF_2}$ ($n=1.38$) a $\lambda=550\ \mathrm{nm}$ yana da $d=\frac{550}{4\times1.38}\approx100\ \mathrm{nm}$. Gilashi ba tare da coating ba yana nuna kusan $4\%$ a kowane fuska, amma idan an yi coating yana raguwa zuwa ƙasa da $1\%$.
p-303.actionItem: Yau, tsabtace gilashin ido da cleaner na musamman da kyalle microfiber, kuma ka guji goge shi da busasshen kyalle ko ruwan zafi.

p-304.title: Idan cable ɗin caji ya yi sirara, caji yana yin jinkiri
p-304.summary: Waya sirara tana da babban resistance, don haka wutar lantarki tana faɗuwa a cikin cable kuma tana zubewa a matsayin zafi. Ko da caja ɗaya, cable mai kauri yana aika ƙarin current.
p-304.principle: Voltage drop shi ne $V=IR$, kuma resistance na waya shi ne $R=\frac{\rho L}{A}$. Ƙarfin da yake ɓacewa a matsayin zafi a cikin cable shi ne $P=I^2R$.
p-304.example: Idan ana caji da $2\ \mathrm{A}$ da wayar tagulla ta tafi da dawowa $2\ \mathrm{m}$ ($\rho=1.7\times10^{-8}\ \Omega\mathrm{m}$), cross-section $0.08\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ (28 AWG) yana da $R\approx0.42\ \Omega$ wanda yake asarar $0.84\ \mathrm{V}$, $1.7\ \mathrm{W}$. $0.2\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ (24 AWG) kuma $0.17\ \Omega$, $0.34\ \mathrm{V}$, $0.7\ \mathrm{W}$.
p-304.actionItem: Yau, maye gurbin cable sirara wanda yake jinkirin caji ko ya yi zafi da cable mai kauri mai rubutaccen rated current.

p-305.title: Firijin kimchi mai murfi a sama yana ƙarancin zubar da sanyi idan an buɗe
p-305.summary: Iska mai sanyi ta fi nauyi don haka tana nutsewa ƙasa tana taruwa. Firijin nau'in murfi a sama yana kiyaye sanyi a cikin akwati kuma ƙarancin sa yana fita idan aka buɗe.
p-305.principle: Density na iska shi ne $\rho=\frac{p}{R_sT}$, wanda yake ƙaruwa idan zafi ya ragu. Buoyancy da bambancin density yake samarwa shi ne $\Delta\rho\,g\,V$, kuma iska mai sanyi tana taruwa a ƙasa a tsayayye.
p-305.example: Iska a $4\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kusan $1.27\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, a $25\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kusan $1.18\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, wato kusan $7\%$ ya fi nauyi. A firiji mai ƙofar gefe, wannan sanyi mai nauyi yana zubewa daga ƙofar da aka buɗe.
p-305.actionItem: Yau, ka yanke shawarar abin da za ka fitar daga firijin kimchi tun da wuri, ka buɗe murfi sau ɗaya a taƙaice.

p-306.title: A kan tukunyar da ke tafasa ta fice, a ɗora sandar cin abinci ta itace a kai
p-306.summary: Idan kumfa ta taɓa sandar ta fashe, yawanci ficewar tana jinkirta. Amma ba cikakken mafita ba ne, don haka ainihin abu shine a rage wuta a kula.
p-306.principle: Bambancin matsin lamba na kumfa guda ɗaya yana bin dokar Laplace $\Delta p=\frac{2\gamma}{r}$ ($\gamma$: tashin hankalin saman ruwa, $r$: radius na lanƙwasa). Idan fatar kumfa ta taɓa saman itace mai kaushi, tana yin sirara ta fashe cikin sauƙi.
p-306.example: Ga ruwa na $100\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ mai $\gamma\approx0.059\ \mathrm{N/m}$ da kumfa mai radius $1\ \mathrm{mm}$, $\Delta p=\frac{2\times0.059}{0.001}\approx118\ \mathrm{Pa}$. Ruwan noodle da pasta mai sitaci mai yawa yana da fatar kumfa mai ƙarfi.
p-306.actionItem: Yau idan za ka dafa noodle, ɗora busasshiyar sandar cin abinci ta itace a kan bakin tukunya a kwance kuma ka sa wuta ta zama matsakaici zuwa ƙasa. Kada sandar ta taɓa wuta.

p-307.title: Duk ƙarin 1m/s na iska, sanyin da ake ji yana raguwa da kusan 1°C
p-307.summary: Idan iska ta hura, tana kawar da layin iska mai ɗumi kusa da fata don haka ana jin sanyi fiye da yanayin zafi iri ɗaya. A lokacin hunturu, zaɓi tufafi ta hanyar duba iska tare da zafin yanayi.
p-307.principle: Asarar zafi ta hanyar convection na tilas shine $q=h(v)\,A\,(T_{\mathrm{skin}}-T_{\mathrm{air}})$ kuma $h$ yana ƙaruwa yayin da gudun iska $v$ ke ƙaruwa. Ma'aunin sanyin iska shine $T_{wc}=13.12+0.6215T-11.37v^{0.16}+0.3965Tv^{0.16}$ ($v$: $\mathrm{km/h}$).
p-307.example: A zafin $0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, gudun iska $1.4\ \mathrm{m/s}$ ($5\ \mathrm{km/h}$) kusan $-1.6\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ne, $5\ \mathrm{m/s}$ ($18\ \mathrm{km/h}$) kuma kusan $-4.9\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, wato ƙarin gudun iska na kusan $3.6\ \mathrm{m/s}$ yana rage zafi da kusan $3.3\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
p-307.actionItem: Yau a ranar da iska ke da ƙarfi, rufe fata da aka bari a waje da jaket mai hana iska da abin rufe wuya.

p-308.title: Zoben wata na iya zama alamar ruwan sama
p-308.summary: Zoben wata zobe ne da lu'ulu'un kankara a cikin gajimare masu tsayi ke yi ta hanyar karkatar da hasken wata. Waɗannan gajimare galibi ana ganinsu idan gaban yanayi ya matso, don haka yiwuwar ruwan sama yana ƙaruwa, amma ba tabbas ba.
p-308.principle: Mafi ƙarancin kusurwar karkata ta prism na lu'ulu'un kankara mai gefe shida shine $D_{\min}=2\arcsin\left(n\sin30^\circ\right)-60^\circ$. Idan $n\approx1.31$ na kankara, $D_{\min}\approx22^\circ$, don haka zobe na $22^\circ$ yana yin kewaye da wata.
p-308.example: A $n=1.31$, $\arcsin(0.655)\approx40.9^\circ$, don haka $D_{\min}\approx2\times40.9-60\approx21.8^\circ$. Faɗin hannu da aka buɗe da hannu da aka miƙe kusan $20^\circ$ ne, don haka tazarar daga wata zuwa zobe kusan faɗin hannu ɗaya ne.
p-308.actionItem: Yau da dare idan ka ga zoben wata, duba hasashen yanayin gobe ka ɗauki laima.

p-309.title: 9H na fim ɗin gilashi mai ƙarfi taurin fensir ne
p-309.summary: 9H yana nufin ko da an ƙwace da fensir mafi tauri ba a samun alama, ba taurin Mohs 9 ba ne. Ƙurar yashi a aljihu na iya ƙwace shi domin ta fi tauri.
p-309.principle: Don a ƙwace sama, ƙwayar dole ta fi saman tauri $H_{\mathrm{particle}}>H_{\mathrm{surface}}$. Ma'aunin taurin fensir da taurin Mohs ma'aunai daban-daban ne.
p-309.example: Quartz (babban sinadarin yashi) yana da taurin Mohs $7$, ya fi gilashi tauri (kusan $5.5\sim6$). Ko da fim ɗin 9H ne, idan ya ragu da taurin Mohs 7, ƙurar yashi na iya ƙwace shi.
p-309.actionItem: Yau ka ajiye waya a aljihu daban da maɓalli da tsabar kuɗi, ka kuma girgiza ƙurar yashi daga aljihu.

p-310.title: A lokacin hunturu, buɗe labule na tagar kudu da rana don samun hasken rana
p-310.summary: A lokacin hunturu, ko da rana tana ƙasa, tagar da ke fuskantar kudu tana karɓar hasken rana kusan kai tsaye kuma tana samun zafi da yawa. Buɗe labule da rana da rufewa bayan faɗuwar rana dumama ce kyauta.
p-310.principle: Ribar zafin rana ta taga shine $Q=A\,I\,\mathrm{SHGC}\cos\theta$ ($I$: ƙarfin hasken rana, SHGC: ma'aunin samun zafin rana, $\theta$: kusurwar shigowa). Tagar tsaye ta kudu a hunturu tana da ƙaramar kusurwar shigowa don haka ratsawar tana da yawa.
p-310.example: Idan taga $2\ \mathrm{m^2}$ ce, hasken rana na tsaye da tsakar rana mai haske $I\approx500\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$, kuma $\mathrm{SHGC}=0.6$, yana da $600\ \mathrm{W}$. Idan aka ɗauka matsakaicin $400\ \mathrm{W}$ na awa 4, ana samun zafi na kusan $1.6\ \mathrm{kWh}$ (ƙimar zato).
p-310.actionItem: Yau a ranar rana mai haske, buɗe labule da blinds na tagar kudu, ka rufe kafin faɗuwar rana don rage asarar zafi da dare.

p-311.title: Ƙofar tsakiya ta shiga gida wuri ne na hana iska
p-311.summary: Ƙaramin sarari tsakanin ƙofar gaban gida da ƙofar tsakiya yana zama wurin kariya wanda ke hana iska mai sanyi shiga gida kai tsaye. Mafi muhimmanci shine kada a buɗe ƙofofin biyu a lokaci ɗaya.
p-311.principle: Musayar iska ta ƙofar da aka buɗe tana faruwa ta convection kuma asarar zafi shine $Q=\rho cV\Delta T$ ($V$: girman iskar da ake musanyawa). Ƙofar tsakiya tana iyakance girman musayar zuwa sararin falon shiga.
p-311.example: Idan $3\ \mathrm{m^3}$ na falon shiga ya musanya da bambancin $20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $Q=1.2\times1005\times3\times20\approx72\ \mathrm{kJ}\approx0.02\ \mathrm{kWh}$. Idan babu ƙofar tsakiya kuma falo na $60\ \mathrm{m^3}$ ya shafa, matsakaicin kusan $0.4\ \mathrm{kWh}$ ne.
p-311.actionItem: Yau idan ka dawo gida, rufe ƙofar gaba kafin ka buɗe ƙofar tsakiya, idan kuma za ka fita, rufe ƙofar tsakiya kafin ka buɗe ƙofar gaba.

p-312.title: Idan saman tanda kawai ke ƙonewa, matsayin rack ne dalili
p-312.summary: Idan kusa da na'urar dumama ta sama, zafin radiation yana ƙaruwa sosai don haka saman yake ƙonewa tukuna. Idan ka saukar da rack da mataki ɗaya, sama da ƙasa suna gasuwa daidai.
p-312.principle: A kimanin tushen haske ɗigo, ƙarfin radiation shine $I=\frac{P}{4\pi r^2}$ wanda ke daidai da juzu'in murabba'in tazara. Na'urar dumama ta gaske tushe ne mai fuska don haka canjin ya fi ƙanƙanta, amma yana ƙaruwa yayin da ya fi kusa.
p-312.example: Idan aka sauƙaƙa, rack mai tazarar $5\ \mathrm{cm}$ daga na'urar dumama yana samun radiation sau $(10/5)^2=4$ na rack mai $10\ \mathrm{cm}$. A zahiri, don na'urar fuska ce, kusan sau 2~3 ne.
p-312.actionItem: Yau idan saman ya fara ƙonewa, saukar da rack da mataki ɗaya, idan kuma ya cancanta ka rufe saman da foil a sakaye.

p-313.title: Saka safa biyu yana rage kumburi a ƙafa
p-313.summary: Kumburi yana faruwa ne daga gogayyar fata da safa, kuma idan safa biyu ne, gogayyar tana faruwa tsakanin layukan safa don haka ba a jan fata sosai. Idan takalmi ya matse sosai sai ya zama akasin haka, don haka bar sarari.
p-313.principle: Ƙarfin gogayya shine $F=\mu N$ kuma damuwar yanke da fata ke karɓa shine $\tau=\frac{F}{A}$. Idan ma'aunin gogayya tsakanin layuka ya fi ƙanƙanta fiye da tsakanin fata da safa, zamewar tana faruwa tsakanin layuka kuma damuwar fata tana raguwa.
p-313.example: Idan aka zata $N\approx700\ \mathrm{N}$ a ƙafa ɗaya yayin tafiya da yankin taɓawa $A\approx100\ \mathrm{cm^2}$, a $\mu=0.5$, $\tau\approx35\ \mathrm{kPa}$, kuma idan $\mu=0.3$ tsakanin layuka, $\tau\approx21\ \mathrm{kPa}$, raguwa ta kusan $40\%$ (ƙimar zato).
p-313.actionItem: Yau idan za ka yi tafiya mai tsayi, saka safa mai sirara mai shan gumi sannan ka ƙara ɗaya a sama, ka kuma tabbatar takalmi bai matse ba.

p-314.title: Dalilin da ya sa hotunan dusar ƙanƙara ke fitowa da launin toka mai duhu
p-314.summary: Auto-exposure na kamara yana daidaita matsakaicin yanayi zuwa launin toka na tsakiya, don haka farar dusar ƙanƙara tana fitowa launin toka. Idan ka ƙara exposure, dusar ƙanƙara tana fitowa fari.
p-314.principle: Auto-exposure yana daidaita matsakaicin reflectance zuwa launin toka $18\%$. Idan reflectance na dusar ƙanƙara $\rho$ ne, gyaran da ake buƙata shine $\Delta\mathrm{EV}=\log_2\frac{\rho}{0.18}$.
p-314.example: Idan reflectance na dusar ƙanƙara $\rho\approx0.8$, $\Delta\mathrm{EV}=\log_2\frac{0.8}{0.18}\approx2.1$. Don haka ana yin gyaran $+1\sim+2\ \mathrm{EV}$ yawanci.
p-314.actionItem: Yau idan za ka ɗauki hoton dusar ƙanƙara, taɓa sashen dusar ƙanƙara a allo ka ɗaga slider na haske zuwa $+1\sim+2$.

p-315.title: Zaɓi laima mai naɗewa da hanyar iska
p-315.summary: Idan iska ta tura fuskar laima da ƙarfi, idan saman yadin yana da hanyar fita ga iska, bambancin matsin lamba yana raguwa kuma ba ya juyewa sosai. Kada ka yi amfani da kowace laima a cikin iska mai ƙarfi.
p-315.principle: Ƙarfin ja shine $F_D=\frac12\rho C_DAv^2$ wanda ke daidai da murabba'in gudun iska. Idan tsarin iska yana rage bambancin matsin lamba, $C_D$ yana raguwa, ƙarfin ma yana raguwa da irin wannan adadi.
p-315.example: A gudun iska $15\ \mathrm{m/s}$, diamita $100\ \mathrm{cm}$ ($A\approx0.79\ \mathrm{m^2}$), $C_D=1.2$, $F_D\approx127\ \mathrm{N}$ (kimanin $13\ \mathrm{kgf}$). Idan $C_D$ ya ragu zuwa $0.9$, ya zama kusan $95\ \mathrm{N}$, raguwar $25\%$ (ƙimar zato).
p-315.actionItem: Yau lokacin zaɓar laima, duba ko tana da rufi biyu ko tsarin iska da ƙasusuwan fiberglass.

p-316.title: Na'urar dumama ta lantarki mai 1kW tana ba da 1kW na zafi
p-316.summary: Na'urar dumama ta lantarki tana mayar da kusan duk wutar da aka yi amfani da ita zuwa zafi. Don haka wutar da ake buƙata don samun adadin zafi ɗaya ana samunsa daidai ta hanyar ninka ƙarfin da lokaci.
p-316.principle: Ingancin dumama ta juriya shine $100\%$ kuma makamashin da aka cinye shine $E=Pt$. Heat pump (dumama da AC) yana da ma'aunin aiki $\mathrm{COP}=\frac{Q}{W}$ na kusan 3, yana samar da zafi iri ɗaya da $\frac13$ na wutar.
p-316.example: Idan ka yi amfani da na'urar dumama $1\ \mathrm{kW}$ na awa 3, $3\ \mathrm{kWh}$ ne, kuma idan aka zata kuɗin wuta KRW 200/kWh, KRW 600 ne (kimanin USD 0.45). Heat pump mai $\mathrm{COP}=3$ yana buƙatar $1\ \mathrm{kWh}$ don zafi iri ɗaya, kimanin KRW 200.
p-316.actionItem: Yau idan za ka yi amfani da na'urar dumama, duba ƙarfin da aka ƙayyade (W) ka saita mai ƙidayar lokaci don kunna ta lokacin da ake buƙata kawai.

p-317.title: Bargon gwiwa yana maye gurbin 1~2°C na zafin dumama
p-317.summary: Zafin da ake ji yana ƙaruwa daidai gwargwadon raguwar zafin da ke fita daga jiki, don haka bargon gwiwa ɗaya yana da tasirin ƙara zafin ɗaki da 1~2°C. Ko da ka rage dumama kaɗan, za ka kasance cikin ɗumi.
p-317.principle: Asarar zafi shine $q=\frac{T_{\mathrm{skin}}-T_{\mathrm{air}}}{R_{\mathrm{clo}}+R_{\mathrm{air}}}$ kuma a aikin zama, tufafi $1\ \mathrm{clo}$ ($0.155\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$) yana rage zafin jin daɗi da kusan $5.5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
p-317.example: Idan bargon gwiwa kusan $0.3\ \mathrm{clo}$ ne, yana rage zafin jin daɗi da kusan $1.7\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Rage dumama da $1\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ƙiyasin yana rage kuɗin dumama da kusan $7\%$, don haka $1.5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kusan $10\%$ ne.
p-317.actionItem: Yau rage saitin dumama na falo da 1°C ka ajiye bargon gwiwa a kan kujera.

p-318.title: Walƙiyar foil a microwave tana farawa daga kusurwa mai tsini
p-318.summary: A kusurwar ƙarfe mai tsini, filin lantarki yana taruwa a wuri ɗaya iska ta tsage kuma walƙiya ta fito. Kada ka saka foil, kwano mai gefen zinariya ko ƙawata ta ƙarfe.
p-318.principle: A ƙarshe mai ƙaramin radius na lanƙwasa, filin lantarki yana ƙaruwa $E\approx\frac{V}{r}$. Iska tana rasa kariyarta a kusan $E_b\approx3\ \mathrm{MV/m}$, wanda ke haddasa fitar corona da walƙiya.
p-318.example: Idan aka zata ƙarfin lantarki da aka jawo $V=300\ \mathrm{V}$ a radius na ƙarshen kusurwar foil $r=0.1\ \mathrm{mm}$, $E=\frac{300}{10^{-4}}=3\ \mathrm{MV/m}$, matakin tsagewar kariya (ƙimar zato). Foil babba mai lebur ya fi ƙanƙanta haɗari fiye da kusurwa amma har yanzu yana da haɗari.
p-318.actionItem: Yau kada ka saka akwatin ƙarfe, foil ko kwano mai gefen zinariya a microwave. Idan walƙiya ta fito, tsayar nan take ka cire bayan ya huce.

p-319.title: Dalilin da ya sa ake jin sanyi a kusa da taga mai sanyi fiye da zafin ɗaki
p-319.summary: Jiki yana rasa zafi ta radiation ba kawai zuwa iska ba har ma zuwa sassan sanyi da ke kewaye. A kusa da taga, ko da iska iri ɗaya ce, saman yana sanyi don haka ana jin sanyi.
p-319.principle: Asarar zafi ta radiation shine $q=\varepsilon\sigma\left(T_{\mathrm{skin}}^4-T_s^4\right)\approx h_r\left(T_{\mathrm{skin}}-T_s\right)$ kuma kusa da zafin ɗaki $h_r\approx5\ \mathrm{W/(m^2\cdot K)}$.
p-319.example: Idan saman tufafi $28\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ne, saman taga $8\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $q\approx5\times20=100\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$, kuma idan bango ne mai saman $18\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $50\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$. Idan yankin da ke fuskantar juna $0.5\ \mathrm{m^2}$ ne, bambancin kusan $25\ \mathrm{W}$ ne (ƙimar zato).
p-319.actionItem: Yau idan kana jin sanyi a wurin zama kusa da taga, nesanta kujera daga taga da kusan mita 1 ko sa labule ko takardar kariya.

p-320.title: Rumfar sansani ta hunturu: a gefen tsauni, ba cikin kwari ba
p-320.summary: A dare mai haske marar iska, iska mai sanyi tana nutsewa tana taruwa a kwari da ramuka. Saman tsauni iska tana da ƙarfi, don haka wuri mai lebur a tsakiyar gangare ya fi kyau inda iska ta fi ƙanƙanta.
p-320.principle: Iska mai sanyi tana da yawa mai girma don haka tana zubowa zuwa ƙasa da hanzarin tashi $a\approx g\frac{\Delta T}{T}$ tana yin tafkin sanyi. Zafi yana raguwa a matsakaicin $0.65\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}/100\ \mathrm{m}$ yayin da tsawo ke ƙaruwa, amma a juyawar dare yana akasin haka.
p-320.example: Idan $\Delta T=5\ \mathrm{K}$, $T=278\ \mathrm{K}$, $a\approx9.8\times\frac{5}{278}\approx0.18\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$. A daren hunturu mai haske da iska mai rauni, ƙasan kwari na iya kasancewa da ƴan $^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ƙasa da gefen tsauni.
p-320.actionItem: Yau idan kana shirin yin sansani, ka guji ramuka a cikin sansanin da aka ware kuma ka zaɓi wuri mai lebur inda iska ta fi ƙanƙanta.

p-321.title: Na'urar dumama ta lantarki ta radiation da ta convection sun bambanta
p-321.summary: Na'urar dumama ta radiation tana dumama mutane da abubuwa kai tsaye don haka nan take akwai ɗumi, ta convection kuma tana dumama iska ta dumama ɗaki gaba ɗaya a hankali. Zaɓi bisa wurin amfani.
p-321.principle: Radiation shine $q=\varepsilon\sigma(T_h^4-T_s^4)A$ wanda ke isar da zafi zuwa saman ba tare da ratsa iska ba, convection kuma shine $q=hA\,\Delta T$ inda iska mai ɗumi ke zagayawa tana ɗaukar zafi.
p-321.example: Radiation na 1 kW yana ɗumama fata a mita 1 da zarar an kunna, amma convection ya buƙaci $Q=mc\Delta T\approx0.18\ \mathrm{MJ}$ kawai don ɗaga iska ta ɗaki 30 m³ (kimanin 36 kg na iska) da 5°C, kuma dumama bango da kayan daki yana ɗaukar lokaci fiye.
p-321.actionItem: Yau idan za ka sayi na'urar dumama, fara ƙayyade amfani: radiation don wuri ɗaya kamar gaban teburi, convection don ɗaki gaba ɗaya.

p-322.title: Motar lantarki a hunturu: kujerun dumama maimakon iska
p-322.summary: Hita da ke dumama iska ta cikin mota tana cin batir da yawa a motar lantarki, don haka dumama jiki kai tsaye da kujera da sitiyari masu dumama da rage saitin cikin mota yana kiyaye tazarar tuki.
p-322.principle: Idan aka dumama ta hanyar taɓa jiki, adadin zafin da ake buƙata ya fi ƙanƙanta sosai. Dumama iska yana buƙatar $Q=mc\Delta T$ da kuma ci gaba da cike asarar da ke zubewa ta jiki da gilashi.
p-322.example: Idan ka rage saiti ka yi amfani da kujera mai dumama na kusan 60 W maimakon hita na ciki na kusan 3 kW, za ka iya adana kusan 1.4 kWh a awa ɗaya, kuma idan mota ce mai 6 km/kWh, kimanin tazarar tuki 8 km.
p-322.actionItem: Yau lokacin tuki, kunna kujera da sitiyari masu dumama tukuna ka rage saitin zafin cikin mota da 1~2°C.

p-323.title: Hita na hunturu a mota zafin sharar inji ne, kusan kyauta
p-323.summary: Hita na motoci masu injin konewa yana amfani da zafin sharar injin da ya taru a ruwan sanyaya, don haka kunna shi kusan ba ya ƙara amfani da mai. Abin da ke cin mai shine compressor na AC.
p-323.principle: Kusan 60% na makamashin mai ana zubar da shi a matsayin zafin shara ($Q_\mathrm{waste}\approx 0.6\,Q_\mathrm{fuel}$) kuma heater core yana juyar da wani ɓangare zuwa cikin mota. Compressor na AC yana ɗaukar ƙarin aiki $W$ daga injin.
p-323.example: Zafin da hita ke amfani da shi kusan 2~4 kW ne, ɗan ƙaramin sashi na zafin sharar injin yayin tafiya mai daidaito, amma compressor na AC yana ƙara ɗaukar kusan 1~3 kW daga ƙarfin injin.
p-323.actionItem: Idan babu hazo, yau a tuƙin hunturu ka bar maɓallin AC a kashe ka yi amfani da hita kawai.

p-324.title: Kwalbar ketchup: ba a girgiza ta ba, a buga ta da ƙarfi a juye
p-324.summary: Ketchup yana tsayawa kamar mai tauri idan an bar shi, amma da zarar ya sami ƙarfi sai ya yi ruwa kwatsam. A juye kwalbar a buga ƙasanta da ƙarfi sau ɗaya don a ba da ƙarfi nan take.
p-324.principle: Ketchup ruwa ne mara-Newton mai raguwar yankewa (shear-thinning): yayin da saurin yankewa $\dot\gamma$ ke ƙaruwa, kauri mai gani $\eta=\tau/\dot\gamma$ yana raguwa kuma yana gudana idan ya wuce damuwar bayarwa.
p-324.example: Idan yana tsaye, kauri yana kusan 50 Pa·s ko fiye, amma idan ya sami yankewa mai ƙarfi, yana iya raguwa sau da yawa. Har yanzu ya fi ruwa (kimanin 0.001 Pa·s) kauri sosai.
p-324.actionItem: Yau juya kwalbar ketchup ka buga da tafin hannu sau ɗaya da ƙarfi a ƙasan wuyan kwalbar.

p-325.title: A treadmill, saita gangare 1% don daidai da waje
p-325.summary: Treadmill ba shi da juriyar iska, don haka ko da gudu iri ɗaya yana da sauƙi fiye da waje. Ɗaga gangare zuwa 1% yawanci yana gyara wannan bambanci.
p-325.principle: Ana cike aikin da juriyar iska ke ɗauka da makamashin matsayi na gangare: $P=mgv\sin\theta\approx mgv\times(\text{ƙimar gangare})$.
p-325.example: Idan mai nauyin 70 kg ya yi gudu a 10 km a awa (kimanin 2.78 m/s), gangare 1% yana ƙara ƙarfi na $70\times9.81\times2.78\times0.01\approx19\ \mathrm{W}$.
p-325.actionItem: Yau idan za ka yi treadmill, saita gangare zuwa 1% ka gudu.

p-326.title: Hotunan wajen taga na bas da jirgin ƙasa: manna ruwan tabarau a gilashi
p-326.summary: Hasken ciki da ke nuna a gilashin taga yana haɗuwa da hoton, kuma idan ka kusanta ruwan tabarau da gilashi yana raguwa sosai. Rufe kewayen ruwan tabarau da hannu ko hood ya fi kyau.
p-326.principle: Tunanin saman gilashi Fresnel reflection ne na kusan 4% a gefe ɗaya ($R=\left(\frac{n-1}{n+1}\right)^2,\ n\approx1.5$), kuma idan ka manna ruwan tabarau, kusurwar da hasken da aka nuna ke shiga ruwan tabarau tana raguwa.
p-326.example: Tun da kusan 4% ake nunawa a kowane gefen gilashi biyu, jimilla kusan 8% na hasken ciki ana nuna shi a taga. A ranar da wajen ya yi duhu, wannan kashi yana bayyana sosai a hoton.
p-326.actionItem: Yau idan za ka ɗauki hoton wajen taga, taɓa ruwan tabarau a gilashi a hankali ka rufe hasken kewaye da hannu ɗaya. Amma kada ka danna da ƙarfi a wurin da ke girgiza sosai.

p-327.title: Duba daidaituwar belun kunne da waya ta impedance (Ω)
p-327.summary: Don na'urori masu ƙaramin ƙarfin fitarwa kamar wayar salula, belun kunne masu ƙaramin impedance suna fitar da sauti mai ƙarfi. Masu babban impedance suna da ƙaramin fitarwa da ƙarfin lantarki iri ɗaya.
