p-327.principle: Ƙarfin da belun kunne ke karɓa shine $P=\frac{V^2}{R}$, don haka a ƙarfin lantarki $V$ iri ɗaya, idan impedance $R$ ya fi girma, $P$ yana raguwa.
p-327.example: A ƙarfin lantarki 0.5 V (rms), belun kunne 16 Ω yana karɓar kusan 15.6 mW, na 300 Ω kuma kusan 0.83 mW, bambancin kusan sau 19.
p-327.actionItem: Yau duba impedance a teburin ƙayyadaddun belun kunne, idan za ka kunna shi kai tsaye a waya, zaɓi na 16~32 Ω.

p-328.title: 1kWh daidai yake da 3.6MJ, kusan 860kcal
p-328.summary: kWh na kuɗin wuta, kcal na abinci da joule (J) na kimiyya duk ma'aunin makamashi ne kuma ana iya musanya su daidai.
p-328.example: 2,000 kcal a rana kusan 8.4 MJ ne, wato kusan 2.3 kWh, kuma matsakaici kusan 97 W. Da 1 kWh za ka iya kunna fitila 100 W na awa 10.
p-328.actionItem: Yau duba amfanin wutar wannan wata (kWh) a takardar kuɗin wuta ko manhaja.

p-329.title: A duk lokacin da aka buɗe ƙofar tanda, zafi yana raguwa da 25°C
p-329.summary: Idan aka buɗe ƙofar tanda sau ɗaya, iska mai zafi tana fita iska mai sanyi kuma tana shiga, zafin ciki yana raguwa a bayyane kuma ana buƙatar makamashi don mayar da shi.
p-329.principle: Idan aka buɗe ƙofa, iska tana musanyawa ta convection saboda bambancin zafi, kuma don murmurewa ana sake shigar da zafi $Q=C\Delta T$. Bango yana riƙe da zafi don haka yawan raguwa ya bambanta a kowane tanda.
p-329.example: A tanda 180°C, an san cewa idan an buɗe ƙofa sau ɗaya zafi yana raguwa da kusan 20~30°C kuma murmurewa yana ɗaukar mintuna kaɗan. Lokacin girki yana ƙaruwa kuma ana amfani da ƙarin wuta.
p-329.actionItem: Yau lokacin girki a tanda, kada ka buɗe ƙofa, ka duba yanayin ta taga da hasken tanda.

p-330.title: Danyen kwai da dafaffen kwai ana bambance su ta juya su
p-330.summary: Idan ka juya kwai a kan tebur, dafaffen kwai yana juyawa a hankali na dogon lokaci, danyen kwai kuma yana ruɗewa yana tsayawa da sauri.
p-330.principle: Dafaffen kwai jiki ɗaya ne mai tauri don haka yana juyawa daidai da $L=I\omega$. A danyen kwai, ruwan ciki yana motsi daban da bawo don haka makamashi yana yaɗuwa, kuma ko bayan tsayawa ruwan yana ci gaba da juyawa don haka yana sake motsi kaɗan.
p-330.example: Idan ka juya kwai mai nauyin kusan 60 g, dafaffen kwai yana juyawa daidai na ɗan daƙiƙoƙi, danyen kwai kuma yawanci yana tsayawa da wuri a bayyane. Idan ka tsayar da shi da hannu na ɗan lokaci ka sake, danyen kwai ne kawai yake sake motsi kaɗan.
p-330.actionItem: Yau juya ƙwai biyu daga firiji a kan tebur ka duba wanne ne ke juyawa a hankali.

p-331.title: Yi tari a hannun riga ko gwiwar hannu, digon yawu yana tashi mita da yawa
p-331.summary: Tari da atishawa suna yin saurin iska mai ƙarfi da ke aika digon yawu zuwa mita da yawa. Idan ka rufe da cikin gwiwar hannu ko hannun riga, tazarar da yake bazuwa tana raguwa sosai.
p-331.principle: Jet ɗin da ke fitowa daga baki yana da momentum $p=mv$ kuma yana bazuwa gaba, gudunsa yana raguwa a hankali yana bazuwa cikin iska.
p-331.example: An ba da rahoton saurin farko na iskar tari kusan 10 m a daƙiƙa, kuma ƙananan ƙwayoyi na iya shawagi a iska su kai har mita da yawa.
p-331.actionItem: Yau idan ka yi tari, rufe baki da hanci da cikin gwiwar hannu ko hannun riga maimakon hannu.

p-332.title: Zaɓi launin ruwan tabarau na gilashin kankara bisa yanayi
p-332.summary: A ranar rana, ruwan tabarau mai duhu yana rage haske; a ranar gajimare ko dusar ƙanƙara, ruwan tabarau mai rawaya/lemu yana kiyaye bambancin ƙasa.
p-332.principle: Ruwan tabarau yana da ratsawa daban ta tsawon raƙuma, kuma haske yana ƙayyadewa ta ratsawar haske mai gani $\mathrm{VLT}=I/I_0$. Rawaya/lemu yana tace hasken shuɗi yana ƙara bambanci a ranar gajimare.
p-332.example: A ranar rana, ruwan tabarau mai launin toka mai duhu ko madubi na VLT kusan 10~20%, a ranar gajimare kuma ruwan tabarau mai rawaya ko ruwan hoda na VLT kusan 40~60% zaɓuɓɓukan gama gari ne.
p-332.actionItem: Yau lokacin shirya gilashin kankara, duba hasashen yanayi ka ƙayyade launin ruwan tabarau (ko ruwan tabarau mai canzawa).

p-333.title: Ajiye lasifika fiye da 20cm daga bango
p-333.summary: Idan ka manna lasifika da bango, bass yana kumbura kuma wasu sautuka suna ɓacewa, sautin yana zama maras haske da gajimare.
p-333.principle: Kusa da bango, saboda tasirin iyaka bass yana ƙaruwa (kimanin 3~6 dB), kuma sauti yana raguwa a mita $f=\frac{c}{4d}$ inda sautin da bango ya mayar yana da lokaci akasin sautin kai tsaye.
p-333.example: A tazara 20 cm daga bango, kusa da $f=\frac{343}{4\times0.2}\approx430\ \mathrm{Hz}$ yana raguwa, a 50 cm kuma kusa da 170 Hz yana raguwa, don haka yankin bass yana canzawa. Ya danganta da yanayin ɗaki.
p-333.actionItem: Yau ka nesanta lasifika fiye da 20 cm daga bango ka sake sauraron waƙa iri ɗaya.

p-334.title: Inverter na mota yana da babban wutar lantarki a 12V
p-334.summary: Idan ka haɗa na'ura mai babban ƙarfi kamar cajar laptop da inverter a mota, wutar lantarki a gefen 12 V tana da girma sosai kuma fuse na soket na iya narkewa.
p-334.principle: Ƙarfi shine $P=VI$, don haka a ƙarfi iri ɗaya, idan ƙarfin lantarki ya fi ƙanƙanta, wutar lantarki $I=P/V$ tana ƙaruwa.
p-334.example: Na'ura mai 150 W a ka'ida $150/12=12.5\ \mathrm{A}$ ne, kuma idan an yi la'akari da ingancin inverter 90%, kusan 13.9 A, kusa da iyakar fuse na soket na yau da kullum na 10~15 A.
p-334.actionItem: Yau duba ƙarfin fuse na soket na mota (A) ka raba ƙarfin amfani na na'urar da za ka haɗa da 12 V.

p-335.title: Zafin farko na tanda tsayayyen kuɗi ne, don haka a gasa tare
p-335.summary: Makamashin da ake buƙata don preheat a duk lokacin da ka kunna tanda iri ɗaya ne ko adadin da za ka gasa nawa. Idan ka gasa abubuwa da yawa a lokaci ɗaya, adadin preheat yana raguwa.
p-335.principle: Zafin da preheat ke buƙata ana ƙayyade shi ta ƙarfin zafi na tanda da hawan zafi: $Q=C_\mathrm{oven}\Delta T$. Ba shi da alaƙa da adadin abinci.
p-335.example: Preheat na tanda ta lantarki zuwa 180°C yana buƙatar kusan 0.3~0.4 kWh, kuma idan ka gasa a lokaci ɗaya maimakon sau biyu za ka iya adana kusan KRW 70 (kimanin dala 0.05).
p-335.actionItem: Yau idan za ka yi amfani da tanda, tara duk abin da za ka gasa ka gasa a kan matakai biyu tare.

p-336.title: A nemo stud a bango ta sauraron ƙwanƙwasa
p-336.summary: Idan ka ƙwanƙwasa bangon plasterboard da yatsa, wuri mara ciki yana ba da sauti mai ƙara mai ƙasa, kuma kan stud (ƙashi) sauti mai tauri da tsayi.
p-336.principle: Fuskar da aka ƙwanƙwasa tana girgiza tana fitar da mitar resonance $f\propto\sqrt{k/m}$, kuma a kan ƙashi taurin $k$ yana da girma don haka sautin yana yin tsayi da gajere.
p-336.example: Studs yawanci suna da tazara 400~600 mm, don haka idan ka ƙwanƙwasa tare da bango kowane kusan 10 cm, wuraren da sautin ke canzawa suna fitowa akai-akai.
p-336.actionItem: Yau kafin ka kafa ƙusa, ƙwanƙwasa bango ka nemo stud, ka duba ko wayoyi ko bututu suna wucewa.

p-337.title: Ana iya jure sauna na 80°C amma ba ruwa na 80°C ba
p-337.summary: Iska ba ta isar da zafi da kyau don haka ana iya jure sauna na 80°C, amma ruwa mai irin wannan zafi yana ƙona fata nan take.
p-337.principle: Zafin da ke zuwa fata yana daidai da conductivity na zafi da ƙarfin zafi. Conductivity na zafi na ruwa kusan $0.6\ \mathrm{W/m\,K}$ ne, kusan sau 25 na iska ($0.026$), kuma ƙarfin zafin kowace girma ma ya fi girma sosai.
p-337.example: Conductivity na zafi na ruwa kusan sau 25 na iska ne, ƙarfin zafin kowace girma kusan sau 3,500, don haka ruwa sama da 60°C na iya haddasa ƙonewa cikin daƙiƙoƙi.
p-337.actionItem: Yau kafin ka yi shawa ko wanka, fara duba zafin ruwa da cikin hannu.

p-338.title: Kankarar tafkin da ya daskare tana tsaye ne kawai idan kauri ya wuce 10cm
p-338.summary: Ƙarfin kankara na ɗaukar nauyi yana ƙaruwa daidai da murabba'in kauri, amma sirarar kankara tana da haɗari. Duba kauri ka bi umarnin wurin.
p-338.principle: Nauyin da farantin kankara ke ɗauka shine $P\propto h^2$, don haka idan kauri $h$ ya ninka sau 2, yana ɗaukar kusan sau 4.
p-338.example: Gabaɗaya, 5 cm yana ɗaukar mutum ɗaya ne kawai yana tafiya da ƙyar, kuma ana cewa 10 cm ko fiye ne lafiya ga mutane da yawa suna tafiya, kuma idan kauri ya ƙaru daga 5 cm zuwa 10 cm, ƙarfin ɗaukar nauyi yana ƙaruwa kusan sau 4.
p-338.actionItem: Yau kafin ka fita kan kankara, fara duba umarnin wurin da kauri, kuma idan akwai shakka kada ka fita.

p-339.title: Ana auna fitila ta lumen, tsawon lokaci kuma ta Wh
p-339.summary: Kwatanta haske na fitila ta lumen (lm), tsawon lokacin da take ci kuma ta ƙarfin batir (Wh) da aka raba da ƙarfin amfani.
p-339.principle: Inganci shine $\eta=\mathrm{lm}/\mathrm{W}$ kuma lokacin amfani shine $t=\frac{E}{P}$.
p-339.example: Idan 300 lm ya fito a inganci 100 lm/W, 3 W ne. Batir 3.7 V 5,000 mAh (kimanin 18.5 Wh) a ka'ida yana kunna kusan awa 6.
p-339.actionItem: Yau duba lumen da Wh na batir (ko mAh×V) a ƙayyadaddun fitilar ka ka ƙirga lokacin amfani.

p-340.title: Ranar da rana ke faɗuwa mafi wuri ba ranar solstice ba ce
p-340.summary: Rana tana faɗuwa mafi wuri a farkon Disamba, kusan makonni 2 kafin solstice na hunturu (kusan 21 ga Disamba) lokacin da rana ta fi gajarta. Akasin haka, rana tana fitowa mafi a ƙarshe a farkon Janairu.
p-340.principle: Lokacin da rana ke zuwa kudu daidai yana karkata da equation of time $E$, don haka mafi ƙarancin lokutan faɗuwa da fitowar rana sun bambanta da solstice.
p-340.example: A Seoul, faɗuwar rana tana mafi wuri da kusan 17:16 a farkon Disamba kuma kusa da solstice kusan 17:20 ne, kusan mintuna 4 daga baya, amma tsawon hasken rana ya fi gajarta a solstice.
p-340.actionItem: Yau duba lokacin faɗuwar rana ka kalli ko lokacin faɗuwa yana sake jinkirta zuwa tsakiyar Disamba.

p-341.title: Ma'aunin kicin yana ɓata ƙarancin kayan abinci fiye da ma'aunin kofi
p-341.summary: Gari da aka ɗiba da kofi adadinsa yana bambanta sosai gwargwadon matsewa, amma ma'auni yana auna daidai da gram don haka ƙarancin kayan abinci ake ɓatawa.
p-341.principle: Yawan abu shine $m=\rho V$, amma gari yawansa $\rho$ yana canzawa da fiye da 20% gwargwadon matsewa, don haka ko da girma iri ɗaya yawan yana bambanta.
p-341.example: Kofi 1 na gari (kimanin 240 mL) yana bambanta tsakanin 100~150 g gwargwadon yadda ake ɗiba, bambancin kusan 50%, wanda ke sa kullu ya yi tauri ko ya yi ruwa.
p-341.actionItem: Yau idan za ka yi burodi ko kuki, auna kayan abinci da ma'auni da gram maimakon kofi.

p-342.title: Saka waya a cikin kofin gilashi yana ƙara sauti
p-342.summary: Idan ka saka waya a cikin kofin gilashi mara komai, sautin yana taruwa yana tafiya gaba kuma yana amsa ƙara a cikin kofin don haka ana jin shi da ƙarfi. Tasirin kusan dB kaɗan ne.
p-342.principle: Bututu da aka rufe gefe ɗaya yana yin resonance kusa da $f=\frac{c}{4L}$, kuma kofin yana tara sauti a gefe ɗaya yana ƙara directivity.
p-342.example: Idan kofin yana da zurfin 10 cm, kusa da $f=\frac{343}{4\times0.1}\approx860\ \mathrm{Hz}$ yana ƙaruwa, kuma yana iya ƙaruwa da kusan 3~6 dB (sau 2~4 na makamashin sauti), ya bambanta a kowane samfuri.
p-342.actionItem: Yau saka gefen lasifikar waya zuwa cikin kofi ka kwatanta ƙarfin sauti.

p-343.title: Ƙonewa ta ƙananan zafi na iya faruwa ko da 44°C cikin 'yan awanni
p-343.summary: Zafi da ba mai tsanani ba kamar bargon lantarki ko hot pack, idan ya taɓa wuri ɗaya na dogon lokaci, yana lalata fata mai zurfi. Ba ya da zafi sosai don haka yana da sauƙi a wuce ba tare da sani ba.
p-343.principle: Lalacewar fata tana faruwa ta conduction na taɓa zafi inda zafi da lokacin bayyanawa ke tarawa, kuma ko da zafi ƙasa yake, idan lokaci ya yi tsawo lalacewar tana ƙaruwa.
p-343.example: An san cewa taɓawa da kusan 44°C na fiye da awa 6 na iya haddasa ƙonewa, kuma hot pack mai kusa da 60°C yana da haɗari ko da cikin gajeren lokaci.
p-343.actionItem: Yau kada ka sa hot pack ko bargon lantarki kai tsaye a fata, ka sa a kan tufafi ko yadi ka kashe kafin ka yi barci.

p-344.title: Ɓarkewar dusar ƙanƙara tana faruwa mafi yawa a gangare na 30~45°
p-344.summary: A gangaren da dusar ƙanƙara ta taru, ɓarkewar dusar ƙanƙara tana faruwa mafi yawa a gangare 30~45°. Idan ya yi sauƙi sosai, dusar ƙanƙara tana tsayawa, idan kuma ya yi tsayi sosai tana zubowa kafin ta taru.
p-344.principle: Idan damuwar yankewa a ƙasan layin dusar ƙanƙara $\tau=\rho g h\sin\theta\cos\theta$ ta wuce juriyar gogayya, tana zamewa, kuma yayin da kusurwar gangare $\theta$ ke ƙaruwa $\tau$ yana ƙaruwa, yana da mafi girma a kusan 45°.
p-344.example: Idan dusar ƙanƙara mai yawan 300 kg/m³ da kauri 1 m tana kan gangare 38°, $\tau\approx300\times9.81\times1\times0.485\approx1.4\ \mathrm{kPa}$, kuma idan wannan ƙimar ta wuce ƙarfin layin dusar ƙanƙara, ɓarkewar tana faruwa.
p-344.actionItem: Yau idan za ka je dutsen dusar ƙanƙara, kafin ka tashi duba hasashen ɓarkewar dusar ƙanƙara da kusurwar gangare, kuma ka guji gangare fiye da 30°.

p-345.title: Idan tripod ɗinka mai sauƙi ne, sa masa nauyi
p-345.summary: Tripod mai sauƙi yana faɗuwa cikin sauƙi ta iska. Idan ka rataya nauyi kamar jaka a tsakiya a ƙasa don rage tsakiyar nauyi, yana da kwanciyar hankali sosai.
p-345.principle: Tripod yana faɗuwa idan ƙarfi a tsayi $h$ ya wuce lokacin maidowa $mgr$ da gefen ƙafa ke zama axis. Ƙarfin da ake buƙata don faɗar da shi shine $F=\frac{mgr}{h}$, don haka idan tsakiyar nauyi ya yi ƙasa, ana buƙatar ƙarfi mafi girma.
p-345.example: Idan ka rataya jaka mai nauyin 3 kg a tsawo 0.3 m na tripod mai nauyin 1.5 kg (tsakiyar nauyi 1.2 m, radius na ƙafa 0.4 m), tsakiyar nauyi yana sauka zuwa 0.6 m, kuma ƙarfin da ake buƙata don faɗar da shi yana ƙaruwa daga kusan 4.9 N zuwa kusan 14.7 N, kusan sau 3.
p-345.actionItem: Yau idan za ka yi amfani da tripod, rataya jaka a ƙugiya ƙarƙashin center column ta yadda ba ta taɓa ƙasa ba.

p-346.title: Mutum ɗaya murhun 100W ne
p-346.summary: Mutum yana fitar da kusan 100 W na zafi ko da yana hutawa, don haka ɗaki da mutane da yawa suna ɗumama da sauri ba tare da dumama ba.
p-346.principle: Makamashin abincin da aka ci a ƙarshe ana fitar da shi azaman zafi, kuma basal metabolic rate kusan $P=E/t\approx80\text{-}120\ \mathrm{W}$.
p-346.example: 2,000 kcal a rana shine $\frac{8.37\ \mathrm{MJ}}{86400\ \mathrm{s}}\approx97\ \mathrm{W}$. Ɗaki da mutane 20 yana da kusan 2 kW, daidai da ƙaramin murhun lantarki ɗaya.
p-346.actionItem: Yau idan akwai taro, rage saitin dumama da 1~2°C.

p-347.title: Goge ƙasan tukunya mai danshi kafin ka ɗora ta
p-347.summary: Ruwan da ke ƙasan tukunya yana ƙafewa a kan wuta yana ɗaukar zafi mai yawa wanda ke ɓata lokaci da gas, kuma digon da ke tsalle na iya zama haɗari.
p-347.principle: Idan ruwa yana ƙafewa ana buƙatar latent heat $Q=mL$, kuma zafin ƙafewar ruwa shine $L\approx2.26\ \mathrm{kJ/g}$.
p-347.example: Idan akwai ruwa 10 g a ƙasa, ana buƙatar $Q=10\times2.26=22.6\ \mathrm{kJ}$, wato zafin kusan daƙiƙa 11 a ƙarfin wuta mai tasiri na 2 kW.
p-347.actionItem: Yau kafin ka ɗora tukunya a kan wuta, goge danshin ƙasanta da kyalle.

p-348.title: Dalilin da ya sa idan fitila ɗaya ta mutu duk igiyar bishiya tana mutuwa
p-348.summary: A igiyar da aka haɗa fitilu a jere, idan ɗaya ta yanke, babu hanyar da wutar lantarki za ta gudana kuma duka suna mutuwa.
p-348.principle: Wutar lantarki a da'irar jere iri ɗaya ce a dukkan sassa $I=\frac{V}{R_1+R_2+\cdots}$. Idan wuri ɗaya ya yanke, juriya ya zama marar iyaka kuma $I=0$.
p-348.example: Idan aka haɗa fitilu 50 na 2.4 V a jere, suna raba kusan 120 V. Idan ɗaya ta fita, wutar lantarki a sauran 49 ma tana zama 0.
p-348.actionItem: Yau idan igiyar fitila ta mutu, cire filog ɗin ka danna fitilar da ta sassauta ko ka maye gurbinta da ta ajiya.

p-349.title: Dalilin da zafin numfashi 'ho~' da 'hu~' ke bambanta
p-349.summary: 'Ho~' da ake fitarwa da baki a buɗe yana jin ɗumi, 'hu~' da ake fitarwa da leɓe a matse kuma yana jin sanyi.
p-349.principle: Idan ka matse leɓe, yana zama jet mai sauri wanda ke jan iskar kewaye (entrainment). Zafin haɗuwa yana raguwa $T=\frac{m_1T_1+m_2T_2}{m_1+m_2}$ kuma sanyayawar faɗaɗa ma tana ƙara kaɗan.
p-349.example: Idan numfashi na kusan 34°C ya haɗu da iskar ɗaki 20°C da rabon 1:1, ya zama kusan 27°C, kuma iskar da ke taɓa hannu tana jin ƙasa da kusan 7°C.
p-349.actionItem: Yau busa 'ho~' da 'hu~' a bayan hannunka a madadin ka ji bambancin zafi.

p-350.title: Saurin sledge na dusar ƙanƙara ana ƙayyade shi ta tsawo kawai
p-350.summary: Idan babu gogayya, saurin ƙasan sledge yana ƙayyadewa ta tsawon da yake saukowa kawai kuma ba ya dogara da nauyin jiki. A zahiri yana da jinkiri saboda gogayya da juriyar iska.
p-350.principle: Makamashin matsayi yana zama makamashin motsi, don haka daga $mgh=\frac12mv^2$, $v=\sqrt{2gh}$.
p-350.example: Idan tsawo 5 m ne, $v=\sqrt{2\times9.81\times5}\approx9.9\ \mathrm{m/s}$, wato kusan 36 km a awa, kuma saurin gaske ya fi wannan ƙasa.
p-350.actionItem: Yau idan za ka yi sledge, zaɓi gangare mai laushi babu cikas ka saka hular kwano.

p-351.title: Kwanta a kan katifa na mintuna 10 ka duba tazarar kugu
p-351.summary: Lokacin sayen katifa, kwanta na kusan mintuna 10 ka duba ko tafin hannu yana shiga cikin sauƙi tsakanin kugu da katifa. Idan tazara ta yi girma, kugu yana ɗagawa kuma matsin lamba yana taruwa a wuri ɗaya.
p-351.principle: Matsin lamba shine $P=\frac{F}{A}$, wanda ke raguwa yayin da yankin tallafi $A$ ke ƙaruwa. Katifa tana rarraba nauyi ta hanyar spring constant $k$ da tsarin layuka.
p-351.example: Idan nauyin jiki na 70 kg (kimanin 686 N) ya hau kan 0.1 m² kawai, kusan 6.9 kPa, kuma idan aka rarraba shi zuwa 0.3 m², kusan 2.3 kPa, kashi ɗaya cikin uku.
p-351.actionItem: Yau lokacin zaɓar katifa, kwanta a gefe ma ka duba mintuna 10 ko kafaɗa, kugu da cinya suna samun tallafi daidai.

p-352.title: Fan na kan murhu yana juyawa ba tare da wuta ba
p-352.summary: Fan da aka ɗora a kan murhu yana juyawa ba tare da waya ko batir ba, da zafin murhu kawai, yana bazuwa ɗumi cikin ɗaki.
p-352.principle: Ta tasirin Seebeck bambancin zafi $\Delta T$ tsakanin mahaɗa biyu yana samar da ƙarfin lantarki $V=S\Delta T$, kuma wannan ƙarfin lantarki yana juya mota.
p-352.example: Tare da thermoelectric module mai Seebeck coefficient kusan 0.05 V/K, bambancin zafi na 100 K yana samar da open-circuit voltage na kusan 5 V, kuma fitarwa ya kai W kaɗan ko ƙasa.
p-352.actionItem: Yau ka ɗora fan na kan murhu a wurin da ke cikin kewayen zafin da aka rubuta a kan samfurin, ka nesanta shi daga hannun yara.

p-353.title: Murhun tukunyar fure da tealight ba ya dumama ɗaki
p-353.summary: Murhun da aka yi da tealight kaɗan da tukunyar fure ba ya samar da isasshen zafi don dumama ɗaki kuma yana ƙara haɗarin gobara da carbon monoxide kawai.
p-353.principle: Kyandir yana ba da zafi daidai da zafin konewar man fetur kawai $P=\dot m\,\Delta H$, kuma tealight ɗaya yana kusan 40 W.
p-353.example: Tealight ɗaya yana ƙone kimanin 14 g na kakin zuma (kimanin 0.6 MJ) a awa 4, kusan 40 W, kuma guda 4 kusan 160 W, wanda ke ƙaramin kashi ne na 1~3 kW da ake buƙata don dumama ɗaki.
p-353.actionItem: Yau maimakon murhun tukunyar fure, toshe giɓin kewayen taga don rage zubar zafi.

p-354.title: Kwalaben shampagne na tashi da gudun 50km a awa
p-354.summary: A cikin kwalbar shampagne akwai matsin lamba na kusan yanayi 6, don haka idan an saki kwalbar tana tashi da gudun kusan 50 km a awa kuma na iya raunata ido.
p-354.principle: Bambancin matsin lamba yana hanzarta kwalbar da ƙarfin $F=\Delta P\cdot A$, kuma aikin da gas ke yi yayin faɗaɗa yana zama makamashin motsi $\frac12mv^2$.
p-354.example: Idan bambancin matsin lamba kusan 5 bar ne kuma yankin kwalba kusan $2.5\times10^{-4}\ \mathrm{m^2}$, $F\approx127\ \mathrm{N}$, kuma idan kwalbar ta tashi da kusan 14 m/s (50 km/h), makamashin motsi kusan 0.9 J.
p-354.actionItem: Yau lokacin buɗe shampagne, karkata kwalba da kusan 45°, danna kwalbar da babban yatsa ka juya kwalbar a hankali, kada ka nuna wa mutum.

p-355.title: A lokacin barci farin amo yana rufe sautuka na kwatsam
p-355.summary: Farin amo mai laushi yana rage bambanci tsakanin sauti na kwatsam da sautin baya, wanda zai iya taimakawa kada barci ya katse. Tasirin ya bambanta a kowane mutum.
p-355.principle: Ta hanyar auditory masking amo mai faɗin mitoci yana ɗaga ƙofar jin sauran sautuka. Ana bayyana bambancin sauti da $\Delta L=L_\mathrm{sound}-L_\mathrm{bg}$.
p-355.example: A baya 30 dB, sautin ƙofa da ke rufewa 70 dB bambanci ne na 40 dB, amma idan akwai farin amo 45 dB, bambancin yana raguwa zuwa 25 dB don haka ba ya damuwa sosai.
p-355.actionItem: Yau da dare, kunna farin amo a ƙaramin sauti na kusan 40 dB a kunne tare da mai ƙidayar lokaci, ka nesanta shi daga kunnen ƙaramin jariri.

p-356.title: Ƙusoshin takalmin kankara na riƙewa ne ta makalewa cikin kankara
p-356.summary: Ƙusoshin takalmin kankara ba su ƙara gogayya ba, amma suna hana zamewa ta hanyar kaifin ƙusoshi da ke shiga kankara suna kama ta jiki.
p-356.principle: Takalmi a kan kankara yana da iyakar zamewa na $\tan\theta=\mu$, ma'aunin gogayya $\mu$ yana da ƙanƙanta sosai, amma spikes suna kamawa ta amfani da juriyar yankewar kankara.
p-356.example: Ma'aunin gogayya na tsaye tsakanin takalmi na yau da kullum da kankara kusan 0.1 ne, don haka yana zamewa a kusan 5.7° ($\tan^{-1}0.1$) kawai, amma ƙusoshin takalmin kankara na iya riƙewa ko da a gangaren kankara mafi tsayi.
p-356.actionItem: Yau kafin hawan dutse, duba ko ƙusoshin takalmin kankara ba su da ƙunci kuma ko ɗaurin yana matsewa da ƙarfi.

p-357.title: Zaɓi laser pointer mai ƙasa da 1mW
p-357.summary: Laser pointer da ke da lafiya ga ido shine samfurin Class 2 mai fitarwa 1 mW ko ƙasa. Idan fitarwar ta fi haka, har blink reflex na ido ba ya isa ya kare.
p-357.principle: Blink reflex na ido kusan daƙiƙa 0.25 ne kuma makamashin da ke shiga ido shine $E=P\,t$. Idan yankin giciye na hasken ya fi ƙanƙanta, haske $I=P/A$ yana ƙaruwa.
p-357.example: 1 mW na daƙiƙa 0.25 shine $E=0.25\ \mathrm{mJ}$. Haske mai diamita 3 mm yana da $I=1\ \mathrm{mW}/7.1\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{m^2}\approx140\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$. Wasu samfuran masu arha suna da fitarwa fiye da yadda aka rubuta.
p-357.actionItem: Yau duba rubutun 'Class 2, 1 mW ko ƙasa' a laser pointer ɗinka, kada ka haska shi a mutane, dabbobi ko motoci.

p-358.title: Murhun itace ko briquette yana ƙonewa sosai idan bututun hayaki ya fi tsawo
p-358.summary: Idan bututun hayaki ya fi tsawo kuma iskar cikinsa ta fi zafi, ƙarfin da ke jan sama (draft) yana ƙaruwa don haka wuta tana kamawa sosai kuma hayaki yana fita cikin sauƙi.
p-358.principle: Ta tasirin bututun hayaki matsin lamba na draft shine $\Delta P=gh(\rho_\mathrm{out}-\rho_\mathrm{in})$, wanda ke daidai da tsawo $h$ da bambancin yawa.
p-358.example: Idan tsawo 5 m ne, waje 0°C (1.29 kg/m³), hayaki 200°C (kimanin 0.75 kg/m³), $\Delta P\approx9.81\times5\times0.54\approx27\ \mathrm{Pa}$.
p-358.actionItem: Yau idan za ka yi amfani da murhu, duba haɗin bututun hayaki ka duba batir na na'urar ƙararrawar carbon monoxide.

p-359.title: Ko a yanayin ƙasa da sifili, tufafi suna bushewa yayin da suke daskarewa
p-359.summary: Tufafin da aka shanya a yanayin ƙasa da sifili suna daskarewa, amma suna bushewa a hankali ta sublimation inda kankara ke komawa tururi ba tare da wucewa ta ruwa ba. Ba sai an yi amfani da na'urar busarwa ba.
p-359.principle: Sublimation inda kankara ke zama gas kai tsaye $\mathrm{H_2O(s)\rightarrow H_2O(g)}$ yana buƙatar $L_s\approx2.83\ \mathrm{kJ/g}$, kuma yana da sauri idan ya bushe kuma akwai iska.
p-359.example: Don 1 kg na ruwa ya yi sublimation ana buƙatar kusan 2.83 MJ. Ko da ya fi lokaci fiye da zagaye ɗaya na na'urar busarwa (kimanin 2~3 kWh), ba a amfani da wuta.
p-359.actionItem: Yau a ranar ƙasa da sifili mai haske da bushewa, shanya tufafi, sannan bayan sun bushe, girgiza su ka gama a cikin gida.

p-360.title: Cire dusar ƙanƙara daga rufin mota kafin ka tuƙa
p-360.summary: Dusar ƙanƙara da ta taru a rufin mota tana tashi a guntuka zuwa baya idan ka tuƙa ta bugi motar da ke baya ko ta rufe gilashin gaba. Cire ta daga rufi, bonnet da gilashi kafin ka tashi.
p-360.principle: Saboda saurin iska yayin tuƙi, guntun dusar ƙanƙara yana tashi baya yana bugun motar da ke baya da makamashin motsi $E=\frac12mv^2$.
p-360.example: Idan dusar ƙanƙara 5 cm (ana zaton yawa 100 kg/m³) ta taru a rufin 2 m², kimanin 10 kg ne. Idan ta buga da saurin dangantaka 80 km/h (22.2 m/s), kusan 2.5 kJ.
p-360.actionItem: Yau idan dusar ƙanƙara ta sauka, kafin ka tuƙa share dusar ƙanƙara duka daga rufi, bonnet da gilashi da buroshi mai laushi.

p-361.title: Dalilin da ake ɗaga murya idan gidan abinci ya yi hayaniya
p-361.summary: Idan hayaniya ta ƙaru, mutum yana ɗaga muryarsa ba tare da sani ba, ana kiran wannan tasirin Lombard. Idan kowa ya yi haka, hayaniya tana ƙaruwa ƙwarai.
p-361.principle: Ta tasirin Lombard sound pressure yana ƙaruwa tare da hayaniya, kuma don a ji murya dole a kiyaye signal-to-noise ratio $\mathrm{SNR}=L_s-L_n$.
p-361.example: An san cewa idan hayaniya ta ƙaru da 20 dB daga 60 dB zuwa 80 dB, maganar tana ƙaruwa da kusan 6~10 dB. Gidan abinci na iya kaiwa 70~80 dB.
p-361.actionItem: Yau a taro, zaɓi kusurwa mai nisa daga lasifika ka karkata jikinka zuwa abokin magana ka yi magana da ƙaramar murya.

p-362.title: Fitowar rana ta sabuwar shekara tana farawa da wuri a yankuna na gabas
p-362.summary: Rana tana fitowa a gabas tukunna. A latitude ɗaya, fitowar rana tana kusantowa da kusan mintuna 4 ga kowane digiri 1 na longitude zuwa gabas.
p-362.principle: Duniya tana juyawa $15^\circ$ a awa ɗaya, don haka bambancin $1^\circ$ na longitude shine $\frac{60\ \mathrm{min}}{15}=4\ \mathrm{min}$.
p-362.example: Homigot a longitude 129.6°E yana da kusan 2.6° gabas da Seoul (127°E) don haka fitowar rana tana kusan mintuna 10 da wuri, kuma ainihin bambancin yana ɗan bambanta gwargwadon latitude.
p-362.actionItem: Yau idan za ka je kallon fitowar rana ta sabuwar shekara, fara duba lokacin fitowar rana na yankin da za ka je.

p-363.title: Matsin iska bar·psi·kPa, a canza su lokaci ɗaya
p-363.summary: Ana rubuta matsin iskar tayoyi da bar, psi, kPa da sauransu. Idan ka tuna ƙimar juyawa ɗaya kacal, za ka iya canza kowane ma'auni.
p-363.example: 2.3 bar shine 230 kPa kuma $2.3\times14.5\approx33\ \mathrm{psi}$. 35 psi kusan 2.41 bar ne.
p-363.actionItem: Yau duba teburin matsin iska da aka ba da shawara a ƙofar kujerar direba ka tabbatar da ainihin ƙima da ma'aunin matsin iska.

p-364.title: Lokacin cajin motar lantarki a gida: kWh÷kW
p-364.summary: Ana samun lokacin caji ta hanyar raba makamashin da za a cika (kWh) da fitarwar caja (kW). Saboda asara, a zahiri yana ɗan ɗaukar lokaci fiye.
p-364.principle: $t=\frac{E}{P}$, kuma idan akwai ingancin caji $\eta$, $t=\frac{E}{\eta P}$.
p-364.example: Idan ka cika batir 60 kWh daga 10% zuwa 80%, $E=42\ \mathrm{kWh}$, kuma da caja 7 kW (inganci 90%) $t=\frac{42}{0.9\times7}\approx6.7$ awa.
p-364.actionItem: Yau duba ƙarfin batir na motarka (kWh) da fitarwar caja (kW) ka ƙirga lokacin caji.

p-365.title: Lokacin narkar da dusar ƙanƙara don yin ruwa, fara sa kofin ruwa
p-365.summary: Dusar ƙanƙara tana da ramukan iska da yawa don haka ba ta isar da zafi da kyau, kuma idan ka sa ta kai tsaye a tukunya mara komai ƙasa na iya ƙonewa. Idan ka fara sa ɗan ruwa, taɓa zafi yana inganta kuma tana narkewa da sauri sosai.
p-365.principle: Conductivity na zafi na dusar ƙanƙara ƙasa ne kuma ramukan suna da girma don haka yankin taɓawa da tukunya ƙanƙane ne. Don narkewa ana buƙatar zafin narkewa $L_f=334\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$.
p-365.example: Don yin ruwa lita 1 ana buƙatar kusan 334 kJ, daidai da zafin da ake ɗaga ruwa da 80°C. Dusar ƙanƙara kusan 10% ne kawai na girma ruwa, don haka ana buƙatar kusan lita 10 na dusar ƙanƙara.
p-365.actionItem: Yau idan za ka yi ruwa daga dusar ƙanƙara, fara dumama kofin ruwa sannan ka ƙara dusar ƙanƙara mai tsabta kaɗan-kaɗan (a tafasa kafin a sha dole).

p-366.title: A kan tudu mai dusar ƙanƙara, hanzarta a hankali ka hau ba tare da tsayawa ba
p-366.summary: A kan tudu mai dusar ƙanƙara, idan ka tsaya yana da wuya ka sake tashi, idan kuma ka hanzarta da sauri ƙafafu suna juyawa a banza. Kafin tudu, bar tazara ka hau a hankali da gudu iri ɗaya.
p-366.principle: Tun da gogayyar tsaye $F\le\mu_sN$ ta fi gogayyar motsi $F=\mu_kN$ ($\mu_s>\mu_k$), idan ƙafafu suka juya a banza, riƙon ƙasa yana raguwa sosai.
p-366.example: Idan $\mu\approx0.2$ na hanyar dusar ƙanƙara da aka matse, a gangare 10% ($\theta\approx5.7^\circ$) kashin nauyi kusan $0.1\,mg$ ne kuma gogayya kusan $0.2\,mg$, don haka tazarar da ta rage kusan $0.1\,mg$ kawai.
p-366.actionItem: Yau a gaban tudu mai dusar ƙanƙara, bar isasshen tazara tsakaninka da motar gaba ka hau da gudu iri ɗaya don kada ka tsaya a tsakiya.

c-001.title: Kada a haɗa baking soda da vinegar, a yi amfani da su daban
c-001.summary: Idan aka haɗa su biyu, kumfa kawai ake samu kuma ƙarfin tsaftacewarsu yana soke juna. Ya fi dacewa a yi amfani da baking soda don maiko, vinegar kuma don ƙurar ruwa mai tauri, kowanne daban.
c-001.principle: Mai rauni na alkali ($\mathrm{NaHCO_3}$) da mai rauni na acid ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$) suna neutralizing, su zama maganin sodium acetate wanda ya kusa zama tsaka-tsaki: $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 + CH_3COOH \to CH_3COONa + H_2O + CO_2\uparrow}$
c-001.example: Idan aka haɗa cokali 1 na baking soda (kusan 12 g) da rabin kofi na vinegar, bayan kumfa ya ɓace pH yana sauka zuwa kusan 8 ko ƙasa da haka, kuma ba ya iya narkar da maiko ko ƙurar ruwa sosai. Idan aka yi amfani da su daban, ana magance dukan ƙazanta biyu da adadi ɗaya.
c-001.actionItem: Yau, a yi amfani da man baking soda kaɗai a kan maikon sink, da tawul ɗin kicin da aka jiƙa da vinegar kaɗai a kan ƙurar ruwa ta famfo.

c-002.title: Kada a taɓa yin amfani da bleach da mai tsabtace acidic tare
c-002.summary: Idan aka haɗa sodium hypochlorite (bleach) da mai tsabtace bayan gida mai acid, ana samun iskar chlorine mai guba. A yi amfani da ɗaya kawai a lokaci guda, a kuma wanke sosai da ruwa a tsakani.
c-002.principle: Idan hypochlorite ta haɗu da acid, tana canzawa zuwa chlorine: $\mathrm{NaOCl + 2HCl \to NaCl + Cl_2\uparrow + H_2O}$
c-002.example: Iskar chlorine tana haifar da ƙaiƙayin idanu da maƙogwaro ko da a kusan 3 ppm, kuma a 30 ppm ko fiye tana haddasa tari mai tsanani da wahalar numfashi. A ƙaramin banɗaki, tana iya kaiwa matakin haɗari cikin 'yan mintuna.
c-002.actionItem: A ɗakin banɗaki, a raba bleach da masu tsabtace acid (hydrochloric, citric) zuwa wurare daban-daban a kan shelf, kuma kafin amfani a duba rubutun 'kada a haɗa' a kan alamar.

c-003.title: Haɗa bleach da ammonia ko mai goge gilashi ma yana da haɗari
c-003.summary: Idan aka haɗa bleach da mai goge gilashi mai ammonia, ana samun iskar chloramine mai guba. A buɗe iska, kuma kada a yi amfani da samfuran biyu a jere a rana ɗaya.
c-003.principle: $\mathrm{NaOCl + NH_3 \to NH_2Cl + NaOH}$ yana samar da chloramine ($\mathrm{NH_2Cl}$), wanda ke harzuƙa hanyar numfashi.
c-003.example: Ko da an haɗa ɗan bleach kaɗan da mai tsabtace mai kusan 5% ammonia, a banɗaki da aka rufe tari da ƙaiƙayin idanu na iya bayyana cikin mintuna. Idan aka yi amfani da bleach a wurin da fitsari ya taɓa, haka ma ana samun iskar mai wari bisa ƙa'ida ɗaya.
c-003.actionItem: A bincika jerin sinadaran masu tsabtace don neman 'ammonia', a yi rubutu don kada a yi amfani da shi da bleach a rana ɗaya, kuma a buɗe taga yayin tsabtace.

c-004.title: Don tafiya, a zaɓi hand sanitizer mai ethanol 60% ko fiye
c-004.summary: Idan babu ruwa, alcohol hand sanitizer madadin ne, amma idan yawan ethanol ya kasa 60%, tasirinsa yana raguwa sosai. A jirgin sama, a raba shi a kwantena masu 100 mL ko ƙasa da haka.
c-004.principle: Ethanol yana lalata sunadaran ƙwayoyin cuta kuma yana narkar da fatar kitsensu. Yana da saurin kamawa da wuta, halayen ƙonewarsa shi ne $\mathrm{C_2H_5OH + 3O_2 \to 2CO_2 + 3H_2O}$.
c-004.example: Samfuran da ke da ethanol 60~80% suna aiki ne idan aka shafa su kusan daƙiƙa 20 aka bar su har sai sun bushe gaba ɗaya. A hannun da ƙasa ta bayyana a kai, ruwa da sabulu sun fi sanitizer.
c-004.actionItem: Yau, a duba yawan ethanol (%) a kan alamar sanitizer da za a saka a jakar tafiya, a raba shi zuwa kwantena masu 100 mL ko ƙasa da haka.

c-005.title: Lokacin zaɓar mai tsabtace, a duba pH a kan alamar
c-005.summary: pH na masu tsabtace kicin da banɗaki yana bambanta bisa amfani. Idan aka zaɓi mai alkali don maiko da mai acid don ƙurar ruwa, kuɗi ɗaya yana tsabtacewa sosai.
c-005.principle: $\mathrm{pH = -\log[H^+]}$, kuma idan pH ya sauka da 1, yawan $\mathrm{H^+}$ yana ninkawa sau 10. Kitse yana saponifying a cikin alkali: $\mathrm{RCOOR' + NaOH \to RCOONa + R'OH}$
c-005.example: Masu tsabtace alkali masu pH 11~12 suna aiki sosai a kan maiko, masu acid masu pH 2~3 kuma a kan ƙurar lime. Sabulun wanke kwano na tsaka-tsaki (pH 6~8) yana da sauƙi ga hannu, amma yana ɗaukar lokaci a kan maiko mai tsanani.
c-005.actionItem: A lokacin siyayya ta gaba, a duba alamar pH da 'amfani' a kan alamar mai tsabtace, kuma a rubuta pH na masu tsabtace 3 da ke gida.

c-006.title: Wanke da ruwan sanyi na 30℃ don rage makamashin dumama
c-006.summary: Sabulun wanki na yanzu yana aiki da enzymes sosai a kusan 30℃, don haka ba a buƙatar kai wanki na yau da kullum zuwa 60℃. Yayin da ake dumama ruwa kaɗan, wutar lantarki tana raguwa.
c-006.principle: Zafin da ake buƙata don dumama ruwa shi ne $Q = mc\Delta T$ ($c = 4.18\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$), kuma enzymes masu rarraba sunadarai suna aiki sosai a 30~40℃.
c-006.example: Dumama lita 10 na ruwa daga 15℃ zuwa 30℃ yana ɗaukar kusan 627 kJ, zuwa 60℃ kuma kusan 1,881 kJ, wato bambanci sau 3. Idan ana wanki sau 4 a mako, tanadin yana taruwa fiye da sau 200 a shekara.
c-006.actionItem: Yau, a saita zafin injin wanki zuwa 30℃ (ko ruwan sanyi), kuma a ɗaga zuwa 40℃ kawai don wanki mai zufa sosai.

c-007.title: Cire ƙurar ruwa daga kettle na lantarki da cokali ɗaya na citric acid
c-007.summary: Farin lime da ke cikin kettle yana narkewa da citric acid. Yana da ƙarancin wari fiye da vinegar kuma mai arha, don haka ya dace a gwada shi kafin a sayi sabon kettle.
c-007.principle: Ƙurar calcium carbonate tana narkewa a cikin acid: $\mathrm{3CaCO_3 + 2C_6H_8O_7 \to Ca_3(C_6H_5O_7)_2 + 3H_2O + 3CO_2\uparrow}$
c-007.example: Idan aka saka cokali 1 na citric acid (kusan 10 g) a 500 mL na ruwa aka tafasa, sa'an nan aka bar shi minti 20, yawancin ƙurar da kaurinta ya kai kusan 1 mm tana narkewa. Kilogram 1 na citric acid da farashinsa ya kai kusan KRW 5,000 yana ba da amfani sau da yawa.
c-007.actionItem: Yau, a saka ruwa da cokali 1 na citric acid a kettle, a tafasa, a bar shi minti 20, a zubar da ruwan, a kuma wanke sau biyu ko uku.

c-008.title: Menene farin ragowar sabulu da ke saura a wanki da banɗaki
c-008.summary: A cikin ruwa mai tauri (hard water), fatty acid na sabulu yana haɗuwa da calcium ya zama ragowar da ba ta narkewa a ruwa. Ana iya rage ta ta amfani da sabulun roba ko wanke da vinegar.
c-008.principle: $\mathrm{Ca^{2+} + 2C_{17}H_{35}COO^- \to Ca(C_{17}H_{35}COO)_2\downarrow}$ yana samar da ruwan tsakuwa (precipitate), kuma kumfa ma yana raguwa.
c-008.example: A yankunan da taurin ruwa ya kai 200 mg/L (bisa CaCO₃) ko fiye, kumfa daga adadin sabulu ɗaya na iya raguwa zuwa rabi ko ƙasa da haka. Farin fim a kan tayal ɗin banɗaki yana narkewa da mai tsabtace acid.
c-008.actionItem: Yau, a fesa vinegar ko ruwan citric acid a kan farin fim ɗin tayal ɗin banɗaki, a bar shi minti 5, sa'an nan a goge.

c-009.title: Rage ragowar chlorine a ruwan famfo ta ajiyewa ko tafasa
c-009.summary: Ruwan famfo yana da ɗan chlorine da ya rage don kashe ƙwayoyin cuta. Yana da aminci, amma idan ba ka son warinsa, ana rage shi ta barin ruwan a buɗe ko ta tafasa shi.
c-009.principle: Hypochlorous acid tana rarraba idan lokaci ya wuce ko haske ya shafe ta: $\mathrm{2HOCl \to 2HCl + O_2\uparrow}$
c-009.example: Ragowar chlorine a famfo yawanci 0.1~0.5 mg/L ne. Idan aka zuba ruwa a kettle aka bar shi sa'o'i kaɗan ko aka tafasa shi minti 5 a buɗe, warin yana raguwa sosai.
c-009.actionItem: A yammacin yau, a zuba ruwa a kettle a bar shi a buɗe, sa'an nan gobe kafin a sha a kwatanta wari.

c-010.title: Dalilin da ya sa gashi ke tauri bayan shawa a ruwa mai tauri a ƙasashen waje
c-010.summary: Ruwa a yankuna masu lime da yawa kamar Turai yana da calcium da magnesium da yawa, don haka kumfan shamfu yana ƙaranci gashi kuma yana tauri. Ana taimakawa ta yin magani mai acid a matakin wankewa.
c-010.principle: $\mathrm{Ca^{2+}, Mg^{2+}}$ na ruwa mai tauri suna haɗuwa da anionic surfactant na shamfu su samar da ƙura. Ana bayyana taurin ruwa da $\mathrm{mg/L\ CaCO_3}$.
c-010.example: Idan taurin ya kai 300 mg/L ko fiye, ana rarraba shi a matsayin 'mai tauri sosai', wanda ya fi ruwan famfo na Koriya (yawanci 50~100 mg/L) sau 3 ko fiye. Idan aka haɗa cokali 1 na apple cider vinegar a kowace lita 1 na ruwa aka wanke da shi a ƙarshe, taurin yana raguwa.
c-010.actionItem: A jakar tafiya ta gaba, a saka ɗan ƙaramin foda na citric acid ko ƙaramin kwalbar vinegar, kuma a tambayi masaukin taurin ruwan wurin.

c-011.title: Ana sabunta ion-exchange resin na matatar ruwa mai laushi da gishiri
c-011.summary: Matatar shawa ta rage taurin ruwa da wasu na'urorin tace ruwa suna kama calcium da ion-exchange resin. Akwai nau'in da ake sabuntawa da ruwan gishiri da nau'in maye, don haka a tabbatar kafin sayi.
c-011.principle: Resin yana kama calcium yana sakin sodium: $\mathrm{2R\text{-}Na + Ca^{2+} \to R_2Ca + 2Na^+}$. Bayan ya cika, ana mayar da shi da ruwan gishiri mai tsanani.
c-011.example: Idan matatar maye ɗaya kuɗinta KRW 10,000 kuma ana maye sau 1 a wata, kuɗin shekara KRW 120,000 ne. Nau'in da ake sabuntawa wani lokaci ana iya amfani da shi shekaru da dama da kuɗin gishiri na kilogram kaɗan kawai.
c-011.actionItem: A kwatanta 'tsawon lokacin maye' da 'ko za a iya sabuntawa' na matatar da za a saya, a lissafa kuɗin shekara.

c-012.title: Na'urar dumama mai ƙurar ruwa tana amfani da makamashi mai yawa kuma tana lalacewa da wuri
c-012.summary: Idan lime ta taru a kan farantin dumama na kettle na lantarki ko humidifier, zafi yana raguwa wajen wucewa zuwa ruwa, lokacin dumama yana ƙaruwa, kuma sassan suna yin zafi fiye da kima. Cire ta akai-akai yana da amfani ga makamashi da tsawon rai.
c-012.principle: Wucewar zafi ita ce $q = \dfrac{kA\Delta T}{d}$, kuma ƙurar ruwa ($k \approx 1\text{-}3\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$) wani layin insulation ne da ke hana zafi fiye da ƙarfe sosai.
c-012.example: Idan ƙura ta taru 2 mm ko fiye, lokacin dumama zuwa zafi ɗaya na iya ƙaruwa da wasu kaso kaɗan, zafin sinadarin dumama yana ƙaruwa kuma tsawon ransa yana raguwa. Wanke da citric acid sau ɗaya a wata ya isa.
c-012.actionItem: A kalanda, a yi rajistar abin da zai maimaita: 'Lahadi ta farko ta kowane wata, wanke kettle da humidifier da citric acid'.

c-013.title: Narkar da ƙanƙara da gishiri: a yayyafa kaɗan kafin ta daskare
c-013.summary: Idan aka yayyafa ɗan gishiri kafin dusar ƙanƙara ko kafin daskarewa, ana buƙatar ƙasa da lokacin da ake narkar da ƙanƙarar da ta riga ta daskare. Dalili shi ne wurin daskarewa yana sauka.
c-013.principle: Saukar wurin daskarewa $\Delta T_f = i K_f m$ ($K_f = 1.86\ \mathrm{K\cdot kg/mol}$, $i \approx 2$ na NaCl)
c-013.example: Ruwan gishiri mai kashi 10% na nauyi yana da $m \approx 1.9\ \mathrm{mol/kg}$, don haka $\Delta T_f \approx 7\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, wato yana fara daskarewa a kusan -7℃. Ƙasa da -10℃ tasirinsa yana raguwa sosai, a lokacin a yi amfani da yashi.
c-013.actionItem: Idan hasashen yanayi ya nuna sanyi ƙasa da sifili yau da dare, a yayyafa ɗan gishiri kaɗan a hankali a kan matakan ƙofa.

c-014.title: Gishirin calcium chloride da gishiri na yau da kullum: me za a yi amfani da shi a ina
c-014.summary: Calcium chloride yana aiki har zuwa zafi mai ƙasa fiye, amma yana lalata siminti da ƙarfe fiye. A zaɓa bisa yanayin zafi da wuri.
c-014.principle: Calcium chloride yana ba da zafi idan ya narke a ruwa: $\mathrm{CaCl_2 \to Ca^{2+} + 2Cl^-}$, $\Delta H \approx -82\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$
c-014.example: Ainihin tasiri shi ne NaCl har kusan -10℃, $\mathrm{CaCl_2}$ kuma har kusan -25℃. A kusa da siminti da aka zuba sabo ko hannayen ƙarfe, a rage amfani da chloride a yi amfani da yashi.
c-014.actionItem: Yau, a duba sinadarin (sodium chloride/calcium chloride) a kan buhun gishirin narkar da ƙanƙara, kuma a yi alama dabam kada a yi amfani da shi a kusa da hannayen ƙarfe kusa da ƙofa.

c-015.title: Wanke ƙafafun dabbar gida da hannu daga gishirin narkar da ƙanƙara
c-015.summary: Gishirin chloride da ake yayyafawa a hanya yana busar da tafin ƙafa, kuma idan dabba ta lasa zai iya sa amai. A wanke da ruwan ɗumi bayan yawo.
c-015.principle: Chloride yana jan ruwan fata kuma yana busar da ita. Ruwan gishiri da ya narke yana saura bisa ƙa'ida ɗaya da saukar wurin daskarewa $\Delta T_f = i K_f m$.
c-015.example: Calcium chloride yana ba da zafi idan ya narke, don haka idan ya taɓa fata mai ruwa yana iya yin zafi. Idan aka wanke ƙafa a ruwan ɗumi daƙiƙa 30 aka busar, yawanci an gama.
c-015.actionItem: Bayan yawo yau, a wanke ƙafafun dabbar gida da ruwan ɗumi, ku mutane kuma a goge tafin takalma da kyalle mai ruwa.

c-016.title: Kafin tuƙi mai nisa a lokacin hunturu, a duba wurin daskarewar ruwan wanke gilashi
c-016.summary: Ruwan wanke gilashi da ruwa kawai ke ciki yana daskarewa a 0℃ ya toshe gani. Ruwan wanke gilashi na hunturu yana da alcohol da ke saukar da wurin daskarewa.
c-016.principle: Tun da $\Delta T_f = K_f m$, idan yawan alcohol ya fi yawa wurin daskarewa yana sauka, amma yana da saurin kamawa da wuta ($\mathrm{C_2H_5OH + 3O_2 \to 2CO_2 + 3H_2O}$).
c-016.example: Samfurin da aka rubuta -20℃ ko -30℃ a kan alamarsa ba ya daskarewa har zuwa wannan zafin, amma idan aka haɗa shi da ruwa wurin daskarewa yana hawa. Tururin samfuran methanol guba ne, don haka a kula da iska.
c-016.actionItem: Kafin tashi, a duba ragowar ruwan tankin wanke gilashi da alamar wurin daskarewa a kan alama.

c-017.title: Antifreeze: a duba rabon haɗawa da alamar ma'auni kafin sayi
c-017.summary: Idan aka haɗa antifreeze (ethylene glycol) da ruwan sanyaya, wurin daskarewa yana sauka kuma wurin tafasa yana hawa. Dole a bi rabo da ma'auni don ya yi tasiri, kuma kada a haɗa nau'o'i daban-daban.
c-017.principle: $\Delta T_f = i K_f m$, kuma da ethylene glycol (kusan 50 vol%) wurin daskarewa yana kusan -37℃ kuma wurin tafasa kusan 106℃.
c-017.example: Idan aka yi amfani da tsantsa kaɗai, wurin daskarewa ma yana hawa kuma wucewar zafi tana lalacewa. Ethylene glycol yana da zaƙi, don haka yana kashe dabbobin gida, a goge shi nan da nan idan ya zube.
c-017.actionItem: A duba ma'aunin antifreeze da rabon haɗawa da aka ba da shawara a littafin jagorar mota, sa'an nan a yi tambaya a lokacin ƙiyasin farashin gareji.

c-018.title: Ana iya hasashen ɗigon ruwa a taga a hunturu ta dew point
c-018.summary: Idan iska mai ɗanshi ta cikin gida ta taɓa gilashi mai sanyi, ɗigon ruwa yana samuwa kuma yana haddasa mold da asarar zafi. Idan aka daidaita ɗanshin cikin gida yadda ya kamata, ba a wuce gona da iri wajen dumama ba.
c-018.principle: Dew point ya kusan bin dabarar $T_d \approx T - \dfrac{100-\mathrm{RH}}{5}$ ($\mathrm{RH}>50\%$), kuma condensation shi ne $\mathrm{H_2O(g) \to H_2O(l)}$.
c-018.example: Idan cikin gida 22℃ ne kuma ɗanshi 60%, dew point kusan 14℃ ne. Idan saman cikin taga 10℃ ne, ɗigon ruwa zai samu, don haka idan aka rage ɗanshi zuwa 40~50%, dew point yana kusan 10~12℃ kuma yawancin hakan ana kauce masa.
c-018.actionItem: Yau, a saita ɗanshin da ake nufi na humidifier zuwa 40~50% kuma a duba ƙimar hygrometer da yamma.

c-019.title: Cire mold na silicone na banɗaki lafiya da bleach mai laushi
c-019.summary: Mold baƙi da ya bazu a kan silicone yana fita launi da bleach mai oxidizing. A tabbatar da iska, kuma kada a yi amfani da shi da samfuran acid.
c-019.principle: Oxidation na hypochlorite: $\mathrm{NaOCl \to Na^+ + OCl^-}$, kuma $\mathrm{OCl^-}$ yana oxidizing launin mold da ƙwayoyin sa.
c-019.example: A laushe bleach na kasuwa (kusan 4~5%) da ruwa 1:10, a shafa, bayan minti 10 a wanke sosai da ruwa. Mold yana girma a ɗanshi na dangi na 60~70% ko fiye, don haka buɗe iska bayan shawa yana hana dawowa.
c-019.actionItem: Yau, a buɗe taga na banɗaki, a saka safar hannu, a goge mold na silicone da maganin bleach 1:10, bayan minti 10 a wanke.

c-020.title: Cire mold da launin rawaya lafiya da sodium percarbonate
c-020.summary: Sodium percarbonate, bleach na oxygen, ba ya harzuƙa kamar bleach kuma ba shi da haɗarin iskar chlorine, don haka yana da sauƙin amfani a kan tufafi masu launi ma. Yana aiki fiye a ruwa mai ɗumi.
c-020.principle: Sodium percarbonate yana rarraba yana sakin hydrogen peroxide: $\mathrm{2Na_2CO_3\cdot 3H_2O_2 \to 2Na_2CO_3 + 3H_2O_2}$, $\mathrm{2H_2O_2 \to 2H_2O + O_2\uparrow}$
c-020.example: Idan aka narkar da cokali 1 na sodium percarbonate (kusan 10 g) a lita 1 na ruwa na 40~50℃ aka jiƙa 30 mintuna zuwa awa 1, tabon zufa da na mold suna fita. Kada a yi amfani da shi a kan ulu da siliki.
c-020.actionItem: Yau, a narkar da cokali 1 na sodium percarbonate a ruwa na 40~50℃ a jiƙa safa ko kyallen kicin mai launin rawaya minti 30.

c-021.title: Na'urar shan ɗanshi a ɗakin tufafi tana daɗewa a ƙaramin wuri
c-021.summary: Na'urar shan ɗanshi ta calcium chloride tana shan ruwan da ke cikin iska ta koma ruwa. Idan aka yi amfani da ita a ƙananan wurare da aka rufe kamar ɗakin tufafi ko akwatin takalma maimakon babban ɗaki, tana da inganci sosai.
c-021.principle: $\mathrm{CaCl_2(s) + 6H_2O(g) \to CaCl_2\cdot 6H_2O}$ yana shan ɗanshi, kuma idan ya sha fiye yana narkewa ya zama ruwa.
c-021.example: Calcium chloride yana shan ruwa sau da yawa na nauyinsa. Idan aka sa shi a wurin da ake buɗe ƙofa akai-akai, yana cika da sauri, don haka yana da amfani a yi amfani da shi fiye da wata ɗaya a ƙaramin wuri da aka rufe. A zubar da ruwan da ya taru ba tare da ya taɓa fata ko ƙarfe ba.
c-021.actionItem: Yau, a sanya na'urar shan ɗanshi 1 a ƙasan ɗakin tufafi, kuma a rage yawan buɗewa da rufe ƙofa.

c-022.title: Ƙananan jakunkuna a cikin abinci: silica gel da quicklime sun bambanta
c-022.summary: Silica gel da quicklime su ne masu bushewa guda biyu da aka fi samu a marufin abinci, kuma kada a ci kowanne daga cikinsu. Quicklime yana zafi idan ya haɗu da ruwa, don haka a kula musamman da idanu da baki.
c-022.principle: Quicklime: $\mathrm{CaO + H_2O \to Ca(OH)_2}$ (yana ba da zafi, $\Delta H \approx -64\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$). Silica gel yana jan kwayoyin ruwa a saman sa (adsorption).
c-022.example: Ana iya sake amfani da silica gel idan aka busar da shi a tanda na 100~120℃ na awa 1~2. Idan jakar quicklime ta jike, ta zama ruwan alkali mai ƙarfi, don haka a jefar da ita ba tare da ta taɓa ruwa ba.
c-022.actionItem: A fitar da jakunkunan masu bushewa daga aljihun kicin, a duba alamar 'silica gel/quicklime', kuma a ajiye su ba tare da isar yara ba.

c-023.title: Hana hazo a gilashin ido da goggles da digo ɗaya na surfactant
c-023.summary: Hazon da ke samuwa a ruwan tabarau idan ka shiga ɗaki mai ɗumi daga waje mai sanyi na hunturu ƙananan digon ruwa ne ke haifar da shi. Idan aka rufe da fim ɗin surfactant, digon ruwan yana yaɗuwa a siraren fim kuma gani yana ci gaba.
c-023.principle: Idan contact angle ya fi girma, digon ruwa yana samuwa. Surfactant yana saukar da surface tension $\gamma$ don digon ya yaɗu.
c-023.example: Idan aka shafa digo ɗaya kacal na sabulun wanke kwano a siraren a kan ruwan tabarau aka goge da busasshen kyalle, hazo yana raguwa na awanni kaɗan. Ruwan tabarau mai coating na iya lalacewa, don haka a duba umarnin masana'anta.
c-023.actionItem: Kafin fita yau, a manne saman abin rufe hanci sosai a hanci, kuma a shafa digo ɗaya na sabulu a gilashin ido a goge.

c-024.title: Idan aka shimfiɗa abinci siriri aka daskare shi da sauri, ba ya lalacewa sosai
c-024.summary: Idan ya daskare a hankali, manyan lu'ulu'un ƙanƙara suna yaga ƙwayoyin halitta, ruwa yana fita bayan narkewa kuma abinci yana tauri. Idan aka shimfiɗa siriri aka daskare da sauri, ƙananan lu'ulu'u suna samuwa kuma inganci yana kasancewa.
c-024.principle: Girman lu'ulu'u yana dogara da saurin sanyaya. Sauyin yanayi $\mathrm{H_2O(l) \to H_2O(s)}$, dole a cire zafi na $\Delta H_{fus} = 6.01\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$.
c-024.example: Idan aka shimfiɗa ragowar miya ko nama a jakar zipper da kauri 2 cm aka daskare shi a kan tire na ƙarfe, yana daskarewa sa'o'i kaɗan da wuri fiye da idan aka daskare a dunƙule kuma asarar ruwan nama yayin narkewa tana raguwa. Ma'aunin ajiya shi ne -18℃ ko ƙasa.
c-024.actionItem: Yau, a shimfiɗa wani abincin da ya rage siriri a jakar zipper, a rubuta kwanan wata, kuma a daskare shi.

c-025.title: Yadda ake magance dankalin da ya tsiro ko ya yi kore
c-025.summary: Tsiro da koren sashen dankali suna da solanine mai guba da yawa. Ba ya rarraba da sauƙi ko da an dafa ko an soya, don haka a yanke su da kauri.
c-025.principle: Solanine yana jure zafi, kuma yana rarrabuwa ne kawai a kusan $290\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Idan haske ya shafe shi, samar da solanine yana ƙaruwa tare da chlorophyll.
c-025.example: Idan aka yanke sosai fiye da 1 cm a kusa da tsiro da koren sashe, ana cire mafi yawansa. Idan fatar gaba ɗaya kore ce ko tana da ɗaci, a jefar da dankalin. Idan aka ajiye shi a wuri mai duhu da sanyi (8~10℃), tsiro yana fitowa a hankali.
c-025.actionItem: Yau, a naɗe dankali a jaridar a ajiye shi a wuri mai duhu da sanyi, kuma a yanke ko a jefar da dankalin da ya tsiro.

c-026.title: A jinkirta launin ruwan kasa na apple da avocado da digo ɗaya na ruwan lemon
c-026.summary: Yankakken 'ya'yan itace suna zama launin ruwan kasa saboda halayen enzyme da ke haɗuwa da oxygen. Idan aka ƙara acid, halayen suna raguwa kuma yana da aminci a ci.
c-026.principle: Polyphenol oxidase: $\mathrm{2\,catechol + O_2 \to 2\,o\text{-}benzoquinone + 2H_2O}$. Ascorbic acid (vitamin C) yana mayar da quinone zuwa asalinsa (reduction).
c-026.example: A pH 4 ko ƙasa, aikin enzyme yana raguwa sosai. Idan aka yanka apple 1 aka yayyafa cokali ƙarami 1 na ruwan lemon, launin ruwan kasa yana jinkiri da awa 2~3. Sashen da ya zama ruwan kasa ba shi da babbar matsala ga abinci mai gina jiki ko aminci.
c-026.actionItem: Idan kun yanka apple ko avocado yau, a jiƙa su kaɗan a ruwan lemon ko ruwan gishiri.

c-027.title: Pressure cooker yana ɗaga wurin tafasa don rage lokacin dafa abinci da gas
c-027.summary: A cikin tukunya da aka rufe, matsin lamba yana ƙaruwa kuma ruwa yana tafasa a zafi sama da 100℃. Idan zafi ya hau, saurin halayen sinadarai yana ƙaruwa.
c-027.principle: Bisa dangantakar Clausius-Clapeyron, a kusan 2 atm (cikakke) ruwa yana tafasa a kusan $120\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Saurin hali shi ne $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$.
c-027.example: Idan zafi ya hau 10℃, saurin hali yana ninkawa sau 2, don haka idan ya hau 20℃ yana ninkawa kusan sau 4. Wake ko nama mai tauri da ke ɗaukar minti 60 a tukunya ta yau da kullum yana raguwa zuwa kusan minti 20 a pressure cooker, kuma amfani da gas yana raguwa sosai.
c-027.actionItem: Yau, a gwada abinci mai tsawon tafasa (wake, shank da sauransu) a pressure cooker, kuma a kwatanta lokaci.

c-028.title: Dalilin da ya sa jam mai sukari da yawa ke daɗewa ba tare da mold ba
c-028.summary: Saboda sukari yana riƙe ruwa, ruwan da ƙananan halittu za su iya amfani da shi yana raguwa. Idan aka tsabtace kwalba aka bi rabon sukari, ana iya ajiye shi na dogon lokaci a firiji.
c-028.principle: Idan water activity $a_w = \dfrac{p}{p_0}$ ya sauka ƙasa da 0.85, yawancin ƙwayoyin cuta ba sa girma, mold kuma yana girma har kusan 0.8.
c-028.example: Jam mai kusan 60% sukari yana da $a_w \approx 0.80$, wanda ke hana ƙwayoyin cuta amma mold yana yiwuwa. Idan aka saka shi a kwalbar da aka tsabtace da ruwan zafi, a firiji kafin buɗewa, kuma a ci cikin makonni 2~3 bayan buɗewa, ana rage almubazzaranci.
c-028.actionItem: Yau, a dafa 'ya'yan itacen da suka rage da sukari 40~50% a yi jam, a saka shi a kwalbar da aka tsabtace a rubuta kwanan wata.

c-029.title: Maikon kaskon soya: a fara goge shi sa'an nan a wanke da ruwan ɗumi
c-029.summary: Maiƙo mai sanyi yana tauri kuma ba a goge shi da sauƙi da sabulu da ruwa. Idan aka fara goge da tawul ɗin kicin sannan aka yi amfani da ruwan ɗumi da sabulu, ana tanadin sabulu da ruwa.
c-029.principle: Kitse yana yin halayen da alkali da surfactant ya zama sabulu mai sauƙin wankewa: $\mathrm{C_3H_5(OOCR)_3 + 3NaOH \to C_3H_5(OH)_3 + 3RCOONa}$
c-029.example: Kitsen alade yana fara narkewa a kusan 30~40℃, don haka ruwa na kusan 40℃ yana narkar da maiko. Idan aka fara goge shi, ruwan wanke kwano yana raguwa zuwa rabi kuma ana hana toshewar magudanar ruwa.
c-029.actionItem: Kafin wanke kwano yau, a fara goge maikon kaskon da tawul ɗin kicin sa'an nan a wanke da ruwan ɗumi.

c-030.title: Idan aka tsaya a launin zinariya mai haske wajen soya da gasa, acrylamide yana raguwa
c-030.summary: Idan aka dafa dankali ko burodi a zafi mai yawa har ya zama launin ruwan kasa mai duhu, acrylamide yana ƙaruwa. Idan aka tsaya a launin zinariya, ana kiyaye ɗanɗano kuma samar da shi yana raguwa.
c-030.principle: Asparagine da reducing sugar suna yin halayen Maillard a $120\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ko fiye, kuma acrylamide ($\mathrm{C_3H_5NO}$) yana samuwa.
c-030.example: Idan aka tsaya a launin zinariya a 175℃ ko ƙasa wajen soya dankali, kuma ba a ajiye dankali a firiji ba, sukari ba ya ƙaruwa kuma yawan acrylamide na iya raguwa sosai. Ya fi kyau a guji sassan launin ruwan kasa mai duhu da ƙonannu.
c-030.actionItem: Yau, a cire toast ko dankalin da aka gasa kafin ya zama launin ruwan kasa mai duhu, kuma a yanke sassan da suka ƙone.

c-031.title: Hot pack na sau ɗaya yana ba da zafi ne daga tsatsar ƙarfe
c-031.summary: Foda na ƙarfe a cikin hot pack yana yin oxidation idan ya haɗu da oxygen na iska, yana ba da zafi. Yana da amfani a tafiyar hunturu, amma idan aka manna shi a fata na dogon lokaci akwai haɗarin ƙonewa mai ƙarancin zafi.
c-031.principle: $\mathrm{4Fe + 3O_2 + 6H_2O \to 4Fe(OH)_3}$ halayen ba da zafi ne, kuma activated carbon da gishiri suna saurin halayen.
c-031.example: Mafi girman zafi kusan 50~60℃ ne kuma yana daɗewa na sa'o'i kaɗan. A manna shi a kan tufafi na waje na kayan ciki, a cire shi idan za a kwanta barci, don hana ƙonewa mai ƙarancin zafi. Kafin buɗewa, marufi da aka rufe yana hana iska.
c-031.actionItem: Idan za a yi amfani da hot pack yau, a manna shi a kan tufafi kuma a duba yanayin fata kowane awa ɗaya.

c-032.title: Mai kawar da wari na gawayi adsorption ne, ba rarrabuwa ba
c-032.summary: Gawayi da activated carbon suna kama kwayoyin wari a saman su don rage shi. Idan sun cika, tasiri yana ɓacewa, don haka a bi lokacin maye ko sabuntawa.
c-032.principle: Adsorption shi ne manne kwayoyin a saman, kuma surface area na activated carbon yana kaiwa $500\text{-}1500\ \mathrm{m^2/g}$.
c-032.example: 100 g na activated carbon na iya samun surface area na girman filin ƙwallon ƙafa, don haka yana kama warin sashe ɗaya na firiji. Idan aka busar da gawayi a rana sau ɗaya a wata, wani sashe yana sabuntawa, kuma a maye shi kowane wata 3~6.
c-032.actionItem: A rubuta ranar maye mai kawar da warin firiji a kan alama, kuma a saita tunatarwa bayan wata 3.

c-033.title: Jiƙa shinkafa na minti 30 yana rage makamashin dafa abinci
c-033.summary: Shinkafar da aka jiƙa ta riga ta sha ruwa, don haka lokacin dumama yana raguwa kuma shinkafa tana dahuwa daidai. Amfani da injin dafa shinkafa na lantarki ko gas yana raguwa kaɗan-kaɗan.
c-033.principle: Starch yana shan ruwa yana gelatinizing: $\mathrm{(C_6H_{10}O_5)_n + nH_2O \to}$ gel da ya kumbura. Gelatinization yana faruwa a kusan $60\text{-}70\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
c-033.example: Idan aka jiƙa shinkafa minti 30, tana shan kusan 20~25% ruwa bisa nauyi kuma ruwa yana kaiwa ciki. Lokacin dafawa yana raguwa da mintuna kaɗan fiye da idan ba a jiƙa ba, don haka idan ana dafawa kullum ana tanadin mintuna da yawa a wata. A hunturu, ruwa mai ɗumi ya fi sauri.
c-033.actionItem: Yammacin yau, a wanke shinkafa a jiƙa minti 30 sannan a dafa, kuma a kwatanta lokacin dafawa.

c-034.title: Daƙiƙa 20 na wanke hannu shi ne lokacin da sabulu ke buƙata don kewaye ƙazanta
c-034.summary: Kwayoyin sabulu suna da gefe ɗaya mai son maiko da ɗaya mai son ruwa, don haka suna kewaye ƙazanta da ƙwayoyin cuta su wanke su. Wannan tsari yana buƙatar gogayya da lokaci.
c-034.principle: Sabulu yana samar da micelles sama da critical micelle concentration (CMC) yana naɗe maiko: $\mathrm{RCOONa \to RCOO^- + Na^+}$
c-034.example: Idan aka shafa sabulu a tafin hannu, bayan hannu, tsakanin yatsu, da ƙarƙashin farce aka goga daƙiƙa 20 (waƙar ranar haihuwa sau biyu), ƙwayoyin cuta na yau da kullum suna raguwa sosai. Zafin ruwa ya isa idan aka daidaita shi da kare fata, ba da tasiri ba.
c-034.actionItem: Yau, idan kuna wanke hannu, a ƙidaya daƙiƙa 20 da mai ƙidayar lokaci ko waƙa, a goga har ƙarƙashin farce.

c-035.title: Mai kare leɓe a hunturu yana yin fim, ba ruwa ba
c-035.summary: Lip balm na hydrocarbon kamar Vaseline yana yin fim mai hana ruwa (hydrophobic) wanda ke hana ruwa fita daga leɓe. Yana da tasiri fiye idan aka shafa a leɓe mai danshi ko a kan fatar da ke barewa.
c-035.principle: Saurin ƙafewa yana daidaita da bambancin matsin tururin ruwa a saman fata, kuma fim ɗin petroleum hydrocarbon $\mathrm{C_nH_{2n+2}}$ ba ya haɗuwa da ruwa don haka yana jinkirta wannan ƙafewa.
c-035.example: A ɗakin hunturu busasshe (ɗanshi na dangi kusan 20%), ruwan leɓe maras komai yana ƙafewa da sauri. Idan aka shafa Vaseline siriri, ƙafewa yana raguwa sosai kuma tsagewa tana raguwa.
c-035.actionItem: Kafin barci yau, a jiƙa leɓe da ruwa sa'an nan a shafa siraren lip balm guda ɗaya.

c-036.title: A shafa hand cream lokacin da hannu yana da ɗanshi don ya daɗe
c-036.summary: Idan aka shafa shi a hannu mai ruwa, tasirin moisturizer da ke kulle ruwa yana ƙaruwa. Da adadi ɗaya hannu yana da ɗanshi fiye, don haka cream yana raguwa.
c-036.principle: Asarar ruwan fata tana bin dokar diffusion $J = -D\dfrac{dC}{dx}$, glycerin yana jan ruwa kuma Vaseline yana hana ƙafewa.
c-036.example: Idan aka shafa girman ƙwayar wake cikin mintuna 3 bayan shawa ko wanke hannu, bayan an goge kaɗan da tawul, ana iya rage adadin da ake shafawa sau biyu ko uku a rana ko da a hunturu busasshe. Sa safar hannu da barci yana da tasiri sosai.
c-036.actionItem: Bayan wanke hannu yau, kafin a busar da su gaba ɗaya, a shafa hand cream girman ƙwayar wake.

c-037.title: A zaɓi sabulun wanke fuska mai acid mai rauni kamar fata (pH 5.5 ko kusa)
c-037.summary: Saman fata yana da fim mai kariya na acid mai rauni, kuma sabulu mai pH mai yawa na iya lalata shi. A hunturu busasshe, mai tsabtace acid mai rauni yana harzuƙa ƙasa.
c-037.principle: $\mathrm{pH = -\log[H^+]}$. Saman fata yana da pH 4.5~5.5, sabulu na yau da kullum kuma pH 9~10, don haka $\mathrm{[H^+]}$ ya ragu kusan sau dubu goma.
c-037.example: pH 5.5 da pH 9.5 suna da bambancin yawan hydrogen ion na sau $10^4$. Mai wanke fuska da aka rubuta 'acid mai rauni' a kan alamarsa yana barin fata da ƙarancin tsukewa bayan wankewa kuma yana rage yawan moisturizer.
c-037.actionItem: Lokacin siyan sabulun wanke fuska na gaba, a duba ƙimar pH a bayanin samfurin, a rubuta yadda fata ke tsukewa bayan wankewa.

c-038.title: Dalilin da ya sa ƙarfin power bank ke raguwa a sanyi
c-038.summary: A ƙananan zafi, halayen sinadarai da motsin ion na lithium-ion battery suna jinkiri, don haka ƙarfin da za a iya amfani da shi yana raguwa. Idan aka sa shi a aljihun ciki, ba ya zubar da caji sosai.
c-038.principle: A cikin saurin hali $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$, idan $T$ ya ragu, $k$ yana ƙanƙanta kuma juriya ta cikin baturi tana ƙaruwa.
c-038.example: A kusan 0℃ ƙarfi na iya raguwa 20~30%, a -10℃ kuma fiye da haka. Power bank na 10,000 mAh na iya ba da kusan 7,000 mAh kawai a waje a hunturu, don haka yana ji kamar yawan caji yana raguwa.
c-038.actionItem: Lokacin fita yau, a saka power bank da wayar hannu a aljihun ciki na riga don zafin jiki ya ɗumama su.

c-039.title: Ana lissafin power bank a jirgin sama da Wh
c-039.summary: Ana iya ɗaukar lithium battery a kayan hannu kawai ba a kayan da aka sanya a ɗakin ajiya ba, kuma iyakar ƙarfi a naúrar Wh ne. Duba mAh kaɗai yana rikitarwa, don haka a lissafa da kanka.
c-039.principle: $\mathrm{Wh = V \times Ah}$ (lithium-ion na ƙididdiga 3.7 V). Ƙasa da 100 Wh an yarda, 100~160 Wh yana buƙatar amincewar kamfanin jirgin sama.
c-039.example: 20,000 mAh = 20 Ah × 3.7 V = 74 Wh babu matsala, 27,000 mAh kuma 99.9 Wh ne, kusa da iyaka. 30,000 mAh (111 Wh) yana buƙatar amincewa.
c-039.actionItem: Yau, a ninka mAh na power bank ɗin ku da 3.7 V a mayar da shi Wh, kuma a duba ko Wh yana a kan alama.

c-040.title: A hana gubar carbon monoxide idan ana amfani da dumama da gawayi a hunturu
c-040.summary: Idan mai ya ƙone ba cikakke ba a wurin da ba a buɗe iska, ana samar da carbon monoxide marar wari. Kada a yi amfani da gawayi, briquette, ko murhun sansani a cikin gida.
c-040.principle: Idan oxygen ya yi ƙaranci, $\mathrm{2C + O_2 \to 2CO}$ yana samar da carbon monoxide, kuma CO yana haɗuwa da hemoglobin sau kusan 200 fiye da oxygen.
c-040.example: A 200 ppm na CO a iska, ciwon kai yana farawa cikin 'yan sa'o'i, a 800 ppm ko fiye kuma yana da haɗari cikin awa ɗaya. A duba haɗin bututun hayaƙin boiler da iska, kuma a sanya na'urar ƙararrawar CO.
c-040.actionItem: Yau, a duba yanayin haɗin bututun hayaƙin boiler kuma a bincika batirin na'urar ƙararrawar CO.

c-041.title: Idan wutar gas rawaya ce, ana ɓarnar mai
c-041.summary: Wutar gas ta al'ada shuɗi ce; idan rawaya ko lemu ce, konewa ba cikakke ba ne, wanda ke ƙara hayaƙi da carbon monoxide. Tsabtace burner yana dawo da inganci.
c-041.principle: Cikakken konewa: $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$. Idan oxygen ya yi ƙaranci $\mathrm{CH_4 + \tfrac{3}{2}O_2 \to CO + 2H_2O}$.
c-041.example: Idan wuta rawaya ce kuma ƙasan tukunya ta yi baƙi da hayaƙi, zafi yana wucewa ƙasa kuma mai yana kasancewa iri ɗaya ko ya ƙaru. Idan aka cire ragowar abinci a ramukan burner da tsinken haƙori, yawanci wutar tana komawa shuɗi.
c-041.actionItem: Yau, a tsabtace ramukan burner na murhun gas da tsinken haƙori kuma a duba launin wuta.

c-042.title: Baturin motar lead-acid: a hana zubar caji a hunturu don tanadin kuɗin maye
c-042.summary: Idan sanyi da gajerun tuƙi suka maimaita, baturin lead-acid yana zubar da caji kuma tsawon ransa yana raguwa. A yanayin da ya zubar, electrolyte yana ruwa kuma yana iya daskarewa a yanayi ƙasa da sifili.
c-042.principle: Zubar da caji: $\mathrm{Pb + PbO_2 + 2H_2SO_4 \to 2PbSO_4 + 2H_2O}$. Sulfuric acid yana ƙarewa, don haka wurin daskarewar electrolyte yana hawa.
c-042.example: Electrolyte na cikakken baturi yana daskarewa a kusan -60℃, amma idan ya zubar yana iya daskarewa a kusan -7℃. Idan aka tuƙa fiye da minti 30 sau 1 a mako ko aka ƙara caji da charger, ana iya jinkirta kuɗin maye na kusan KRW 100,000.
c-042.actionItem: Yau, kafin kunna mota, a kashe dumama, heating wire, da audio, kuma a tsara tuƙin minti 30 sau 1 a mako.

c-043.title: Seasoning na kaskon ƙarfe halayen polymerization ne na mai yana tauri
c-043.summary: A sabon kaskon ƙarfe, idan aka gasa siraren mai a zafi mai yawa aka yi fim mai tauri, tsatsa da mannewa suna raguwa. Idan aka shafa da kauri, yana zama mai danko.
c-043.principle: Unsaturated fatty acid yana yin halayen da oxygen yana polymerizing. Tsatsa tana samuwa kamar $\mathrm{4Fe + 3O_2 + 6H_2O \to 4Fe(OH)_3}$.
c-043.example: Idan aka shafa ƙaramin mai sosai aka goge da tawul ɗin kicin, aka gasa a tanda na 220℃ awa 1, fim yana samuwa. Bayan amfani, idan aka busar da ruwa nan da nan, ana iya amfani da kasko da aka yi seasoning shekaru da dama, don haka yana da arha.
c-043.actionItem: Bayan wanke kaskon ƙarfe yau, a ɗora shi a wuta don ruwa ya ƙafe, kuma a goge siraren mai a kai.

c-044.title: A goge cokalin azurfa da ya canza launi da foil na aluminium da baking soda
c-044.summary: Baƙin silver sulfide a saman azurfa ana mayar da shi azurfa ta halayen lantarki-sinadarai. Ba a goge, don haka azurfa tana ƙarancin gogewa. Wari na sulfur zai fito, don haka a buɗe iska.
c-044.example: A narkar da cokali 1 na baking soda a 500 mL na ruwan zafi, a jiƙa azurfar tana taɓa foil na minti 2~5. Kada a yi amfani da shi a kan lu'u-lu'u, duwatsu masu daraja, ko kayan da ke da hannun da aka manne.
c-044.actionItem: Yau, a jiƙa cokalin azurfa ɗaya da ya canza launi a ruwan zafi mai baking soda da foil.

c-045.title: Kada a ci koren tsatsar kaskon jan ƙarfe
c-045.summary: Idan jan ƙarfe ya haɗu da acid da ɗanshi, koren tsatsa (verdigris) yana samuwa, kuma yana da guba. Kada a bar abinci mai acid a cikin jan ƙarfe na dogon lokaci, kuma a duba yanayin coating na ciki.
c-045.principle: Copper oxide yana narkewa a vinegar: $\mathrm{CuO + 2CH_3COOH \to Cu(CH_3COO)_2 + H_2O}$. Verdigris shi ne $\mathrm{Cu_2(OH)_2CO_3}$.
c-045.example: Kaskon jan ƙarfe da cikinsa aka rufe da tin ko stainless steel yana da aminci. Tsatsar saman waje ana goge ta da man vinegar 1 : gishiri 1 minti 5 sa'an nan a wanke. Idan coating na ciki ya kware, kada a dafa a ciki.
c-045.actionItem: Yau, a duba yanayin coating na ciki na kaskon jan ƙarfe, kuma idan ya kware kada a yi amfani da shi don dafa abinci.

c-046.title: Kaskon da abinci ya manne: a jiƙa da tafasa baking soda yana rage makamashi
c-046.summary: Maimakon goga na dogon lokaci da ƙarfi da ruwan zafi, tafasa da maganin alkali mai rauni yana sassauta tabon ƙonewa da ƙaramin ƙarfi. Kaskon aluminium yana canza launi, don haka a guji.
c-046.principle: Idan aka yi zafi, $\mathrm{2NaHCO_3 \to Na_2CO_3 + H_2O + CO_2\uparrow}$ yana samar da sodium carbonate kuma pH yana hawa zuwa kusan 11.
c-046.example: Idan aka saka cokali 2 na baking soda a 500 mL na ruwa aka tafasa a ƙaramar wuta minti 10, tabon ƙonewa yana sassauta. Ya fi barin famfo yana gudu na dogon lokaci kana goge, saboda ruwa da sabulu suna raguwa kuma ana tanadin amfani da ruwan zafi.
c-046.actionItem: Yau, a saka ruwa da cokali 2 na baking soda a kaskon da ya ƙone, a tafasa minti 10, a bar shi ya huce sa'an nan a goge.

c-047.title: Tufafi masu jini: a fara da ruwan sanyi
c-047.summary: Ana cire tabon jini idan aka fara wankewa da ruwan sanyi na 20℃ ko ƙasa, ba ruwan ɗumi ba.
c-047.principle: Sunadaran jini kamar hemoglobin da fibrinogen suna denaturing da coagulating idan zafi ya shafe su, suna manne a zaren yadi. Hydrogen peroxide yana rarrabuwa idan ya haɗu da catalase a jini: $\mathrm{2H_2O_2 \xrightarrow{catalase} 2H_2O + O_2\uparrow}$
c-047.example: Rigar auduga da aka wanke da ruwan zafi na 60℃ tabon jini yana tauri ya zama ruwan kasa, amma idan aka jiƙa ta a ruwan sanyi na 15℃ minti 5 sa'an nan aka digo digo kaɗan na 3% hydrogen peroxide, kumfa (oxygen) yana tashi kuma yawancinsa yana fita. A yi amfani da shi a kan fararen tufafi kawai, a tufafi masu launi kuma a fara gwadawa a wurin da ba a gani.
c-047.actionItem: Idan tabo ya samu yau, a bar ruwan sanyi yana gudu maimakon ruwan zafi, a wanke daga baya zuwa gaba.

c-048.title: A yi amfani da sabulun wanki gwargwadon taurin ruwa, adadin da ya dace kawai
c-048.summary: Idan aka ƙara sabulu fiye da adadin da aka ba da shawara, ƙarfin tsaftacewa kusan iri ɗaya ne, kuma kawai ruwan wankewa da kuɗin sabulu suna ƙaruwa.
c-048.principle: Surfactant na sabulu ba ya ƙara cire ƙazanta idan ya wuce critical micelle concentration (CMC). Calcium ion na ruwa mai tauri yana sa sinadaran sabulu su zauna: $\mathrm{Ca^{2+} + 2C_{17}H_{35}COO^- \to Ca(C_{17}H_{35}COO)_2\downarrow}$
c-048.example: A injin wanki mai ƙarfin 2kg, ko da aka saka 80mL na sabulu maimakon adadin da aka ba da shawara 40mL, tasirin wankewa yana kusan iri ɗaya, amma ragowar sabulu yana buƙatar wanke sau 1 ƙari. Idan aka yi wanki sau 20 a wata aka tanadi 40mL kowane lokaci, ana tanadin lita 9.6 a shekara, kusan KRW 20,000.
c-048.actionItem: Kafin wanki yau, a duba alamar a murfin sabulu a auna adadin da aka ba da shawara kawai.

c-049.title: Ultrafine dust ana samar da shi a cikin iska
c-049.summary: Wani babban sashe na PM2.5 ba daga bututun hayaƙi ba ne, ana samar da shi ne ta halayen sinadarai a cikin iska, don haka a lokacin yawan ƙura a bazara, abin rufe fuska na KF94 yana da amfani.
c-049.principle: Sulfur oxides da nitrogen oxides suna yin halayen da ammonia su samar da secondary particles: $\mathrm{NH_3 + HNO_3 \to NH_4NO_3}$, $\mathrm{2NH_3 + H_2SO_4 \to (NH_4)_2SO_4}$
c-049.example: A lokacin yawan ultrafine dust a Koriya, ammonium nitrate da ammonium sulfate wani lokaci suna kusan rabin PM2.5. KF94 yana tace sama da 94% na barbashi masu 0.4μm, kuma yana aiki ne idan ya manne a fuska sosai.
c-049.actionItem: Idan hasashen ƙura yau 'mara kyau' ne, kafin fita a danna ƙugiyar hanci na abin rufe fuska don ya manne ba tare da gibi ba.

c-050.title: Rufin hana ruwa na gilashin mota fim ɗin silane ne da ke korar ruwa
c-050.summary: Rufin hana ruwa yana yin fim na kwayoyin siloxane da fluorine a saman gilashi don ruwan sama da dusar ƙanƙara su zama digo su gangara. Gani yana inganta, don haka tuƙin hunturu yana da aminci.
c-050.principle: Rukunin $\mathrm{Si{-}OH}$ na gilashi da silane suna haɗuwa su yi fim $\mathrm{Si{-}O{-}Si}$, kuma sarƙoƙin hydrophobic na waje suna ƙara contact angle $\theta$ na digon ruwa zuwa kusan $100^\circ$ ko fiye.
c-050.example: Contact angle na gilashi maras rufi kusan $30^\circ$ ne, ruwa yana yaɗuwa, amma gilashi mai rufi $100^\circ$ ko fiye ne, don haka a iska mai gudun kilomita 60~80 a awa digon ruwa yana tashi. Rufin yawanci yana ƙarewa bayan wasu watanni.
c-050.actionItem: A wannan mako, a goge gilashin gaba don cire fim ɗin mai, a shafa siraren rufin hana ruwa, kuma a goge da busasshen kyalle.

c-051.title: Dalilin da ya sa auduga da polyester ke bushewa da gudu daban-daban
c-051.summary: Idan aka zaɓi polyester don tufafin motsa jiki, auduga kuma don kayan ciki da tawul, sarrafa zufa da ɗanshi yana zama da sauƙi.
c-051.principle: Cellulose na auduga yana da rukunin -OH da yawa, yana yin hydrogen bond da ruwa kuma yana shan har kusan 25% na ruwa, amma polyester hydrophobic ne bisa ester bonds kuma yana shan kusan 0.4% kawai. $\mathrm{HO{-}R + H_2O \rightleftharpoons HO{-}R{\cdots}H_2O}$
c-051.example: Idan aka jiƙa riga mai gajeren hannu mai nauyin 100g da zufa, auduga tana riƙe zufa kuma tana ɗaukar sa'o'i 2 ko fiye kafin ta bushe, amma polyester tana bushewa cikin kusan awa 1. A madadin haka, kwayoyin wari ma suna zama a zaren polyester, don haka tana buƙatar wankewa.
c-051.actionItem: Lokacin siyan sutura ta gaba, a duba rabon haɗin kayan a kan alama, kuma ga na motsa jiki a duba ko rabon polyester yana da yawa.

c-052.title: Ana ƙididdige kuɗin city gas bisa zafi ba girma ba
c-052.summary: Ana lissafin kuɗin city gas bisa zafi, wato girman da aka yi amfani da shi (㎥) a ninka da coefficient na canza zafi (MJ/㎥). Idan ka san naúrar zafi a takardar lissafi, kwatanta amfani da dumama yana da sauƙi.
c-052.principle: Konewar methane: $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$, $\Delta H \approx -890\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$. 1㎥ na city gas kusan $42\ \mathrm{MJ}$ ne.
c-052.example: Idan amfani da gas na wata 50㎥ ne, kusan $50 \times 42 = 2100\ \mathrm{MJ}$ ne. Idan aka rage zafin saitin boiler aka rage amfani da 10%, ana tanadin kusan 210 MJ.
c-052.actionItem: Yau, a nemo amfanin wannan wata (㎥) a takardar lissafin gas, a kwatanta da wata da ya gabata a rubuta.

c-053.title: Cire tsatsa da citric acid
c-053.summary: Jan tsatsa a kan ƙananan kayan ƙarfe yawanci yana ɓacewa idan aka jiƙa su a maganin citric acid.
c-053.principle: Iron(III) oxide yana narkewa ta hanyar yin chelate da citric acid: $\mathrm{Fe_2O_3 + 6H^+ \to 2Fe^{3+} + 3H_2O}$, sa'an nan $\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}$ ya haɗu da citrate ions.
c-053.example: A narkar da 25g na citric acid (5%) a 500mL na ruwa, a jiƙa almakashi mai tsatsa awa 4~6 sa'an nan a goge da buroshi, tsatsa tana fita. Kada a taɓa haɗa shi da masu tsabtace chlorine, kuma bayan goge, a busar nan da nan a shafa siraren mai.
c-053.actionItem: Yau, a jiƙa ɗan ƙaramin kayan aiki mai tsatsa guda ɗaya a 5% citric acid, gobe a busar da shi a shafa masa mai.

c-054.title: Bleach na oxygen yana aiki a ruwan ɗumi
c-054.summary: Sodium percarbonate yana aiki sosai a ruwa na kusan 40℃, yana dawo da fararen wanki a farashi mai arha.
c-054.principle: Sodium percarbonate yana rabuwa a ruwa zuwa hydrogen peroxide da sodium carbonate: $\mathrm{2Na_2CO_3\cdot 3H_2O_2 \to 2Na_2CO_3 + 3H_2O_2}$, sa'an nan $\mathrm{H_2O_2 \to H_2O + \tfrac12 O_2}$
c-054.example: Idan aka narkar da 25g na sodium percarbonate a lita 5 na ruwa na 40℃ aka jiƙa farar safa mai launin rawaya awa 1, tana yin fari. Farashinsa ya fi bleach na kasuwa arha, ba shi da warin chlorine, kuma kada a yi amfani da shi a kan ulu da siliki.
c-054.actionItem: Yau, a jiƙa fararen wanki sau ɗaya a ruwa na 40℃ da 5g/L na sodium percarbonate.

c-055.title: Lokacin pollen: a wanke hanci da saline na ilimin halitta
c-055.summary: Ga alerji na bazara, idan aka wanke hanci da 0.9% saline, pollen da ya manne a mucous membrane yana wankewa.
c-055.principle: 0.9% NaCl, wanda yake da osmotic pressure iri ɗaya da ruwan jiki (isotonic), ba ya kumbura ko matse ƙwayoyin mucous membrane. Osmotic pressure: $\Pi = iMRT$
c-055.example: A narkar da gishiri 4.5g (0.9%) a 500mL na ruwa da aka tafasa aka bar ya huce, kuma a guji amfani da ruwan famfo kai tsaye. Ruwa maras gishiri hypotonic ne kuma yana yi wa hanci ƙaiƙayi.
c-055.actionItem: Bayan dawowa gida yau, a wanke kowane hancin ɗaya sau ɗaya da feshin saline na kasuwa.

c-056.title: Warin takalma ba daga zufa yake ba, ƙwayoyin cuta da suka ci zufa ne ke yin sa
c-056.summary: Zufa kanta kusan ba ta da wari; ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin takalma suna rarraba kitse da sunadaran zufa su samar da fatty acid mai wari. Baking soda yana neutralizing wannan warin acid kuma yana rage ɗanshi.
c-056.principle: Fatty acid mai gajeren sarƙa mai wari (misali isovaleric acid) yana yin halayen da base mai rauni: $\mathrm{RCOOH + NaHCO_3 \to RCOONa + H_2O + CO_2}$.
c-056.example: Idan aka saka cokali ƙarami 1~2 na baking soda a kowane takalmi guda aka bar shi dare ɗaya, warin acid yana raguwa kuma ana shan ɗanshi ma. Washegari a girgiza a saka.
c-056.actionItem: Idan kun cire takalma yau, a yayyafa cokali 1 na baking soda a ciki a bar shi dare ɗaya.

c-057.title: Lambobin ƙasan filastik: za a iya amfani da microwave ko a'a
c-057.summary: Lambar sake sarrafawa a ƙasan kwantena tana nuna ko ana iya amfani da shi a microwave da abinci mai zafi.
c-057.principle: PP (lamba 5) yana da melting point mai yawa na kusan 160℃, don haka ana amfani da shi a microwave, kuma kwantena na PS (lamba 6) foam yana canza siffa a kusan 80℃. Polymerization: $\mathrm{n\,CH_2{=}CHCH_3 \to [-CH_2{-}CH(CH_3)-]_n}$
c-057.example: Akwatin abincin rana na PP yana canza siffa kaɗan ko da an saka miya sama da 100℃, amma idan aka ɗumama abinci mai mai a kwantena na ramen na PS na sau ɗaya, yana iya narkewa. A duba alamar 'za a iya amfani da microwave' a kan alama.
c-057.actionItem: Yau, a duba lambar ƙasan kwantena 3 da kuke yawan amfani da su, kuma waɗanda ba lamba 5 ba a cire su daga microwave.

c-058.title: Vitamin A, D, E, K ana ci da mai don a sha su
c-058.summary: Fat-soluble vitamins ba sa narkewa a ruwa, don haka suna buƙatar kitse don a ɗauke su a micelles a ƙaramin hanji a sha su. Cin karas ko supplement a cikin ciki wofi na iya rage sha.
c-058.principle: Kwayoyin non-polar suna narkewa a cikin micelles da bile acid ke samarwa suna tafiya. Idan babu kitse, ƙirƙirar micelles yana raguwa kuma yawan sha yana ƙasa.
c-058.example: An san cewa a karas da aka soya da cokali ƙarami 1 na man zaitun, sha beta-carotene yana ƙaruwa sau da yawa fiye da raw karas. Supplement na vitamin D ma ya fi a ci shi a lokacin abinci.
c-058.actionItem: Idan kuna shan vitamin D ko fat-soluble supplement yau, a sha shi a lokacin abinci mai kitse.

c-059.title: Tabon kofin shayi: da baking soda
c-059.summary: Tabon shayi da kofi a cikin kofi ana goge shi da man baking soda, yana ɓacewa ta ɗan goge da tasirin alkali.
c-059.principle: Tannin da polyphenol na shayi suna narkewa da kyau a cikin alkali. $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 \rightleftharpoons Na^+ + HCO_3^-}$, alkali mai rauni pH kusan 8.3
c-059.example: Idan aka haɗa cokali 1 na baking soda da cokali ƙarami 1 na ruwa aka goge da soso minti 1, yawancin fim ɗin ruwan kasa ma na kofin shekara 5 yana fita. Ba a kashe kuɗin sayen mai tsabtace dabam.
c-059.actionItem: Yau, a goge mug ɗaya mai tabon ruwa da man baking soda.

c-060.title: Ragowar kofi ba taki ba ne nan take
c-060.summary: Dole a bushe ragowar kofi sosai a haɗa kaɗan, kuma idan aka yayyafa da yawa, mold da hana girma suna faruwa.
c-060.principle: Ingancin compost yana da kyau idan carbon:nitrogen ratio (C/N) kusan 25~30:1 ne. Ragowar kofi kusan 20:1 ne, mai wadatar nitrogen, kuma ragowar caffeine na iya hana tsirowa.
c-060.example: Idan aka haɗa a bushe kawai ƙasa da 10% na girman ƙasar tukunya (100mL na ragowa a kowace lita 1 na ƙasa), ana iya amfani da shi lafiya. Idan aka shimfiɗa da kauri yana jike, mold yana samuwa.
c-060.actionItem: Ragowar kofin da kuka sha yau, a shimfiɗa su a jarida a busar.

c-061.title: Idan aspirin yana warin vinegar
c-061.summary: Idan kwalbar aspirin tana warin vinegar, ya rarraba ne saboda ɗanshi, don haka kada a sha shi a jefar da shi.
c-061.principle: Acetylsalicylic acid yana rarrabuwa idan ya yi halayen da ruwa: $\mathrm{C_9H_8O_4 + H_2O \to C_7H_6O_3 + CH_3COOH}$ (salicylic acid + acetic acid)
c-061.example: Idan aka ajiye shi a wuri mai ɗanshi sama da 80% kamar shelf na banɗaki, hydrolysis yana ci gaba cikin watanni kaɗan. A ajiye shi a aljihun tebur mai sanyi da bushe da murfi a rufe, kuma sanya jakar silica gel 1 a tare yana da kyau.
c-061.actionItem: Yau, a mayar da magunguna da supplements da ke banɗaki zuwa aljihun tebur mai bushe.

c-062.title: Jaket mai hana ruwa: zafi yana farfaɗo da shafe-shafen
c-062.summary: Idan ɗigon ruwa ba ya samuwa a jaket mai hana ruwa, bayan wanki a bushar da shi a ƙaramin zafi don farfaɗo da shafen hana ruwa.
c-062.principle: Shafen DWR yana da sarƙoƙin fluorine da hydrocarbon masu ƙin ruwa waɗanda suke tsaye a saman zaren, kuma tashin hankalin saman ruwa yana sa ruwa ya zama ƙwallaye. Kusurwar taɓawa $\theta>90^\circ$ ce, lissafin Young: $\cos\theta=\dfrac{\gamma_{SV}-\gamma_{SL}}{\gamma_{LV}}$
c-062.example: Ragowar sabulu da datti suna kwantar da sarƙoƙin, don haka bayan wanki da sabulu mai tsaka-tsaki, idan aka bushar a na'urar bushewa mai matsakaicin zafi (kusan 40~60℃) na mintuna 20 ko a yi guga da ƙaramin zafi, sarƙoƙin suna sake tsayawa kuma ɗigon ruwa yana samuwa. Idan bai yi aiki ba, yi amfani da feshin hana ruwa na kasuwa.
c-062.actionItem: Yau, yayyafa ruwa a jaket mai hana ruwa ka ga ko ɗigon ruwa yana samuwa.

c-063.title: Menene 20-10-10 a jakar taki?
c-063.summary: Lambobin N-P-K a jakar taki suna nuna adadin nitrogen, phosphorus da potassium (%), don haka dole ne a zaɓi rabon da ya dace da amfanin gona.
c-063.principle: Tsirrai suna amfani da nitrogen (NO3−, NH4+) don ganye, phosphorus ($\mathrm{H_2PO_4^-}$) don saiwa da furanni, da potassium ($\mathrm{K^+}$) don kara da 'ya'yan itace. Rushewar urea ta ruwa: $\mathrm{CO(NH_2)_2 + 2H_2O \to 2NH_4^+ + CO_3^{2-}}$
c-063.example: 1kg na taki 20-10-10 yana da 200g nitrogen, 100g phosphate da 100g potassium. Kayan ganye suna dacewa da taki mai yawan nitrogen, furanni da 'ya'yan itace kuma suna dacewa da mai yawan phosphorus da potassium. Idan aka wuce adadin da aka rubuta a lakabi, saiwa tana ƙonewa.
c-063.actionItem: Yau, nemi rabon N-P-K da ya dace da nau'in shukar da kake nomawa.

c-064.title: Batir alkaline da lithium AA, ina za a yi amfani da su?
c-064.summary: A na'urar sarrafa TV (remote) batir alkaline, a cikin sanyi ko na'urori masu yawan wuta kuma batir lithium na farko suna daɗe.
c-064.principle: Alkaline: $\mathrm{Zn + 2MnO_2 + H_2O \to ZnO + 2MnO(OH)}$. A ƙaramin zafi, electrolyte na ruwa yana raguwa, amma batir lithium na farko yana da electrolyte mara ruwa kuma yana aiki har -40℃.
c-064.example: A kyamara ta dijital, alkaline AA 2 sukan ɗauki hotuna kusan 300, lithium AA kuma sau da yawa 800 ko fiye. Amma a remote ko agogon bango masu ƙaramar wuta, alkaline ya fi araha sosai kuma ya fi dacewa.
c-064.actionItem: Yau, rubuta wanne na'ura ya fi dacewa da alkaline ko lithium.

c-065.title: Launin hydrangea yana tabbata ta acidity na ƙasa
