c-065.summary: Shuɗi da ruwan hoda na hydrangea ana ƙayyade su ta pH na ƙasa, don haka ana iya daidaita ƙasa don samun launin da ake so.
c-065.principle: A ƙasa mai acid (pH kusan 5.5 ko ƙasa), aluminium yana narkewa a matsayin $\mathrm{Al^{3+}}$ kuma yana haɗuwa da anthocyanin don yin shuɗi; a tsaka-tsaki zuwa alkaline, yana ƙwanƙwasa a matsayin $\mathrm{Al(OH)_3}$ kuma ya zama ruwan hoda: $\mathrm{Al^{3+} + 3OH^- \to Al(OH)_3\downarrow}$
c-065.example: Idan ka ba hydrangea mai ruwan hoda aluminium sulfate kusan 3g a kowace lita 1 na ruwa a kowane wata, bayan watanni kaɗan shuɗi yana ƙaruwa. Akasin haka, idan ka ɗaga pH sama da 6.5 da lemun tsami, yana zama ruwan hoda. Yawan amfani yana lalata saiwa.
c-065.actionItem: Yau, auna pH na ƙasar tukunya da takardar pH ka ƙayyade launin hydrangea da kake so.

c-066.title: Dalilin da rigar ulu ke ƙanƙancewa
c-066.summary: Rigar ulu tana ƙanƙancewa da ruwan zafi da gogayya, don haka a wanke ta da hannu da ruwan ɗumi da sabulu mai tsaka-tsaki.
c-066.principle: Ulu shi ne furotin keratin, kuma saman mai kama da ma'auni (scales) yana haɗuwa da gogayya: felting yana faruwa. Alkali da zafi suna rushe haɗin peptide: $\mathrm{R{-}CO{-}NH{-}R' + H_2O \to RCOOH + R'NH_2}$
c-066.example: Idan ka wanke a ruwan da bai wuce 30℃ ba da sabulu mai tsaka-tsaki ta hanyar matsewa na mintuna 2~3, ba tare da murɗawa ba, ka cire ruwa da tawul, ka shimfiɗa ka bushar, kusan babu ƙanƙancewa. Wanke na yau da kullum a injin wanki 40℃ na iya rage girma ɗaya, kuma rigar ulu mai tsada za ta lalace.
c-066.actionItem: Yau, duba alamar wanki a tufafin ulu ka shirya sabulu mai tsaka-tsaki daban.

c-067.title: Vitamin C yana raunana da haske da iska
c-067.summary: Dole ne a adana kariyar abinci ta vitamin C nesa da hasken rana da danshi, a kwalba mai duhu tare da rufe murfi sosai.
c-067.principle: Ascorbic acid yana yin oxidation idan ya haɗu da iska: $\mathrm{C_6H_8O_6 \rightarrow C_6H_6O_6 + 2H^+ + 2e^-}$ (dehydroascorbic acid), kuma zafi da haske suna ƙara gudu.
c-067.example: Idan an bar vitamin C mai foda a buɗaɗɗen kwalba a 25℃ da danshi 70%, cikin makonni kaɗan yana yin launin ruwan kasa kuma ƙarfinsa yana raguwa. Idan aka adana a wuri mai sanyi, samfurin iri ɗaya zai tsaya a hali mai kyau har zuwa ranar karewa.
c-067.actionItem: Yau, motsa kariyar abinci daga kan taga ko shiryayyen kicin zuwa aljihun tebur mai sanyi.

c-068.title: Zaɓar maganin tunkuɗe kwari DEET da icaridin
c-068.summary: Kafin ayyukan waje, yi amfani da samfurin DEET 20~30% ko icaridin 10~20% don kariya na awanni kaɗan.
c-068.principle: DEET (N,N-diethyl-m-toluamide, $\mathrm{C_{12}H_{17}NO}$) yana rikita masu karɓar ƙamshi na sauro, yana sa su wahalar gano mutum. Idan yawan sinadarin ya ƙaru, tsawon lokaci yana ƙaruwa, amma tasirin yana cika a wani matakin.
c-068.example: DEET 30% yana ba da kariya kusan awanni 6, 10% kusan awanni 2, kuma sama da 50% ƙarin tasirin kaɗan ne. Kada ka fesa a fuska kai tsaye; zuba a hannu ka shafa, kuma kada ka yi amfani da shi ga jariri ƙasa da watanni 2.
c-068.actionItem: Yau, duba sinadari da kaso a lakabin maganin tunkuɗe kwari ka saka a jakar waje.

c-069.title: Yadda ake karanta lakabin bakin karfe 304 da 316
c-069.summary: Ga akwatunan abinci masu gishiri ko kusa da teku, bakin karfe 316 mai molybdenum yana jure tsatsa fiye.
c-069.principle: Bakin karfe yana da chromium kusan 10.5% ko fiye kuma yana samar da fim mai kare $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$ a sama: $\mathrm{4Cr + 3O_2 \to 2Cr_2O_3}$. 316 yana da ƙarin molybdenum 2~3% kuma yana jure lalacewa ta chloride ions (Cl−).
c-069.example: 304 (18-8) ya isa ga amfanin kicin na yau da kullum, amma a muhalli mai gishiri mai yawa, ramuka (pitting) suna iya faruwa. Don tulun zafi iri ɗaya, ko da 316 ya fi tsada da 20~30%, yana daɗewa idan aka yi amfani da shi a bakin teku.
c-069.actionItem: Yau, nemi alamar 304 ko 316 a ƙasan kayan bakin karfe da kake amfani da su.

c-070.title: Fluoride a man goge baki yana mai da saman haƙora zuwa lu'ulu'u mai ƙarfi
c-070.summary: Fluoride ions suna mai da hydroxyapatite na enamel zuwa fluoroapatite mai juriya ga acid. Idan ba a wanke baki da ruwa mai yawa ba bayan goge baki, fluoride yana daɗe.
c-070.principle: $\mathrm{Ca_{10}(PO_4)_6(OH)_2 + 2F^- \to Ca_{10}(PO_4)_6F_2 + 2OH^-}$. Fluoroapatite yana fara narkewa a pH kusan 4.5 kuma yana jure acid fiye da hydroxyapatite (kusan pH 5.5).
c-070.example: Yi amfani da man goge baki mai fluoride 1000~1500 ppm gwargwadon girman wake, kuma bayan goge baki ka wanke baki da ruwa sau ɗaya kawai a hankali, don amfani da ragowar tasirin fluoride.
c-070.actionItem: Yau da dare bayan goge baki, kada ka wanke baki da ruwa sau da yawa; wanke sau ɗaya a hankali kawai.

c-071.title: Dalilin da tukunyar aluminium ke baƙi
c-071.summary: Idan aka bar abinci mai acid a tukunyar aluminium na dogon lokaci, tana duhu, don haka a yi amfani da wani akwati don ajiya.
c-071.principle: Fim ɗin $\mathrm{Al_2O_3}$ a saman aluminium yana narkewa a cikin acid: $\mathrm{Al_2O_3 + 6H^+ \to 2Al^{3+} + 3H_2O}$, $\mathrm{2Al + 6H^+ \to 2Al^{3+} + 3H_2}$. Hakanan abin wanki mai alkali yana lalata ta, don haka a yi hankali.
c-071.example: Idan aka bar miyar tumatir (pH kusan 4.5) a tukunyar aluminium na kwana ɗaya, saman na iya canza launi kuma ya ɗanɗana kamar ƙarfe. Ana cire canjin launi ta tafasa cokali 2 na cream of tartar ko citric acid a lita 1 na ruwa na mintuna 10.
c-071.actionItem: Yau, kada ka bar sauran miya da ruwan dafa abinci a tukunya; zuba su a gilashi ko akwatin bakin karfe.

c-072.title: Asalin tabon rawaya a hammata
c-072.summary: Tabon rawaya a hammatar farar riga yana samuwa ne ta gumi da aluminium na deodorant, don haka bleach mai oxygen yana da tasiri.
c-072.principle: Furotin da fatty acids na gumi suna haɗuwa da gishirin aluminium suna samar da ƙwanƙwasa mara narkewa, kuma bleach na oxygen yana oxidizing abubuwan halitta: $\mathrm{H_2O_2 \to H_2O + [O]}$
c-072.example: Idan ka haɗa cokali 1 na sodium percarbonate da kofi 1 na ruwa 40℃ zuwa kauri, ka bar a kan tabon na mintuna 30 sannan ka wanke, launi yana ragewa sosai. Bleach na chlorine na iya sa tabon furotin ya ƙara rawaya.
c-072.actionItem: Yau, shafa man bleach na oxygen a hammatar farar rigar da ka sa tun da wuri.

c-073.title: Ƙamshin sabbin kayan gida alamar formaldehyde ne
c-073.summary: Ƙamshin sabbin kayan gida ko takardar bango yana fitowa daga sinadarai masu ƙafewa (VOC), don haka buɗe taga na kwanaki kaɗan don fitar da shi.
c-073.principle: Urea resin na manne plywood yana rushewa yana sakin formaldehyde: $\mathrm{HCHO}$. Adadin da ake saki yana ƙaruwa tare da zafi da danshi.
c-073.example: A makonni 2 na farko bayan shigar da sabbin kayan gida, idan ka fitar da iska sau 3 a rana na mintuna 30 kuma ka ɗaga zafin ɗaki zuwa 25~30℃ (bake-out), yawan sinadarin yana raguwa sosai. Ƙa'idar da ake ba da shawara ga formaldehyde a cikin gida ita ce 0.1ppm ko ƙasa.
c-073.actionItem: Yau, fitar da iska sau 3 a rana na fiye da mintuna 10 ta buɗe tagogi biyu masu gaba da juna.

c-074.title: Ruwan wurin yawon buɗe ido: tafasawa da amfani da kwayoyin tsarkake ruwa
c-074.summary: Ruwa mara aminci za a iya kashe yawancin ƙwayoyin cuta ta tafasa fiye da minti ɗaya ko ta kashe ƙwayoyin cuta da kwayoyin chlorine.
c-074.principle: Kwayoyin tsarkake ruwa na chlorine suna samar da hypochlorous acid a ruwa suna oxidizing ƙwayoyin cuta: $\mathrm{NaDCC + H_2O \to HOCl + \cdots}$, $\mathrm{HOCl \rightleftharpoons H^+ + OCl^-}$
c-074.example: Saka kwaya 1 a lita 1 na ruwa mai tsabta ka bar na mintuna 30 (mafi tsawo don Cryptosporidium). Dole ne a fara tace ruwa mai laka da zane, kuma a tsaunin sama da 2,000m a tsawaita lokacin tafasa zuwa mintuna 3.
c-074.actionItem: Yau, saka kwayar tsarkake ruwa ko matatar tafi-da-gidanka a jakar tafiyarka.

c-075.title: Jakar wanki don fleece, rage microplastics
c-075.summary: Idan ka saka tufafin zaren roba a jakar wanki ka wanke da ruwan sanyi, fitar microfibers yana raguwa sosai.
c-075.principle: Polyester shi ne ester polymer wanda ba ya ruɓewa amma yana ɓarkewa ta gogayya: $\mathrm{n\,HOOC{-}C_6H_4{-}COOH + n\,HOCH_2CH_2OH \to [-OC{-}C_6H_4{-}COO{-}CH_2CH_2O-]_n + 2n\,H_2O}$
c-075.example: Wanke jaket fleece ɗaya sau ɗaya yana fitar da dubbai zuwa ɗaruruwan dubbai na microfibers. Amfani da jakar wanki da matata yana kamawa da yawa daga ciki, yana rage shigarsu cikin koguna, kuma wanki a ƙaramin zafi yana tanadin makamashi ma.
c-075.actionItem: Yau, rufe zip ɗin tufafin fleece da polyester, saka su a jakar wanki, ka wanke da ruwan sanyi.

c-076.title: Zaɓi batir nickel-metal hydride mai ƙarancin fitar da kai
c-076.summary: Batir NiMH na yau da kullum yana fitar da kansa da kusan 20% a wata ko da ba a yi amfani da shi ba. Nau'in mai ƙarancin fitarwa yana riƙe 70~85% bayan shekara ɗaya, wanda ya dace da remote da agogo.
c-076.principle: Amsawar batir nickel-metal hydride: $\mathrm{NiOOH + MH \rightleftharpoons Ni(OH)_2 + M}$. Fitar da kai yana faruwa lokacin da hydrogen ke ƙaura a hankali tsakanin electrolyte da electrode.
c-076.example: Idan ka yi amfani da batir AA mai ƙarancin fitar da kai (kusan 2000 mAh) ta caji sau 500, zai iya maye gurbin ɗaruruwan batir alkaline na amfani ɗaya, kuma kuɗin dogon lokaci yana raguwa sosai.
c-076.actionItem: Yau, idan akwai batir da ake amfani da shi a remote ko agogo, shirya shirin musanya shi zuwa batir mai caji mai ƙarancin fitar da kai.

c-077.title: Ana cire tabon tawada na biro da barasa, ba da ruwa ba
c-077.summary: Tawada na biro tawada ce mai mai da launi aka narkar da shi a abin narkarwa na halitta, don haka ruwa ba ya yaɗa ta. Idan ka dafa shi da zane mai jike da ethanol na tsaftacewa, launi yana narkewa yana fitowa.
c-077.principle: Abubuwa masu irin polarity iri ɗaya suna haɗuwa sosai. Launi mai mai yana narkewa a ethanol ($\varepsilon \approx 25$) fiye da ruwa ($\varepsilon \approx 80$) sosai.
c-077.example: Idan ka shimfiɗa busasshen tawul na takarda a ƙarƙashin tabon kuma ka dafa daga waje zuwa ciki da swab mai ethanol 70%, tawada tana ƙaura zuwa tawul ba tare da yaɗuwa ba. Fara gwadawa a ƙaramin wuri.
c-077.actionItem: Yau, idan akwai tabon biro a tufafi ko kayan gida, fara gwada barasa a wuri da ba a gani.

c-078.title: Ana farfaɗo da kayan lambu da suka yi laushi ta jiƙa a ruwan sanyi
c-078.summary: Latas da alayyahu da suka yi laushi sun rasa ruwa a cikin ƙwayoyin halittarsu. Idan an jiƙa su a ruwan sanyi na mintuna 20~30, ruwa yana sake shiga ta osmosis kuma sun sake yin ƙarfi, don haka ana jefar da ƙasa.
c-078.principle: Idan yawan solute a cikin ƙwayar halitta ya fi na ruwan waje, ruwa yana shiga ciki. Matsin osmotic $\Pi = iMRT$ yana haifar da turgor pressure da ke kumbura ƙwayar halitta.
c-078.example: Idan aka jiƙa ɗan latas da ya yi laushi bayan kwana ɗaya a ruwan sanyi na mintuna 30, nauyi yana ƙaruwa da 5~10% kuma ƙarfinsa yana dawowa. Amma ba ya shafi ganyen da suka riga suka yi taushi ko lalacewa.
c-078.actionItem: Yau, jiƙa kayan lambu masu ganye da suka yi laushi a firiji a ruwan sanyi na mintuna 30, girgiza ruwan, ka ci.

c-079.title: Alerjin ƙurar gida mite yana raguwa ne kawai da wanki da ruwa 60℃ ko fiye
c-079.summary: Mites da furotin na alerji a kwanciya ba sa raguwa sosai da wanki da ruwan sanyi. A ruwan zafi kusan 60℃, furotin yana denaturing, mites suna mutuwa kuma alerji yana raguwa.
c-079.principle: Zafi yana kwance tsarin furotin na uku, yana sa enzymes da alerjin su rasa aiki (thermal denaturation). Yawanci a 55~60℃ mites suna mutuwa cikin mintuna.
c-079.example: Wanke zanen gado da akwatin matashin kai a 60℃ yana rage alerji sosai, amma wanki a 30℃ yana da ƙaramin tasiri. Idan lakabin yadi bai yarda ba, ana iya maye gurbinsa da bushewa mai zafi a na'urar bushewa.
c-079.actionItem: Yau, wanke akwatin matashin kai ko zanen gado, bayan duba lakabin wanki, a mafi zafin da aka yarda.

c-080.title: Gas na zango: a lokacin sanyi butane ba ya fitowa
c-080.summary: Gwangwanin isobutane yana raunana wuta kusa da sifili, don haka don zango a ƙarshen sanyi yi amfani da gas mai haɗin propane.
c-080.principle: Gas ɗin ruwa ba ya zama tururi a ƙasa da wurin tafasarsa. Butane kusan $-1^\circ\mathrm{C}$, isobutane $-12^\circ\mathrm{C}$, propane $-42^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Konewa: $\mathrm{C_4H_{10} + \tfrac{13}{2}O_2 \to 4CO_2 + 5H_2O}$
c-080.example: A ƙasa da 0℃, gwangwanin butane yana da ƙaramin matsi, wuta tana raunana kuma lokacin tafasa ruwa na iya ninkawa sau 2. Ka riƙe gwangwani a cikin jakar bacci ko kusa da jiki don dumama shi, kuma idan ka yi amfani da shi a cikin tanti akwai haɗarin guba ta CO, don haka a fitar da iska.
c-080.actionItem: Yau, duba jerin sinadaran (rabon butane da propane) a gwangwanin gas na zango.

c-081.title: Karanta sinadaran man kariya daga rana
c-081.summary: Kafin UV na bazara ya ƙaru, san bambanci tsakanin man kariya na inorganic (zinc oxide) da na organic, sannan ka zaɓa.
c-081.principle: Zinc oxide ($\mathrm{ZnO}$) yana komar da UV ya watsa shi, yayin da tace-tace na organic kamar avobenzone suna shan shi su saki shi a matsayin zafi: $h\nu + \text{tacewa} \to \text{tacewa}^* \to \text{zafi}$
c-081.example: SPF 50 yana toshe kusan 98% na UVB, SPF 30 kusan 97%, bambanci ƙanana ne. Don fuska ana buƙatar kusan 0.5g (layuka biyu na tsawon manuniya da yatsa na tsakiya) a sake shafawa kowane awa 2~3.
c-081.actionItem: Yau, kafin ka fita, matse man kariya daga rana tsawon yatsu biyu ka shafa.

c-082.title: Idan ka matse ruwan sharar abinci, ƙamshi da girma suna raguwa
c-082.summary: Ƙamshin mara daɗi na sharar abinci iskar gas ce kamar hydrogen sulfide da ƙwayoyin cuta ke samarwa lokacin rushe furotin. Idan ka fara matse ruwa kafin zubarwa, ƙwayoyin cuta suna jinkirin yaɗuwa, ƙamshi yana raguwa kuma nauyi yana raguwa.
c-082.principle: Rushewar amino acid mai sulfur a furotin: $\mathrm{R{-}SH \to H_2S}$. Saurin yaɗuwar ƙwayoyin cuta yana raguwa yayin da ayyukan ruwa $a_w$ suka ragu.
c-082.example: 70~80% na sharar abinci ruwa ne. Idan ka matse sosai har ma ka rage ruwa da 20% kawai, nauyi yana raguwa kusan 15%, farashin zubarwa da ƙamshi suna raguwa tare.
c-082.actionItem: Yau, kafin ka zubar da sharar abinci, saka ta a abin tace ka matse ruwan sosai.

c-083.title: Ranar karewa ana ƙayyade ta ta dogaro da zafi na saurin amsawa
c-083.summary: A abinci, idan zafi ya ƙaru da 10℃, amsawar lalacewa tana ninkawa kusan sau 2 da sauri. Don haka dole a bi zafin ajiya da aka rubuta don ranar karewa da ranar amfani su sami ma'ana.
c-083.principle: Lissafin Arrhenius: $k = A e^{-E_a/RT}$. Ga amsawar lalacewa mai matsakaicin makamashin kunnawa, gudu yana ninkawa sau 2~3 a kowane ƙaruwar 10℃.
c-083.example: Idan madara a firiji 4℃ tana ɗaukar kwana 7, a 14℃ tana iya lalacewa cikin kusan kwana 3~4. Ya fi kyau a ajiye ta a cikin firiji maimakon a shiryayyen ƙofa (inda zafi ke bambanta sosai).
c-083.actionItem: Yau, duba zafin firiji ka ga ko yana tsakanin 0~4℃.

c-084.title: Soda na wanki (sodium carbonate) maimakon percarbonate, don mai
c-084.summary: Tsohon mai a fanka na kicin da murhun gas ana cire shi da soda na wanki (sodium carbonate), wanda ya fi baking soda alkali.
c-084.principle: Mai (triglyceride) yana yin saponification a alkali: $\mathrm{RCOOR' + OH^- \to RCOO^- + R'OH}$. $\mathrm{Na_2CO_3}$ soda na wanki yana da pH kusan 11.
c-084.example: Idan ka narkar da cokali 1 na soda na wanki a lita 1 na ruwan zafi, ka bar a jiƙa na mintuna 10 sannan ka goge, tsohon mai yana saki. Yana ɓata fata, don haka sa safar roba, kuma kada ka yi amfani da shi a kwanonin aluminium ko masu shafe.
c-084.actionItem: Yau, jiƙa matatar fanka ɗaya a cikin maganin soda na wanki.

c-085.title: Ƙananan ƙurar da ke fitowa lokacin soya
c-085.summary: Dafa abinci ta soya da gasa yana ƙara PM2.5 a cikin gida sosai, don haka a kunna fanka kuma a buɗe taga lokacin girki.
c-085.principle: Idan aka ɗumama mai fiye da kusan 180℃, yana rushewa ta zafi yana samar da ɓangarori da acrolein: $\mathrm{C_3H_5(OH)_3 \to CH_2{=}CHCHO + 2H_2O}$ (cire ruwa daga glycerol)
c-085.example: An auna cewa PM2.5 na cikin gida na iya tashi zuwa ɗaruruwan μg/m³ lokacin gasa kifi a kwanon rufi, kuma kunna fanka yana rage shi sosai. Bayan girki ma, bar fanka a kunne na ƙarin mintuna 10.
c-085.actionItem: Yau, kafin ka fara girki, fara kunna fanka, kuma ka bar shi na ƙarin mintuna 10 bayan girki.

c-086.title: Bayan tafiya bakin teku, wanke keke da mota
c-086.summary: Gishirin iskar teku yana lalata ƙarfe da sauri, don haka bayan tafiya bakin teku a wanke mota da keke da ruwa kawai.
c-086.principle: Maganin sodium chloride yana zama electrolyte kuma yana samar da ƙwayar tsatsa ta ƙarfe: $\mathrm{Fe \to Fe^{2+} + 2e^-}$, $\mathrm{O_2 + 2H_2O + 4e^- \to 4OH^-}$
c-086.example: A muhalli mai gishiri da danshi, saurin tsatsar ƙarfe ya ninka na wuri mai bushe sau da yawa. Idan ka wanke ƙasan mota da sarkar keke da ruwa cikin awanni 24 bayan tuƙi a bakin teku kuma ka shafa mai na sarka, tsatsa tana raguwa sosai.
c-086.actionItem: Idan ka dawo daga bakin teku, yau wanke ƙasan mota da sarkar keke da ruwa.

c-087.title: Yadda ake wanke magungunan kwari: ruwa da farko, baking soda bayan haka
c-087.summary: Ruwa mai gudana shi ne asali ga 'ya'yan itace da kayan lambu, kuma bincike ya nuna cewa jiƙa a ruwan baking soda na mintuna 12 yana rage wasu magungunan kwari a saman sosai.
c-087.principle: Wasu magungunan kwari (kamar thiabendazole) suna rushewa da sauƙi a alkali mai rauni. Maganin baking soda 1% ($\mathrm{NaHCO_3}$) yana da pH kusan 8.1.
c-087.example: A gwaji, idan an jiƙa tuffa a maganin baking soda 1% (10g a lita 1 na ruwa) na mintuna 12, ragowar maganin kwari a saman ya ragu fiye da wanke da ruwa kawai. Ga 'ya'yan itacen da ake ci da fata, bayan jiƙa a sake wanke su da ruwa mai gudana.
c-087.actionItem: Yau, jiƙa tuffa ko inabi a ruwan baking soda 10g/L ka wanke.

c-088.title: Najasar tsuntsaye da tabon kwari furotin ne, dole a jiƙa su da sauri a goge
c-088.summary: Najasar tsuntsaye da ruwan jiki na kwari suna ɗauke da sinadarai masu acid da furotin, kuma idan sun bushe suna manne da saman fenti su yaɗu. Idan ka jiƙa su da kyau da zane mai jike sannan ka goge a hankali, lalacewar fenti ta yi ƙanƙanta.
c-088.principle: Furotin idan ya bushe yana haɗuwa ya taurara kuma yana yin haɗin hydrogen da saman. Ruwa da sabulu mai alkali mai rauni (pH 8~9) suna karya waɗannan haɗin.
c-088.example: Najasar tsuntsaye da aka bari fiye da kwana ɗaya na iya lalata saman fenti a fili cikin kwanaki 1~2, don haka ya fi aminci ka ajiye tawul na microfiber mai jike a kai na mintuna 5 sannan ka goge.
c-088.actionItem: Yau, idan akwai busasshiyar najasar tsuntsaye a mota ko taga, sa zane mai jike a kai na mintuna 5 ka jiƙa sannan ka goge.

c-089.title: Baking powder da baking soda abubuwa ne daban-daban
c-089.summary: Baking soda sodium bicarbonate ne kaɗai kuma yana buƙatar acid don ya tashi; baking powder yana da sinadarin acid a ciki, don haka yana tashi ko da ruwa kawai. Idan aka musanya su, ɗanɗano na iya zama ɗaci ko ba zai tashi sosai ba.
c-089.principle: $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 + H^+ \to Na^+ + H_2O + CO_2\uparrow}$. Karamin cokali 1 na baking soda (kusan 5 g) na iya samar da carbon dioxide kusan lita 1.
c-089.example: Idan girke-girke yana da ½ ƙaramin cokali na baking soda da yogurt (acid), acid ɗin yana sa soda ta yi amsawa. Idan ka saka soda kawai a kullu mara acid, sodar da ba ta yi amsawa ba tana barin ɗanɗano mai ɗaci kamar sabulu.
c-089.actionItem: Yau, duba lakabin baking soda da baking powder a shiryayyen kicin ka raba su a kwantena daban.

c-090.title: Dole a ajiye tuffa da ayaba daban
c-090.summary: Iskar ethylene da tuffa ke fitarwa tana sa ayaba ta nuna da sauri, don haka a ajiye 'ya'yan itace nesa da juna.
c-090.principle: Ethylene $\mathrm{CH_2{=}CH_2}$ hormone ne na shuka wanda ke kunna enzymes masu rushe bangon ƙwayar halitta kuma yana hanzarta nuna. Samarwa: sakin $\mathrm{C_2H_4}$ yana ƙaruwa sosai lokacin da 'ya'yan itace ke nuna.
c-090.example: Idan ka ajiye ayaba da ba ta nuna ba a jaka ɗaya da tuffa, tana nuna kwana ɗaya ko biyu da wuri, kuma za ka iya amfani da hakan da gangan. Akasin haka, idan kana so ta daɗe, ajiye tuffa daban yana ƙara lokacin ajiya da kwana ɗaya ko biyu kuma yana rage zubar da abinci.
c-090.actionItem: Yau, raba tuffa da ayaba a wurare ko kwantena daban-daban.

c-091.title: Tannin na shayi da kofi yana hana shan kwayoyin ƙarfe
c-091.summary: Tannins da polyphenols na shayi da kofi suna haɗuwa da ƙarfe ions suna samar da haɗin da ke da wuyar sha. Ya fi kyau a bar tazarar akalla awa 1~2 daga kwayoyin ƙarfe ko abinci mai yawan ƙarfe.
c-091.principle: Tannin yana yin chelate da ƙarfe: $\mathrm{Fe^{2+} + tannin \to Fe{-}tannin\ complex}$. Wannan haɗin yana da wuyar sha a hanji.
c-091.example: An ba da rahoton cewa shayi da ake sha tare da abinci na iya rage shan non-heme iron har 40~60%. Idan ka sha awa ɗaya bayan abinci, tasirin ya yi ƙasa sosai.
c-091.actionItem: Yau, idan ka sha kwayar ƙarfe ko ka ci abincin alayyahu ko wake, jinkirta shayi ko kofi da awa ɗaya.

c-092.title: Ana iya rage kuka lokacin yanka albasa ta sanyaya a firiji
c-092.summary: Idan ka yanka albasa, ƙwayoyin halitta suna fashewa kuma enzyme yana samar da iskar da ke ɓata idanu. Idan ka sanyaya albasa a firiji na mintuna 30, amsar enzyme tana jinkiri kuma kuka yana raguwa.
c-092.principle: Alliinase yana mai da sulfoxide zuwa abu mai ɓata rai: propanethial S-oxide ($\mathrm{C_3H_6OS}$) yana motsa jijiyoyin ido, yana haifar da hawaye. Saurin amsar enzyme yana raguwa daidai da zafi.
c-092.example: Idan aka kwatanta da albasa a zafin ɗaki (25℃), albasar da aka sanyaya zuwa 4℃ na mintuna 30 tana samar da abu mai ɓata rai a gudun da ya ragu zuwa kusan rabi ko ƙasa. Ɓangaren tushe yana da enzyme da yawa, don haka a yanka shi a ƙarshe.
c-092.actionItem: Yau, saka albasa a firiji mintuna 30 kafin ka yi amfani da ita.

c-093.title: Ƙunƙun tufafi sabuwar kafuwar haɗin hydrogen ce
c-093.summary: Zaren kamar auduga, idan ya sami ruwa da zafi, haɗin hydrogen tsakanin sarƙoƙin molecule yana sassautawa sannan ya taurara a sabon siffa lokacin sanyi. Idan ka sassauta da tururi da zafi kuma ka miƙa kafin ya yi sanyi, ƙunƙun yana ɓacewa.
c-093.principle: Ƙungiyoyin $\mathrm{{-}OH}$ na sarƙoƙin cellulose suna yin haɗin hydrogen da juna. Danshi da zafi suna karya waɗannan haɗin, kuma yayin sanyaya suna sake haɗuwa a siffar da aka miƙa.
c-093.example: Zafin guga da ya dace kusan 200℃ ne ga auduga, 110℃ ko ƙasa ga zaren roba. Idan ka rataya tufafi a ban ɗaki bayan wanka mai zafi, danshi da zafi na iya kawar da ƙananan ƙunƙun da kansu.
c-093.actionItem: Yau, duba lakabin wanki na rigar da za ka sa, ka miƙa ƙunƙun da tururi a zafin da aka yarda.

c-094.title: A ranakun ƙura da ƙananan ƙura, wanke fuska na dakika 30 da surfactant
c-094.summary: Ƙananan ƙura suna manne da mai na fata (sebum) kuma ruwa kawai ba ya cire su sosai. Mabuɗin shi ne wanke mai da ƙura tare da kumfa.
c-094.principle: Surfactant yana da wutsiya mai son mai da kai mai son ruwa, kuma sama da yawan micelle mai mahimmanci yana kama sebum da ƙura a cikin micelle ruwa ya wanke su. $c>\mathrm{CMC}\;\Rightarrow\;\text{micelle}\ (\text{sebum + dust trapped inside})$
c-094.example: Idan ka goge sabulun kumfa na wanke fuska da ruwan ɗumi 30~35°C na dakika 30 ka wanke, yawancin ƙurar fuska tana fita. Saboda pH na saman fata kusan 4.7~5.5 ne, samfura masu acid mai rauni (pH 5~6) sun fi kyau.
c-094.actionItem: Yau bayan ka dawo daga waje, ka yi kumfa sosai da ruwan ɗumi ka wanke fuska a hankali na dakika 30 (ka guji ruwan zafi).

c-095.title: Busasshen iskar jirgin sama yana buƙatar mai shafawa da shan ruwa
c-095.summary: Danshin da ke cikin gidan jirgin kusan 10~20% ne, kamar hamada, don haka fata da mucosa na hanci suna rasa ruwa da sauri. Mai shafawa da shan gilashin ruwa akai-akai suna taimakawa.
c-095.principle: Danshi na dangantaka $RH = \dfrac{p_{\mathrm{H_2O}}}{p^{*}_{\mathrm{H_2O}}} \times 100\%$. Saboda ana dumama iskar waje kafin shigar da ita gidan jirgin, matsin tururin cikakken ruwa yana da yawa kuma ainihin matsin tururin ruwa kaɗan ne, don haka $RH$ ƙasa ne.
c-095.example: Yayin da danshin cikin gida na yau da kullum ya kasance 40~60%, a gidan jirgin 10~20% asarar ruwa tana da sauri sau 2~3. A dogon hawan jirgi, ana ba da shawarar sha 100~200 mL na ruwa kowace awa.
c-095.actionItem: A tafiyar jirgin na gaba, ɗauki man shafawa a kwantena ƙasa da 100 mL.

c-096.title: Dafa ganyen bazara a tafasasshen ruwa na dakika 30 kawai
c-096.summary: Idan ka dafa shi na ɗan lokaci kaɗan, enzymes suna tsayawa, launi yana kasancewa mai haske kuma ɗacin da ƙamshin ganye suna raguwa. Idan ka dafa shi tsawon lokaci, chlorophyll yana canzawa ya zama launin zaitun mai rawaya.
c-096.principle: Zafi yana fitar da iska daga ƙwayoyin halitta kuma yana hana enzymes masu canza launi. Lokacin da magnesium na chlorophyll aka maye gurbinsa da hydrogen ions a zafi ko acid, pheophytin mai ruwan kasa yana samuwa. $\mathrm{Chl\text{-}Mg}+2\,\mathrm{H^+}\rightarrow \mathrm{Pheophytin}+\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}$
c-096.example: Idan ka saka gishiri 10 g (1%) a tafasasshen ruwa lita 1, ka dafa alayyahu 100 g na dakika 30 ka wanke da ruwan sanyi, kore yana kasancewa. Idan ka dafa fiye da mintuna 5, yana canzawa zuwa launin zaitun.
c-096.actionItem: Yau, idan ka sayi ganyen bazara, dafa su a tafasasshen ruwa mai gishiri 1% na dakika 30 sannan ka sanyaya nan take a ruwan sanyi.

c-097.title: Itace ta kama wuta sosai idan danshinta ya kai 20% ko ƙasa
c-097.summary: Rigar itace tana amfani da zafi da farko wajen ƙafe ruwa kafin ta ƙone, don haka hayaki mai yawa da ƙaramin zafi. Itacen da aka kare daga ruwan sama kuma aka bushar fiye da watanni 6 yana da inganci.
c-097.principle: Zafin ƙafewar ruwa $\Delta H_{vap} \approx 2.26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$ ne. Daga zafin konewar itace (kusan $18\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$ a tushen bushe), ana rage zafin gwargwadon danshi.
c-097.example: Itacen kore mai danshi 40% yana da zafin amfani da ya yi ƙasa da na busasshen itace (15~20%) da fiye da 30% kuma yana samar da hayaƙi da ƙoli da yawa. Raba itace ka duba ko tsakiyarsa busasshe ne.
c-097.actionItem: Yau, idan kana da itace da za a yi amfani da ita a waje, tara ta a wuri mai iska wanda ruwan sama ba ya taɓawa.

c-098.title: Ana tsoma koren shayi a ruwa 70~80℃ don rage ɗaci
c-098.summary: Catechins na koren shayi suna narkewa da yawa a babban zafi kuma suna ƙara ɗaci da kaushi, yayin da amino acid theanine mai daɗi yana fitowa har a ƙaramin zafi. Ruwan da aka sanyaya zuwa 70~80℃ yana ba da daidaito mai kyau.
c-098.principle: Narkewa yawanci yana ƙaruwa da zafi. Catechin epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) yana fitowa da sauri a sama da 80℃, yana ƙara kaushi.
c-098.example: Shayin da aka tsoma da ruwa 90℃ na mintuna 3 yana da yawan fitar catechin fiye da wanda aka tsoma da ruwa 70℃ a fili, don haka yana ɗanɗana ɗaci. Idan ka tura tafasasshen ruwa zuwa kofi sau ɗaya, yana sauka kusan 10℃.
c-098.actionItem: Yau, lokacin tsoma koren shayi, tura tafasasshen ruwa zuwa kofi sau ɗaya don ya huce, sannan ka tsoma na mintuna 2.

c-099.title: Glacial acetic acid ba vinegar ba ne, acetic acid ne 99%
c-099.summary: Vinegar maganin acetic acid ne 4~8%, amma glacial acetic acid kusan 99% acetic acid ne mai tsabta, wanda zai iya ƙone fata da idanu. Don amfani da shi a abinci, dole ne a duba alamar abinci kuma a tsoma shi sosai.
c-099.principle: Vinegar: $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ kusan $0.7\ \mathrm{mol/L}$ (4~5%). Glacial acetic acid kusan $17\ \mathrm{mol/L}$ ne, fiye da sau 20 yana da kauri. Tsabtataccen acetic acid yana taurara kamar ƙanƙara ƙasa da 16.6℃, don haka ake kiransa glacial.
c-099.example: A girke-girke da ke amfani da vinegar 5%, idan ka yi amfani da adadi iri ɗaya na glacial acetic acid 99%, acid ɗin da ke shiga ya fi kauri kusan sau 20. Idan lakabin bai da hanyar tsoma don abinci ba, ya fi aminci kada ka saya.
c-099.actionItem: Yau, duba acidity (%) da sinadaran a lakabin vinegar na gida.

c-100.title: Giya tana zama acetaldehyde a hanta kuma tana haifar da ciwon hangover
c-100.summary: Barasa tana rushewa a hanta zuwa acetaldehyde, wanda ke haifar da ciwon kai da tashin zuciya har sai ya koma acetic acid. Shan ruwa ba ya sa hanta ta yi rushewa da sauri.
c-100.principle: $\mathrm{CH_3CH_2OH \xrightarrow{ADH} CH_3CHO \xrightarrow{ALDH} CH_3COOH}$. Hantar babba tana rushe kusan $7\ \mathrm{g}$ na barasa mai tsabta ne kawai a awa.
c-100.example: Hanta tana ɗaukar sama da awanni 7 don rushe kwalbar soju ɗaya (kusan 360 mL, barasa kusan 50 g). Ruwa yana rage rashin ruwa a jiki kawai, ba ya ƙara saurin rushewa.
c-100.actionItem: Yau, idan akwai taron sha, sha gilashin ruwa tare ka ƙayyade yawan shanka tun da wuri.

c-101.title: Dole a kashe wutar zango gaba ɗaya da ruwa
c-101.summary: Wuta tana buƙatar mai, oxygen da zafi, kuma cire ɗaya kaɗai yana kashe ta. A zuba ruwa mai yawa a kan itace, a juya, a tabbatar da toka ya yi sanyi domin hana sake kamawa.
c-101.principle: Daga abubuwa uku na konewa, ruwa yana kashewa ta hanyar ɗaukar zafi. Zafin ƙafewar ruwa $\approx 2.26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$ yana shan zafin garwashi sosai.
c-101.example: Kwal ɗaya (kusan 100 g) yana ba da zafin MJ kaɗan, kuma zuba lita 1 na ruwa yana shan har zuwa kusan 2.3 MJ a matsayin zafin ƙafewa. Zuba har sai ka sa bayan hannu kusa ba ka ji zafi ba.
c-101.actionItem: Lokacin amfani da wuta a waje, ka ɗebo guga ɗaya na ruwa tun da wuri kafin ka tattara kaya.

c-102.title: Sodium na lakabin abinci × 2.54 = adadin gishiri
c-102.summary: Ƙimar sodium ba gishiri ba ne (sodium chloride), nauyin sodium ion ne. Idan ka mai da shi adadin gishiri, za ka fi fahimtar abin da kake sha a rana.
c-102.principle: Idan ka raba nauyin molar na NaCl 58.44 g/mol da na Na 22.99 g/mol, kusan 2.54 ne; don haka sodium × 2.54 shi ne adadin gishiri. $m_{\mathrm{NaCl}}=m_{\mathrm{Na}}\times\frac{58.44}{22.99}\approx 2.54\,m_{\mathrm{Na}}$
c-102.example: Jakar noodles mai sodium 1,800 mg ya yi daidai da gishiri kusan 4.6 g, wanda ya cinye mafi yawan shawarar WHO ta gishiri 5 g a rana (sodium 2,000 mg).
c-102.actionItem: Yau, ɗauki ƙimar sodium mg na abincin da aka sarrafa a gida ka ninka da 2.54 don mai da shi gishiri g.

c-103.title: Ana iya dafa noodles da zafin da ya rage bayan kashe wuta
c-103.summary: Bayan ka tafasa noodles na mintuna 2~3, idan ka kashe wuta ka rufe murfi, sitaci yana ci gaba da dahuwa. Hanya ce ta rage amfani da gas.
c-103.principle: Gelatinization na sitaci yana farawa kusan 60~70℃ kuma yana ci gaba muddin zafin ruwa ya kasance sama da 90℃. Saurin amsawa yana ƙaruwa da zafi.
c-103.example: Ruwa a tukunyar da aka rufe yana sauka kusan 5~8℃ ne kawai a mintuna 5 bayan kashe wuta, don haka gelatinization na sitacin noodle yana ci gaba. Ana iya rage lokacin amfani da gas da mintuna 3~4.
c-103.actionItem: Yau, lokacin dafa taliya ko noodles, kashe wuta bayan kashi 2/3 na lokacin da aka rubuta a fakiti ka rufe murfi.

c-104.title: Ruwan gilashin fure da sukari da ɗan vinegar don furanni su daɗe
c-104.summary: Furen da aka yanke ma suna numfashi suna ƙone sukari. Idan ka ba su ɗan sukari da acidity mai rauni, ana ƙara abinci mai gina jiki kuma ƙwayoyin cuta a ruwa suna raguwa.
c-104.principle: Furen da aka yanke suna amfani da glucose a matsayin makamashi ta numfashi, kuma ruwa mai acid mai rauni (pH kusan 3.5~4) yana jinkirta toshewar xylem ta ƙwayoyin cuta. $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}+6\,\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow 6\,\mathrm{CO_2}+6\,\mathrm{H_2O}$
c-104.example: Idan ka haɗa sukari 10 g (1%) da vinegar 5 mL a lita 1 na ruwa, pH yana kusan 3.7, kuma idan ka canza ruwa kowane kwana 2, yawanci furanni suna daɗewa da ƙarin kwanaki.
c-104.actionItem: Yau, canza ruwan gilashin fure zuwa lita 1 na ruwa mai tsabta tare da sukari 10 g da vinegar 5 mL, ka yanke ƙarshen kara a ƙeƙashe.

c-105.title: Goge ɗanko na lakabi da man girki
c-105.summary: Ɗankon da ya rage bayan cire lakabi ba ya fita da ruwa, amma yana narkewa da mai. Yawanci ana warware shi ba tare da ƙaƙƙarfan abin narkarwa ba.
c-105.principle: Manne polymer ne mara polarity, don haka ba ya narkewa a ruwa mai polarity amma yana haɗuwa da mai mara polarity (kamanni suna narkewa tare). $\delta_{\text{oil}}\approx\delta_{\text{adhesive}}\;\Rightarrow\;\text{like dissolves like}$
c-105.example: Idan ka shafa digo kaɗan na man girki a wurin ɗanko, ka jira mintuna 5, ka goge sannan ka cire sauran mai da sabulun kwano, yawancin ɗankon lakabi na gilashi da yumbu yana fita.
c-105.actionItem: Yau, shafa man girki a ɗankon da ke kan kwalba ko faranti, jira mintuna 5, ka goge (acetone na iya lalata filastik).

c-106.title: Goro yana ɓarkewa saboda unsaturated fats suna yin oxidation
c-106.summary: Unsaturated fatty acids na goro da man ridi suna yin oxidation idan sun haɗu da iska kuma suna ba da ƙamshin ɓaci. Rufe ƙarfi da daskarewa yana jinkirta ɓarkewa na watanni.
c-106.principle: Autoxidation na lipid: yana farawa da $\mathrm{RH + O_2 \to ROOH}$, aldehydes suna samuwa kuma ƙamshi yana fitowa. Saurin amsawa yana raguwa zuwa kusan rabi a kowane raguwar zafi 10℃.
c-106.example: A zafin ɗaki (25℃), walnuts suna fara ɗanɗanon ɓarkewa cikin makonni zuwa watanni, amma a ajiyar daskarewa -18℃ da rufewa ƙarfi suna iya 6~12 watanni. Idan akwai ɗaci ko ƙamshin ɓarkewa, jefar.
c-106.actionItem: Yau, saka sauran goro a jakar zip ko akwatin da ke rufe sosai ka saka a injin daskarewa.

c-107.title: Ana iya rage ƙaiƙayin cizon sauro da zafi
c-107.summary: Lokacin da yawun sauro ya shiga jiki, amsar garkuwar jiki tana sakin histamine kuma wurin yana kumbura da ƙaiƙayi. Idan ka sa zafi kusan 50℃ na dakika kaɗan, furotin na yawun yana denaturing kuma siginar ƙaiƙayi tana raguwa.
c-107.principle: Histamine $\mathrm{C_5H_9N_3}$ yana motsa ƙarshen jijiyoyi, kuma zafi yana kwance tsarin furotin na uku na yawun kuma yana rage amsawa (thermal denaturation).
c-107.example: An ba da rahoton cewa sa facin zafi 50℃ na kusan dakika 10 yana rage ƙaiƙayi na awanni. Don hana ƙonewa, kada ka daɗe da sa abu mai zafi kai tsaye a fata.
c-107.actionItem: A wannan tafiya, ɗauki maganin rage ƙaiƙayi ko gel mai sanyaya don amfani idan sauro ya cije ka.

c-108.title: Potassium sorbate a lakabin abinci mai kiyayewa ne na hana mold
c-108.summary: Potassium sorbate mai kiyayewa ne wanda ke hana mold da yeast a yanayi mai acid, ana amfani da shi a cuku, abin sha da burodi. A cikin iyakokin da aka yarda ana ɗaukarsa mai aminci, amma masu hankali na iya duba sinadaran.
c-108.principle: Sorbic acid ($\mathrm{C_5H_7COOH}$, $pK_a = 4.76$) yana da ƙarin siffar da ba a rarraba ba a ƙaramin pH, kuma yana ratsa membrane na ƙwayar halitta don yin tasiri.
c-108.example: A pH 4.8, kusan 50% na sorbic acid yana cikin siffar da ba a rarraba ba mai tasiri, amma a pH 6.8 kusan 1% kawai. Saboda haka yana aiki mafi kyau a abinci mai acid.
c-108.actionItem: Yau, nemi alamar kiyayewa a jerin sinadaran abinci biyu da kake ci akai-akai.

c-109.title: Ana zubar da batir da aka gama amfani da shi a akwatin tattarawa, ba a shara ta yau da kullum ba
c-109.summary: Batir yana ɗauke da karafa kamar zinc, manganese da nickel, kuma idan aka binne shi a shara ta yau da kullum, yana iya shiga ƙasa. Idan aka tattara shi a akwatunan tattara batir da aka gama, ana iya sake samun karafa.
c-109.principle: Amsawar batir alkaline: $\mathrm{Zn + 2MnO_2 + H_2O \to ZnO + 2MnOOH}$. Idan an sake samo waɗannan karafa, sun zama sabbin albarkatu.
c-109.example: Batir AA ɗaya yana da nauyin kusan 23 g, kuma fiye da kusan 20% daga ciki karafa ne kamar zinc da manganese. Idan ka tara 100, ana iya sake sarrafa yawancin karafa daga kusan 2.3 kg na batir.
c-109.actionItem: Yau, tara batir da aka gama amfani da su a gida a kwantena ɗaya ka kai akwatin tattarawa na unguwa.

c-110.title: Ana farfaɗo da sukarin ruwan kasa da ya taurara da guntun burodi
c-110.summary: Sukarin ruwan kasa yana taurara saboda ruwan molasses ya ƙafe kuma lu'ulu'u suna manne. Idan ka rufe shi da guntun burodi ko tawul na takarda mai jike, ruwa yana dawowa kuma yana laushi.
c-110.principle: Sukari yana shan danshi, yana jawo tururin ruwa $\mathrm{H_2O(g)}$, kuma fim ɗin molasses na saman yana sake laushi. Daidaito yana faruwa tsakanin matsin tururin ruwa na iska da saman sukari.
c-110.example: Idan ka saka guntun burodi 1 a 500 g na sukarin ruwan kasa da ya taurara ka rufe shi sosai, yawanci yana laushi cikin kwana ɗaya. Idan kana gaggawa, rufe shi da tawul na takarda mai jike a microwave na dakika 20 yana sassauta shi.
c-110.actionItem: Yau, idan kana da sukarin da ya taurara, saka shi a kwantena mai rufewa tare da guntun burodi.

c-111.title: Idan ka tsoma kombu a ruwan sanyi na dogon lokaci, umami yana fitowa da kyau
c-111.summary: Glutamic acid na kombu yana fitowa a hankali har a ruwan sanyi, kuma tafasa mai ƙarfi tana fitar da ruwan ɗanko, wanda ke sa romo ya zama gizagizai da ɗanko. Idan ka tsoma a ruwan sanyi fiye da mintuna 30 ka ɗauka kafin tafasa, romo yana da tsabta.
c-111.principle: Glutamic acid $\mathrm{HOOC{-}CH_2CH_2{-}CH(NH_2){-}COOH}$ yana narkewa a ruwa, kuma mucilaginous polysaccharides kamar alginic acid suna fitowa da yawa idan an tafasa na dogon lokaci.
c-111.example: Idan ka tsoma kombu guda biyu masu tsawon 10 cm a lita 1 na ruwa na mintuna 30 ka ɗauke su lokacin da ruwa ya fara tafasa (kusan 90℃), umami yana fitowa sosai. Kombun da aka cire ana iya sake amfani da shi a abincin da aka dafa a hankali.
c-111.actionItem: Yau da yamma, lokacin yin romo, tsoma kombu a ruwan sanyi na mintuna 30 sannan ka tafasa.

c-112.title: Launin fitsari yana nuna ko ana shan isasshen ruwa
c-112.summary: Rawayar fitsari tana fitowa daga pigment da ake kira urochrome kuma tana duhu idan ruwa ya ragu. Idan rawaya ce mai haske, gabaɗaya yana nufin kana shan isasshe.
c-112.principle: A cikin yawan $c = \dfrac{n}{V}$, idan shan ruwa ya ragu kuma $V$ ya ragu, urochrome $n$ iri ɗaya yana bayyana da ƙarfi.
c-112.example: Idan yawan fitsari a rana kusan lita 1.5 ne kuma launin rawaya mai haske kamar ciyawa, gabaɗaya ya isa. Idan launin amber mai duhu, alama ce ta ƙara shan ruwa, amma idan ana shan vitamin B ko magani, launi na iya canzawa.
c-112.actionItem: Yau, duba launin fitsarinka sau ɗaya, kuma idan ya yi duhu, sha gilashin ruwa.

c-113.title: Matakin fetur shi ne octane number kuma a yi amfani da wanda ya dace da mota
c-113.summary: Octane number yana nuna yadda mai ke jure knocking, wato fashewar kansa lokacin matsawa. Idan littafin motarka ya ba da matakin da ya dace, saka mai mai tsada fiye da haka ba shi da tasiri.
c-113.principle: Octane number ƙima ce da ke kwatanta juriyar knocking, tare da isooctane ($\mathrm{C_8H_{18}}$) a matsayin 100 da heptane a matsayin 0.
c-113.example: Idan littafin mota ya ba da shawarar octane 91 (na yau da kullum) kuma ka saka 94 (premium), kawai ya fi tsada da ɗaruruwan won a lita ɗaya kuma inganci ba ya ƙaruwa kusan komai. Yi amfani da premium ne kawai lokacin da injin mai matsi mai yawa ya buƙata.
c-113.actionItem: Yau, duba octane number da aka ba da shawara a littafin mota ko lakabin cikin bakin tankin mai.

c-114.title: Ana rubuta dukkan sinadaran kwalliya daga mafi yawa zuwa mafi ƙaranci
c-114.summary: A lakabin kwalliya, ana rubuta sinadarai masu 1% ko fiye daga mafi yawa, kuma waɗanda ke ƙasa da 1% a kowace tsari. Sinadaran farko kaɗan sun fi mamaye samfurin, don haka idan sinadarin talla yana ƙarshe, yawansa kaɗan ne.
c-114.principle: A mafi yawan samfura ruwa ($\mathrm{H_2O}$) yana zuwa da farko. Idan yawan $w = \dfrac{m_{\text{sinadari}}}{m_{\text{jimilla}}} \times 100\%$ ya yi ƙasa da 1%, ana yarda a rubuta ba tare da tsari ba.
c-114.example: Idan jerin sinadaran toner shi ne ruwa, glycerin, butylene glycol, sinadarai uku na farko na iya zama sama da 90% na samfurin. Idan sinadarin talla yana ƙarshe, yawanci yana ƙasa da 1%.
c-114.actionItem: Yau, karanta sinadarai biyar na farko a jerin dukkan sinadaran kwalliya ɗaya da kake amfani da shi.

c-115.title: A abincin zango, wuce yankin 4~60℃ da sauri
c-115.summary: Ƙwayoyin cuta suna haɓaka da sauri a kusan 4~60℃, wanda ake kira yankin zafin haɗari. A zango, a ajiye abincin nama da kwai a akwatin kankara a 4℃ ko ƙasa, kuma lokacin dafa su, a dumama har tsakiya.
c-115.principle: Yawan ƙwayoyin cuta yana ƙaruwa kamar $N = N_0 \cdot 2^{t/t_d}$. E. coli na iya ninkawa kowane minti 20 kusa da 37℃.
c-115.example: A zafin ɗaki (30℃) a tsakiyar bazara, a abincin da aka bari na awanni 2, ƙwayoyin cuta na iya ƙaruwa kusan $2^{6} = 64$ sau. Dafa nama a zafin tsakiya sama da 75℃ na fiye da minti 1.
c-115.actionItem: A wannan zango, cika akwatin kankara da kankara ka ɗauki ma'aunin zafi.

c-116.title: Ko da an saka gishiri a ruwan noodles, wurin tafasa kusan ba ya ƙaruwa
c-116.summary: Cewa gishiri yana sa ruwa ya fi zafi kuskure ne. Don tanadin gas, murfi da ƙaramin wuta sun fi tasiri fiye da gishiri.
c-116.principle: Akwai 'boiling point elevation' inda wurin tafasa ke ƙaruwa tare da ƙarin ɓangarori da aka narkar, amma ƙimar ƙanana ce sosai. $\Delta T_b=i\,K_b\,m=2\times0.512\times0.171\approx0.17\ \mathrm{K}$
c-116.example: Ko da ka saka gishiri 10 g a lita 1 na ruwa, wurin tafasa yana ƙaruwa da kusan 0.17°C kawai, don haka lokacin girki bai canza ba kuma kawai ɗanɗano ake daidaitawa.
c-116.actionItem: Yau, lokacin tafasa noodles, yi amfani da gishiri don ɗanɗano kawai, kuma idan ya tafasa, rufe murfi ka rage wuta.

c-117.title: Tabon ciyawa: barasa da farko, sannan abin wanki na enzyme
c-117.summary: Ruwan ciyawa yana ɗauke da chlorophyll (sinadarin mai) da furotin gauraye, don haka ruwa kawai ba ya cire shi. Ko da bin tsarin magani kawai yana cire shi sosai.
c-117.principle: Chlorophyll yana narkewa a ethanol, kuma tabon furotin ana yanke shi zuwa peptides ta protease na abin wanki na enzyme. Ruwan zafi yana taurara furotin ya gyara shi. $\text{protein stain}+\mathrm{H_2O}\xrightarrow{\ \text{protease}\ }\text{peptides}$
c-117.example: Idan ka jiƙa tabon da ethanol 70% na mintuna 5 sannan ka wanke da abin wanki na enzyme a ruwa 30~40°C, ruwan ciyawa yana raguwa sosai.
c-117.actionItem: Yau, shafa ethanol na tsaftacewa a tabon ciyawa na mintuna 5 ka wanke a 30~40°C (a fara duba canjin launi a wurin da ba a gani).

c-118.title: Idan aka ci ƙarfen alayyahu da lemo, shan shi yana ƙaruwa
c-118.summary: Ƙarfen shuka (non-heme iron) ba a sha shi da kyau, amma vitamin C yana mai da shi siffar da za a iya sha. Tannins na shayi da kofi, akasin haka, suna hana shan.
c-118.principle: Non-heme iron galibi yana kasancewa a matsayin $\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}$, amma a hanji ana shan $\mathrm{Fe^{2+}}$ kawai; vitamin C yana rage ƙarfe mai valence 3 zuwa 2 kuma yana yin chelate da ƙarfe. $\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}+\text{ascorbate}\rightarrow\mathrm{Fe^{2+}}+\text{dehydroascorbate}$
c-118.example: Idan aka ƙara vitamin C kusan 100 mg (daidai da lemo ɗaya) a abinci, shan non-heme iron na iya ƙaruwa sau 2~3.
c-118.actionItem: Yau, yayyafa ruwan lemo a abincin alayyahu ko wake, kuma ka sha shayi ko kofi awa ɗaya bayan abinci.

c-119.title: Sanyaya abin sha da sauri a waje da kankarar gishiri
c-119.summary: Idan ka haɗa kankara da gishiri, yana sauka ƙasa da 0°C sosai kuma abin sha yana yin sanyi cikin mintuna kaɗan. Za a iya amfani da shi a madadin firiji a fikinik.
c-119.principle: Saboda freezing point depression, ruwan da aka narkar da gishiri yana daskarewa ne kawai a ƙasa da 0°C, kankara tana narkewa tana shan zafi daga kewaye kuma zafi yana sauka (eutectic point -21°C). $\Delta T_f=i\,K_f\,m,\quad K_f=1.86\ \mathrm{K\,kg\,mol^{-1}}$
c-119.example: Idan ka haɗa kankara da gishiri a nauyi 3:1, yana sauka zuwa kusan -15~-20°C, kuma idan ka saka gwangwani ka juya, yana yin sanyi zuwa kusan 5°C cikin mintuna kaɗan.
c-119.actionItem: Yau a fikinik, haɗa kankara 3 da gishiri 1 a akwatin kankara ka juya gwangwanin abin sha na mintuna 3~5 (ka tabbata gwangwani bai daskare ya fashe ba).

c-120.title: Naman da ya yi launin ruwan kasa ba lallai ya lalace nan take ba
c-120.summary: Launin nama yana ƙayyade ta yanayin ƙarfen myoglobin kuma ba koyaushe yake dacewa da sabo ba. Duba kwanan wata da ƙamshi tare.
c-120.principle: Oxymyoglobin da ke haɗe da oxygen yana ja mai haske, kuma idan ƙarfe ya yi oxidation yana zama metmyoglobin mai ruwan kasa. A cikin kunshin vacuum ko mai matse, ciki yana da ƙarancin oxygen kuma launi shunayya mai duhu. $\mathrm{Mb}(\mathrm{Fe^{2+}})+\mathrm{O_2}\rightleftharpoons\mathrm{MbO_2}$ (red),  $\mathrm{Mb}\rightarrow\mathrm{metMb}(\mathrm{Fe^{3+}})$ (brown)
c-120.example: Naman shanu da aka niƙa yana zama ja mai haske cikin mintuna 15~30 idan ya taɓa iska, kuma bayan kwanaki a firiji na iya zama ruwan kasa, amma launi kaɗai bai isa a yanke hukuncin ya lalace ba.
c-120.actionItem: Yau, lokacin sayen nama, duba ba launi kaɗai ba, har da ranar amfani, yanayin kunshin, ƙamshi mai tsami da ɗanko.

c-121.title: Dole a dafa tafarnuwa mintuna 10 bayan yankawa don allicin ya samu
c-121.summary: Idan ka yanka ko ka dake tafarnuwa, enzyme alliinase yana mai da alliin zuwa allicin, wanda ke zama tushen sinadaran tafarnuwa na maganin ƙwayoyin cuta da lafiya. Idan ka dafa nan take, enzyme yana tsayawa kuma allicin yana raguwa.
c-121.principle: Alliin $\xrightarrow{\text{alliinase}}$ allicin ($\mathrm{C_6H_{10}OS_2}$). Enzyme yana denaturing da sauri a sama da kusan 60~70℃.
c-121.example: An ba da rahoton cewa idan ka bar tafarnuwa da aka niƙa na mintuna 10 kafin dafa shi, sinadaran da suka samo asali daga allicin suna ragewa sau da yawa fiye da dafawa nan take. A ci kusan ƙwayoyin tafarnuwa 1~2 a lokaci ɗaya.
c-121.actionItem: Yau, idan za ka yi amfani da tafarnuwa a girki, yanka ta ka bar na mintuna 10 kafin dumama.

c-122.title: Idan ka tace man soya ka ajiye a wuri mai duhu, yana daɗewa
c-122.summary: Mai yana ɓarkewa idan ya haɗu da zafi, haske da oxygen kuma yana ba da ƙamshi mara daɗi. Ajiya mai kyau kawai tana hana ɓata mai.
c-122.principle: Unsaturated fatty acids suna yin oxidation ta hanyar free radical chain reaction suna samar da peroxides da aldehydes. Zafi da ragowar abinci suna haɓaka amsawa. $\mathrm{R}\cdot+\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow\mathrm{ROO}\cdot,\ \ \mathrm{ROO}\cdot+\mathrm{RH}\rightarrow\mathrm{ROOH}+\mathrm{R}\cdot$
c-122.example: Yi amfani da man girki mai yawan unsaturation cikin kusan watanni 3 bayan buɗewa, kuma ga man soya ya fi kyau a tace ragowa a yi amfani da shi sau 2~3 kawai.
c-122.actionItem: Yau, tace man soyan da ka yi amfani da shi da matatar kofi, saka shi a kwalba mai duhu, ka ajiye a wuri mai sanyi, kuma idan ya yi ƙamshin fenti, jefar.

c-123.title: Karfen da ba ya tsatsa ma yana tsatsa idan an bar miya mai gishiri na dogon lokaci
c-123.summary: Karfen da ba ya tsatsa ba ya tsatsa saboda siraran fim ɗin chromium oxide, amma ions na chloride na iya huda wannan fim ɗin kuma su haddasa ƙananan ramuka da tabo na tsatsa.
c-123.principle: Idan chromium ya wuce kashi 10.5, fim ɗin $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$ yana samuwa a saman kuma yana gyara kansa idan akwai oxygen, amma $\mathrm{Cl^-}$ yana lalata fim ɗin a wani yanki kuma yana haddasa pitting. $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}\ (1\text{-}5\ \mathrm{nm\ film})\ +\ \mathrm{Cl^-}\rightarrow\text{pitting}$
c-123.example: 316 mai kashi 2 na molybdenum yana jure gishiri fiye da 304 (chromium kusan kashi 18, nickel kashi 8). Barin ruwan gishiri na wasu awanni na iya haddasa pitting.
c-123.actionItem: A yau, wanke tukunyar karfen da ba ya tsatsa da aka ajiye miya ko abinci mai gishiri a ciki nan take, ka goge ka bushar da ita.

c-124.title: Kofi na yamma yana da fiye da rabi a jiki da daddare ma
c-124.summary: Caffeine yana fita daga jiki a hankali, don haka kofi na ƙarshe yana shafar barcin dare. Gaggawar lokacin ƙarshe na kofi kaɗai yana taimaka.
c-124.principle: Rabin rayuwar caffeine kusan awanni 5 ne (3 zuwa 7), kuma yana raguwa kamar martani na mataki na farko, wani kaso a lokaci guda. $C(t)=C_0\left(\tfrac12\right)^{t/t_{1/2}},\quad t_{1/2}\approx5\ \mathrm{h}$
c-124.example: Idan ka sha 150 mg na caffeine da ƙarfe 3 na rana, bayan awanni 8, da ƙarfe 11 na dare, har yanzu kusan 50 mg (1/3) ya rage. Ana ba da shawarar jimillar kullum ƙasa da 400 mg.
c-124.actionItem: A yau, ƙayyade abin sha na ƙarshe mai caffeine awanni 8 kafin barci, kuma bayan haka sha decaf ko shayin sha'ir.

c-125.title: A tsaunuka masu tsayi ruwa yana tafasa a 95°C kuma girki yana raguwa
c-125.summary: Yayin da tsayi ke ƙaruwa, matsin iska yana raguwa kuma ruwa yana tafasa a ƙaramin zafi. Shi yasa cup noodles ko shinkafa suke yin ɗanye.
c-125.principle: Idan matsin iska ya ragu, wurin tafasa yana raguwa (kusan 3.3°C a kowane mita 1,000). Idan aka yi amfani da ƙa'idar cewa saurin martani yana ninkawa a kowane 10°C, lokacin girki yana ƙaruwa. $\Delta T_b\approx -3.3\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}\ \text{per}\ 1000\ \mathrm{m};\quad \frac{t'}{t}\approx 2^{\Delta T/10}$
c-125.example: A tsayin mita 1,500 ruwa yana tafasa a kusan 95°C, saurin yana zama $2^{-0.5}\approx0.7$, don haka lokacin girki yana ƙaruwa da kusan kashi 40.
c-125.actionItem: Idan kuna da shirin hawan dutse yau, yi rubutu cewa a wannan tsayin za a ninka lokacin noodles da 1.4, kuma shinkafa a dafa da murfi na tsawon lokaci.

c-126.title: Kada ka dumama kasko mai shafi a wuta mai ƙarfi babu komai a ciki
c-126.summary: Shafin Teflon (PTFE) yana tsayawa har kusan 260°C amma bayan haka yana rubewa yana fitar da hayaki mai cutarwa. A gida, dumama kasko mara komai a wuta mai ƙarfi shi ne mafi yawan dalili.
c-126.principle: PTFE yana da tsayayye saboda mahaɗan C-F suna da ƙarfi sosai, amma sama da kusan 300°C yana rubewa kuma yana fitar da iskar fluorine mai kisa ga tsuntsaye. $-(\mathrm{CF_2\text{-}CF_2})_n-,\quad E_{\mathrm{C\text{-}F}}\approx485\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$
c-126.example: Kasko mara komai a wuta mai ƙarfi na iya wuce 300°C cikin mintuna 2 zuwa 5. A wuta matsakaiciya da mai ko kayan abinci a ciki, yawanci yana tsayawa ƙasa da 200°C.
c-126.actionItem: A yau, yi amfani da kasko mai shafi a wuta matsakaiciya ko ƙasa da haka, zuba mai da farko, kada ka dumama shi babu komai, kuma kauce wa kayan ƙarfe.

c-127.title: Shan vinegar ba tare da narkewa ba yana narkar da enamel na haƙori
c-127.summary: pH na vinegar kusan 2.5 ne, wanda ya fi ƙasa da pH 5.5 da enamel ya fara narkewa. Idan za ka sha, ka narkar da shi sosai kuma ka wanke baki da ruwa bayan haka.
c-127.principle: Narkewar enamel na haƙori: $\mathrm{Ca_{10}(PO_4)_6(OH)_2 + 14H^+ \to 10Ca^{2+} + 6H_2PO_4^- + 2H_2O}$. Mafi ƙarancin $\mathrm{pH} = -\log[\mathrm{H^+}]$, mafi sauri narkewa.
c-127.example: Vinegar mai pH 2.5 yana da yawan ions na hydrogen sau 1000 fiye da pH 5.5. Haɗa babban cokali ɗaya na vinegar da aƙalla 200 mL na ruwa ka sha da bambaro, kuma goge haƙora bayan mintuna 30.
c-127.actionItem: A yau, idan ka sha vinegar ko abin sha mai tsami, wanke baki da ruwa sau ɗaya kuma ka goge haƙora bayan mintuna 30.

c-128.title: Saka burodi a firiza, ba a firiji ba
c-128.summary: Burodi ba ya taurara saboda ya bushe, sai dai saboda starch yana sake yin crystal, kuma wannan yana faruwa mafi sauri a firiji.
c-128.principle: Retrogradation, wato sake tsara amylose da amylopectin na dafaffen starch, yana da sauri a 0 zuwa 5°C kuma yana kusan tsayawa ƙasa da −18°C. $\text{amylose/amylopectin recrystallization (retrogradation)},\ \text{fastest at }0\text{-}5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$
c-128.example: Burodi a zafin ɗaki yana taurara cikin kwanaki 2 zuwa 3 kuma a firiji da sauri, amma a firiza −18°C yana ɗaukar kusan watanni 3, kuma idan an dumama sama da 60°C, crystals suna narkewa kuma yana laushi.
c-128.actionItem: A yau, raba burodin da ya rage zuwa yanka ɗaya-ɗaya ka daskarar da su, kuma idan za ka ci, sake dumama da toaster ko tururi.

c-129.title: Cire tabon tumatir daga kwantena na roba da rana da mai
c-129.summary: Launin ja na miyar tumatir yana haɗuwa da mai kuma yana shiga cikin roba. Mai da hasken UV sun fi ruwa tasiri.
c-129.principle: Lycopene launi ne maras-polar da ke narkewa cikin roba, kuma 11 conjugated double bonds ɗinsa suna shan haske su yi ja, kuma UV yana karya waɗannan mahaɗai ya mayar da shi mara launi. $\text{lycopene (11 conjugated C=C)}\xrightarrow{h\nu}\text{colourless fragments}$
c-129.example: Idan ka shafa digon mai ka goge, ka wanke da sabulun wanke kwano sannan ka bar shi a rana awanni 2 zuwa 3, yawancin tabon yana ɓacewa.
c-129.actionItem: A yau, shafa digon man girki a kwantena na roba mai tabo, ka goge, ka wanke da sabulu sannan ka bar shi a rana kusa da taga awanni 2 zuwa 3 (amfani da gilashi tun farko yana hana matsalar).

c-130.title: Ga gudawa da rashin ruwa a jiki: maganin gishiri da sukari
c-130.summary: Idan glucose da sodium suna sha tare, ruwa yana biyo. Yana ƙara ruwa a jiki fiye da shan ruwa kaɗai.
c-130.principle: SGLT1 mai jigilar ƙwayar hanji yana ɗaukar ƙwayar glucose 1 tare da ions na sodium 2 kuma ruwa yana biyo ta osmosis. $\mathrm{SGLT1}:\ 1\ \text{glucose}+2\ \mathrm{Na^+}\rightarrow\text{water uptake}$
c-130.example: Girkin WHO na gida shine lita 1 na tafasasshen ruwa da aka sanyaya, cokali 6 na sukari (kusan 25 g) da rabin cokali na gishiri (kusan 3 g). Idan rashin ruwa mai tsanani, jarirai ko zazzabi mai zafi, je asibiti.
c-130.actionItem: A yau, shirya fakitin ORS ɗaya ko biyu da ake sayarwa a kantin magani a akwatin magungunan gaggawa.

c-131.title: Ƙonewar ido a wurin ninkaya ba daga chlorine ba ne, daga chloramine
c-131.summary: Jajayen ido ba ya faruwa saboda maganin kashe ƙwayoyin cuta na tafkin ya yi ƙarfi sosai, sai dai saboda chloramines da suka samu daga gumi da fitsari. Wanka shine mafi kyawun rigakafi.
c-131.principle: Chlorine a ruwa yana zama hypochlorous acid (HOCl) kuma yana kashe ƙwayoyin cuta, kuma idan ya haɗu da ammoniacal nitrogen yana yin chloramines masu ƙonawa. A pH 7.5, HOCl kusan kashi 50 ne. $\mathrm{Cl_2}+\mathrm{H_2O}\rightleftharpoons\mathrm{HOCl}+\mathrm{H^+}+\mathrm{Cl^-},\quad \mathrm{HOCl}\rightleftharpoons\mathrm{H^+}+\mathrm{OCl^-}\ (\mathrm{p}K_a\approx7.5)$
c-131.example: Shawarar tafkin shine pH 7.2 zuwa 7.8, free chlorine 1 zuwa 3 ppm. Wanka da sabulu na minti ɗaya kafin ninkaya yana rage abubuwan halitta sosai.
c-131.actionItem: A yau, kafin zuwa tafkin ninkaya, yi wanka da sabulu na minti ɗaya, kuma kada ka yi fitsari a ruwa yayin ninkaya.

c-132.title: Lissafa taurin ruwa daga calcium da magnesium a lakabin ruwan kwalba
c-132.summary: Ko da ruwan kwalba ɗaya ne, taurin ruwan ya bambanta, wanda ke shafar ɗanɗanon kofi da shayi da laka. Lambobin lakabin kaɗai suna nuna ko ruwan mai laushi ne ko mai tauri.
c-132.principle: Taurin shi ne jimillar ions na calcium da magnesium da aka canza zuwa nauyin calcium carbonate. Don cire kofi, ana ba da shawarar kusan 50 zuwa 175 mg/L. $H=2.497\,[\mathrm{Ca}]+4.118\,[\mathrm{Mg}]\ (\mathrm{mg\,L^{-1}}\text{ as }\mathrm{CaCO_3})$
c-132.example: Ruwa mai calcium 80 mg/L da magnesium 26 mg/L shine $2.497\times80+4.118\times26\approx307$ mg/L, ruwa mai tauri sosai (fiye da 180), kuma lemun tsami yana samuwa da sauƙi a tukunyar lantarki.
c-132.actionItem: A yau, lissafa taurin ruwan kwalbar da kake sha daga lambobin Ca da Mg a lakabin.

c-133.title: Calorie zafin ƙonewa ne, kuma carb, protein, fat su ne 4·4·9 kcal/g
c-133.summary: An ƙayyade makamashin abinci ta zafin da ake samu idan aka ƙona shi a wajen jiki. Za ka iya lissafa makamashi daga grams na tebur ɗin abinci mai gina jiki kai tsaye.
c-133.principle: 1 mol na glucose idan ya ƙone yana fitar da 2,803 kJ (kusan 15.6 kJ/g, 3.7 kcal/g). Ma'aunin Atwater shine carbohydrate da protein 4, fat 9 kcal/g. $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}+6\,\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow6\,\mathrm{CO_2}+6\,\mathrm{H_2O},\ \Delta H=-2803\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}\approx3.7\ \mathrm{kcal\,g^{-1}}$
c-133.example: Biscuit mai carbohydrate 50 g, fat 20 g, protein 10 g yana da $50\times4+20\times9+10\times4=420$ kcal.
c-133.actionItem: A yau, ka lissafa makamashin abun ciye-ciye ɗaya daga grams na carb, protein da fat a tebur ɗin abinci mai gina jiki.

c-134.title: Busar da wanki a rana yana da tasirin farar da shi
c-134.summary: UV na hasken rana yana oxidize kuma yana rushe tabon launi da ya rage a zaren, yana sa farin tufafi su ƙara fari. Ko da babu sodium percarbonate, ana iya rage ƙananan tabo da hasken rana.
c-134.principle: Photo-oxidation: photons na UV suna karya mahaɗan $\pi$ na launi kuma suna martani da oxygen su zama abubuwa marasa launi. Dole makamashin photon $E = h\nu$ ya fi makamashin mahaɗi.
c-134.example: Idan ka shanya farar T-shirt mai tabo a rana kai tsaye ta jiƙa na awanni 4 zuwa 6, ƙananan tabo suna ɓacewa a fili. Amma tufafi masu launi na iya kaɗewa da wannan ƙa'ida, don haka bushar da su a juye.
c-134.actionItem: A yau, shanya farin wanki mai tabo a jiƙe a wurin rana.

c-135.title: Idan manne mai sauri ya manne a hannu, jiƙa shi cikin ruwan sabulu
c-135.summary: Manne mai sauri yana taurara saboda danshin fata, amma ana iya sassauta shi a hankali da ruwan sabulu mai ɗumi. Idan ka tilasta cire shi, fata za ta yage.
c-135.principle: Cyanoacrylate yana polymerize a jere ta danshi (OH⁻) cikin daƙiƙu zuwa minti ɗaya ya zama polymer mai tauri. Ruwan sabulu da gogayya suna kumburar da layin manne su tura shi. $n\,\mathrm{CH_2{=}C(CN)COOR}\xrightarrow{\ \mathrm{OH^-}\ (\text{moisture})\ }\left[\mathrm{CH_2\text{-}C(CN)(COOR)}\right]_n$
c-135.example: Idan ka jiƙa a ruwan sabulu mai ɗumi na mintuna 10 zuwa 15 sannan ka mirgina da babban yatsa, yawanci yana saki. Idan ya manne a ido ko leɓe, kada ka goga, je asibiti.
c-135.actionItem: A yau, idan za ka yi amfani da manne mai sauri, bar iska ta shiga, kuma idan yatsunka suka manne, jiƙa su a ruwan sabulu mai ɗumi na mintuna 15 sannan ka mirgina ka raba.

c-136.title: Ƙamshin kifi yana raguwa idan aka ƙara acid
c-136.summary: Babban mai haddasa ƙamshin kifi shine trimethylamine, wani abu mai alkaline. Idan ka yayyafa acid kamar ruwan lemun tsami ko vinegar, yana neutralize kuma ƙamshin yana raguwa.
c-136.principle: $\mathrm{(CH_3)_3N + H^+ \to (CH_3)_3NH^+}$. Amine da ya zama ion ba ya ƙafewa, don haka ƙamshi yana raguwa.
c-136.example: Idan ka yayyafa cokali 1 na ruwan lemun tsami (kusan 5 mL) a kifi ka bar shi mintuna 5, ƙamshi yana raguwa a fili. Jiƙa a madara na mintuna 20 shima yana aiki ta ƙa'ida ɗaya, inda protein ke riƙe abin da ke ƙamshi.
c-136.actionItem: A yau, lokacin da kake gasa kifi, yayyafa ruwan lemun tsami ko vinegar da farko.

c-137.title: Idan tsayi ya ƙaru, matsin oxygen yana raguwa kuma ana ƙoƙarin numfashi
c-137.summary: Rabon oxygen a iska kusan kashi 21 ne a ko'ina, amma yayin da tsayi ke ƙaruwa, matsin iska yana raguwa kuma matsin oxygen ma yana raguwa. A tsayin mita 3000 za ka iya shaƙar kusan kashi 70 na abin da ake shaƙa a matakin teku.
c-137.principle: Dokar matsi ta Dalton: $p_{\mathrm{O_2}} = x_{\mathrm{O_2}} \times P_{\mathrm{total}}$. $x_{\mathrm{O_2}} \approx 0.21$ ba ya canzawa kuma $P_{\mathrm{total}}$ yana raguwa.
c-137.example: A matakin teku (101 kPa) matsin oxygen kusan 21 kPa ne, kuma a tsayin mita 3000 (kusan 70 kPa) kusan 14.7 kPa. Idan ka hau a hankali ba fiye da mita 500 a rana ba, haɗarin cutar tsayi yana raguwa.
c-137.actionItem: Idan kana da shirin tafiya zuwa wuri mai tsayi, shirya jadawali ta yadda za ka hau a hankali.

c-138.title: Idan gwangwanin abinci ya kumbura ko ya yi mummunan lalacewa, jefar da shi
c-138.summary: Gwangwani mai kumbura alama ce cewa ƙananan halittu suna samar da iska a ciki, kuma yana iya zama ƙwayar cuta mai haɗari kamar botulinum. Kada ka buɗe gwangwanin da ya kumbura, jefar da shi.
c-138.principle: Iskar fermentation ta ƙananan halittu: Martanin kamar $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6 \to 2C_2H_5OH + 2CO_2}$ yana samar da $\mathrm{CO_2}$ wanda ke ƙara matsin ciki.
c-138.example: Gwangwanin abinci na al'ada yana da kusan vacuum a ciki, don haka murfi yana lebur ko ɗan nitse. Idan ya kumbura ko akwai ƙarfi sosai idan an buɗe shi ko kumfa, kada ka ci.
c-138.actionItem: A yau, ɗauki gwangwanin da ke gida ka duba ko akwai wanda ya kumbura ko ya yi tsatsa.

c-139.title: Mai a bututun ruwan wankin kwano yana taurara idan ya yi sanyi yana toshewa
c-139.summary: Mai mai zafi ruwa ne, amma idan ya yi sanyi, saturated fat yana taurara, yana manne a bangon bututu kuma yana cakudewa da tarkace. Kada ka zubar da mai a magudanar ruwa; goge shi da takarda ka jefa a sharar gari.
c-139.principle: Wurin narkewar saturated fat kusan 30 zuwa 60℃ ne, kuma idan man girki ya yi sanyi yana yin canjin yanayi $\mathrm{liquid \to solid}$. Idan ya haɗu da ions na calcium, yana kuma yin gishirin calcium na fatty acid (tarkacen sabulu).
c-139.example: Idan ka zuba 200 mL na man soya a magudanar ruwa, yana taurara a bangon bututu da kauri 1 zuwa 2 mm, kuma bayan maimaitawa kaɗan yana iya toshewa. Kafin wanke kwano, fara goge kwano mai mai da takardar kitchen.
c-139.actionItem: A yau, goge kasko mai mai da takardar kitchen da farko kafin wankewa.

c-140.title: Ruwan PET a cikin mota a bazara, za a iya sha?
c-140.summary: PET da aka bar shi a mota mai zafi na dogon lokaci na iya fitar da ƙarin ƙananan abubuwa kamar antimony. Haɗarin yana ƙasa na kwana ɗaya ko biyu, amma gara a guji ruwan da aka bar na tsawon lokaci.
c-140.principle: Fitarwa yana ƙaruwa da zafi: $k = A\,e^{-E_a/RT}$ (ma'aunin Arrhenius, idan $T$ ya ƙaru, $k$ yana ƙaruwa)
c-140.example: A tsakiyar bazara zafin cikin mota na iya kaiwa 60 zuwa 70 °C, kuma saurin fitarwa yana ninkawa sau da yawa idan aka kwatanta da 20 °C.
c-140.actionItem: A yau, kada ka sha ruwan PET da ya rage a mota, kuma don tafiye-tafiye, yi amfani da kwalbar bakin karfe.

c-141.title: Fa'idodin refrigerant R-32 na na'urar sanyaya iska
c-141.summary: R-32 yana buƙatar ƙarancin refrigerant fiye da R-410A don ƙarfin sanyaya iri ɗaya, kuma GWP ɗinsa kusan kashi ɗaya cikin uku ne. Abu ne da ya dace a bincika yayin zaɓar sabuwar na'urar sanyaya iska.
c-141.principle: R-32: $\mathrm{CH_2F_2}$. Idan zafin ƙafewa $q = h_{\mathrm{g}} - h_{\mathrm{f}}$ ya yi girma, adadin zagayowar refrigerant yana raguwa.
c-141.example: GWP na R-410A kusan 2088 ne, na R-32 kusan 675. Adadin refrigerant da ake cikawa kuma yana raguwa da kusan kashi 20 zuwa 30, don haka inganci yana ƙaruwa kaɗan.
c-141.actionItem: Lokacin siya ko duba na'urar sanyaya iska, bincika nau'in refrigerant (R-32 ko R-410A) a lakabin samfur.

c-142.title: Dalilin da abin sha mai gas yake rasa fizz
c-142.summary: Carbon dioxide yana narkewa da kyau a matsi da ƙarancin zafi, kuma yana fita idan ya ɗumama ko matsin ya sake. Ajiye shi sanyi kuma rufe murfi nan take don fizz ya daɗe.
c-142.principle: Dokar Henry: $C = k_{\mathrm{H}}\,P_{\mathrm{CO_2}}$, kuma $k_{\mathrm{H}}$ yana raguwa idan zafi ya ƙaru.
c-142.example: Matsin ciki a kwalba kusan yanayi 3 zuwa 4 ne, kuma a 25 °C narkewar $\mathrm{CO_2}$ tana sauka zuwa kusan rabin abin da take a 4 °C.
c-142.actionItem: A yau, rufe murfin abin sha mai gas nan da nan bayan sha ka ajiye shi a tsaye a firiji.

c-143.title: Baking soda don cire wari a firiji
c-143.summary: Baking soda yana da alkali mai rauni, don haka yana neutralize abubuwan wari masu acid na firiji (misali fatty acids). Amma ƙarfinsa na adsorption ƙarami ne kuma dole a canza shi kowane watanni 2 zuwa 3.
c-143.example: Kimanin 100 g (rabin kofi) na baking soda a cikin kwantena ɗaya ya isa ya rage raunin wari na ƙaramin firiji.
c-143.actionItem: Sanya kofi ɗaya na baking soda a ƙaramin faranti a shelf na firiji, rubuta kwanan wata ka canza bayan watanni 3.

c-144.title: Dankalin turawa yana da daɗi sosai idan aka gasa a hankali a 70 zuwa 75 ℃
c-144.summary: Enzyme beta-amylase na dankalin yana rushe starch zuwa maltose mai daɗi, kuma yana aiki sosai a kusan 70 zuwa 75 ℃ kuma yana tsayawa sama da 90 ℃. Idan ka gasa a hankali, lokacin daɗi yana tsawaita.
c-144.principle: $\mathrm{(C_6H_{10}O_5)_n + n/2\,H_2O \xrightarrow{\beta\text{-amylase}} n/2\,C_{12}H_{22}O_{11}}$. Enzyme yana da zafin aiki mafi kyau.
c-144.example: Idan ka gasa a tanda 180 ℃ na minti 5 kawai, maltose yana samuwa da ƙaranci fiye da gasa a ƙasa da 150 ℃ na fiye da minti 50, domin zafin cikin dankali yana zama a kewayon 70 zuwa 75 ℃ na dogon lokaci. Shi yasa gasasshen dankali yake da daɗi.
c-144.actionItem: A yau, idan ka gasa dankali, yi shi a ƙaramin zafi na dogon lokaci a hankali.

c-145.title: Ƙwai yana zama rabin dafaffe a 62 zuwa 65 ℃ saboda denaturation na protein
c-145.summary: Proteins na farin ƙwai da gwaiduwa suna taurara a zafin daban-daban. Farin yana taurara daga kusan 62 zuwa 65 ℃ kuma gwaiduwa a kusan 65 zuwa 70 ℃, wanda ke ƙayyade rabin dafaffe ko cikakken dafaffe.
c-145.principle: Denaturation na zafi yana buɗe tsarin mataki na uku na protein kuma yana sa su manne. Ovotransferrin yana denature a kusan 62 ℃ kuma ovalbumin a kusan 80 ℃.
c-145.example: Idan ka tafasa a ruwan zafi na minti 6, farin yana taurara kuma gwaiduwa tana kusa da ruwa (rabin dafaffe), kuma idan ya wuce minti 10 yana zama cikakke. Saboda haɗarin salmonella, tsofaffi da mata masu ciki su ci cikakken dafaffe.
c-145.actionItem: A yau, saita mai ƙidayar lokaci zuwa minti 6 da minti 10 yayin tafasa ƙwai don ganin bambanci.

c-146.title: Bitamin masu narkewa a ruwa suna fita da fitsari ko da an sha da yawa
c-146.summary: Bitamin C da B suna narkewa a ruwa, kuma abin da ya wuce buƙata ba ya taruwa a jiki, sai dai ya fita da fitsari. Yawancin ragowar manyan kari na iya zama ɓarna.
c-146.principle: Kwayoyin da ke narkewa a ruwa suna da polar kuma suna narkewa da kyau a jini da fitsari, kuma koda tana tace su. Bitamin masu narkewa a mai kuwa suna taruwa a kitse.
c-146.example: Shawarar bitamin C na kullum ga babba kusan 100 mg ne, kuma idan ka sha 1000 mg a lokaci ɗaya, shan yana sauka ƙasa da kashi 50 kuma yawancin sauran yana fita. Ɗaya daga 'ya'yan itace ya isa ya cika kusan 50 mg.
c-146.actionItem: A yau, idan ka sha kari na bitamin, bincika cewa jimillarsa da abin da kake samu daga abinci bai wuce shawarar ba.

c-147.title: Gishirin teku da gishirin da aka tace sun bambanta a rabon sodium chloride da ma'adinai
c-147.summary: Gishirin da aka tace yana da sodium chloride (NaCl) fiye da kashi 99, kuma gishirin teku kusan kashi 80 zuwa 90 tare da magnesium, calcium da danshi. A kowanne, gishiri da sodium iri ɗaya ne kusan, don haka cin ƙarancinsa shine muhimmi.
c-147.principle: Rabon sodium shine $\dfrac{M_{\mathrm{Na}}}{M_{\mathrm{NaCl}}} = \dfrac{23}{58.5} \approx 0.39$. Idan adadin gishiri ɗaya ne, mafi girman rabon NaCl, ƙarin sodium.
c-147.example: 5 g na tsantsar NaCl na ɗauke da kusan 1.97 g na sodium, kuma gishirin teku idan NaCl kashi 85 ne kusan 1.67 g. WHO tana ba da shawarar gishiri ƙasa da 5 g a rana.
c-147.actionItem: A yau, bincika abin da ke cikin sodium (mg/100 g) a tebur ɗin abinci mai gina jiki na gishirin gidanka.

c-148.title: Gilashin ido da ke canza launi da haske
c-148.summary: Gilashin photochromic: halide na azurfa a cikinsa yana rabuwa zuwa ƙwayoyin azurfa idan ya sami UV kuma ya yi duhu, kuma idan haske ya ɓace yana komawa. A mota, UV gilashi yana toshewa, don haka yana duhu ƙasa.
c-148.example: Gilashin photochromic a rana yana saukar da wucewar haske daga kusan kashi 85 zuwa kashi 20 cikin minti ɗaya, kuma komawa a cikin gida yana ɗaukar minti 5 zuwa 15.
c-148.actionItem: Lokacin tuƙi a rana mai ƙarfi, ɗauki gilashin rana na yau da kullum masu toshe UV daban da gilashin photochromic.

c-149.title: Motar lantarki tana ɓata ƙarancin makamashi fiye da motar fetur
c-149.summary: Injin fetur yana mayar da kusan kashi 20 zuwa 30 na makamashin mai kawai zuwa motsin ƙafafu kuma sauran yana ɓaci a matsayin zafi. Motar lantarki tana mayar da kusan kashi 80 zuwa 90 na makamashin lantarki zuwa ƙafafu, don haka tafiya iri ɗaya tana buƙatar ƙarancin makamashi.
c-149.principle: Lita 1 na fetur tana da kusan $32\ \mathrm{MJ}$ ($\approx 8.9\ \mathrm{kWh}$), kuma idan inganci $\eta = \dfrac{W_{\text{out}}}{E_{\text{in}}}$ kusan kashi 25 ne, aikin amfani shine kusan 2.2 kWh.
c-149.example: Motar fasinja da ke tafiya kusan 12 km da lita 1 na fetur tana tafiya 12 km da 2.2 kWh, kuma motar lantarki tana buƙatar kusan 2 kWh a 12 km (inganci kusan 6 km/kWh). Idan an ƙidaya asarar matakin samar da wuta, bambanci yana raguwa.
c-149.actionItem: A yau, yi tafiyar ƙasa ko amfani da sufurin jama'a don gajerun tafiye-tafiye don ceton mai.

c-150.title: Wurin hayaki na man girki da man soya
c-150.summary: Idan mai ya wuce wurin hayakinsa, yana fitar da hayaki da acrolein waɗanda ke ƙona ido da maƙogwaro. Don girki a wuta mai ƙarfi, mai mai babban wurin hayaki shine mafi aminci.
c-150.example: Wurin hayaki na man zaitun (extra virgin) kusan 190 °C ne, na man canola kusan 240 °C, na man sunflower da aka tace kusan 230 °C.
c-150.actionItem: Don soya da gasa, zaɓi man da aka tace mai babban wurin hayaki, kuma idan hayaki ya fito, rage wuta nan take ka buɗe taga.

c-151.title: Dalilin da ice tea yake yin gajimare
c-151.summary: Idan baƙin shayi mai ƙarfi ya yi sanyi, caffeine da tannin suna haɗuwa su zama ƙwayoyi kuma shayi yana gajimare. Ƙara ruwan zafi yana mayar da shi mai haske, kuma sanyi-jiƙa yana rage gajimare.
c-151.principle: Caffeine + tannin (theaflavin) $\rightleftharpoons$ complex: idan zafi ya ragu, narkewa yana raguwa kuma yana yin hazo.
c-151.example: Idan baƙin shayi da aka tafasa a 100 °C ya yi sanyi zuwa 4 °C, yana yin gajimare cikin mintuna kaɗan, amma sanyi-jiƙa (4 °C, awanni 8) yana ƙarancin gajimare sosai.
c-151.actionItem: A yau, jiƙa jakar shayi a 500 mL na ruwan sanyi a firiji na awanni 8.

c-152.title: Amygdalin na iri na ume yana da haɗari idan an ci shi ɗanye
c-152.summary: Ume mara nuna da iri suna da amygdalin wanda idan ya rushe zai iya fitar da hydrogen cyanide. Ka yi maganin ume ba tare da iri ba ko ka bar shi ya nuna fiye da watanni 6 kafin ka tace, kuma kada ka ci iri.
c-152.principle: $\mathrm{C_{20}H_{27}NO_{11} + 2H_2O \xrightarrow{\text{enzyme}} C_6H_5CHO + HCN + 2C_6H_{12}O_6}$. Idan ya haɗu da enzyme, hydrogen cyanide yana samuwa.
c-152.example: Amygdalin na iri ɗaya na ume ƙanƙanta ne sosai, amma idan an tauna da yawa ɗanye, yana iya zama haɗari. Ume kore mara nuna ya kamata a cire iri a jiƙa da sukari 1:1 na watanni 6 kafin a cire naman.
c-152.actionItem: A yau, idan ka yi maganin ume, kada ka ci iri ka rubuta a kalanda lokacin cire 'ya'yan.

c-153.title: Gwangwanin feshi na iya fashewa idan aka bar shi a wuri mai zafi
c-153.summary: A cikin gwangwanin aerosol akwai iska mai matsawa da propellant mai ƙonewa, don haka matsi yana ƙaruwa idan zafi ya ƙaru. A mota a bazara ko kusa da wuta yana iya fashewa, don haka dole a bi umarnin lakabi na ajiyewa ƙasa da 50 ℃.
c-153.principle: Matsin gas yana daidaita da zafi: $\dfrac{P_1}{T_1} = \dfrac{P_2}{T_2}$ ($T$ a Kelvin). Matsin tururin propellant da aka ruwaito yana ƙaruwa da sauri tare da zafi.
c-153.example: Idan gwangwani a 20 ℃ (293 K) yana da yanayi 5 kuma ya yi zafi zuwa 60 ℃ (333 K), a ƙididdiga mai sauƙi matsi yana kusan yanayi 5.7, kuma idan aka ƙara matsin tururin propellant, ya fi haka sosai. A tsakiyar bazara cikin mota na iya wuce 60 ℃.
c-153.actionItem: A yau, tara samfuran feshi na gidanka ka mayar da su wuri mai sanyi inda zafi ba zai taɓa su ba.

c-154.title: Dalilin da jelly ba ya taurara idan an saka abarba ko kiwi
c-154.summary: Enzymes na rushe protein a abarba da kiwi sabo suna yanyanka gelatin. Idan an dumama sau ɗaya ko an yi amfani da gwangwani, enzymes sun tsaya kuma jelly yana taurara.
c-154.principle: Bromelain da actinidin suna hydrolyze peptide bonds: $\mathrm{R{-}CO{-}NH{-}R' + H_2O \to R{-}COOH + H_2N{-}R'}$. Enzymes suna denature sama da kusan $70\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
c-154.example: 100 mL na gelatin mai abarba sabo ba ya taurara ko bayan awanni, amma abarba da aka dumama sama da 80 ℃ na minti ɗaya ko na gwangwani yana taurara kamar yadda ya kamata. Ana amfani da enzyme iri ɗaya wajen laushin nama.
c-154.actionItem: A yau, idan ka saka 'ya'yan itace sabo a jelly ko pudding, fara tafasa abarba da kiwi a ruwan zafi na minti ɗaya.

c-155.title: Warin danshi daga tawul mai bushewa
c-155.summary: Warin wanki da bai bushe sosai ba yana fitowa daga fatty acids kamar 4-methyl-3-hexenoic acid da ƙwayoyin Moraxella ke samarwa. Mabuɗin shine a bushar da wanki da sauri kafin ƙwayoyin su yawaita.
c-155.principle: Metabolism na ƙwayoyin cuta: lipids na fata $\rightarrow$ fatty acids masu ƙafewa kamar $\mathrm{C_7H_{12}O_2}$ (4-methyl-3-hexenoic acid)
c-155.example: Idan jikakken wanki bai bushe cikin awanni 5 a gida ba, wari yana farawa, kuma na'urar bushewa sama da 60 °C tana rage ƙwayoyin cuta sosai.
c-155.actionItem: Shanya wanki nan da nan bayan wankewa kuma kunna fanka ko mai busar da danshi don bushewa cikin awanni 5.

c-156.title: Menene ruwan hoda a banɗaki
c-156.summary: Ruwan hoda mai ɗaukar jiki ba mold ba ne, fim ɗin launi ja ne da ƙwayoyin cuta kamar Serratia ke yi. Danshi da tarkacen sabulu abincinsu ne, don haka bushewa shine mafi kyawun rigakafi.
c-156.principle: Yawaitar ƙwayoyin cuta $N = N_0\,2^{t/t_d}$ (idan lokacin rabuwa $t_d$ kusan minti 30 ne, yana ƙaruwa sau ɗaruruwan dubbai a rana)
c-156.example: A banɗaki mai ɗanshi 25 zuwa 35 °C, yawan ƙwayoyin cuta yana ƙaruwa kusan sau 4,000 a kowane awa 6. Idan ya bushe, yawaita yana tsayawa.
c-156.actionItem: Bayan wanka, tura ruwa daga bango da ƙasa da squeegee kuma kunna fanka na iska na minti 30.

c-157.title: Yadda ake adana kankana da aka yanka
c-157.summary: Daga saman yankan kankana, ruwa da sukari suna fita kuma ƙwayoyin cuta suna yawaita. Rufe sashin da aka yanka da robar abinci, ka adana a firiji ka ci cikin kwana biyu don aminci.
c-157.principle: Ƙafewa yana daidaita da yankin da aka buɗe da zafi. A 4 °C saurin yawaitar ƙwayoyin cuta yana raguwa zuwa kusan 1/20 na na 25 °C.
c-157.example: A zafin ɗaki (30 °C) kankana da aka yanka yana samun ƙwayoyin cuta sau dubun cikin awanni 2, kuma a firiji (4 °C) yana da aminci kusan kwana 2.
c-157.actionItem: Ajiye ragowar kankana a manyan guda da bawonsa kuma danna robar abinci sosai a kan yankin da aka yanka, ka sanya a firiji.

c-158.title: Abincin makaranta na bazara yana da aminci da shinkafa mai vinegar da abinci mai sanyi
c-158.summary: A yanayi mai acid (pH ƙasa da 4.6), yawancin ƙwayoyin guba abinci ba sa girma. Ƙara babban cokali na vinegar a shinkafar akwatin abinci ko sanyaya abinci kafin saka shi yana sa ya fi aminci na dogon lokaci.
c-158.principle: Daidaiton rarrabuwar rauni acid $\mathrm{CH_3COOH \rightleftharpoons CH_3COO^- + H^+}$ yana ƙara $[\mathrm{H^+}]$, kuma idan pH ya sauka, saurin girman ƙwayoyin cuta yana raguwa.
c-158.example: Idan ka saka babban cokali 1 (15 mL) na vinegar a kofuna 2 na shinkafa (kusan 300 g), pH na shinkafa yana sauka zuwa kusan 5 kuma yawaitar ƙwayoyin cuta yana jinkiri. Rufe akwatin abinci bayan ya yi sanyi gaba ɗaya kuma ka saka ice pack.
c-158.actionItem: A yau, bar shinkafar akwatin abinci ta yi sanyi sosai kafin ka rufe ka saka ice pack.

c-159.title: Dalilin da kayan aiki suke tsatsa a ranar danshi
c-159.summary: Ƙarfe yana yin iron oxide (tsatsa) tare da ruwa da oxygen, kuma yana ƙaruwa idan danshi ya wuce kashi 60. Layin mai ko desiccant yana jinkirta tsatsa.
c-159.example: Idan danshi kwatance ya wuce kashi 60, saman ƙarfe tsirara yana tsatsa cikin kwanaki, kuma a ƙasa da kashi 40 kusan ba ya ci gaba.
c-159.actionItem: Goge kayan aiki da kyalle mai man ɗinki sirara kuma sa silica gel a akwatin kayan aiki.

c-160.title: Taka tsantsan lokacin amfani da mothballs (naphthalene) a kabad
c-160.summary: Mothball yana canzawa daga daskararre zuwa gas kai tsaye (sublimation) don korar kwari. Tururin yana cutar da hanyar numfashi, don haka ana buƙatar iska da nisa.
c-160.principle: Sublimation: $\mathrm{C_{10}H_8(s) \rightarrow C_{10}H_8(g)}$, matsin tururi yana ƙaruwa idan zafi ya ƙaru.
c-160.example: Matsin tururin naphthalene a 25 °C kusan 11 Pa ne, kuma a 40 °C yana ƙaruwa kusan sau huɗu. Kada ka bar shi ya taɓa tufafi kai tsaye.
c-160.actionItem: Kafin ka saka tufafin da aka yi amfani da mothball a ciki, bar su su sha iska a baranda na awanni 2 zuwa 3, kuma ka ajiye mothballs nesa da yara.

c-161.title: Wari na tafarnuwa da kifi yana raguwa idan aka goga hannu da bakin karfe
c-161.summary: An san cewa warin sulfur compounds na tafarnuwa da albasa yana raguwa idan aka goga hannu da bakin karfe. Wanke da sabulu yana wanke sulfur compounds da suka rage.
c-161.principle: Sulfur compounds $\mathrm{R{-}SH}$ suna adsorb a fim ɗin oxide na saman ƙarfe ($\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$), wanda ke rage ƙafewarsu.
c-161.example: Mutane da yawa sun ce bayan yanka tafarnuwa, goge hannu da famfon bakin karfe na daƙiƙa 30 yana rage wari, amma shaidar kimiyya game da girman tasiri ba ta da yawa. Ana iya amfani da ruwan lemun tsami da vinegar tare.
c-161.actionItem: A yau, bayan yanka tafarnuwa, goge hannu da kwanon bakin karfe na daƙiƙa 30 sannan ka wanke da sabulu.

c-162.title: Dalilin da burodi yake mold da sauri a damina
c-162.summary: Burodi yana da yawan ayyukan ruwa kuma a danshi sama da kashi 70 mold yana girma da sauri. Zaren mold yana shiga cikin burodi, don haka yanke sashin da ake gani kawai yana da haɗari.
c-162.principle: Ayyukan ruwa $a_w = \dfrac{p}{p_0}$ (burodi kusan 0.95, mold yana girma daga kusan 0.80 sama)
c-162.example: A ranar danshi, burodi a 25 °C yana mold cikin kwanaki 3 zuwa 4, kuma idan aka daskarar (−18 °C) yana adanuwa na makonni da dama.
c-162.actionItem: A yau, naɗe burodin da ba za ka ci ba yanka ɗaya-ɗaya da robar abinci ka daskarar, kuma lokacin ci, gasa da toaster.

c-163.title: Dalilin da ruwan sama yake da ɗan acid
c-163.summary: Ruwan sama yana da ɗan acid saboda carbon dioxide na iska ya narke a ciki, pH kusan 5.6, kuma ruwan sama mai acid yana ƙasa da pH 5.6. Wannan bai cutar da fata ba amma karafa da dutse suna lalacewa a hankali.
c-163.example: Idan $[\mathrm{H^+}] \approx 2.5\times10^{-6}\,\mathrm{mol/L}$, pH $= -\log[\mathrm{H^+}] \approx 5.6$. Tsantsar ruwa pH 7 ne.
c-163.actionItem: Bayan ruwan sama, goge ruwa daga sarƙar kekenka kuma shafa digo na mai.

c-164.title: Shinkafar da ta yi sanyi tana da ƙarin resistant starch kuma ƙarancin sukari mai sha
c-164.summary: Idan shinkafa ta yi sanyi, wani ɓangare na starch yana zama resistant starch mai wuyar narkewa. Ko da an sake dumama bayan firiji, wani ɓangare na resistant starch yana tsirowa kuma hawan sukarin jini na iya zama ɗan sauƙi.
c-164.principle: Retrogradation na starch wani al'amari ne da amylose da aka gelatinize ke sake yin tsarin crystal idan ya yi sanyi. Enzyme na narkewa amylase ba ya rushe wannan crystal da kyau.
c-164.example: An san cewa shinkafar da aka dumama bayan awanni 12 zuwa 24 a firiji tana da resistant starch sau da dama fiye da sabuwar dafaffa, amma ƙarin shi ne kaɗan kashi na jimillar starch. Kada ka bar shinkafa a zafin ɗaki; sanya ta a firiji da sauri.
c-164.actionItem: A yau, sanya shinkafar da ta rage a firiji cikin awa ɗaya.

c-165.title: Tasirin softener na wanki a kan tawul
c-165.summary: Fabric softener yana rufe zaren yadi da cationic surfactant don ya yi laushi, amma yana rage shan ruwa. Ga tawul, gara a rage yawan amfani ko a yi amfani da vinegar.
c-165.principle: Cationic surfactant $\mathrm{R_2N^+(CH_3)_2}$ yana adsorb a zaren da ke da caji mara kyau $\mathrm{{-}COO^-}$ ya yi fim mai ƙin ruwa.
c-165.example: Tawul da aka yi amfani da softener a kai na iya rasa kusan kashi 20 zuwa 30 na shan ruwa. Idan ka wanke tawul 10, yi amfani da softener sau ɗaya cikin uku.
c-165.actionItem: A yau, wanke tawul ɗinka ba tare da softener ba kuma ka girgiza su da kyau kafin ka bushar.

c-166.title: Sake sarrafa gwangwanin aluminium yana buƙatar kusan kashi 5 na makamashin sabon samarwa
c-166.summary: Samar da aluminium daga ma'adinai yana cin wutar lantarki mai yawa, amma sake sarrafawa ta narkarwa yana ceton kusan kashi 95. Wanke gwangwani da ware shi yana ƙara tasiri.
c-166.principle: Electrolysis na bauxite: $\mathrm{2Al_2O_3 \to 4Al + 3O_2}$. Sabon aluminium yana buƙatar kusan $14\ \mathrm{kWh}$ a kowace kg kuma aluminium da aka sake sarrafawa kusan $0.7\ \mathrm{kWh}$.
c-166.example: Sake sarrafa gwangwanin aluminium ɗaya (kusan 14 g) yana ceton kusan 0.2 kWh. Gwangwani 100 kusan 20 kWh ne, kusan daidai da wutar da na'urar sanyaya iska ke cinyewa na awanni 5.
c-166.actionItem: A yau, ɓata gwangwanin da ka sha, wanke shi ka sa shi a kwandon aluminium.

c-167.title: Abincin da ya yi mold ba shi da aminci ko da an yanke sashin da ake gani
