c-260.title: Dalilin da bai kamata a ƙona ganyen kaka da shara ba
c-260.summary: Idan aka ƙona ganye da shara a waje, ƙonewa ba ya cika kuma ana fitar da ƙurar ƙura da abubuwa masu cutarwa da yawa, kuma ƙona leda ko PVC yana samar da dioxin.
c-260.principle: Ƙona a waje inda oxygen ya yi ƙaranci yana ba da ƙonewa ba tare da cikawa ba da ke samar da PAH da carbon monoxide. $2\mathrm{C} + \mathrm{O_2} \to 2\mathrm{CO}$ PVC $(\mathrm{C_2H_3Cl})_n$ idan ya ƙone zai iya samar da hydrogen chloride da dioxins.
c-260.example: PVC yana da kusan 57 % chlorine ta taro, don haka 1 kg yana ɗauke da kusan 570 g na chlorine. Ƙona ragowar noma a waje na iya fitar da kusan 5~15 g na ƙurar ƙura a kowace 1 kg.
c-260.actionItem: Yau kada ka ƙona ganyen kaka, tara su ka yi takin zamani ko ka zubar bisa tsarin tarawa na gundumarka.

c-261.title: Farin foda na humidifier ma'adinan ruwan famfo ne
c-261.summary: Farin foda da ke taruwa kusa da ultrasonic humidifier ma'adinai ne kamar calcium da magnesium da ke narke a ruwan famfo.
c-261.principle: Ultrasonic humidifier yana watsa ruwa a matsayin ƙananan ɗigo ba tare da tafasa ba, don haka gishirin da ke narke a ruwa yana zama barbashi masu tsayayye idan ɗigon ya bushe. Tafasa yana sa wasu abubuwan taurin su nutse. $\mathrm{Ca(HCO_3)_2 \to CaCO_3 + CO_2 + H_2O}$
c-261.example: Idan ma'adinai na ruwan famfo kusan 80 mg/L ne kuma aka fesa 2.4 L cikin dare 8 hours, kusan 190 mg na barbashi na iya yaɗuwa a iska. Waɗannan barbashi suna da ƙanƙanta sosai har suna iya kaiwa hanyar numfashi.
c-261.actionItem: Yau, wofintar da tankin humidifier kowace rana ka wanke ka sake cika, kuma idan zai yiwu yi amfani da distilled water ko humidifier mai dumama ko evaporative.

c-262.title: Dalilin da tsofaffin littattafai ke zama rawaya
c-262.summary: Tsofaffin littattafai suna zama rawaya suna kuma ɓarkewa saboda sinadaran acidic da lignin a cikin takardar suna oxidize kuma suna ruɓewa.
c-262.principle: Lignin na takarda mai acid yana oxidize da haske da oxygen ya zama rawaya, kuma acid yana hydrolyze cellulose yana raunana takarda. $(\mathrm{C_6H_{10}O_5})_n + n\mathrm{H_2O} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{H^+}} n\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}$
c-262.example: Takarda mai yawan lignin kamar jarida (lignin kusan 25 %) tana zama rawaya cikin ƴan watanni, amma littafin neutral paper wanda ba ya da acid na iya daɗe ɗaruruwan shekaru. Yayin da danshi da zafi suka ƙaru, amsawar tana ƙaruwa.
c-262.actionItem: Yau ajiye littattafai masu daraja a kan shelf mai sanyi da bushe ba tare da hasken rana kai tsaye ba, kuma kada ka saka yankin jarida tsakanin littattafai.

c-263.title: Baƙar ruɓewar ƙasan tumatir saboda ƙarancin calcium ne
c-263.summary: Ruɓewar baƙi a ƙasan 'ya'yan tumatir (blossom end rot) ba kawai saboda ƙarancin calcium a ƙasa ba ne, calcium ba ya kai 'ya'yan itacen ne.
c-263.principle: Calcium ions suna motsi tare da kwararar ruwan da transpiration ke haifarwa, kuma ƙarshen 'ya'yan itacen da ƙarancin transpiration yana karɓa a ƙarshe. Idan saurin kwarara ya yi jinkiri, kayan da ake kaiwa suna raguwa. $J = C \times \dot{V}$ ($C$: ƙarfin calcium, $\dot{V}$: kwararar ruwa)
c-263.example: Idan ana shayarwa ba daidai ba, motsin calcium yana katsewa kuma alamun suna fitowa, kuma ana ba da shawarar a ba da ruwa daidai gwargwado na kusan 25 mm (2.5 cm) a mako. Gudanar da ruwa ya fi tasiri fiye da zuba calcium mai yawa a ƙasa.
c-263.actionItem: Yau, maimakon shayar da tumatir sau ɗaya bayan kwanaki da yawa, shayar da su a lokuta daidai kafin ƙasa ta bushe kuma ka rufe da mulch.

c-264.title: Toka na gawayi taki ne na potassium kyauta na gona, amma a kula
c-264.summary: Tokar itacen da aka ƙona taki ne na alkaline da ke ba da potassium da calcium, amma yana cutar da amfanin gona masu son acid, kuma kada a yi amfani da tokar gawayi mai ƙari ko itacen da aka fenti.
c-264.principle: $\mathrm{K_2CO_3}$ na toka yana narkewa a ruwa yana sakin potassium ions da hydroxide ions yana ɗaga pH na ƙasa. $\mathrm{K_2CO_3 + H_2O \rightleftharpoons 2K^+ + HCO_3^- + OH^-}$
c-264.example: pH na tokar itace 10~13 ne kuma yana ɗauke da kusan 3~10 % potassium (K₂O). Adadin da aka ba da shawara kusan 100 g (dunƙule ɗaya ko biyu) ko ƙasa da haka a kowace m² a shekara, kuma kada ka yi amfani da shi a blueberry ko dankali.
c-264.actionItem: Yau idan kana da tokar itace tsantsa wadda ta huce gaba ɗaya, tace ta da sieve, auna pH na ƙasa, ka watsa ta a hankali a gonar neutral zuwa alkaline kawai.

c-265.title: Idan taki ya yi wari, ƙara carbon
c-265.summary: Idan takin zamani yana wari kamar ammonia ko ruɓaɓɓe, nitrogen ya yi yawa, don haka gauraya kayan carbon kamar busassun ganye.
c-265.principle: Don ƙananan halittu su yi aiki da kyau, rabon carbon da nitrogen ya zama kusan 30:1. $\mathrm{C/N} = \frac{m_C}{m_N} \approx 30$ Idan nitrogen ya yi yawa, $\mathrm{NH_4^+ + OH^- \to NH_3 + H_2O}$ yana ba da ƙamshin ammonia.
c-265.example: C/N na ragowar abinci kusan 15~20 ne, busasshen ganye 50~80, da sawdust kusan 400. Idan ka gauraya ragowar abinci 1 da kayan ruwan kasa kamar busassun ganye 2~3 bisa girma, wari yana raguwa sosai.
c-265.actionItem: Yau idan akwatin takinka yana wari, saka jaka ɗaya ta busassun ganye ko yagaggen kwalin takarda ka gauraya sosai ka shigar da iska.

c-266.title: Wake kidney bean da ba a dafa sosai ba yana da guba ta lectin
c-266.summary: Kidney beans ɗanye ko waɗanda aka dafa kawai a kusan 80℃ na iya haddasa amai da gudawa saboda lectin, don haka dole a dafa su sosai har su tafasa.
c-266.principle: Lectin na kidney bean (phaseolus agglutinin) protein ne kuma sai an ɗumama shi sosai a 100℃ ne yake denaturing. $\text{lectin mai aiki} \xrightarrow{100^\circ\mathrm{C},\ \ge 10\ \text{mintuna}} \text{lectin da aka denature}$ A kusan 80℃ gubar na iya ƙaruwa sau da yawa.
c-266.example: Ko wake jan kidney 4~5 kawai ɗanye na iya haddasa tashin zuciya da amai cikin sa'o'i 1~3, kuma an samu rahoton cewa dafa shi a ƙaramin zafi 80℃ na iya ƙara guba sau kusan 5 fiye da ɗanyen wake. Waken gwangwani an riga an dafa shi.
c-266.actionItem: Yau idan za ka yi amfani da busasshen kidney beans, jiƙa su fiye da sa'o'i 5 ka zubar da ruwan, ka tafasa sosai aƙalla mintuna 10 sannan ka dafa a ƙaramar wuta.

c-267.title: Kada ka matse murfin kwalbar maesil-cheong
c-267.summary: Maesil-cheong yana samar da carbon dioxide ta yisti fermentation, don haka idan ka matse kwalbar da ƙarfi, matsin lamba yana taruwa kuma zai iya fashewa.
c-267.principle: Yisti yana ruɓar sukari ya samar da alcohol da carbon dioxide. $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6 \to 2\,C_2H_5OH + 2\,CO_2}$
c-267.example: Ko da glucose 10 g (kusan 0.056 mol) kawai ya yi fermentation, ana samun kusan 2.7 L na CO2, kuma a cikin kwalba 3 L matsin lamba na iya hauhawa da sauri. Yana faruwa da sauƙi idan sukari bai narke ba ko zafin yanayi ya yi yawa.
c-267.actionItem: Yau, kwalbar maesil-cheong ka rufe ta a sako-sako ko ka rufe da zanen auduga, kuma idan kumfa ya hau, buɗe murfin sau ɗaya a rana don fitar da gas.

c-268.title: Dalilin da tabon curry ke yin ja idan aka wanke da sabulu
c-268.summary: Launin rawaya na curry (curcumin) yana canzawa zuwa ja a alkali, don haka idan ka goge da sabulu mai alkali, tabon yana ƙara ja da duhu.
c-268.principle: Curcumin pH indicator ne wanda yake rawaya a acid da neutral kuma ja-ruwan kasa a pH kusan 8.6 ko fiye. $\mathrm{HCur \rightleftharpoons H^+ + Cur^-}$ (rawaya ⇌ ja)
c-268.example: Maganin sabulun tsayayye yana da pH 9~10 wanda ya wuce wannan kewayen canjin launi. Idan ka yi amfani da mai tsaftace tasa na neutral (pH kusan 7), launin ba ya canzawa, kuma idan ka busar a rana, curcumin yana photodecompose kuma ya dushe.
c-268.actionItem: Yau idan tabon curry ya samu, wanke shi da ruwan sanyi ka buga da mai tsaftace tasa na neutral, kuma kada ka goge da sabulu, ka busar a rana.

c-269.title: Dalilin da gwaiduwar kwai da aka dafa ke koma koren launi
c-269.summary: Koren gefen gwaiduwar kwai da aka daɗe ana dafawa wani sinadari ne marar illa da ake kira iron sulfide, kuma ana iya hana shi ta hanyar rage lokacin dafawa.
c-269.principle: Hydrogen sulfide da ke fitowa daga amino acids masu sulfur na farin kwai yana haɗuwa da iron na gwaiduwa ya samar da iron sulfide. $\mathrm{Fe^{2+} + H_2S \to FeS + 2H^+}$
c-269.example: Babban kwai yana dafuwa gaba ɗaya cikin kusan mintuna 10~12 bayan ya fara tafasa kuma idan an dafa fiye da mintuna 15 koren gefen yana samuwa cikin sauƙi. Idan ka jiƙa shi a ruwan sanyi na mintuna 5 nan take bayan dafawa, amsawar tana tsayawa.
c-269.actionItem: Yau idan za ka dafa kwai, dafa shi mintuna 10~12 kawai bayan ya tafasa ka jiƙa a ruwan sanyi na mintuna 5 nan take.

c-270.title: Idan ka haɗiye button battery, ƙonewa cikin sa'o'i 2
c-270.summary: Idan ka haɗiye batirin button mai siffar tsabar kuɗi, ƙonewa mai tsanani na iya faruwa a hanjin abinci cikin sa'o'i 2, don haka ko da babu alamomi je ɗakin gaggawa nan take.
c-270.principle: Idan batir ya taɓa miyau a hanjin abinci, wuta tana gudana ruwa yana electrolyze, kuma a cathode hydroxide ions suna samuwa suna haddasa ƙonewar alkali mai ƙarfi. $2\mathrm{H_2O} + 2e^- \to \mathrm{H_2} + 2\mathrm{OH^-}$
c-270.example: Batirin lithium button 3 V na diamita 20 mm (CR2032) yana makalewa cikin sauƙi a hanjin abinci na yara, kuma pH na nama na iya kaiwa 12~13. Lalacewa tana farawa cikin sa'o'i 2 kuma kada ka tilasta amai ko ka jira.
c-270.actionItem: Yau duba cewa ɗakunan batirin button na remote, smart key da kayan wasa suna a kulle da sukurori, kuma ka ajiye batura na ajiya a wurin da yara ba sa kaiwa.

c-271.title: Tuna da swordfish saboda mercury sau 1~2 a mako
c-271.summary: Manyan kifaye masu cin nama kamar tuna da swordfish suna tara methylmercury, don haka yana da kyau a daidaita yawan cin su zuwa sau 1~2 a mako.
c-271.principle: Mercury yana canzawa zuwa methylmercury ta ƙananan halittu kuma yana taruwa ta hanyar sarkar abinci. $\mathrm{Hg^{2+} \xrightarrow{\text{ƙananan halittu}} CH_3Hg^+}$ Hukumar Tsaron Abinci ta Turai tana ba da izinin mako-mako na 1.3 μg a kowace 1 kg na nauyin jiki.
c-271.example: Idan nauyi 60 kg ne, izinin mako-mako shi ne 78 μg. Swordfish 100 g mai mercury 1.0 ppm yana ɗauke da kusan 100 μg kuma cin sau ɗaya kawai zai iya wuce iyaka, yayin da light tuna 100 g mai kusan 0.1 ppm kusan 10 μg ne. Mata masu ciki da yara su yi taka-tsantsan fiye.
c-271.actionItem: Yau idan za ka ci tuna, swordfish ko shark, ci kusan 100 g kawai a lokaci ɗaya, kuma ka shirya wannan makon kada ka ci babban kifi iri ɗaya fiye da sau 1~2.

c-272.title: Shrimp da kaguwa suna yin ja idan sun dahu
c-272.summary: Idan shrimp da kaguwa suka dahu, protein yana canzawa kuma jan pigment da aka kulle yana fitowa suna yin ja, kuma wannan alama ce mai kyau cewa sun dahu sosai.
c-272.principle: Idan suna da rai, astaxanthin yana manne da protein (crustacyanin) yana da launin shuɗi-toka, amma idan zafi ya denature protein, jan astaxanthin yana fitowa. $\text{astaxanthin-protein (shuɗi-toka)} \xrightarrow{\Delta} \text{astaxanthin (ja)} + \text{protein da aka denature}$
c-272.example: Shrimp yana dahuwa idan zafin ciki ya kai 63℃ (145℉) ko fiye kuma ya zama ruwan hoda mara haske, kuma tafasa a ruwan tafasa na mintuna 2~3 ya isa. Idan an daɗe, naman yana yin tauri.
c-272.actionItem: Yau idan za ka dafa shrimp, cire su nan take idan jikinsu ya koma ruwan hoda mara haske mai siffar C don kada su yi tauri.

c-273.title: Idan ruwan birki ya tsufa, birki yana raunana
c-273.summary: Ruwan birki yana shan danshi daga iska don haka wurin tafasa yana ƙasa, kuma a birki mai tsanani kamar a gangara yana iya tafasa ƙarfin birki ya faɗi.
c-273.principle: Brake fluid na glycol yana hygroscopic don haka idan ruwa ya haɗu wurin tafasa yana ƙasa kuma tururi yana samuwa, wanda ake matsawa kuma ba ya watsa ƙarfin birki. $\ln\frac{P_2}{P_1} = -\frac{\Delta H_{vap}}{R}\left(\frac{1}{T_2} - \frac{1}{T_1}\right)$
c-273.example: Busasshen wurin tafasa na DOT 4 mafi ƙaranci 230℃ ne amma idan ya sha danshi yana sauka zuwa 155℃, ƙasa da kusan 75℃. Yawanci yana shan kusan 2~3 % na danshi a shekara, don haka ana ba da shawarar canzawa kowace shekaru 2 ko kowane 40,000 km.
c-273.actionItem: Yau duba a bayanan kula ranar ƙarshe da aka canza ruwan birki, kuma idan ya wuce shekaru 2, yi booking na dubawa a gareji.

c-274.title: Hodar ruwan hoda ta kyautar ham launin nitrite ne
c-274.summary: Ham yana riƙe da launin ruwan hoda ko da ya dahu saboda nitrite ne ke ba shi wannan launi, kuma bai kamata a ci naman da aka sarrafa da yawa ba.
c-274.principle: Nitrite a cikin acid yana zama nitric oxide (NO) wanda ke haɗuwa da iron na myoglobin pigment na nama ya samar da nitrosomyoglobin mai ruwan hoda. $\mathrm{NO + Mb(Fe^{2+}) \to Mb(Fe^{2+})\text{-}NO}$
c-274.example: Iyakar nitrite ion da aka yarda a samfuran nama a Korea shi ne 70 mg/kg ko ƙasa. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta rarraba naman da aka sarrafa a matsayin Group 1 carcinogen kuma ta kimanta cewa cin 50 g a kowace rana yana ƙara haɗarin kansar hanji da kusan 18 %.
c-274.actionItem: Yau, ajiye kyautar ham ɗin da aka ba ka a firiji, ka raba ta zuwa kusan 50 g a lokaci ɗaya ka ci tare da kayan lambu.

c-275.title: Gotgam da ke da farin foda ba mold ba ne, lu'ulu'un sukari ne
c-275.summary: Farin fodar da ke saman gotgam (busasshiyar persimmon) mafi yawa ba mold ba ne, lu'ulu'un sukari ne (glucose·fructose) da suka tsayu a saman. Idan akwai shuɗi ko baƙin tabo masu kama da gashi, mold ne, don haka zubar da shi.
c-275.principle: Yayin bushewa danshi yana raguwa kuma ƙarfin sukari yana ƙaruwa, kuma idan ya wuce saturated solubility, sukari yana crystallize. Yanayin saturation shi ne $C > C_{\mathrm{sat}}(T)$, sakamakon danshi ya tashi yana rage mai raba na $C=\frac{m_{\mathrm{sukari}}}{V_{\mathrm{ruwa}}}$.
c-275.example: Sabuwar persimmon tana da kusan 80 % danshi da kusan 15 % sukari, amma gotgam danshi yana raguwa zuwa kusan 25~30 % kuma sukari yana taruwa zuwa fiye da 60 %. Saboda haka farin foda yana samuwa a saman.
c-275.actionItem: Yau idan za ka sayi gotgam, zaɓi wanda fodar ta yi daidai kuma mai tauri kuma saman yana bushe, ka guji masu shuɗin gashi ko tabon mai ɗaukewa.

c-276.title: Ƙamshin ƙonewa idan an fara kunna na'urar dumama ƙurar da ta taru ce ke ruɓewa ta zafi
c-276.summary: Idan ka kunna na'urar dumama da ta huta duk rani a karon farko, ƙamshin ƙonewa mai ɗaci galibi ƙurar da ta taru a heater ce ke ruɓewa ta zafi. Idan ka bar iska ta shiga na mintuna kaɗan yawanci yana ɓacewa, amma idan ya ci gaba ana buƙatar dubawa.
c-276.principle: Kwayoyin halitta masu rai a cikin ƙura (zaren yadi, ɓarnar fata da sauransu) idan an ɗumama su suna thermal decomposing su fitar da abubuwa masu tururi da carbonized. Yana farawa a kusan $T \approx 150\text{~}250\,^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$, kuma saman heating element ya fi wannan zafi sosai.
c-276.example: Saman heating element na heater na lantarki yawanci yana kaiwa 300~800°C wanda ƙura ke ƙonewa cikin sauƙi. Heater na 1~2 kW yana ba da ƙamshi ko da bayan mintuna 30 kawai, kuma idan an tsabtace shi sai ya kusan ɓace.
c-276.actionItem: Yau kafin ka kunna na'urar dumama, cire ta daga wuta, cire ƙurar mashigar iska da bene da vacuum cleaner, buɗe taga ka yi gwajin gudu na mintuna 10. Idan ƙamshin ƙonewa ya ci gaba ko hayaƙi ya fita, kashe nan take ka ba da a duba.

c-277.title: Ana gishirin kabeji ne don ya yi laushi kuma kimchi ya sha ɗanɗano
c-277.summary: Idan ka yi pickling kabeji da gishiri, ruwa yana fita ta osmosis kuma yana yin laushi, kayan ƙamshi suna shiga da kyau kuma crunchiness yana riƙewa. Idan salting bai isa ba, kimchi yana zama mara gishiri da laushi sosai.
c-277.principle: Cell membrane yana da semipermeable don haka idan ƙarfin gishiri a waje ya yi yawa, ruwa yana motsi daga ciki zuwa waje. Ana bayyana osmotic pressure da $\Pi = iCRT$, kuma calcium yana cross-linking pectin yana riƙe tsarin nama.
c-277.example: Idan ka yi salting kabeji ɗaya (kusan 2.5 kg) da kusan 200 g na gishiri (kusan 8 %) na sa'o'i 4~6, nauyi yana raguwa da kusan 20~25 % wato kusan 0.5~0.6 kg na ruwa ya fita. Gishirin kabejin da aka salting ya kamata ya zama kusan 2 %.
c-277.actionItem: Yau idan za ka yi kimchi, lokacin salting kabeji juya shi sau ɗaya a tsakiya, kuma ka wanke shi lokacin da ɓangaren kara ya lanƙwasa amma bai karye ba sannan ka tace ruwa.

c-278.title: Persimmon mai ɗaci ba ya ɗaci sai soluble tannin ya taurare
c-278.summary: Ɗacin persimmon yana daga soluble tannin da ke narkewa a ruwa, kuma idan ya zama insoluble ya taurare, ba ya ɗaci. Bushewar gotgam ko tsarin cire ɗaci shi ne ƙa'idarsa.
c-278.principle: Soluble tannin yana haɗuwa da proteins na harshe yana sa mutum ya ji ɗaci. Idan persimmon ya nuna, ya bushe ko aka rufe shi, acetaldehyde ($\mathrm{CH_3CHO}$) da aka samar yana polymerize tannin ya mayar da shi dunƙule insoluble wanda ba ya narkewa a miyau.
c-278.example: Persimmon mai ɗaci yana da soluble tannin kusan 1 % don haka baki yana bushewa, amma idan aka bar shi a rufe a kusan 20~25°C na kwanaki 3~5, mafi yawansa yana zama insoluble kuma ɗacin yana kusan ɓacewa.
c-278.actionItem: Yau idan kana da persimmon mai ɗaci, bar shi a kwantena ko jaka a rufe tare da apple ko banana na kwanaki 2~3, ko ka yanke fata ka busar a rana. Kafin ka ci, ɗanɗana yanki ɗaya don tabbatar da ɗacin ya ɓace.

c-279.title: Ruwan grapefruit yana canza tasirin wasu magunguna
c-279.summary: Grapefruit na iya hana ruɓewar wasu magunguna ya ƙara ƙarfin maganin a jini. Idan kana shan magani, tambayi likitan magunguna game da hulɗa da grapefruit.
c-279.principle: Furanocoumarins na grapefruit suna hana CYP3A4 enzyme na metabolism na magunguna a hanji. Idan ruɓewa ya ragu, maganin da ake sha ya ƙaru kuma $AUC=\int_0^\infty C(t)\,dt$ ya yi girma kuma haɗarin illa yana ƙaruwa.
c-279.example: Wasu statins (maganin cholesterol) idan aka sha kofi 1 (kusan 250 mL) na ruwan grapefruit, exposure na jini (AUC) na iya ƙaruwa sau da yawa kuma tasirin na iya ɗaukar fiye da kwana ɗaya. Tasirin ya bambanta sosai ta magani.
c-279.actionItem: Yau duba umarnin maganin da kake sha ko tambayi likitan magunguna ko akwai gargaɗin grapefruit, kuma idan akwai, ka guji ruwan grapefruit da 'ya'yan itace ɗanye. Kada ka daina magani da kanka.

c-280.title: Dalilin raba ruwa zuwa 100mL ko ƙasa a cikin jirgi
c-280.summary: A jiragen ƙasashen waje ana iya ɗaukar ruwa da gels a kwantena 100mL ko ƙasa a cikin jakar zipper mai haske. Ƙa'idar girma tana sa ya yi wuya a samar da adadi mai haɗari da kwantena ɗaya.
c-280.principle: Ana iyakance girman kwantena bisa cewa ruwan fashewa yana da haɗari ne kawai idan ya taru fiye da wani adadi. Jimillar da za a iya ɗauka $V_{\mathrm{jimilla}}=\sum V_i$ inda kowane $V_i \le 100\,\mathrm{mL}$ kuma yawanci ana iyakance zuwa jakar zipper 1 L ɗaya.
c-280.example: Idan ka saka kwantena 100mL guda 10 a jakar zipper 1 L, matsakaicin jimilla kusan 1 L ne. Kwantena 200mL ko da rabin cike yana faɗa cikin ƙa'idar girman kwantena kuma sau da yawa ba ya wucewa.
c-280.actionItem: Idan kana shirya tafiya yau, mayar da shampoo, lotion da maganin ruwa zuwa ƙananan kwantena 100mL ko ƙasa, ka saka su a jakar zipper mai haske ɗaya ka sanya a saman kayanka. Duba ƙa'idojin kamfanin jirgi da na kowace ƙasa sau ɗaya kafin tashi.

c-281.title: Zaɓi jeotgal bisa lokacin tsufa da ɗanɗanon amino acid, ba gishiri kawai ba
c-281.summary: Ɗanɗanon umami na jeotgal yana fitowa daga amino acids da suka samu ta ruɓewar protein yayin tsufa. Ka zaɓa ta hanyar duba ko gishiri ne kawai mai ƙarfi, kuma ko bayanin yin da tsufa a bayyane yake.
c-281.principle: Proteolytic enzymes na ciki na kifi suna hydrolyze protein zuwa peptides da amino acids: $\text{protein} + n\,\mathrm{H_2O} \to n\,\text{amino acids}$. A wannan tsari glutamic acid yana ba da umami.
c-281.example: Saeujeot yawanci yana da gishiri kusan 20 %, kuma idan ya tsufa watanni 3~6 amino nitrogen yana ƙaruwa kuma ɗanɗanon yana zurfafa. Ko da gishiri iri ɗaya ne, idan tsufa ya yi gajere, ƙamshin kifi da gishiri sun fi fitowa.
c-281.actionItem: Yau idan za ka sayi jeotgal, duba ranar yin, kayan da aka yi amfani da su da gishiri a kan kwali, kuma idan za ka iya ɗanɗana, zaɓi wanda zaki da ɗanɗanon da ke daɗewa ya rage bayan gishiri.

c-282.title: Duba mahaɗar gas da kumfar ruwan sabulu, ba da ƙamshi ba
c-282.summary: Mahaɗan da ake zargin gas yana zuba, shafa ruwan sabulu ka ga ko kumfa ya samu. Yin gwaji da wuta ko wuta na lighter haɗarin fashewa ne kuma an hana shi gaba ɗaya.
c-282.principle: Gas ɗin da ke zuba yana tura fim ɗin surfactant na ruwan sabulu sama yana samar da kumfa. Matsin lamba a cikin kumfa shi ne $\Delta P = \frac{4\gamma}{r}$ (a kumfar sabulu), don haka ko ƙaramin zubewa yana zama kumfa mai ganuwa.
c-282.example: Shafa maganin da aka haɗa da mai tsaftace tasa kusan 1 mL a ruwa 100 mL a mahaɗar bututun murhun gas, kuma idan kumfa ya yi girma ko ya ci gaba da samuwa, zubewa ce. Gas ɗin birni yana da sauƙi fiye da iska don haka yana taruwa sama, LPG yana da nauyi don haka yana taruwa a ƙasa.
c-282.actionItem: Yau, tare da gas valve a rufe, shafa ruwan sabulu a mahaɗar bututun ka ga ko kumfa ya samu. Idan kumfa ya ci gaba da girma, rufe valve, buɗe iska sannan ka ba ƙwararre ya duba.

c-283.title: Idan aka ajiye chestnut a ƙaramin zafi, starch yana zama sukari kuma ya fi zaƙi
c-283.summary: Idan ka ajiye ɗanyen chestnut a firiji na 0~4°C na makonni da yawa, starch yana zama sukari kuma ya fi zaƙi. Idan ka bar shi a yanayin ɗaki yana lalacewa cikin sauƙi, don haka ajiya a firiji hanya ce mai tsada.
c-283.principle: A ƙaramin zafi amylase da sauransu suna ruɓar starch zuwa maltose da glucose: $(\mathrm{C_6H_{10}O_5})_n + n\,\mathrm{H_2O}\to n\,\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}$. Shuka tana tara sukari don hana daskarewa tana kare kanta ta hanyar osmotic.
c-283.example: Sabon chestnut yana da sukari kusan 5~8 %, amma idan aka adana shi a 0~2°C na makonni 4~8, sukarin yana ƙaruwa zuwa kusan sau 1.5~2 kuma zaƙi na iya ƙaruwa sosai. A yanayin ɗaki, kwari da mold suna samuwa cikin sauƙi cikin kwana 15.
c-283.actionItem: Yau, ɗanyen chestnut ka naɗe da fatarsa a kitchen towel ka saka a jakar zipper ka ajiye a firiji (kusan 1~4°C), ka tururi ko gasa su cikin makonni 1~2.

c-284.title: Ko pickling na gida lafiya ne ya dogara da pH 4.6
c-284.summary: Lokacin da kake yin canning na gida, dole ne ka bambanta abinci mai acid na pH 4.6 ko ƙasa da abinci mai ƙarancin acid sama da haka. Abinci mai ƙarancin acid idan aka ɗumama kawai a ruwan tafasa, haɗarin botulinum toxin na iya rage.
c-284.principle: Spores na Clostridium botulinum na iya samar da toxin a yanayin rufe ba tare da oxygen ba idan pH ya wuce 4.6. Acidity shine $\mathrm{pH}=-\log_{10}[\mathrm{H^+}]$ kuma pH 4.6 shi ne $[\mathrm{H^+}]\approx 2.5\times10^{-5}\,\mathrm{mol/L}$.
c-284.example: Jam da 'ya'yan itace da aka tsince suna da pH kusan 3~4 acidic don haka ɗumama a ruwan tafasa kusan lafiya ne, amma kayan lambu, nama da wake suna da pH 5~7 ƙarancin acid kuma suna buƙatar high-pressure heating a kusan 116~121°C. Ruwan tafasa ba zai wuce 100°C ba.
c-284.actionItem: Yau idan za ka yi canning, duba acidity na kayan (ko 'ya'yan itace ko vinegar pickling ne), kuma kayan masu ƙarancin acid ka ajiye a firiji ko freezer maimakon canning a gida. Idan murfi ya kumbura ko akwai kumfa ko ƙamshi mara kyau, kada ka ci ka zubar.

c-285.title: Cakulan na iya zama guba ga kare
c-285.summary: Theobromine na cakulan yana ruɓewa a hankali a kare kuma yana iya haddasa guba. Yayin da cocoa ya fi yawa, haɗarin ya fi girma, don haka idan kare ya ci, duba yawa da nau'in ka tuntuɓi likitan dabbobi.
c-285.principle: Theobromine ($\mathrm{C_7H_8N_4O_2}$) yana da half-life na kusan sa'o'i 17 a kare, wanda ya fi na mutum (kusan sa'o'i 6~10) don haka yana taruwa a jiki. Ana auna haɗarin guba da yawan abin da aka ci a kowace nauyi $D=\frac{m_{\mathrm{theobromine}}}{m_{\mathrm{nauyi}}}$.
c-285.example: Dark chocolate (cocoa 70 %) yana ɗauke da theobromine kusan 5~8 mg/g, don haka idan kare mai 10 kg ya ci kusan 50 g (rabin allon cakulan na al'ada), kusan 250~400 mg ne (kusan 25~40 mg/kg), wanda ke cikin yankin haɗarin alamomi masu tsanani. Cakulan madara yana da ƙarancin yawa.
c-285.actionItem: Yau ajiye cakulan da samfuran cocoa a wuri mai tsayi ko akwatin rufewa da karenka ba ya kaiwa. Idan ya ci, kada ka jira, rubuta nau'i, adadi da lokacin da ya ci ka tuntuɓi likitan dabbobi nan take.

c-286.title: Abincin jirgi yana da rashin ɗanɗano saboda matsin cikin jirgi da bushewa
c-286.summary: Cikin jirgi matsin lamba yana ƙasa kuma iska ta bushe sosai don haka jin ƙamshi da ɗanɗano yana raunana kuma abinci yana kama da ba shi da gishiri. Saboda haka ana ƙara gishiri da gangan a abincin jirgi.
c-286.principle: Matsin kabin kusan daidai yake da tsayin 2,000~2,400 m sama da teku (kusan 0.75~0.8 atm) kuma danshi mai dangantaka 10~20 %. A ƙaramin matsin lamba da bushewa, ƙwarewar masu karɓar jin ƙamshi da ɗanɗano tana faɗuwa sosai kuma ana ba da rahoton zaƙi da gishiri suna raunana da kusan 30 %. Rabon matsin lamba shi ne $\frac{P_{\mathrm{kabin}}}{P_0}\approx0.8$.
c-286.example: Ko abinci na yau da kullum a ƙasa, a tsayin tafiya zaƙi da gishiri na iya jin ƙasa da kusan 20~30 %, don haka abincin jirgi yawanci yana amfani da gishiri da kayan ƙamshi da yawa. Dalilin da ruwan tumatir ke da daɗi musamman a jirgi ana bayyana shi da irin wannan dalili.
c-286.actionItem: Idan za ka hau jirgi yau, sha ruwa akai-akai don kada baki ya bushe, kuma ko da abinci yana da rashin gishiri kada ka ƙara gishiri, zaɓi abinci mai ƙamshi mai ƙarfi ko abin sha mai tsami.

c-287.title: Zaɓi fulawar yin burodi bisa yawan protein: strong, medium, weak
c-287.summary: Rarraba fulawa zuwa strong, medium da weak (kang-ryeok, jung-ryeok, bak-ryeok) bambancin yawan protein ne. Don burodi zaɓi strong flour mai protein da yawa, don kek da kuki weak flour mai ƙarancin protein don ɗanɗano ya dace.
c-287.principle: Gliadin da glutenin na proteins na alkama suna yin gluten network idan sun hadu da ruwa: $\text{gliadin}+\text{glutenin}+\mathrm{H_2O}\to\text{gluten}$. Yayin da protein ya fi yawa, networks ɗin yana ƙara tauri da ƙarfin ɗagawa.
c-287.example: Strong flour yana da protein kusan 11~13 % don burodi mai taunawa da bagel, medium flour kusan 9~10 % don noodles da buchimgae, weak flour kusan 7~9 % don kek da kuki masu laushi. 100 g na weak flour yana ɗauke da protein kusan 8 g.
c-287.actionItem: Yau lokacin da za ka sayi fulawa, duba yawan protein a bayanin abinci na bayan kunshin ka zaɓi strong, medium ko weak flour bisa abincin da za ka yi.

c-288.title: Idan ka gauraya sabbin batura da tsofaffi haɗarin zubewar ruwa yana da girma
c-288.summary: Idan ka gauraya sabbin batura da tsofaffi ko batura daban-daban, baturin mai rauni yana over-discharge kuma ruwa na iya zuba. A na'ura, canza batura iri ɗaya na lokaci ɗaya gaba ɗaya.
c-288.principle: A series connection wuta iri ɗaya tana gudana, amma idan ƙarfin lantarki na baturin mai rauni ya fara faɗuwa kusa da 0 V, sauran suna cajin wannan baturi a baya. Sannan ana samar da hydrogen ta amsawa kamar $2\,\mathrm{H_2O}+2e^-\to \mathrm{H_2}+2\,\mathrm{OH^-}$ kuma matsin ciki yana hauhawa ya haddasa zubewa.
c-288.example: A cikin batura 1.5 V uku a series (4.5 V), idan ɗaya ya ƙare kusan 0 V, sauran biyu suna ci gaba da tura kusan 3 V kuma wannan baturin yana caji a baya. Potassium hydroxide da ya zuba alkali ne mai ƙarfi (pH kusan 14) wanda ke lalata fata da na'ura.
c-288.actionItem: Yau duba batura na remote, agogo da kayan wasa, kuma lokacin canzawa maye gaba ɗaya batura na na'ura ɗaya da sababbin iri da alama iri ɗaya. Kada ka taɓa farin foda da ya zuba da hannu.

c-289.title: Dafa romon sagol sau ɗaya ka raba shi
c-289.summary: Idan an daɗe ana dafa sagol, collagen yana zama gelatin yana samar da romo mai kauri, kuma idan ya huce yana tauri kamar jelly. Dafa sau ɗaya ka raba kuma ka daskare don adana gas da lokaci.
c-289.principle: Collagen yana narkewa idan an ɗumama shi ya zama gelatin, kuma idan ya huce yana canzawa daga sol zuwa gel. Hydrolysis na ɗumama shi ne $\text{collagen}\xrightarrow{\Delta,\ \mathrm{H_2O}}\text{gelatin}$, kuma yawanci yana taurare ƙasa da kusan 35°C.
c-289.example: Tafasa sagol 1 kg da ruwa kusan 6 L na sa'o'i 6~8 yana ba da kusan 4~5 L na romo. Maimakon kunna murhu kowane lokaci, dafa sau ɗaya ka raba zuwa rabo 15 na 300 mL kowanne don rage amfani da gas sosai.
c-289.actionItem: Idan za ka dafa romon sagol yau, bar shi ya huce gaba ɗaya, raba shi zuwa jakar zipper ko kwantena na kowane abinci ka daskare, kuma lokacin cin abinci narkar da adadin da kake buƙata kawai ka ɗumama.

c-290.title: Farin foda a saman ƙasar tukunya ba mold ba ne, gishirin ma'adinai ne
c-290.summary: Farin foda da ke samuwa a ƙasar tukunya ko gefen tukunya na iya zama ragowar gishirin taki ko ruwan famfo, ba mold ba. Idan ka ba da isasshen ruwa ka wanke shi, yana raguwa.
c-290.principle: Idan ruwa ya ƙafe daga sama, gishirin da ya narke yana crystallize. Ƙarfin gishiri $C=\frac{m_{\mathrm{gishiri}}}{V_{\mathrm{ruwa}}}$ yana ƙaruwa idan $V_{\mathrm{ruwa}}$ ya ragu kuma idan ya wuce saturation yana zama lu'ulu'u. Misali, abubuwan hard water kamar $\mathrm{CaCO_3}$ suna rage.
c-290.example: Idan taurin ruwan famfo kusan 100 mg/L ne (a matsayin CaCO3), idan 1 L na ruwa ya ƙafe kusan 100 mg na calcium carbonate yana rage. Ko da ka ba da 200 mL kowane mako, cikin watanni ƙaramin fari mai gani yana samuwa a saman ƙasa.
c-290.actionItem: Yau idan ka ga farin foda, cire saman ƙasar 1~2 cm ka rufe da sabuwar ƙasa, sannan ka zuba ruwa a hankali daidai da girman tukunya don ya fita ta ramin magudanar ruwa sosai.

c-291.title: Xylitol gum yana da haɗari idan kare ya ci
c-291.summary: Xylitol da ke da aminci ga mutane yana da haɗari sosai ga karnuka kuma ko ɗan kaɗan zai iya haddasa hypoglycemia da lalacewar hanta. Ajiye gum, alewa marasa sukari da wasu man gyada da karenka ba ya kaiwa.
c-291.principle: Pancreas na kare yana kuskuren xylitol a matsayin glucose yana saki insulin da sauri. Sannan sukarin jini yana faɗuwa sosai kuma ana auna haɗarin xylitol $\mathrm{C_5H_{12}O_5}$ da $D=\frac{m}{m_{\mathrm{nauyi}}}$.
c-291.example: Kare mai 10 kg zai iya samun hypoglycemia da xylitol kusan 0.1 g/kg (kusan 1 g) kawai, kuma sama da 0.5 g/kg (kusan 5 g) haɗarin lalacewar hanta yana da yawa. Gum ɗaya mara sukari yawanci yana ɗauke da xylitol kusan 0.2~1 g don haka guda kaɗan yana cikin yankin haɗari.
c-291.actionItem: Yau, cire gum da alewa marasa sukari daga jaka, aljihu da drawer zuwa wurin da kare ba ya kaiwa. Idan ya ci, ɗauki jerin sinadarai ka tuntuɓi likitan dabbobi nan take.

c-292.title: Dalilin da ruwan zafi alkaline ke zama mai santsi
c-292.summary: Idan ka nutse a cikin alkaline hot spring, santsin yana faruwa ne saboda lipids na saman fata suna zama kamar sabulu. Idan fatarka ta yi rauni, kada ka daɗe, kuma bayan fitowa ka shafa moisturizer.
c-292.principle: Alkali (pH 8.5 ko fiye) yana saponify sinadarin mai na fata (triglycerides) ya zama sabulu da glycerol: $\text{mai} + 3\,\mathrm{OH^-}\to 3\,\text{gishirin fatty acid (sabulu)}+\text{glycerol}$. Wannan sabulu yana emulsify a saman yana jin santsi.
c-292.example: Idan ka nutse a alkaline hot spring mai pH kusan 9~10 da kusan 40°C na mintuna 20, matattun sel da sebum suna narkewa kuma fata tana yin santsi. Amma pH 10 yana da $[\mathrm{OH^-}]$ sau 1,000 fiye da neutral (pH 7).
c-292.actionItem: Idan za ka yi wanka a hot spring yau, a alkaline spring yi kusan mintuna 10~20 a lokaci ɗaya, kuma bayan fitowa goge ruwa ka shafa moisturizer nan take.

c-293.title: Olive oil 'extra virgin' alamar daraja ce ta acidity 0.8 % ko ƙasa
c-293.summary: Extra virgin shi ne darajar mai da aka samu ta matse olives wanda free fatty acid acidity ɗinsa 0.8 % ko ƙasa kuma ya wuce gwajin organoleptic. Ƙarancin acidity ba koyaushe yana nufin ɗanɗano mafi kyau ba, don haka duba ranar girbi da cikawa ma.
c-293.principle: Acidity ita ce rabon free fatty acids a mai (a matsayin oleic acid) $\text{acidity (\%)}=\frac{m_{\mathrm{free\ fatty\ acid}}}{m_{\mathrm{mai}}}\times100$. Yayin da olives ya fi sabo, triglycerides suna ruɓewa ƙasa don haka acidity yana ƙasa, kuma polyphenols suna jinkirta oxidation.
c-293.example: Idan acidity 0.8 % ko ƙasa ne ana rarraba shi extra virgin, kuma 2 % ko ƙasa virgin. A kwalba 1 L, free fatty acid a extra virgin kusan 8 g ko ƙasa. Yana raunana ga haske da zafi don haka kwalba mai duhu ya fi kyau.
c-293.actionItem: Yau lokacin da za ka sayi olive oil, duba alamar 'extra virgin' da shekarar girbi da ranar cikawa a kwalba, ka zaɓi kwalba mai duhu maimakon mai haske ka ajiye a wuri mai sanyi.

c-294.title: Rufe tashoshin baturin 9V da tef lokacin ajiya
c-294.summary: Baturin 9V yana da tashoshi biyu a fuska ɗaya kusa da juna don haka idan ya taɓa ƙarfe yana short-circuit kuma yana iya zafi. Idan za ka saka a drawer, rufe tashoshin da tef ko ka naɗe kowanne daban.
c-294.principle: Idan tashoshi sun taɓa ƙarfe kamar maɓalli ko tsabar kuɗi suka yi short-circuit, resistance yana da ƙarami sosai don haka babban current $I=\frac{V}{R}$ yana gudana kuma Joule heat $P=I^2R$ yana samuwa. Misali idan $R=0.5\,\Omega$, $I=18\,\mathrm{A}$.
c-294.example: Idan baturin 9 V yana da internal resistance kusan 1.5 Ω kuma aka yi short-circuit, a ka'ida $I\approx6\,\mathrm{A}$ kuma zafi har kusan 54 W na iya fitowa wanda ke zafi cikin mintuna kaɗan. Batir alkaline yawanci ya fi wannan ƙasa amma haɗarin ƙonewa da gobara yana nan.
c-294.actionItem: Yau, rufe tashoshin baturin 9V na ajiya a drawer da tef mai haske ko saka su a marufi na asali ko akwatin filastik. Kada ka adana su tare da tsabar kuɗi da maɓallai.

c-295.title: Tofu yana daɗewa idan aka nutsar da shi a ruwa kuma aka canza ruwan kowace rana
c-295.summary: Tofu da aka buɗe idan aka nutsar da shi a ruwa mai tsabta aka ajiye a firiji kuma aka canza ruwan kowace rana, yana iya zama sabo ƙarin kwanaki 2~3. Idan ƙamshi mai tsami ko ɗaukewa ya fito, zubar da shi.
c-295.principle: Tofu protein na waken soya ne da ya yi gel da coagulant kuma yana da kusan 85 % danshi don haka ƙwayoyin cuta suna yaduwa cikin sauƙi. Idan aka nutsar da shi, canjin water activity na saman $a_w=\frac{p}{p_0}$ da tuntuɓar oxygen yana raguwa kuma canza ruwa kowane lokaci yana wanke ƙwayoyin da suka ƙaru da metabolites.
c-295.example: A firiji na 4°C, tofu da aka buɗe idan aka nutsar da shi a ruwa kuma aka canza kowace rana yana kai kwanaki 3~5, idan aka bar shi yawanci saman yana ɗaukewa cikin kwana 1~2. Kawai rashin zubar da tofu ɗaya (300 g, kusan 2,000 won) babban tanadi ne.
c-295.actionItem: Yau, tofu da ya rage saka shi a kwantena mai rufi ka zuba ruwa mai tsabta (ruwan kwalba ko ruwan da aka tafasa aka huce) har ya nutse ka ajiye a firiji, kuma daga gobe canza ruwa sau ɗaya a rana.

c-296.title: Down padding a wanke da neutral detergent a busar sosai gaba ɗaya
c-296.summary: Idan ka yi amfani da detergent mai ƙarfin alkali a kan down (duck/goose) padding, mai na gashin yana fita kuma ƙarfin dawowa yana raguwa. Wanke da neutral detergent kuma busar da shi gaba ɗaya har cikin ciki don hana ƙamshi da mold.
c-296.principle: Lipids na gashin tsuntsu suna saponify a yanayin alkali su wanke: $\text{mai}+3\,\mathrm{OH^-}\to\text{sabulu}+\text{glycerol}$. Idan mai ya ɓace, gashin yana dunƙulewa kuma kaurin layin iska da ke samar da insulation yana raguwa.
c-296.example: Maganin detergent mai foda na al'ada yana da pH kusan 10~11 alkaline, yayin da neutral detergent yana da pH kusan 7~8. Idan padding mai 800 fill power da 500 g ya rage da danshi 100 g kawai, ƙamshi mai danshi da mold na iya samuwa ko da bayan bushewa.
c-296.actionItem: Idan za ka wanke padding yau, yi amfani da neutral detergent (na wool·down), ka kurkura sosai, sannan ka busar da shi gaba ɗaya a low-temperature dryer tare da ƙwallan tennis 2~3 ko a inuwa na kwanaki da yawa har ciki ya bushe.

c-297.title: Sha calcium da iron supplements a lokuta daban-daban
c-297.summary: Idan ka sha calcium supplement da iron supplement tare, za su iya hana shan juna. Idan za ka sha biyun, bar tazarar aƙalla sa'o'i 2.
c-297.principle: Divalent cations kamar $\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}$ da $\mathrm{Fe^{2+}}$ suna gasa a kan transporters na sha iri ɗaya a ƙaramin hanji (DMT1 da sauransu). Idan ƙarfin ɗaya ya yi yawa, shan ɗayan yana raguwa, kuma a calcium 500 mg ko fiye shan iron na iya raguwa sosai.
c-297.example: An ba da rahoton cewa idan ka sha calcium 600 mg da iron 18 mg tare, shan iron yana raguwa zuwa kusan 40~50 %. Ana yawan shan iron a kan komai a ciki tare da vitamin C, kuma calcium tare da abinci a rarrabe.
c-297.actionItem: Idan kana shan duka biyun yau, raba lokaci ka sha iron da safe a kan komai ko da safe kuma calcium tare da abincin dare. Idan akwai magani da aka rubuta, tambayi likitan magunguna da farko.

c-298.title: Lighter yana da ƙa'idoji a ɗauka cikin jirgi
c-298.summary: Ƙa'idojin lighter sun bambanta ta ƙasa da kamfanin jirgi, kuma gaba ɗaya a ɗauki ɗaya a kowane mutum a jiki kuma sau da yawa ba za a iya saka shi a checked baggage ba. Torch-type (turbo) galibi an hana. Duba kafin tashi.
c-298.principle: Mai na lighter butane ($\mathrm{C_4H_{10}}$) yana cikin ruwa mai matsin lamba kuma yana da saurin ƙonewa sosai, kuma ƙonewa shi ne $2\,\mathrm{C_4H_{10}}+13\,\mathrm{O_2}\to8\,\mathrm{CO_2}+10\,\mathrm{H_2O}$. Idan matsin kabin ya ragu, bambancin matsin ciki da wajen kwantena $\Delta P$ yana ƙaruwa.
c-298.example: Butane yana da vapor pressure kusan 2 atm a 20°C. A kabin (kusan 0.8 atm) bambanci da waje ya fi na ƙasa girma kuma a wasu lighters mai na iya zuba ko wutar ta ƙara girma. Lighter na yau da kullum guda ɗaya yawanci yana ɗauke da butane ƴan gram.
c-298.actionItem: Idan za ka yi tafiya yau, duba ƙa'idojin lighter na kamfanin jirgi da ƙasar da za ka je, kuma idan ba ka buƙata, bar lighter a gida. Idan za ka ɗauka, saka ɗaya kawai a aljihu don ka iya fitar da shi a lokacin binciken tsaro.

c-299.title: Brewed soy sauce da acid-hydrolyzed soy sauce amsawarsu ta yin ta bambanta
c-299.summary: Brewed soy sauce ana yin shi ne ta hanyar fermentation da tsufa na waken soya da alkama da ƙananan halittu, kuma acid-hydrolyzed soy sauce ana yin shi ne ta hanyar ruɓar protein na waken soya da hydrochloric acid da sauri. Za ka iya bambanta ta hanyar duba alamar 'brewed' da kayan da aka yi amfani da su a kan lakabi.
c-299.principle: Duka biyun suna hydrolyze protein zuwa amino acids amma catalysts ɗin sun bambanta. Fermentation shi ne enzyme $\text{protein}\xrightarrow{\text{enzyme},\ \text{watanni}}\text{amino acids}$, acid hydrolysis shi ne $\text{protein}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{HCl},\ \Delta}\text{amino acids}$ kuma yana ƙarewa cikin sa'o'i zuwa kwanaki.
c-299.example: Brewed soy sauce yawanci yana ɗaukar watanni 6 zuwa shekaru da yawa kafin ya tsufa, kuma acid-hydrolyzed soy sauce ana iya yin shi cikin kwanaki don haka yana da arha amma ƙamshinsa mai sauƙi ne. Mixed soy sauce na kasuwa haɗin biyu ne kuma ana rubuta rabo a lakabi.
c-299.actionItem: Yau lokacin da za ka sayi soy sauce, duba sunan kayan ko '100 % brewed' ne ko 'acid-hydrolyzed mixed', kuma zaɓi brewed don miya da jorim, mixed don soyayyen abinci da stews bisa amfani.

c-300.title: Idan diesel ya yi sanyi sosai paraffin wax yana taurarewa kuma injin ba zai tashi ba
c-300.summary: Paraffin wax a diesel yana zama lu'ulu'u idan zafi ya sauka ƙasa da sifili kuma yana toshe tace mai don motar ta kasa tashi. Idan aka yi hasashen sanyi mai tsanani, saka winter diesel ka cika tanki sosai.
c-300.principle: n-paraffins na diesel (misali $\mathrm{C_{20}H_{42}}$) suna crystallize idan zafi ya sauka ƙasa da cloud point $T_{\mathrm{cp}}$. Idan $T<T_{\mathrm{cp}}$, lu'ulu'un kakin zuma suna girma kuma a ƙaramin cold filter plugging point tace tana toshewa.
c-300.example: Summer diesel cloud point ɗinsa kusan 0°C ne, kuma ana daidaita winter grade zuwa ƙasa kusan -15~-20°C. Idan safiyar sanyi -10°C ta zo a lokacin hunturu lokacin da summer diesel ya rage, haɗarin tashi mara kyau yana ƙaruwa.
c-300.actionItem: Idan aka yi hasashen sanyi mai tsanani yau, duba a gidan mai cewa motar ta karɓi winter diesel, kuma ka cika man fiye da rabi. Idan injin bai tashi ba, kada ka ci gaba da juyawa, kira gareji ko sabis na taimakon hanya.

c-301.title: Shinkafa guda kaɗan a gwangwanin gishiri tana hana shi taurarewa
c-301.summary: Lokacin da gishiri ya taurare saboda danshi, idan ka saka shinkafa guda kaɗan, shinkafa tana shan danshi da farko don haka gishiri ba ya dunƙulewa. Ba cikakke ba ne, don haka ajiya a rufe yana da fifiko.
c-301.principle: Sodium chloride yana nuna deliquescence, yana shan danshin iska ya narke idan relative humidity ya kai kusan 75 % ko fiye. Wannan critical humidity shi ne $\mathrm{RH}_{\mathrm{c}}\approx75\%$, kuma sama da shi barbashi suna manne da juna su zama dunƙule.
c-301.example: A lokacin damina idan danshi ya kai 80 % ko fiye, gwangwanin gishiri a buɗe zai iya taurarewa cikin kwana ɗaya ko biyu. Idan ka saka shinkafa kusan 10~20, tana shan wasu gram na danshi a kowace 100 g na gishiri tana jinkirta dunƙulewa.
c-301.actionItem: Yau saka shinkafa 10~20 a gwangwanin gishiri, rufe murfin sosai, ka ajiye shi a wuri mai sanyi da bushe ba kusa da murhun gas wuri mai danshi ba.

c-302.title: Kada ka yi amfani da enzyme detergent a rigunan wool da silk
c-302.summary: Wool da silk zaren protein ne don haka enzyme detergent mai ɗauke da protein-digesting enzymes yana narkar da zaren ya lalata shi. Yi amfani da neutral detergent na wool·silk.
c-302.principle: Protease na enzyme detergent yana hydrolyze peptide bonds na protein: $\mathrm{R{-}CO{-}NH{-}R'}+\mathrm{H_2O}\to\mathrm{R{-}COOH}+\mathrm{H_2N{-}R'}$. Keratin na wool da fibroin na silk ma protein ne iri ɗaya don haka suna raunana ta amsawa iri ɗaya.
c-302.example: Protease enzymes sun fi aiki a 30~50°C don haka suna aiki a yanayin wanki na al'ada. Ko jiƙa sweater na wool da enzyme detergent a 30°C na awa 1 kawai, zaren yana yin siriri, sheƙi yana raguwa ko ramuka na iya samuwa.
c-302.actionItem: Yau duba lakabin wanki na rigar wool ko silk, kuma idan jerin sinadaran detergent yana da alamar 'enzyme (protease)', kada ka yi amfani da shi, wanke da hannu a hankali a ruwan sanyi da neutral detergent na wool·silk.

c-303.title: Bi alamar zafin ajiya na samfuran probiotics
c-303.summary: Probiotics ƙwayoyin rai ne don haka suna raunana ga zafi da danshi kuma dole a bi alamar zafin ajiya. Idan akwai alamar firiji, kada ka bar su a isar da kaya a lokacin rani ko a cikin mota.
c-303.principle: Rayayyun ƙwayoyin suna mutuwa da sauri idan zafi ya hauhawa kuma suna raguwa da $N(t)=N_0\,e^{-kt}$, kuma yayin da zafi ya fi girma $k$ yana ƙaruwa. Spore-forming strains (misali Bacillus) ko samfura masu rufi ko freeze-dried suna karko a yanayin ɗaki.
c-303.example: Idan ka bar samfurin da aka rubuta firiji a 25~30°C, yawan rayayyun ƙwayoyin na iya raguwa sosai cikin makonni, kuma a cikin mota sama da 40°C yana da sauri. Adadin da aka tabbatar yawanci yana dogara ne kan adadin da zai rayu har ranar ƙarewa, ba lokacin yin ba.
c-303.actionItem: Yau duba lakabin probiotic ɗin da kake da shi ko 'ajiye a firiji' ne ko 'ajiye a yanayin ɗaki', kuma idan an rubuta firiji, ajiye a firiji kuma kada ka bar shi a mota ko kusa da taga a lokacin rani. Idan kana da matsalar lafiya, tuntuɓi likita.

c-304.title: A kantin magani na ƙasashen waje, nemo magani da sunan sinadari
c-304.summary: Magani ɗaya yana da sunayen kasuwanci daban-daban a kowace ƙasa, don haka a kantin magani na ƙasashen waje faɗar sunan sinadari (Turanci) shi ne mafi daidai. Misali, acetaminophen ana kuma kiransa paracetamol a ƙasashen waje.
c-304.principle: Sunayen sinadari (generic name, INN) na magunguna sun haɗu a duniya kuma sunayen kasuwanci sun bambanta ta mai ƙera. Sinadari ɗaya $\mathrm{C_8H_9NO_2}$ ana kiransa acetaminophen (Amurka, Korea) da paracetamol (Turai, Asiya da sauransu).
c-304.example: Samfurin acetaminophen 500 mg ana sayar da shi a matsayin 'Tylenol', 'Panadol', 'Paracetamol' da sauransu bisa ƙasa amma sinadarin iri ɗaya ne. Matsakaicin yawan manya a kowace rana yawanci kada ya wuce 4 g (kwayoyi 8 na 500 mg).
c-304.actionItem: Yau a matsayin shirin tafiya, rubuta sunan sinadari (Turanci) na magungunan da kake sha ko adana a wayarka. A kantin magani faɗi alamomi, magungunan da kake sha da rashin lafiya tare, kuma ɗauki takardar likita don magungunan da aka rubuta.

c-305.title: Bambancin black, green da oolong tea shi ne matakin oxidation na ganye
c-305.summary: Black tea, oolong tea da green tea ganyen shukar shayi ɗaya ne amma matakin oxidation (fermentation) ya bambanta don haka ɗanɗano da launi sun bambanta. Green tea yana hana oxidation, kuma black tea ana oxidize shi sosai.
c-305.principle: Polyphenol oxidase (PPO) na ganyen shayi yana sa catechins su amsa da oxygen su koma theaflavins da sauransu: $\text{catechin}+\mathrm{O_2}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{PPO}}\text{theaflavin}$. Green tea yana fara hana enzyme da zafi don hana oxidation.
c-305.example: Green tea oxidation kusan 0 %, oolong tea kusan 10~80 %, kuma black tea kusa da 100 %. Gabaɗaya ana jiƙa green tea da ruwa kusan 70~80°C na mintuna 1~2 da black tea da ruwa kusan 90~95°C na mintuna 3~5.
c-305.actionItem: Yau lokacin da za ka sayi shayi, duba bayanin 'ba oxidation (green)·rabin oxidation (oolong)·cikakken oxidation (black)' a kan kunshin, kuma ka jiƙa da zafin ruwa da lokaci da suka dace da nau'in.

c-306.title: A lokacin sanyi, ka bar tankin mai a cike fiye da rabi
c-306.summary: Idan tankin mai ba shi da komai a lokacin sanyi, tururin ruwa na iska yana taruwa ya zama ruwa ya gauraya da man, kuma a yanayin ƙasa da sifili yana daskarewa ya toshe bututun mai. Idan ka bar man ya fi rabin tanki, ana iya rage wannan matsala.
c-306.principle: Tururin ruwa da ke cikin fanko yana taruwa a jikin bangon tanki mai sanyi. Taruwar tana faruwa idan zafi ya sauka ƙasa da wurin raɓa $T_d$, kuma yayin da iska a cikin tanki ta yi yawa, tururin da zai taru yana ƙaruwa. Ruwa yana daskarewa a $0^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ ko ƙasa da haka, ya toshe kwararar mai.
c-306.example: Idan tanki mai lita 50 ba shi da komai, yana ɗauke da iska mai laima ta kimanin lita 50, kuma a yanayin danshi na 80% da 10°C, a ka'ida ruwa gram kaɗan zai iya taruwa. Idan ka cika tankin, iskar tana raguwa, ruwa ya ragu, kuma ba za a yi fama da daskarewar bututun mai da safiyar sanyi ta -10°C da ke hana mota tashi ba.
c-306.actionItem: A yau, ka duba yawan man da ya rage a tankin motarka ko na na'urar dumama gida; idan bai kai rabi ba, ka ƙara mai. Ya fi sauƙi a lokacin sanyi ka riƙa tabbatar da tankin bai gaza rabi ba, maimakon ka riƙa cika shi gaba ɗaya a kowane lokaci.

c-307.title: Idan kofi yana ɗaci, kada ka ƙara gawayin kofi; ka rage lokacin tsamo shi
c-307.summary: Idan kofi yana ɗaci, maimakon ƙara gawayin kofi, ka rage lokacin tsamo shi ko ka niƙa shi da ƙaiƙayi. Tsamo fiye da kima shi ne sanadin ɗacin, don haka za ka daidaita ɗanɗanon ba tare da ɓarnatar da gawayin ba.
c-307.principle: Yawan abin da aka tsamo shi ne $\text{yawan tsamowa(\%)}=\frac{m_{\mathrm{daskararrun\ da\ suka\ narke}}}{m_{\mathrm{gawayin\ kofi}}}\times100$, kuma yawanci 18 zuwa 22% ne daidai. Idan ya wuce haka, abubuwa masu ɗaci (kamar chlorogenic acid lactone da phenylindane) suna narkewa da yawa.
c-307.example: Idan aka tsamo fiye da 22% daga gram 20 na gawayin kofi, sama da gram 4.4 zai narke, kofi kuma ya yi ɗaci da ɗaurewa a baki. Idan aka daidaita tsamowar zuwa 20% daga gram 20 ɗin nan, kimanin gram 4 ne zai narke, kofi ya yi zaƙi da daidaito. Idan gram 20 na gawayin kofi yana kimanin won 1,000, wannan yana rage ɓarna.
c-307.actionItem: A yau, idan kofi yana ɗaci, kada ka ƙara yawan gawayin kofi; ka niƙa shi da ƙaiƙayi mataki ɗaya ko ka rage lokacin tsamowa da daƙiƙa 20 zuwa 30. Ka daidaita zafin ruwa zuwa 90 zuwa 94°C.

c-308.title: Yisti yana mutuwa idan ka zuba shi a ruwa mai zafi fiye da 55°C
c-308.summary: Yistin da ake amfani da shi a kullun burodi yana mutuwa idan aka zuba shi a ruwa mai zafi da yawa, kullun kuma ba zai kumbura ba. Ka daidaita zafin ruwa zuwa kusan 30 zuwa 38°C, wato ruwan da yake ɗumi idan ka taɓa shi da hannu.
c-308.principle: Yisti (Saccharomyces) yana mutuwa da sauri daga kusan 55°C zuwa sama, inda sunadaran jikinsa suke lalacewa. Mafi kyawun aikinsa yana kusan 28 zuwa 35°C, kuma a cikin ƙoshi, $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}\to2\,\mathrm{C_2H_5OH}+2\,\mathrm{CO_2}$, iskar carbon dioxide ce ke kumbura kullun.
c-308.example: Idan ka zuba gram 7 na yisti a gram 500 na gari, a ruwa mai zafin 35°C kullun zai kumbura har ya ninka kusan sau 2 cikin awa 1, amma a ruwa mai zafin 60°C yawancin yistin zai mutu, kullun kuma kusan ba zai kumbura ba. Wannan hanya ce ta kare jakar yisti ɗaya (kimanin won 500).
c-308.actionItem: Idan za ka toya burodi a yau, ka duba zafin ruwa da ma'aunin zafi ko da cikin wuyan hannunka, ka tabbatar ba mai zafi ba ne amma ɗumi ne, tsakanin 30 zuwa 38°C, kuma ka haɗa gishiri da yisti daban don kada su taɓa juna kai tsaye.

c-309.title: Shan magungunan mura da yawa a lokaci ɗaya na iya ninka acetaminophen
c-309.summary: Idan ka sha maganin mura na gama gari, maganin rage zazzaɓi da zafi, da Tylenol daban-daban, acetaminophen zai iya ninkawa, har ya wuce matsakaicin adadin yini ɗaya. Ka duba jerin sinadaran, ka haɗa adadin acetaminophen (paracetamol) da ke ciki.
c-309.principle: Yawancin acetaminophen ana sarrafa shi a hanta, amma idan ya yi yawa, sinadarin guba NAPQI yana ƙaruwa, glutathione ya ƙare, ƙwayoyin hanta kuma su lalace. Ka haɗa jimillar yini ta $D_{\mathrm{jimla}}=\sum D_i$, kuma ka tabbatar ba ta wuce gram 4 ga babba ba (yawanci ana ba da shawarar gram 3 ko ƙasa).
c-309.example: Idan ka ƙara buhunan maganin mura 3 (kimanin gram 1) masu ɗauke da 325 mg na acetaminophen a kan kwayoyin Tylenol 4 na 500 mg (gram 2), jimilla gram 3 ce a yini. Idan za ka sake shan Tylenol, dole ne ka haɗa jimillar don kada ta wuce gram 4.
c-309.actionItem: Idan kana shan maganin mura a yau, ka duba yawan acetaminophen a jerin sinadaran kowane magani, ka rubuta jimillar yini, kuma ka tabbata ba ka wuce adadin da aka ba da shawara ba. Idan ba ka da tabbas, ka tambayi likitan magunguna.

c-310.title: A tafiya, sabulun shamfu da na kwandishan masu tauri suna kauce wa takunkumin ruwa
c-310.summary: Shamfu da kwandishan masu tauri ba ruwa ko gel ba ne, don haka ba su cikin iyakar mL 100 a cikin jirgi, kuma kayan tafiyarka suna yin sauƙi. A kamfanonin jirgi da ƙasashe da yawa, ba a ɗaukar sabulu mai tauri a matsayin ruwa.
c-310.principle: Ana yin su ne ta hanyar taurara surfactant (misali sodium cocoyl isethionate) ba tare da ruwa ba, don haka kusan ba su da ruwa a cikinsu. Dokar ruwa ta shafi ƙarar $V\le100\,\mathrm{mL}$ ne, don haka mai tauri ba ya cikinta, amma hukuncin ƙarshe na ma'aikacin bincike ne.
c-310.example: Kwalbar shamfu na ruwa ta mL 250 ba za a shigar da ita cikin jirgi ba saboda girman kwandon, amma shamfu mai tauri guda ɗaya (kimanin gram 50) yawanci ana iya amfani da shi sau 50 zuwa 80, kuma nauyinsa kusan 1/5 ne na kwalba ɗaya ta ruwa.
c-310.actionItem: Idan za ka yi tafiya a yau, ka sa shamfu da kwandishan masu tauri a kwandon da ruwa yake zubewa daga ciki, kuma kada ka saka su da jikakke; ka bar su su bushe sosai kafin ka tattara su. Dokoki sun bambanta bisa kamfanin jirgi da ƙasa, don haka ka tabbatar kafin tafiya.

c-311.title: Ka duba abubuwan mai da alamar trans fat a man shanu da margarine
c-311.summary: Man shanu da margarine suna da nau'ikan mai daban-daban, don haka ka kwatanta saturated fat da trans fat a jerin sinadaran abinci kafin ka zaɓa. Ba lallai ba ne margarine ya fi kyau ko ya fi muni; ya danganta da kowane samfuri.
c-311.principle: Idan aka ƙara hydrogen a cikin unsaturated fatty acid na man tsire-tsire, yana tauri, kuma wani ɓangare yana zama trans isomer: $\mathrm{C{=}C}+\mathrm{H_2}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{Ni}}\mathrm{C{-}C}$. A wannan hanyar taurarawa ta wani ɓangare, trans fat na iya samuwa.
c-311.example: Man shanu yana da kusan 80% mai, yawancinsa saturated fat (kimanin 50%), da ɗan trans fat na halitta kaɗan. Margarine na tsohon tsari da aka yi da mai da aka taurara a wani ɓangare yana da trans fat mai yawa, amma samfuran yanzu yawancinsu ba su kai gram 0.5 ba, kuma kason saturated fat ɗinsu ma yana da ƙasa.
c-311.actionItem: Idan za ka sayi man shanu ko margarine a yau, ka kwatanta saturated fat da trans fat a kowane abin da ake ci a lokaci ɗaya a jerin sinadaran, ka kuma duba ko 'partially hydrogenated oil' yana cikin sinadaran.

c-312.title: Ka karanta aikin sinadaran kafin ka yarda da tallan ƙarin man fetur
c-312.summary: Game da ƙarin man fetur, ka duba wane sinadari yake yin me, ba kalmomin talla ba. Sinadarin tsaftacewa da watsa yana wanke tarkace, amma babu tabbacin zai ƙara ingancin amfani da man sosai.
c-312.principle: Sinadarin tsaftacewa da watsa, wanda ƙwayoyin surfactant masu halaye biyu ne, yana kewaye tarkace (carbon) ya watsa su cikin man. Ana auna sauyin ingancin man da $\eta=\frac{\text{tazarar tafiya}}{\text{yawan mai}}$, kuma a injin da yake da tsabta, ƙarin yana da ƙanƙanta sosai.
c-312.example: Yawancin samfuran suna buƙatar zuba mL kaɗan a kowace lita 1, amma ƙarin ingancin man sau da yawa yana da iyaka, kusan 1 zuwa 2% a matsakaici. A mota mai 12 km/L, 2% yana nufin 12.24 km/L, kuma farashin kwalbar ƙari ta won 5,000 yana iya wahalar dawowa ta rage kuɗin mai.
c-312.actionItem: Idan za ka sayi ƙarin man fetur a yau, ka duba bayanin sinadaran da ke jikin kunshin (misali sinadarin tsaftacewa da watsa, mai ƙara lambar cetane) da nau'in mai da mota da ya dace, kuma ka duba ko adadin ingancin da aka tallata yana da wasu sharuɗɗa.

c-313.title: A takalmin fata, ka cika shi da mai ta hanyar kirim, ba kawai ka goge shi ya yi sheƙi ba
c-313.summary: Takalmin fata yana buƙatar a ƙara masa mai da kirim, ba kawai a goge shi ya yi sheƙi ba, don kada ya bushe ya tsattsage. Yana tsawaita rayuwarsa, don haka za ka tsira daga kashe kuɗin sabon takalmi.
c-313.principle: Fata tana yin laushi ne saboda lipid da ke cika tsakanin zaren collagen. Idan wannan lipid ya ragu saboda ƙafewa ko wanki, zaren suna goga juna, fata ta bushe ta tsattsage. Kirim yana cika wannan fanko da mai da kakin zuma.
c-313.example: Idan takalmin fata guda ɗaya yana kimanin won 150,000, kuma kana shafa masa kirim sau ɗaya a wata, rayuwarsa za ta iya ƙaruwa daga shekara 2 zuwa 3 zuwa shekara 5 ko fiye. A shekara-shekara, kuɗin takalmi yana raguwa zuwa kusan rabi. Kwano ɗaya na kirimin takalmi (kimanin won 5,000) yana isa takalmi da yawa.
c-313.actionItem: A yau, ka goge ƙurar takalmin fatarka da busasshiyar kyalle, sannan ka shafa ɗan kirimin takalmi siriri, bayan mintuna 5 ka goge shi da goga mai laushi ko kyalle.

c-314.title: Kayan lambu koraye suna zama rawaya idan ka sa vinegar
c-314.summary: Idan ka sa acid kamar vinegar ko ruwan lemun tsami lokacin da kake dafa kayan lambu koraye kamar alayyafo ko broccoli, koren launi mai kyau yana juyawa zuwa rawayar zaitun. Ka sa acid a ƙarshe ko ka yayyafa shi kafin ka ci.
c-314.principle: $\mathrm{H^+}$ na acid yana maye gurbin $\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}$ da ke tsakiyar chlorophyll, ya zama pheophytin: $\text{chlorophyll}+2\,\mathrm{H^+}\to\text{pheophytin}+\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}$. Pheophytin yana da launin rawaya mai ruwan ƙasa, don haka launin yana dushewa.
c-314.example: Idan ka dafa gram 100 na alayyafo a ruwan da aka zuba cokali ɗaya (mL 15) na vinegar, pH zai sauka daga kusan 7 zuwa kusan 4, launin kuma zai fara sauyawa cikin mintuna 5. Akasin haka, idan ka sa ɗan gishiri a ruwan tafasa ka dafa shi na ɗan lokaci kaɗan, koren launin zai daɗe.
c-314.actionItem: Idan za ka dafa kayan lambu koraye a yau, ka dafa su ba tare da rufe tukunya ba a ruwan tafasa na minti 1 zuwa 2 kawai, ka wanke su da ruwan sanyi, kuma ka yayyafa vinegar ko ruwan lemun tsami kafin ka ci.

c-315.title: Ka yi amfani da samfuran retinol da dare, kuma da rana ka sa man kariya daga rana
c-315.summary: Retinol yana lalacewa idan haske ya same shi, kuma yana iya sa fata ta fi jin hasken ultraviolet, don haka ka yi amfani da shi da dare kuma ka tabbata ka shafa man kariya daga rana da rana. Idan kana da juna biyu ko kana da cutar fata, ka fara tuntuɓar ƙwararre.
c-315.principle: Retinol yana rushewa a ƙarƙashin ultraviolet: $\text{retinol}\xrightarrow{h\nu}\text{abubuwan da suka rushe}$. Bugu da ƙari, saman fata yana yin sirara, sabuwar fata kuma tana fitowa, don haka ja (erythema) yana iya zuwa da sauƙi ko da adadin ultraviolet iri ɗaya ne.
c-315.example: Ana fara da retinol mai ƙaramin ƙarfi (0.1 zuwa 0.3%) sau 2 zuwa 3 a mako, kuma da rana yawanci ana shafa man kariya daga rana na SPF 30 ko fiye kusan 2 mg/cm². SPF 30 yana toshe kusan 97% na ultraviolet B.
c-315.actionItem: A daren yau, bayan ka wanke fuska ka yi amfani da retinol, kuma gobe da safe ka shafa man kariya daga rana na SPF 30 ko fiye. Idan kana jin kunci ko ja sosai, ka rage amfani kuma ka tuntuɓi likita.

c-316.title: Dalilin da ya sa shinkafar retort mai shirin ci take daɗewa a yanayin ɗaki
c-316.summary: Shinkafa mai shirin ci tana daɗewa a yanayin ɗaki saboda bayan an rufe ta sosai, ana kashe ƙwayoyin cuta da zafi da matsi mai yawa, kusan duka su ƙare. Kafin ka buɗe, ana iya adana ta a yanayin ɗaki, don haka tana da kyau a matsayin abincin gaggawa na tafiya.
c-316.principle: Kashe ƙwayoyin cuta ta retort yana amfani da kusan 120°C tare da matsi don kashe har da spores na ƙwayoyin cuta masu jure zafi. Ana ƙididdige lokacin kashewa da $F=D_T\,\log\frac{N_0}{N}$, kuma saboda an rufe ta babu iskar oxygen, ƙwayoyin cuta masu bukatar iska ba sa girma.
c-316.example: Ana kashe ƙwayoyin cuta na shinkafa mai shirin ci guda ɗaya (gram 210) a kusan 120°C na mintuna 20 zuwa 30, kuma yawanci ana adana ta a yanayin ɗaki na watanni 6 zuwa 12. Kafin buɗewa ana iya adana ta a yanayin ɗaki, amma bayan buɗewa dole ne a ci ta nan da nan ko a saka ta a firiji.
c-316.actionItem: Idan kana tattara kayan tafiya a yau, ka ɗauki shinkafa mai shirin ci a matsayin abincin gaggawa, kuma ka zubar da wadda murfinta ya kumbura ko marufinta yake zubowa, kada ka ci ta. Idan za ka dumama a microwave, ka bi umarnin da ke jikin kwanon.

c-317.title: Madadin sukari kamar allulose da erythritol suna da zaƙi da halaye daban-daban
c-317.summary: Madadin sukari kamar allulose, erythritol, da xylitol suna da zaƙi, kalori, da tasiri a narkewar abinci daban-daban, don haka ka zaɓi bisa amfani. Idan ka ci da yawa, cikinka na iya yin rashin daɗi, don haka ka fara da ɗan kaɗan.
c-317.principle: Sugar alcohol da rare sugar suna da tsarin ƙwayoyi daban-daban, don haka shan su cikin jini da kalori sun bambanta. Misali, yawancin erythritol ($\mathrm{C_4H_{10}O_4}$) ana sha shi sannan a fitar da shi cikin fitsari, don haka kaloriyarsa kusan sifili ce, kuma idan yana narkewa yana shan zafi ($\Delta H_{\mathrm{sol}}>0$), don haka yana ba da jin sanyi.
c-317.example: Gram 1 na sukari yana da kusan 4 kcal, amma erythritol yana da kusan 0 zuwa 0.2 kcal/g, allulose kuma kusan 0.4 kcal/g. Idan zaƙin sukari 1 ne, erythritol yana kusan 0.7 kuma allulose kusan 0.7. Idan za ka yi amfani da su maimakon sukari, sai ka daidaita adadin.
c-317.actionItem: Idan za ka sayi madadin sukari a yau, ka duba nau'insa (allulose, erythritol, da sauransu) da kalori a kowane abin da ake ci a lokaci ɗaya a jerin sinadaran, ka fara da kusan gram 10 a yini, ka kuma lura da yadda jikinka yake mayar da martani.

c-318.title: Ruwa baƙi a bututun dumama shi ne laka ta ƙarfe da ya yi tsatsa
c-318.summary: Idan ruwan da aka zubar daga bututun dumama baƙi ne, yana iya zama laka (magnetite) da ƙarfen bututun ya yi tsatsa ya samar, kuma idan ta taru, canja zafi yana lalacewa. Ka yi la'akari da kiran kamfanin boiler ya tsaftace bututu ya kuma duba ƙarin rigakafin tsatsa.
c-318.principle: A cikin ruwan zafi wanda kusan babu oxygen a ciki, ƙarfe yana yin tsatsa a hankali: $3\,\mathrm{Fe}+4\,\mathrm{H_2O}\to\mathrm{Fe_3O_4}+4\,\mathrm{H_2}$. Magnetite ($\mathrm{Fe_3O_4}$) da aka samar yana taruwa a matsayin baƙin foda, yana ƙara hana canja zafi.
c-318.example: Idan laka ta taru da kauri na mm 1 a cikin bututu da radiator, canja zafi na iya raguwa da wasu kaso kaɗan, boiler zai daɗe yana aiki, kuma kuɗin mai na iya ƙaruwa da kusan 5 zuwa 10%. Tsaftace bututu yawanci yana kashe dubban dubbai na won, amma ana iya dawo da shi ta rage kuɗin dumama da tsawaita rayuwar na'ura.
c-318.actionItem: A yau, ka duba tarihin tsaftace bututun dumama; idan ba a yi ba tsawon shekaru da yawa, ka tambayi kamfanin boiler ya duba. Kada ka wargaza bututu da kanka, kada kuma ka taɓa ruwan da aka zubar da hannu.

c-319.title: Konewar daskarewa alama ce ta ruwan da ya ƙafe daga wurin da iska ta taɓa
c-319.summary: Wuraren fari da busassu a nama ko kayan lambu da aka daɗe a injin daskarewa konewar daskarewa ne; ba su da lahani ga ci, amma suna taurin kai kuma ɗanɗano yana ragewa. Ana iya hana su ta hanyar fitar da iska da rufe sosai.
c-319.principle: A lokacin daskarewa, ƙanƙarar da ke saman tana tashi kai tsaye zuwa tururi ba tare da ta zama ruwa ba, don haka ruwa yana ƙarewa: $\mathrm{H_2O(s)}\to\mathrm{H_2O(g)}$. Busasshen saman yana taɓa iska, mai ya yi oxidation, kuma ɗanɗanon ya lalace.
c-319.example: Nama da aka bar a injin daskarewa na -18°C ba tare da marufi ba, cikin 'yan makonni ruwan saman yana raguwa da wasu kaso kaɗan, ya bushe ya yi fari. Idan ka fitar da iska da vacuum ko jakar zipper, ingancinsa yana daɗewa na watanni 3 zuwa 6 ko fiye, kuma kuɗin abincin da ake zubarwa (won dubbai a wata ko fiye) yana raguwa.
c-319.actionItem: A yau, ka saka nama ko kayan lambu da za ka daskarar a jakar zipper bisa adadin cin abinci ɗaya, ka fitar da iska gwargwadon iko, ka rufe, ka rubuta kwanan wata. Ka yanke wuraren da konewar daskarewa ta riga ta shafa, ka yi amfani da sauran a miya ko stew.

c-320.title: Ka fara narkar da garin curry da miya a ruwan sanyi don kada ya yi gudaji
c-320.summary: Idan ka zuba garin curry ko miya kai tsaye a romo mai zafi, saman kawai yake dahuwa, ya yi gudaji. Ka fara narkar da shi a ruwan sanyi ko ɗumi sannan ka zuba, ko ka kashe wuta ka haɗa a hankali kaɗan-kaɗan.
c-320.principle: Idan ƙwayoyin sitaci suka haɗu da ruwan zafi, saman yana yin gelatinization da farko ya samar da fim mai ɗaɗɗaɗa, kuma wannan fim yana hana ruwa isa ga garin da ke ciki. Gelatinization yana farawa a kusan 60 zuwa 70°C, kuma yana faruwa da farko a saman da $T>T_{\mathrm{gel}}$.
c-320.example: Idan ka zuba gram 100 na garin curry gaba ɗaya a romo mai 90°C, saman yana yin gelatinization, gudaji masu diamita na mm kaɗan suna samuwa; amma idan ka fara narkar da shi a mL 200 na ruwa mai 20 zuwa 30°C sannan ka zuba, ƙwayoyin suna yaɗuwa daidai kuma kusan babu gudaji.
c-320.actionItem: Idan za ka yi curry ko miya a yau, ka fara narkar da garin a ruwan sanyi ka tace shi da matata, ko ka kashe wuta ka zuba a hankali kaɗan-kaɗan kana juyawa, sannan ka sake tafasa shi a ƙaramar wuta.

c-321.title: A AHA da BHA masu cire matacciyar fata, pH da yawan sinadari su ne mabuɗi
c-321.summary: A acid masu cire matacciyar fata, pH da yawan samfurin ne ke ƙayyade tasiri da fushin fata, ba sunan sinadarin ba. Ko samfuri mai sauƙi yana iya zama mai fusata sosai idan pH ɗinsa ya yi ƙasa.
c-321.principle: Acid yana ionization bisa $\mathrm{pH} = \mathrm{p}K_a + \log\frac{[\mathrm{A^-}]}{[\mathrm{HA}]}$, kuma abin da yake aiki a fata shi ne free acid ($\mathrm{HA}$) wanda bai rabu ba. Idan pH ya yi ƙasa da $\mathrm{p}K_a$, kason free acid yana ƙaruwa.
c-321.example: Samfurin glycolic acid ($\mathrm{p}K_a$ kusan 3.83) na 10% yana da free acid 50% a pH 3.83, kuma a pH 3.0 yana ƙaruwa zuwa kusan 87%, fushi yana ƙaruwa. Ana amfani da salicylic acid ($\mathrm{p}K_a$ kusan 2.97) galibi a kusa da pH 3 zuwa 4.
c-321.actionItem: Idan za ka yi amfani da mai cire matacciyar fata a yau, ka duba nau'in acid, yawansa, da pH na samfurin, ka fara da sau 2 a mako ko ƙasa, kuma ka shafa man kariya daga rana washegari.

c-322.title: Ana hana shigar da durian otal saboda wari
c-322.summary: Dalilin da ya sa ake hana durian a otal-otal da jigilar jama'a ba guba ba ne, sai warinsa wanda ake ji da ƙarfi ko da kaɗan ne.
c-322.principle: Ester ($\mathrm{RCOOH + R'OH \rightleftharpoons RCOOR' + H_2O}$) da mahaɗan sulfur (thiol $\mathrm{R{-}SH}$) suna da iyakar jin wari a matakin ppb, don haka ana iya jin su ko da kaɗan ne ƙwarai.
c-322.example: 1 ppb yana nufin kashi ɗaya cikin biliyan ɗaya na ƙara, don haka a ɗaki mai m³ 30 yana daidai da kimanin mL 0.03 na iskar gas. Saboda haka idan ka bar shi da bawonsa, wari yana zama a ɗakin gaba ɗaya da kuma a matatar na'urar sanyaya.
c-322.actionItem: Kafin tafiya Kudu maso Gabashin Asiya, ka duba sanarwar hana shigar da abinci a masaukinka, kuma ka ci durian a shago mai marufi ko a waje.

c-323.title: A cikin man shafawa mai danshi, ceramide, glycerin, da mai suna da ayyuka daban-daban
c-323.summary: Mai shafawa mai kyau yana ɗauke da sinadaran da ke jawo ruwa, da waɗanda ke cike giɓi, da waɗanda ke hana ƙafewa, a lokaci guda.
c-323.principle: Humectant (glycerin) yana jawo ruwa, emollient (kamar ceramide) yana cike giɓin matacciyar fata, occlusive (Vaseline) kuma yana hana ruwa ƙafewa. Ana bayyana motsin ruwa da $J = -D\frac{\Delta C}{\Delta x}$.
c-323.example: Yawanci ana amfani da glycerin na 5 zuwa 10%, kuma an san Vaseline yana rage asarar ruwa ta fata da fiye da 90%. Idan duka abubuwa uku suna ciki, yana daɗewa a lokacin sanyi mai bushewa fiye da samfurin da yake da ɗaya kawai.
c-323.actionItem: A yau, ka duba ko glycerin, ceramide, da mai (ko Vaseline) suna cikin jerin sinadaran man shafawarka, kuma ka shafa shi cikin mintuna 3 bayan wanka.

c-324.title: Ka duba creosote a bututun hayaƙin murhu da na wuta kowace shekara
c-324.summary: Idan kwalta a cikin hayaƙin itace ta taru ta tsaya a bangon bututun hayaƙi, tana iya haddasa gobarar bututun hayaƙi, don haka dole ne a duba kowace shekara.
c-324.principle: Tururin kwalta da kuma ƙurar hayaƙi da ƙonewa maras cikawa ya samar suna taruwa a bangon bututun hayaƙi mai sanyi su zama creosote. Idan oxygen ya yi ƙaranci kamar a $\mathrm{C_xH_y + O_2 \to C + CO + H_2O}$, abubuwan da ba su ƙone ba suna ƙaruwa.
c-324.example: NFPA 211 ta Amurka tana ba da shawarar a tsaftace bututun hayaƙi idan abin da ya taru a bangonsa ya kai kimanin mm 3 (1/8 inch). Itace mai danshi sama da 20% tana rage zafin ƙonewa, tana sa tarin ya yi sauri.
c-324.actionItem: A yau, ka duba ko danshin itacen wuta bai wuce 20% ba, wato ya bushe sosai, kuma ka tsara ƙwararre ya duba ya tsaftace bututun hayaƙi.

c-325.title: Idan ka ajiye man shanu kusa da abinci mai wari mai ƙarfi, warin yana shiga
c-325.summary: Man shanu yana da kusan 80% mai, don haka yana narkar da ƙwayoyin wari kamar na kimchi ko kifi ya sha su sosai.
c-325.principle: Mai ba shi da polarity, don haka yana narkar da ƙwayoyin wari masu tashi marasa polarity sosai. Ma'aunin rabawa shi ne $K = \frac{C_{\mathrm{fat}}}{C_{\mathrm{water}}}$, kuma idan $\log K = 3$, yawan da ke gefen mai ya ninka na ruwa sau 1,000.
c-325.example: A cikin gram 200 na man shanu, mai yana kusan gram 160. Idan ka bar shi ba murfi kusa da kimchi na kwanaki kaɗan, warin zai shiga, ka kuma zubar da man shanu mai tsada.
c-325.actionItem: A yau, ka saka man shanu a kwandon da ke rufe sosai bisa marufinsa na asali, ka ajiye shi a wuri nesa da abinci mai wari mai ƙarfi.

c-326.title: Dalilin da ya sa gilashin shan ruwa yake yin hazo a na'urar wanke kwano
c-326.summary: Dalilin hazon na iya zama ƙazantar ruwa mai tauri ko kuma gogewar saman gilashi. Idan ka tsoma shi a vinegar, za ka iya bambance su.
c-326.principle: Idan aka yi amfani da ruwa mai laushi da sabulu mai alkali a zafi mai yawa, raga na silicate na gilashi yana narkewa, saman yana tsatsa (etching). $\mathrm{SiO_2 + 2OH^- \to SiO_3^{2-} + H_2O}$
c-326.example: Etching ba ya komawa, amma fim ɗin lime na ruwa mai tauri yana ɓacewa idan ka tsoma shi a farin vinegar na mintuna 5. Idan ka rage yawan sabulu kuma ka yi amfani da shirin tattalin na kusan 55°C, etching yana raguwa.
c-326.actionItem: A yau, ka tsoma kofin da yake da hazo a farin vinegar na mintuna 5 don ka tabbatar ko ƙazanta ce, kuma ka zuba sabulu daidai adadin da aka ba da shawara a umarni kawai.

c-327.title: Ka sauya mascara bayan watanni 3 zuwa 6
c-327.summary: Ana amfani da mascara kusa da ido, kuma duk lokacin da aka buɗe shi iska tana shiga, ƙwayoyin cuta suna ƙaruwa cikin sauƙi, don haka ya fi kyau a sauya shi cikin watanni 3 zuwa 6 bayan buɗewa.
c-327.principle: Bayan buɗewa, abin kiyayewa yana ƙarewa a hankali, ƙwayoyin cuta kuma suna ƙaruwa kamar $N = N_0\,2^{t/t_d}$. Duk lokacin da aka saka goga aka ciro, iska tana shiga, bushewa da gurɓata suna faruwa tare.
c-327.example: A yanayi mafi kyau, idan ƙwayoyin cuta suna ninkawa kowane minti 20, bayan awa 6 za su zama $2^{18}$, wato kusan sau 260,000. Idan idonka yana ƙaiƙayi ko ya yi ja, ka fara zargin mascara da ka daɗe kana amfani da shi.
c-327.actionItem: A yau, ka rubuta kwanan watan buɗewa a kwandon mascara, kuma idan ya wuce watanni 3, ka sauya shi da sabo.

c-328.title: Shinkafar ƙasashen waje tana da amylose daban, don haka ɗanɗanon abinci yana bambanta
c-328.summary: Shinkafar da kake ci a ƙasashen waje, ko ta zama mai tsattsagewa ko mai ɗaurewa, yana faruwa ne saboda bambancin rabon amylose da amylopectin a cikin shinkafar.
c-328.principle: Idan amylose (madaidaiciya) ya yi yawa, ƙwayoyin shinkafa suna rabuwa kuma su yi tauri; idan amylopectin (mai rassa) ya yi yawa, ɗaurewa yana ƙaruwa. $\text{Amylose \%} = \frac{m_{\mathrm{amylose}}}{m_{\mathrm{amylose}}+m_{\mathrm{amylopectin}}}\times 100$
c-328.example: Shinkafa mai gajeren ƙwaya ta Koriya da Japan tana da amylose na kusan 17 zuwa 20%, indica mai tsawon ƙwaya kusan 22 zuwa 28%, kuma shinkafa mai ɗaurewa (glutinous) kusan 0%. Shinkafa mai tsawon ƙwaya yawanci tana buƙatar ruwa ninki 1.5 zuwa 2 na ƙarar shinkafar.
c-328.actionItem: A yau, ka duba alamar ƙwaya gajeru, matsakaici, ko dogo a jakar shinkafa, ka dafa shinkafar bisa rabon ruwan da aka rubuta a jakar.

c-329.title: A wankin baki, ka duba rashin alcohol da sinadarin CPC
c-329.summary: Ka zaɓi wankin baki bisa sinadari mai kashe ƙwayoyin cuta (CPC) da ko yana ɗauke da alcohol. Alcohol na iya bushar da baki.
c-329.principle: CPC (cetylpyridinium chloride) cationic surfactant ne wanda yake mannewa a bangon ƙwayoyin cuta masu cajin lantarki mara kyau, ya lalata bangon. Ana bayyana jan hankalin da $F = k\frac{q_1 q_2}{r^2}$.
c-329.example: Samfuran CPC yawanci suna da ƙarfi na 0.05 zuwa 0.07%, kuma a wankin baki ɗaya na mL 20 akwai kusan mg 10 zuwa 14. Wasu samfuran suna da ethanol sama da 20%, don haka masu bushewar baki sun fi samun sauƙi da waɗanda ba su da alcohol.
c-329.actionItem: A yau, ka duba CPC da ethanol a jerin sinadaran wankin bakinka, ka wanke bakin na daƙiƙa 30, sannan ka tofa, kada ka haɗiye.

c-330.title: Warin silicone caulking a firam ɗin taga acetic acid ne da ke fita yayin taurara
c-330.summary: Warin caulking kamar vinegar yana faruwa ne saboda acetic acid yana fita yayin da silicone yake tauri, kuma yana raguwa idan taurarawa ta ƙare.
c-330.principle: Acetoxy silicone yana amsawa da danshin iska ya saki acetic acid yayin da yake haɗuwa (cross-link). $\mathrm{R{-}Si(OCOCH_3)_3 + 3H_2O \to R{-}Si(OH)_3 + 3CH_3COOH}$
c-330.example: Saman yawanci yana tauri cikin mintuna 10 zuwa 30, kuma kauri na mm 3 yana ɗaukar kimanin awa 24 kafin ya taurara gaba ɗaya. Acetic acid na iya cinye ƙarfe da marmara, don haka a irin waɗannan wurare silicone na tsaka-tsaki (neutral) ya dace.
c-330.actionItem: Idan ka yi aikin a yau, ka buɗe taga ka bar iska ta shiga na awa 24, kuma don ƙarfe da dutse ka zaɓi silicone na tsaka-tsaki.

c-331.title: Idan man zaitun ya yi hazo ya taurara a firiji, ba yana nufin ya lalace ba
c-331.summary: Man zaitun da ya yi hazo ya taurara a firiji bai lalace ba; maiƙar ce ta yi crystallization, kuma idan ka bar shi a yanayin ɗaki yana sake bayyana.
c-331.principle: Unsaturated fatty acid ma suna zama lu'ulu'u a ƙasa da wurin narkewarsu. Ana ƙayyade zafin narkewa da $T_m = \frac{\Delta H}{\Delta S}$, kuma man zaitun yana fara yin hazo a ƙasa da kusan 5 zuwa 10°C.
c-331.example: A firiji na 4°C yana yin hazo ya taurara, amma idan ka bar shi a yanayin ɗaki na 20 zuwa 25°C na minti 30 zuwa awa 1, yana sake bayyana. Don hana oxidation, man zaitun ya fi kyau a ajiye a yanayin ɗaki mai duhu da sanyi fiye da firiji.
c-331.actionItem: A yau, man zaitun da ya yi hazo ya taurara, ka bar shi a yanayin ɗaki na minti 30 ya narke maimakon microwave, kuma daga yanzu ka ajiye shi a kabad mai duhu.

c-332.title: A yin caramel, ana narkar da sukari ba tare da juyawa ba
c-332.summary: Dalilin da ya sa ba a juya sukari yayin yin caramel shi ne don a hana lu'ulu'un sukari sake samuwa a jere.
c-332.principle: Idan ƙwayar sukari ɗaya ta zama iri, maganin da ke kewaye yana crystallization a jere. A 160°C ko fiye, hydrolysis da dehydration suna faruwa, sukarin ya yi launin ruwan kasa. $\mathrm{C_{12}H_{22}O_{11} + H_2O \to C_6H_{12}O_6 + C_6H_{12}O_6}$
c-332.example: Idan ka zuba mL 50 na ruwa a gram 200 na sukari ka tafasa, a kusan 170 zuwa 180°C bayan mintuna 5 zuwa 10 yana zama caramel mai launin zinariya. Caramel a wannan zafi na iya ƙone ka idan ya fantsama.
c-332.actionItem: Idan za ka yi caramel a yau, kada ka juya da cokali; ka karkaɗa kaskon don ya haɗu, kuma ka wanke lu'ulu'un da ke bangon tukunya da goga mai ɗan ruwa.

c-333.title: Idan fata ta yi ja saboda kayan ado na ƙarfe, yana iya zama rashin lafiya ga nickel
c-333.summary: Idan fatarka ta yi ja kuma tana ƙaiƙayi a wurin 'yan kunne ko maɗaurin agogo, yana iya zama saboda nickel da ke cikin ƙarfen. Ka je asibitin fata don ganewa.
c-333.principle: Nickel na ƙarfe yana yin oxidation da gumi ya narke ya zama ions. $\mathrm{Ni \to Ni^{2+} + 2e^-}$ Idan waɗannan ions suka haɗu da sunadaran fata, contact dermatitis na iya faruwa.
c-333.example: EU ta sa iyakar sakin nickel na kayan da suke taɓa fata na dogon lokaci a $0.5\ \mu\mathrm{g/cm^2}$ a mako. An san cewa kusan mutum 1 cikin 10 yana da rashin lafiya ga nickel.
c-333.actionItem: A yau, ka duba alamar 'nickel free' a kayan adon da ke sa ka ƙaiƙayi akai-akai, kuma idan alamomin suka ci gaba, ka je likitan fata.

c-334.title: Yaji na wasabi yana fitowa ne idan an niƙa shi, kuma yana ɓacewa da sauri
c-334.summary: Yajin wasabi na ainihi yana samuwa idan an niƙa shi sel suka fashe, kuma yana tashi da sauri don mai iya tashi ne.
c-334.principle: Idan sel sun fashe, enzyme myrosinase yana rushe glycoside sinigrin ya samar da allyl isothiocyanate mai yaji. $\mathrm{C_{10}H_{16}KNO_9S_2 + H_2O \to C_4H_5NS + C_6H_{12}O_6 + KHSO_4}$
c-334.example: Yajin yana da ƙarfi mafi girma cikin mintuna kaɗan bayan niƙawa, kuma cikin mintuna 15 zuwa 30 yana raguwa sosai. Wasabi na bututu galibi horseradish ne babban sinadarinsa.
c-334.actionItem: Idan za ka yi amfani da sabon wasabi a yau, ka niƙa shi da grater kafin ka ci kuma ka rufe shi, kuma don samfurin bututu ka duba sunayen sinadaran.

c-335.title: Yawan kumfa a sabulun wanke kwano ba yana nufin ƙarfin tsaftacewa ba
c-335.summary: Yawan kumfa da iya goge ƙazantar mai abubuwa ne daban-daban. Kumfa na iya zama saboda abin daidaita kumfa.
c-335.principle: Surfactant yana samar da micelle a sama da critical micelle concentration (CMC) ya kewaye mai. Tashin hankalin sama yana raguwa har zuwa CMC, bayan haka kusan baya canzawa.
c-335.example: CMC na SDS kusan 8.2 mM ne, wato kimanin gram 2.4 a kowace lita 1 na ruwa. Idan ka ƙara sabulu bayan wannan adadi, ƙarfin tsaftacewa ba ya ƙaruwa sosai, wankewa kawai yana wahala.
c-335.actionItem: A yau, ka yi amfani da sabulun wanke kwano ɗan kaɗan kamar ƙwayar wake, kuma ka yanke hukunci bisa ko mai ya fita, ba yawan kumfa ba.

c-336.title: Rigar ciki mai ɗumi kamar Heattech tana ba da zafi saboda danshin gumi yana mannewa a zaren
c-336.summary: Rigar ciki mai ɗumi tana da ɗumi saboda idan tururin da jiki ya fitar ya manne a zaren, zafi yana fitowa; tasirinta ba babba ba ne kuma ba ya daɗewa.
c-336.principle: Idan tururin ruwa ya manne a zaren, ana sakin zafi kamar na condensation. $Q = m\,L$, kuma zafin condensation na ruwa $L$ kusan $2.26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$ ne.
c-336.example: Idan gram 10 na danshi ya manne, har kusan kJ 23 na zafi na iya fitowa, amma idan zaren ya cika, yana tsayawa. Idan gumi ya yi yawa ya jiƙe, zafi yana ɓacewa, kuma sai ka ƙara jin sanyi.
c-336.actionItem: A yau, ka sa siririn tufa a kan rigar ciki mai ɗumi, kuma idan gumi ya fito, ka cire layi ɗaya don kada ka jiƙe.

c-337.title: Kwalaben PET sai a raba lakabi da murfi domin su zama kayan sake sarrafawa
c-337.summary: Ka cire lakabin kwalbar PET ka kurkure kafin ka zubar domin kada ta gauraya da sauran robobi, ta zama kyakkyawan kayan sake sarrafawa.
c-337.principle: A sake sarrafawa, ana raba PET da yake nutsewa a ruwa da PP da PE da suke yin ruwa ta bambancin yawa $\rho = \frac{m}{V}$ sannan a narkar. PET yana narkewa a kusan 250°C, PP a kusan 165°C, PE kuma a kusan 110 zuwa 130°C.
c-337.example: Yawan PET kusan 1.38 g/cm³ ne, kuma PP da PE kusan 0.9 g/cm³, don haka suna rabuwa a cikin ruwa. Idan kwalba ta mL 500 mai nauyin kusan gram 20 ta gauraya da murfi na kusan gram 2, ƙazanta ta kai 10%.
c-337.actionItem: A yau, ka zubar da abin da ke cikin kwalbar PET, ka kurkure, ka cire lakabi, ka saka a akwatin tattara kwalbar PET mai bayyana.

c-338.title: Meringue ba zai tashi ba ko da digon mai ɗaya ya shiga
c-338.summary: Mafi yawan dalilin da meringue ba ya tashi shi ne mai da ya shafi kwano ko farin ƙwai.
c-338.principle: Sunadaran farin ƙwai suna shimfiɗa a iyakar iska da ruwa su samar da fim da ke riƙe kumfa. Mai yana zama a wannan fim tun da farko ya hana samuwar fim ɗin. Bambancin matsi a cikin kumfa da waje shi ne $\Delta P = \frac{4\gamma}{r}$.
c-338.example: Farin ƙwai 3 (kimanin gram 100) kusan 90% ruwa ne, sunadaran kuma kusan 10%, amma kusan 30% na gwaiduwa mai ne, don haka ko digo ɗaya ya shiga, ƙarar tana raguwa sosai. Kwanon roba yana iya zama da mai a cikinsa cikin sauƙi.
c-338.actionItem: Idan za ka yi meringue a yau, ka goge kwanon gilashi ko na bakin ƙarfe (stainless steel) da vinegar ko ruwan lemun tsami, kuma ka raba farin ƙwai daban ɗaya-ɗaya kafin ka zuba.

c-339.title: Kafin rina furfura, ka yi gwajin faci kwana biyu a gaba
c-339.summary: Rashin lafiya ga rini na iya fara faruwa farat ɗaya, don haka ya fi kyau a yi gwajin faci a bayan kunne ko cikin hannu sa'o'i 48 kafin rinawa.
c-339.principle: Rini masu oxidation kamar para-phenylenediamine (PPD) idan suka haɗu da hydrogen peroxide suna samar da abubuwan tsaka-tsaki masu saurin amsawa, waɗanda suke haɗuwa da sunadaran fata su haddasa rashin lafiya. $\mathrm{C_6H_4(NH_2)_2 \xrightarrow{H_2O_2} \text{abin tsaka-tsaki mai saurin amsawa}}$
c-339.example: EU ta iyakance PPD da ake shafawa a kai zuwa mafi yawa 2% bayan haɗawa. Ka shafa ɗan kaɗan wanda bai fi girman tsabar kuɗi ta won 500 ba, ka lura na sa'o'i 48, kuma idan akwai ja, ƙaiƙayi, ko kumburi, kada ka yi rinawa.
c-339.actionItem: Idan kana da shirin rinawa, ka yi gwajin faci kwana biyu a gaba ta hanyar shafa ɗan kaɗan a bayan kunne; idan alamomi sun bayyana, kada ka yi amfani da shi, kuma idan sun yi tsanani, ka je asibiti.

c-340.title: Proof a kwalbar giya ta ƙasashen waje ninki biyu ne na adadin alcohol
c-340.summary: Proof na kwalbar giya ta Amurka ninki biyu ne na yawan alcohol (ABV), don haka 80 proof yana nufin 40%.
c-340.principle: Tsarin Amurka shi ne $\text{proof} = 2 \times \text{ABV}$. Tsohon proof na Biritaniya yana da ma'auni daban, 100 proof ya kai kusan 57.15%, don haka dole ne a duba a kowace ƙasa.
c-340.example: A cikin mL 45 (1.5 oz) na whiskey mai 80 proof, ethanol yana $45 \times 0.40 = 18\ \mathrm{mL}$, kimanin gram 14.2, wanda yake kofi 1 a ma'aunin Amurka. 100 proof (50%) a adadin iri ɗaya yana da kimanin gram 17.8.
c-340.actionItem: A yau, ka raba proof na kwalbar giya ta ƙasashen waje da 2 don ka lissafa adadin alcohol, ka rubuta abin da ka sha don kada ka sha da yawa.

c-341.title: A matatar ruwa, activated carbon da membrane na reverse osmosis suna tace abubuwa daban-daban
