c-341.summary: Activated carbon yana tace sinadarai masu rai kamar chlorine da wari, reverse osmosis kuma yana tace galibi ions da suka narke a ruwa. Kafin ka zaɓa, ka tantance abin da kake son tacewa.
c-341.principle: Activated carbon yana ɗaukar abubuwa a samansa (adsorption), kuma reverse osmosis yana sa matsi da ya fi osmotic pressure $\pi = iMRT$ don ruwa kawai ya wuce ta membrane mai zaɓi.
c-341.example: Osmotic pressure na NaCl 500 mg/L (kimanin 8.6 mmol/L) a 25°C kusan 0.42 atm ne. Reverse osmosis na gida yawanci yana sa matsi na 3 zuwa 4 bar don cire yawancin ions.
c-341.actionItem: A yau, ka duba lokacin canza matatar ruwanka, kuma ka tabbatar da aikin cire abubuwan da kake so ta alamar shaidar hukuma.

c-342.title: Dalilin da gas mantle na fitilar zango yake haske shi ne oxide na rare earth
c-342.summary: Haske mai ƙarfi na fitilar gas ba daga harshen wuta yake ba, sai daga mantle na oxide na rare earth wanda zafin harshen wuta ya ƙona shi.
c-342.principle: Idan mantle na oxide ya yi zafi zuwa kusan 2,000 K, yana fitar da radiation zuwa gefen haske mai gani. Tsawon raƙuman radiation mafi girma shi ne $\lambda_{\max} T = 2898\ \mu\mathrm{m\cdot K}$.
c-342.example: A 2,000 K, $\lambda_{\max}$ kusan 1.45 μm ne. Mantle na yttrium oxide da cerium yana da babban kaso na haske mai gani, don haka da mai iri ɗaya yana haske fiye da harshen wuta kawai. Tsoffin mantle sun yi amfani da thorium oxide mai radiation.
c-342.actionItem: A yau, ka fara ƙona sabon mantle a waje don ya taurara, kada ka taɓa tokarsa, kuma ka duba alamar 'thorium free'.

c-343.title: Kofin takarda ba a sake sarrafa shi kamar takarda ta yau da kullun saboda rufin polyethylene a ciki
c-343.summary: Kofin takarda yana da fim ɗin roba don hana ruwa, don haka idan ka saka shi a akwatin takarda na yau da kullun, sake sarrafawa yana wahala.
c-343.principle: Polyethylene (PE) da ke cikin kofin takarda ba ya narkewa a ruwa kuma yana yin ruwa saboda yawansa $\rho \approx 0.92\ \mathrm{g/cm^3}$, don haka yana da wahala a raba shi da zaren a tsarin pulping.
c-343.example: Kofin takarda ɗaya yana kusan gram 10, kuma rufin PE yana da kusan 5%. Idan ba tsari na musamman ba, wannan rufi na iya sa dukkan takardar ta rasa ingancin sake sarrafawa.
c-343.actionItem: A yau, ka ɗauki tumbler naka, kuma idan dole ne ka yi amfani da kofin takarda, ka duba ƙa'idar raba shara ta yankinka ka tara su daban.

c-344.title: Sai an sanyaya kirim sosai ne zai yi tauri idan aka busa shi
c-344.summary: Kirim yana tsayawa da tauri idan ya yi sanyi sosai, amma idan yana ɗumi, ko da kana juyawa yadda kake so ba zai tashi ba.
c-344.principle: Idan yana sanyi, mai da ke cikin ƙwayoyin mai ya yi crystallization, don haka a lokacin bugawa ƙwayoyin mai suna haɗuwa a wani ɓangare su samar da raga da ke kewaye kumfar iska. Idan mai ya narke, ba a samar da wannan raga.
c-344.example: Idan ka buga mL 200 na kirim mai ƙitsen madara sama da 35% a 4°C, cikin mintuna 3 zuwa 5 ƙarar ta ninka kusan sau 2. A 20°C ko fiye ba ya tashi da kyau, kuma idan ka daɗe kana juyawa, yana rabuwa zuwa man shanu da ruwan madara.
c-344.actionItem: A yau, kafin buga kirim, ka sanyaya kirim da kwano na fiye da mintuna 10, kuma da zarar kololuwa ya tsaya, ka dakata nan da nan.

c-345.title: Kada ka daɗe kana riƙe peroxide na man haƙori mai farar da haƙori
c-345.summary: Peroxide da ke cikin man haƙori ko strips masu farar da haƙori na iya fusata gumi, don haka ka yi amfani da su na lokacin da aka ƙayyade kawai.
c-345.principle: Hydrogen peroxide yana yin oxidation da rushe ƙwayoyin launi ya saki oxygen. $2\mathrm{H_2O_2} \to 2\mathrm{H_2O} + \mathrm{O_2}$ Wannan saurin amsawa yana iya fusata mucosa ma.
c-345.example: EU ta iyakance hydrogen peroxide a man haƙori na yau da kullun zuwa 0.1% ko ƙasa, kuma samfuran farar da haƙori na 0.1 zuwa 6% a yi amfani da su ƙarƙashin kulawar likitan haƙori. Idan ba ka kiyaye lokaci ba, ka daɗe kana riƙe shi, fusata gumi da jin sanyi a haƙora suna ƙaruwa.
c-345.actionItem: A yau, ka yi amfani da samfurin farar da haƙori na lokacin da aka rubuta a umarni kawai, kuma idan gumi yana yi maka zafi, ka dakata ka tuntuɓi likitan haƙori.

c-346.title: Kada ka sha ruwan dusar ƙanƙara da aka narkar kai tsaye
c-346.summary: Ko da dusar ƙanƙara ta yi kama da tsabta, tana tara gurɓatattun abubuwa da ƙwayoyin cuta daga iska, don haka dole ne a dafa ruwan da aka narkar kafin a sha.
c-346.principle: Lu'ulu'un dusar ƙanƙara suna kama ƙura da ƙananan ƙwayoyi yayin da suke samuwa suna faɗuwa. Tafasa tana kashe ƙwayoyin cuta, amma ba ta kawar da ƙarfe masu nauyi da gurɓatattun sinadarai ba. Ana ƙayyade yawan ruwa da yawan dusar ƙanƙara, kuma $V_{\mathrm{water}} \approx \frac{V_{\mathrm{snow}}}{10}$.
c-346.example: Idan ka narkar da lita 10 na sabuwar dusar ƙanƙara, ruwan yana kusan lita 1, kuma ƙa'idar gama gari ita ce tafasa na minti 1 ko fiye (minti 3 a sama da mita 2,000 sama da matakin teku). Kada ka yi amfani da dusar ƙanƙara kusa da hanya ko wadda launinta ya canza.
c-346.actionItem: A yanayin gaggawa a yau, ka tattara sabuwar dusar ƙanƙara mai tsabta kawai, ka fara zuba ɗan ruwa a tukunya kafin ka narkar, ka dafa ka sha, kuma a kullum ka ɗauki ruwan kwalba.

c-347.title: Madarar lactose-free madara ce da aka rushe lactose ɗinta tun da farko
c-347.summary: Madarar lactose-free madara ce da aka rushe lactose ɗinta tun da farko, don haka ta dace da masu rashin jure lactose, amma sunadaran madara ba su canza ba, don haka bai dace da rashin lafiyar madara ba.
c-347.principle: Enzyme lactase yana yin hydrolysis na lactose ya zama glucose da galactose. $\mathrm{C_{12}H_{22}O_{11} + H_2O \xrightarrow{\text{lactase}} C_6H_{12}O_6 + C_6H_{12}O_6}$
c-347.example: Lactose na madara ta yau da kullun yana kusan gram 4.7 zuwa 5 a kowane mL 100, don haka mL 200 yana kusan gram 9.5. Alamar lactose-free a ma'aunin EU ita ce 0.01 g/100 g ko ƙasa, kuma saboda monosaccharide da aka rushe, tana ɗan fi zaƙi.
c-347.actionItem: Idan cikinka yana damunka saboda rashin jure lactose a yau, ka zaɓi samfurin lactose-free, amma idan kana da rashin lafiyar madara, ka guji duka na yau da kullun da lactose-free.

c-348.title: Murhun gas yana fitar da nitrogen dioxide lokacin girki, don haka ka kunna hood
c-348.summary: Harshen wuta na gas yana samar da nitrogen dioxide wanda zai iya lalata iskar ƙaramin kicin, don haka ya fi kyau ka kunna hood lokacin girki.
c-348.principle: A harshen wuta mai zafi, nitrogen da oxygen na iska suna amsawa ($\mathrm{N_2 + O_2 \to 2NO}$) sannan su yi oxidation. $2\mathrm{NO} + \mathrm{O_2} \to 2\mathrm{NO_2}$
c-348.example: An ba da rahoton wasu lamura a ma'aunin ƙaramin kicin ba tare da iska ba, inda yawan nitrogen dioxide ya wuce shawarar sa'a 1 ta WHO ta $200\ \mu\mathrm{g/m^3}$. Hood da yake fitar da iska waje yana rage wannan yawa sosai.
c-348.actionItem: A yau, ka kunna hood kafin ka fara girki, kuma bayan ka kashe wuta, ka bar shi yana aiki na kimanin mintuna 10 ƙari.

c-349.title: Za ka iya yin sabulun wanki da man girki da ya rage
c-349.summary: Maimakon ka zubar da man girki da ya rage a magudanar ruwa, ka tara shi, kuma za ka iya sa shi ya amsa da caustic soda don yin sabulu.
c-349.principle: Saponification: triglyceride da NaOH suna samar da sabulu da glycerol. $\mathrm{C_3H_5(OOCR)_3 + 3NaOH \to C_3H_5(OH)_3 + 3RCOONa}$
c-349.example: Man waken soya yana buƙatar kusan gram 0.135 na NaOH a kowane gram 1 na mai, don haka gram 500 na mai yana buƙatar kusan gram 68. Caustic soda alkali ne mai ƙarfi, don haka gilashin kariya da safar hannu wajibi ne, kuma sabulu a bar shi ya taurara na kusan makonni 4 kafin a yi amfani da shi.
c-349.actionItem: A yau, ka tace man da ya rage da matatar kofi ka tara shi a kwalba mai rufewa sosai, kuma kada ka zubar da shi a magudanar ruwa har abada.

c-350.title: Cakulan da aka narkar yana tauri idan digon ruwa ɗaya ya shiga
c-350.summary: Idan ɗan ruwa kaɗan ya shiga cakulan da aka narkar, wanda yake santsi, yana zama dunƙule mai tauri farat ɗaya.
c-350.principle: Ƙwayoyin sukari da koko suna shan ruwa su samar da fim mai ɗaure na syrup, ƙwayoyin su manne da juna, dankoncin (viscosity) ya yi tsalle sosai. Ana kiran wannan seizing.
c-350.example: Idan gram kaɗan na ruwa, kusan 1 zuwa 2%, ya shiga gram 200 na cakulan, yana tauri. Idan ka ƙara ruwa har ya kai kusan 20% ko fiye, yana iya sake zama santsi kamar ganache mai ruwa.
c-350.actionItem: A yau, lokacin da za ka narkar da cakulan, ka goge ruwan da ke kwano da cokali, kuma ka tabbata ruwan bain-marie bai taɓa kwanon ba kuma tururi bai shiga ba.

c-351.title: A wanke allon yanka nan da nan bayan amfani, kuma a bushe shi sosai
c-351.summary: Ƙwayoyin cuta suna ƙaruwa ne idan akwai danshi, don haka mabuɗin shi ne a wanke allon yanka nan da nan bayan amfani a bushe shi sosai.
c-351.principle: Water activity, wanda yake nuna yadda ruwa yake samuwa, shi ne $a_w = \frac{p}{p_0}$, kuma yawancin ƙwayoyin cuta masu haddasa cuta suna ƙaruwa da sauri idan $a_w$ ya kai kusan 0.9 ko fiye.
c-351.example: $a_w$ na saman ɗanyen nama kusan 0.99 ne, wanda ƙwayoyin cuta suke girma cikin sauƙi. Idan ba ka tsayar da shi a jike ba, kuma ka busar da shi a wurin da iska ke shiga, danshin sama yana raguwa, ƙaruwar ƙwayoyin cuta tana tsayawa.
c-351.actionItem: A yau, nan da nan bayan ka yi amfani da allon yanka, ka wanke shi da ruwan zafi da sabulu, ka tsaya shi ya bushe sosai. Ka yi amfani da daban don ɗanyen nama da kayan lambu.

c-352.title: Glühwein na kasuwar Kirsimeti yana rasa ƙamshi idan an tafasa shi
c-352.summary: Kada ka tafasa glühwein (vin chaud); ka ɗumama shi kawai har tururi ya fara tashi, don ƙamshi da alcohol su ragu a tashi.
c-352.principle: Ethanol yana da wurin tafasa na kusan 78°C, wanda ya yi ƙasa da na ruwa, don haka idan aka ɗumama shi yana ƙafewa da fari. Ana bayyana matsin tururi na cakuda da $P = x_{\mathrm{EtOH}}\,P^{\circ}_{\mathrm{EtOH}}$ (dokar Raoult).
c-352.example: A cikin mL 750 na ruwan inabi mai 12%, ethanol yana kusan mL 90. Yawanci ana ɗumama shi zuwa 60 zuwa 70°C a ba da shi, kuma idan ka tafasa shi sama da 78°C, alcohol da ƙamshi suna tashi da sauri.
c-352.actionItem: A yau, ka ɗumama ruwan inabi a ƙaramar wuta kada ya wuce 70°C, kuma ka ciro kayan ƙamshi kafin ya tafasa.

c-353.title: Alamar ABC a na'urar kashe wuta tana nuna nau'in wuta
c-353.summary: A, B, da C a na'urar kashe wuta suna nuna wutar da za a iya amfani da ita a kai, kuma na gida yawanci na'urar kashe wuta ta foda ABC ce.
c-353.principle: A alamar Koriya da Amurka, A wutar kayan yau da kullun ce, B wutar mai, C kuma wutar lantarki. Ammonium dihydrogen phosphate yana rushewa idan ya yi zafi ya hana sarkar amsawar ƙonewa. $\mathrm{NH_4H_2PO_4 \to NH_3 + H_3PO_4}$
c-353.example: Na'urar kashe wuta ta foda ta gida mai nauyin kg 3.3 yawanci lokacin fitarwa kusan daƙiƙa 10 zuwa 20 ne, don haka dole ne ka san yadda ake amfani da ita tun da farko. A Turai alamar tana bambanta, misali C yana nufin wutar gas, don haka ka duba ƙa'idar yankinka.
c-353.actionItem: A yau, ka duba ko ma'aunin matsi na na'urar kashe wuta yana cikin kore, kuma ka ajiye ta a wurin da hannu zai kai.

c-354.title: Hot pack da ake sake amfani da shi yana amfani da zafin crystallization na sodium acetate
c-354.summary: Hot pack da ake sake amfani da shi yana amfani da zafin da ke fita lokacin da maganin supersaturated ya yi crystallization gaba ɗaya a lokaci ɗaya, kuma za a iya sake amfani da shi idan aka narkar da shi a ruwan zafi.
c-354.principle: Sodium acetate trihydrate yana narkewa a kusan 58°C, kuma idan ruwan da ya yi sanyi ta supersaturation ya yi crystallization, yana saki zafin narkewa. $Q = m\,\Delta H_{\mathrm{fus}}$, kuma $\Delta H_{\mathrm{fus}}$ kusan 265 J/g ne.
c-354.example: Idan gram 100 na hot pack ya yi crystallization, kusan kJ 26 na zafi yana fitowa, kuma saman yana ɗaga zuwa kusan 50°C. Idan ka bar pack ɗin a ruwan tafasa na kimanin mintuna 10, ya sake zama ruwa mai tsabta.
c-354.actionItem: A yau, ka tsoma hot pack a ruwan tafasa har sai duk lu'ulu'u ya narke, sannan ka bar shi ya huce a hankali, kuma kada ka daɗe kana taɓa shi da fata ba tufa.

c-355.title: Ruwan inabi da aka buɗe yana daɗe kwana huɗu idan ka hana oxygen
c-355.summary: Babban dalilin da ruwan inabi da aka buɗe yake lalacewa shi ne oxygen, don haka idan ka rufe murfi ka saka shi a firiji, yawanci za ka iya sha shi na kwana 3 zuwa 5 ƙari.
c-355.principle: Oxygen da ƙwayoyin acetic acid suna mayar da ethanol zuwa acetic acid ta acetaldehyde. $\mathrm{CH_3CH_2OH + O_2 \to CH_3COOH + H_2O}$ Saurin amsawa $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$ ne, kuma idan zafi ya sauka da kusan 10°C, yana raguwa da kusan rabi.
c-355.example: Idan ka rufe da murfi ka saka a firiji, duka jan ruwan inabi da fari yawanci suna ɗanɗano da kyau na kwana 3 zuwa 5, amma a yanayin ɗaki ba tare da murfi ba, ɗanɗano yana lalacewa cikin kwana 1 zuwa 2. Idan abin da ya rage kaɗan ne, ka zuba shi a ƙaramar kwalba don rage iskar da ke cikin kwalbar.
c-355.actionItem: A yau, ka rufe ruwan inabin da ya rage ka saka shi a firiji nan da nan, kuma ka fitar da jan ruwan inabi mintuna 20 kafin ka sha.

c-356.title: Lu'ulu'u fari a ƙasan kwalbar ruwan inabi tartrate ne da ya zauna
c-356.summary: Ƙwayoyin farare a ƙasan kwalbar ruwan inabi ko a kan abin rufe kwalba ba lalacewa ba ne, lu'ulu'un tartrate ne, kuma ba su da lahani.
c-356.principle: Potassium hydrogen tartrate (KHT) yana raguwa a narkewa a ƙananan zafi ya yi precipitation. $\mathrm{KHC_4H_4O_6(s) \rightleftharpoons K^+ + HC_4H_4O_6^-}$ kuma $K_{sp} = [\mathrm{K^+}][\mathrm{HC_4H_4O_6^-}]$.
c-356.example: Ruwan inabi yawanci yana ɗauke da tartaric acid na 1.5 zuwa 4 g/L, kuma a ƙananan zafi kamar a firiji lu'ulu'u yana samuwa a hankali. Wannan abu ɗaya ne da cream of tartar da ake amfani da shi wajen yin burodi da kek.
c-356.actionItem: A yau, idan ka ga lu'ulu'u, kada ka zubar; ka tsaya kwalbar a tsaye, sannan ka zuba a hankali don ka bar tarkacen da ke ƙasa.

c-357.title: Kada ka saka man ƙamshi ko sabulu a humidifier
c-357.summary: A cikin kwandon ruwa na humidifier ruwa mai tsabta kawai ya kamata a zuba. Idan ka zuba mai ko sabulu, suna zama ƙananan ƙwayoyi a shaƙa kai tsaye.
c-357.principle: Ultrasonic humidifier yana fesa ruwa a matsayin ƙananan digo, kuma abubuwan da suka narke a ciki ma suna fita zuwa iska tare. Yawan abin da ba ya tashi da aka fesa shi ne $m = C \times V_{\mathrm{mist}}$.
c-357.example: Idan yawan feshi kusan mL 300 a sa'a, kuma ka zuba da ƙarfin 1%, kusan mL 3 na mai ko sabulu yana fesuwa a sa'a. Ma'adinai na ruwan famfo (a ɗauka 150 mg/L) ma kusan mg 45 a sa'a yana zama farin foda.
c-357.actionItem: A yau, ka canza ruwan humidifier kowace rana, ka yi amfani da diffuser na musamman don ƙamshi, kuma ka wanke kwandon ruwa kowane mako.

c-358.title: E10 a gidan mai na motar haya ta ƙasashen waje fetur ne da aka gauraya da ethanol
c-358.summary: E10 fetur ne da aka gauraya da kusan 10% ethanol, wanda yawancin motocin fetur za su iya amfani da shi, amma ƙarfin zafinsa ya ɗan yi ƙasa.
c-358.principle: Ethanol yana da ƙarfin zafi na kusan 21 MJ/L, ƙasa da fetur (kusan 32 MJ/L). $E_{\mathrm{E10}} = 0.9E_{\mathrm{gas}} + 0.1E_{\mathrm{EtOH}}$, kuma octane number yana ɗan ƙaruwa kaɗan.
c-358.example: Ƙarfin zafin E10 kusan 30.9 MJ/L ne, kusan 3% ƙasa da fetur, don haka mota mai 14 km/L tana zama kusan 13.6 km/L. Ana tabbatar da ko motar ta dace da E10 ta alamar da ke murfin bakin mai.
c-358.actionItem: A yau, idan ka karɓi motar haya, ka duba alamar mai a murfin bakin mai (fetur, dizal, ko ya dace da E10), kuma kada ka rikita dizal da fetur.

c-359.title: Na'urorin gano hayaƙi na photoelectric da ionization suna da bambanci
c-359.summary: Na'urorin gano hayaƙi suna gano wuta daban-daban bisa tsarin su, kuma photoelectric ya fi ƙarfi a wutar da hayaƙi ke fitowa a hankali.
c-359.principle: Ionization: americium-241 yana ionize iska, kuma idan wutar da ke gudana ta ragu saboda ƙwayoyin hayaƙi, yana yin ƙararrawa; photoelectric kuma yana gano haske da ƙwayoyin hayaƙi suka watsa ta hanyar sensor.
c-359.example: Ionization yana da sauri a ƙananan ƙwayoyi (kusan 0.01 zuwa 0.3 μm) na gobara mai manyan harshen wuta, kuma photoelectric a manyan ƙwayoyi (kusan 0.3 zuwa 10 μm) na gobara mai ƙonewa tare da hayaƙi. Ionization yana ɗauke da americium na kusan 30 zuwa 40 kBq.
c-359.actionItem: A yau, ka danna maɓallin gwaji na na'urar gano hayaƙi don tabbatar da tana aiki, kuma idan ranar ƙera da ke bayanta ta wuce shekaru 10, ka canza ta.

c-360.title: Idan motar dizal tana yin gajerun tafiye-tafiye kawai, matatar hayaƙi tana toshewa
c-360.summary: Idan ka hau motar dizal gajerun tafiye-tafiye kawai, hayakin da yake fita ba ya yin zafi sosai, kuma ƙurar hayaƙi tana taruwa a matatar hayaƙi (DPF).
c-360.principle: Ƙurar da ta taru a DPF tana buƙatar regeneration, wato a ƙone ta a zafi mai yawa. Amsawar $\mathrm{C + O_2 \to CO_2}$ tana faruwa a kusan 350 zuwa 450°C idan akwai catalyst, kuma active regeneration a kusan 600°C.
c-360.example: A gajerun tafiye-tafiye, zafin hayaƙin da ke fita ba ya kai ko 200°C, don haka regeneration ba ya faruwa. Saboda haka wani lokaci ya kamata ka yi tuƙi cikin sauri na fiye da mintuna 20 zuwa 30 don ƙone matatar.
c-360.actionItem: A wannan makon, ka yi tuƙi a babbar hanya cikin sauri iri ɗaya na fiye da mintuna 20 zuwa 30, kuma idan fitilar gargaɗi tana kunne, ka je wurin gyara don a duba.

c-361.title: Nama mai tauri yana yin laushi da ɗan baking soda
c-361.summary: Idan ka yi amfani da ɗan baking soda kaɗan sosai a nama mai tauri, pH yana ƙaruwa, naman yana riƙe ruwa fiye, kuma ya yi laushi.
c-361.principle: Sunadaran zaren tsoka suna riƙe ruwa mafi ƙaranci kusa da isoelectric point (pH kusan 5 zuwa 5.5). Idan ka ɗaga pH na nama (kusan 5.5 zuwa 5.7) da baking soda, cajin mara kyau na sunadaran yana ƙaruwa, suna ture juna, suna riƙe ruwa fiye. $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 \rightleftharpoons Na^+ + HCO_3^-}$
c-361.example: Ka shafa kusan gram 2.5 (0.5%) na baking soda a gram 450 na yankakken nama na mintuna 15, sannan ka kurkure. Idan ka yi amfani da yawa, yana da ɗanɗanon sabulu kuma nama yana zama mai laushi sosai.
c-361.actionItem: A yau, idan naman soyawa yana tauri, ka shafa masa baking soda 0.5% ko ƙasa na mintuna 15 kawai, ka kurkure sosai, sannan ka dafa.

c-362.title: Wani lokaci madara tana yin dunƙulewa idan ka zuba ta a kofi mai zafi
c-362.summary: Dunƙulewar madara a kofi abu ne da sunadarai ke haɗuwa saboda acid da zafi, kuma idan madarar sabuwa ce, yawanci ba ta da lahani.
c-362.principle: Isoelectric point na casein na madara kusan pH 4.6 ne, don haka idan pH ya kusanto shi, caji yana raguwa, suna dunƙulewa. Zafi yana sa wannan dunƙulewa ta yi sauri.
c-362.example: pH na madara kusan 6.7 ne, na kofi kuma kusan 4.8 zuwa 5.1. Tsohuwar madara tana da pH da ya riga ya yi ƙasa, don haka tana dunƙulewa cikin sauƙi, kuma idan tana da wari mai tsami, kada ka sha, ka zubar.
c-362.actionItem: A yau, ka zuba madara a kofin da farko kafin kofi, ko ka yi amfani da madara mai ɗumi, kuma idan tana da wari mai tsami, ka zubar.

c-363.title: Shaƙar gas na balan-balan na helium yana da haɗari
c-363.summary: Shaƙar helium yana canza muryarka, amma yana korar oxygen kuma yana iya shaƙe ka, don haka yana da haɗari.
c-363.principle: Matsin ɓangare na oxygen a iskar da ake shaƙa shi ne $P_{\mathrm{O_2}} = F_{\mathrm{O_2}} \times P$. Helium tsantsa yana da $F_{\mathrm{O_2}} = 0$, don haka yana korar oxygen na huhu. Saurin sauti shi ne $v = \sqrt{\frac{\gamma RT}{M}}$, kuma a helium yana da sauri sosai, don haka murya tana tashi sama.
c-363.example: Oxygen a iska yana 20.9%, amma a helium 100% yana 0%. Saurin sauti a helium kusan 1,007 m/s ne, kusan ninki 3 na iska (kusan 343 m/s), kuma idan ka shaƙa kai tsaye daga tankin da aka matsa, huhu na iya lalacewa.
c-363.actionItem: A yau, lokacin da kake hura balan-balan, kada ka shaƙi helium, kuma a ɗaki da aka rufe, ka bar iska ta shiga.

c-364.title: Kada ka ba da fim mai ƙarfin ji (high sensitivity) ga X-ray na filin jirgi a kyamarar fim
c-364.summary: X-ray na filin jirgi na iya sa fim ya yi hazo, don haka ga fim mai ƙarfin ji, ya fi aminci ka nemi a duba da hannu kai tsaye.
c-364.principle: Idan ƙwayoyin silver halide suka karɓi haske ko photon na X-ray, latent image yana samuwa inda atom na azurfa ke fitowa. $\mathrm{AgBr + h\nu \to Ag + Br}$ Bayyanar tana taruwa.
c-364.example: Fim mai ISO 800 ko fiye na iya yin hazo idan an wuce bincike sau da yawa, kuma X-ray na kayan da ake ba da su (checked baggage) ya fi ƙarfi. Saboda bayyanar tana taruwa, ya fi kyau ka rage yawan binciken yayin tafiya.
c-364.actionItem: A yau, ka saka fim a jaka mai bayyana daban, ka nemi a duba da hannu a wurin binciken tsaro, kuma kada ka saka shi a kayan da ake ba da su.

c-365.title: Ka ƙiyasta tsawon lokacin ƙamshi da farashin turare ta yawan EDP da EDT
c-365.summary: A turare, za ka iya ƙiyasta tsawon lokacinsa da farashinsa ta yawan sinadarin ƙamshi (%) fiye da sunansa.
c-365.principle: Idan yawan sinadarin ƙamshi ya yi yawa, tashi yana raguwa kuma ƙamshi yana daɗewa. Eau de Parfum (EDP) kusan 15 zuwa 20% ne, Eau de Toilette (EDT) kusan 5 zuwa 15%, Eau de Cologne (EDC) kuma kusan 2 zuwa 4%.
c-365.example: A kwalba ta mL 50, EDP 15% yana ɗauke da kusan mL 7.5 na sinadarin ƙamshi, EDT 8% kuma kusan mL 4, don haka EDP yawanci ya fi tsada. Tsawon lokaci a gama gari kusan awa 3 zuwa 4 ne ga EDT, kuma kusan awa 5 zuwa 8 ga EDP.
c-365.actionItem: Kafin ka sayi turare, ka fesa shi a cikin hannunka, ba a wuyan hannu ba, ka tabbatar da ƙamshin har bayan awa 4.

c-366.title: Aerogel a insoles da safar hannu na sanyi silica ne kusan iska ne
c-366.summary: Aerogel a kayan hana sanyi tsarin silica ne wanda kusan iska ne, don haka ko da siriri ne yana toshe zafi sosai.
c-366.principle: Ramuka masu girman nano sun fi ƙanƙanta da mean free path na ƙwayoyin iska (kusan 68 nm), don haka canja zafi yana toshewa. $\lambda = \frac{k_B T}{\sqrt{2}\,\pi d^2 P}$ Gudun zafi shi ne $Q = \frac{kA\,\Delta T}{L}$.
c-366.example: Thermal conductivity na silica aerogel kusan 0.015 zuwa 0.02 W/m·K ne, ƙasa da na iska mara motsi (kusan 0.026). A fili na 0.02 m², kauri mm 3, da bambancin zafi 20 K, idan $k = 0.02$, asarar zafi kusan 2.7 W ne.
c-366.actionItem: A yau, ka duba ainihin yawan aerogel da kauri a insole da safar hannunka na sanyi, kuma idan sun jiƙe, rufin zafi yana raguwa, don haka ka yi amfani da su a bushe.
